Denne udmelding blev fremsat af Jutta Urpilainen, EU’s chef for internationale partnerskaber, ved den officielle lancering af EU’s Global Gateway-initiativ (GGI) i Abuja. GGI er skabt for at styrke forbindelser, fremme bæredygtig udvikling og styrke de økonomiske relationer mellem EU og partnerlande som Nigeria. Urpilainen forklarede, at EU gennem Global Gateway vil støtte Nigeria i udbygning af infrastruktur som transport, energi og digitale netværk. Initiativet fokuserer desuden på landbrug, økonomisk vækst, sundhed, uddannelse, miljøbeskyttelse og omfattende samarbejde med andre partnerlande. Krigen, som Rusland startede mod Ukraine sidste år, militærkuppet i Niger i juli og optrapningen af Israel-Palæstina-konflikten er tydelige påmindelser om dette.' Nigeria er en væsentlig deltager i denne Global Gateway-investeringspakke.' Desuden bekræftede Urpilainen, at EU vil støtte udrulningen af 5G i Nigeria og arbejder på potentielle lån til små og mellemstore virksomheder (SMV’er) inden for digitale og trykte medier. EU har også afsat midler til Nigerias energisektor, herunder mini-grids og små vandkraftværker. Med støtte fra EU og Den Europæiske Investeringsbank får Nigeria nu gavn af en digital økonomisk pakke på 820 millioner euro. Denne støtter udrulningen af digitale ID’er, udvidelse af mobilnetværk i samarbejde med MTN i Lagos og andre stater, samt infrastruktur mellem Katsina og Daura og styrkelse af Nigeria-Benin-forbindelsen i det vestafrikanske elnet. EU har for nylig lanceret Empowerment-projektet i det nordvestlige Nigeria, som skal forbedre adgangen til kvalitetsundervisning i regionen—et tydeligt tegn på det fortsatte EU-Nigeria-samarbejde. Urpilainen påpegede, at Nigeria stadig er en førende modtager af Erasmus+-programmet for studenterudveksling og videregående uddannelse, hvor over 2.020 nigerianske studerende sidste år fik stipendier til EU. Hun afsluttede: 'Global Gateway styrker partnerskabet mellem EU og Nigeria og åbner nye muligheder for alle. Vi er dedikerede til at udvikle dette samarbejde med Nigerias regering, EU-medlemslande, civilsamfund og erhvervslivet.' Bosun Tijani, Nigerias minister for kommunikation, innovation og digital økonomi, fremhævede, at Global Gateway stemmer fuldt overens med præsident Bola Ahmed Tinubus “Renewed Hope”-dagsorden. Han understregede, at regeringens vision er et inkluderende Nigeria, som gavner alle borgere. Tijani understregede de dybe historiske bånd og gensidig respekt mellem Afrika og Europa og pointerede, at samarbejdet er nøglen til en fælles fremtid. Han fremhævede, at Afrikas unge befolkning—cirka 60 % af nigerianerne er under 25 år—repræsenterer et stort udviklingspotentiale. Han sluttede med at fastslå, at investeringerne og partnerskaberne gennem Global Gateway giver muligheder for Nigerias unge, digitale befolkning for at deltage i den globale økonomi og fremme udviklingen både i Nigeria og internationalt.

Kristyn Caddell, a 32-year-old reporter, has spoken publicly about her affair with Dateline NBC host Chris Hansen, highlighting what she describes as a double standard against women in broadcast media. Caddell has released photographs that allegedly show her kissing Hansen, contradicting his previous claims that reports of the affair were ‘full of hurtful lies’ and that they were only friends.

Caddell says she has struggled to find work since news of their four-month affair became public in 2011, while Hansen’s career has continued unaffected. According to Caddell, stigmatization from the scandal has made it difficult for her to keep jobs at three different stations. ‘No matter your opinion about affairs, there are always two people involved. If I can’t work, he shouldn’t be able to work,’ Caddell told RadarOnline. She further commented, ‘I have lived the double standard. The women get fired and the men keep going.’

Caddell met then-54-year-old Hansen in Palm Beach, Florida, while working for NBC affiliate WPTV. She claims Hansen led her to believe his 20-year marriage was ending and that he was available to date. ‘I believed him with my heart. Maybe I was naive, but that was my biggest mistake.’

When the National Enquirer first reported the affair, Hansen denied it, saying the two were simply friends and that the photos were of them having dinner. However, Caddell recently released images of the two kissing. She asserts Hansen did not hide their relationship and she believed it was not a secret before news of it broke. ‘Chris flew me around the country, stayed with me at the best hotels, and took photos with me in public. I had no reason to think our relationship was a secret,’ she wrote in an open letter to the Enquirer.

Caddell maintains that the situation has damaged her career. Potential employers have told her that the publicity makes her a less attractive hire. She told the Enquirer, ‘For two years, everyone told me to stay silent and let it blow over, but I still can’t escape the impact on my career.’

She said she thought not speaking publicly, as she was advised, would help her move on, but that hasn’t happened. ‘Right before the affair, I finally thought my career was taking off. Then, to have it all taken away because of a man with money and fame, it’s not a good feeling.’ Hansen has maintained the two were only friends, according to Fox News.

article_content: The parents of a newborn baby found dead inside a carrier bag left on a country lane requested an Islamic funeral for their child, an inquest heard. There were fears the baby — called Alia by detectives — may have lain by the roadside for up to 11 days after several people mistook the bag containing her for rubbish. A coroner issued a final plea for the baby's parents to come forward, stating 'it is never too late.' A message written on the carrier bag read 'please please bury him Islamic way please please.' The discovery was made when a couple walking their dog picked up the bundle to dispose of it properly and found the infant, wrapped in a white t-shirt along with a pair of jogging bottoms. Despite witness reports of seeing a distressed woman in the area, believed to be Asian, the child's parents have never been found. DNA samples taken from the newborn did not lead to identification, and the police named her Alia, meaning 'beautiful.' Greater Manchester Police extensively investigated the case, reviewing 3,000 hours of CCTV footage, analyzing receipts, and visiting 53 individuals who had purchased similar white shirts locally. Public health facilities, schools, and retailers also assisted in the search for clues. The inquest took place 20 months after baby Alia was discovered in Ox Hey Lane, Lostock, Bolton, on 14th March 2013. She was found to be a full-term infant, approximately 36 weeks old, who had likely lived just a few hours. The placenta and umbilical cord were still attached. Pathologist Dr. Philip Lumb found no major injuries and could not establish a medical cause of death. Witnesses described seeing carrier bags in the area in the days before the discovery, but most believed them to be rubbish. Dog walker Colin Eccles described how he and his wife found the infant. Another witness, Dean Crombie, remembered seeing a black Sports Direct carrier bag under a hedgerow, which later disappeared. Arron Goodison, a student at the nearby Bolton Wanderers Academy, at first mistook the bag for containing a doll. He and others noted a strange smell coming from the area and recalled seeing a woman appearing upset nearby. As part of the investigation, all local purchasers of a particular white Florence and Fred shirt were contacted. Detective Inspector Aaron Duggan stated that 'best chance' inquiries had been completed. Coroner Alan Walsh returned an open verdict at the inquest. Hundreds of mourners attended baby Alia's funeral at a mosque in Bolton. The coroner expressed sorrow at the short life Alia experienced and disappointment that her parents had not come forward, but emphasized the possibility remains open for information to emerge that could reveal what happened.
translated_content: Forældrene til en nyfødt baby, der blev fundet død i en bærepose efterladt på en landevej, bad om en islamisk begravelse for deres barn, oplyste en retsmedicinsk undersøgelse. Der var frygt for, at babyen – som detektiver kaldte Alia – kunne have ligget ved vejkanten i op til 11 dage, fordi flere troede, at posen med hende var affald. En retsmediciner bad til sidst barnets forældre om at komme frem og sagde, at 'det aldrig er for sent.' En besked skrevet på bæreposen lød 'please please bury him Islamic way please please.' Fundet blev gjort, da et par, der gik tur med deres hund, tog posen for at bortskaffe den og fandt spædbarnet, indpakket i en hvid t-shirt sammen med et par joggingbukser. På trods af vidneudsagn om at have set en fortvivlet kvinde i området, formodet at være asiatisk, er barnets forældre aldrig blevet fundet. DNA-prøver fra spædbarnet gav ikke identificering, og politiet navngav hende Alia, hvilket betyder 'smuk.' Greater Manchester Police gennemførte en omfattende efterforskning, herunder gennemsyn af 3.000 timers overvågningsvideo, analyse af kvitteringer og besøg hos 53 personer, der havde købt tilsvarende hvide skjorter i området. Sundhedsmyndigheder, skoler og butikker hjalp også med eftersøgningen. Retsmødet foregik 20 måneder efter, at Alia blev fundet på Ox Hey Lane, Lostock, Bolton, den 14. marts 2013. Hun var en fuldbåren baby, cirka 36 uger gammel, som sandsynligvis kun levede få timer. Moderkagen og navlestrengen var stadig fastgjort. Retsmediciner Dr. Philip Lumb fandt ingen større skader og kunne ikke fastslå dødsårsagen. Vidner fortalte, at de havde set bæreposer i området i dagene før fundet, men de fleste troede, det bare var affald. Hundelufteren Colin Eccles forklarede, hvordan han og hans kone fandt spædbarnet. Et andet vidne, Dean Crombie, huskede at have set en sort Sports Direct-bærepose under en hæk, som siden forsvandt. Arron Goodison, en elev fra den nærliggende Bolton Wanderers Academy, troede først, at posen indeholdt en dukke. Han og andre bemærkede en mærkelig lugt fra området og huskede en kvinde, der virkede meget ked af det. Som led i efterforskningen kontaktede politiet alle lokale, der havde købt en bestemt hvid Florence and Fred-skjorte. Efterforskningsleder Aaron Duggan oplyste, at alle mulige spor var undersøgt. Retsmediciner Alan Walsh afsagde en åben dom ved retsmødet. Hundredvis deltog i Alias begravelse i en moské i Bolton. Retsmedicineren udtrykte sorg over Alias korte liv og skuffelse over, at hendes forældre aldrig kom frem, men understregede, at der stadig er mulighed for at finde ud af, hvad der skete.

article_content: MSCI has released its latest quarterly updates to global stock indexes, announcing a range of additions and deletions. The MSCI ACWI index will gain 46 new securities and remove 69. In the MSCI Frontier Markets Index, there will be 14 additions and two deletions. These changes will be implemented after market close on November 30. Key developed market additions to the MSCI ACWI include Vertiv Holdings and Celsius Holdings from the United States, alongside Leonardo from Italy. For emerging markets, the most prominent new entries are Tata Motors from India, Amman Mineral International from Indonesia, and CGN Power Co from China. The Frontier Markets Index will welcome Vietnam Prosperity Joint Stock Commercial Bank, Oman International Development & Investment Company, and Banque Marocaine pour le Commerce et l'Industrie among its largest additions. MSCI is making notable adjustments to its China-focused indexes. Ten securities will be included and 45 removed from the China A Onshore Indexes. The primary new inclusions here are CGN Power Co, Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare, and Empyrean Technology Co. Additionally, the MSCI China All Shares Index will add 16 securities and eliminate 25, with the same three companies among the top additions.

article_content: Tokyo—The operator of Japan’s damaged Fukushima nuclear plant announced on Monday that the facility completed its third release of treated radioactive wastewater into the Pacific Ocean as scheduled, amid economic strain on the country’s seafood sector due to a Chinese ban on imports. The Fukushima plant has accumulated large volumes of contaminated water since being battered by a massive earthquake and tsunami in 2011. On August 24, the plant began gradually discharging treated and diluted wastewater into the ocean; the third batch, containing 7,800 tons, was completed on Monday. The project, expected to continue for decades, has drawn strong opposition from fishing groups and neighboring countries, especially China, which has imposed a total ban on Japanese seafood imports—damaging Japanese exporters, particularly those dealing in scallops and other seafood. Tokyo Electric Power Company Holdings (TEPCO), which operates the plant, stated the third release was carried out smoothly and, like the previous batches, met all safety requirements. Government and TEPCO tests confirmed that radionuclide levels were far below international safety limits. In a meeting last Friday at the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in San Francisco, Prime Minister Fumio Kishida pressed Chinese President Xi Jinping to lift the seafood ban, but the outcome was only a vague commitment to pursue dialogue. Technical experts from both nations will meet to discuss the issue, though no timeline has been set for lifting the ban. The Japanese government has created a relief fund to help seafood producers find alternative markets, accompanied by campaigns to encourage domestic fish consumption and support for Fukushima’s fishing industry. TEPCO is compensating fisheries for reputational damage; 580 compensation applications have been distributed so far. The discharged wastewater is treated to remove radioactivity to legally permissible levels and then diluted with seawater. TEPCO and Japanese officials affirm the process is safe, though some scientists caution that continued discharges from damaged reactors are unprecedented and require close monitoring. As of the third completed release, a total of 23,400 tons of wastewater has been discharged. A fourth release is planned by March 2024. Despite these efforts, only about 10 of the roughly 1,000 onsite storage tanks will be emptied, as wastewater production continues. The tanks currently hold more than 1.3 million tons of water, most of which requires further treatment before discharge. Government and plant officials argue that ocean release is necessary to free up space and enable decommissioning of the plant.
translated_content: Tokyo—Operatøren af Japans beskadigede Fukushima-atomkraftværk meddelte mandag, at anlægget har afsluttet sin tredje udledning af behandlet radioaktivt spildevand i Stillehavet som planlagt. Dette sker samtidig med, at landets fiskeindustri lider økonomisk efter et kinesisk forbud mod import. Fukushima-værket har opsamlet store mængder forurenet vand, siden det blev ramt af et voldsomt jordskælv og en tsunami i 2011. Siden 24. august begyndte værket gradvist at udlede behandlet og fortyndet spildevand i havet; den tredje runde på 7.800 tons blev afsluttet mandag. Projektet forventes at fortsætte i årtier og møder kraftig modstand fra både fiskerigrupper og nabolande, især Kina, der har indført et totalt forbud mod japanske fiskeeksporter—hvilket skader især eksportører af kammuslinger og andet fisk. Tokyo Electric Power Company Holdings (TEPCO), der driver værket, oplyser, at den tredje udledning forløb uden problemer og ligesom de tidligere levede op til alle sikkerhedskrav. Prøver foretaget af regering og TEPCO viser, at niveauerne af radionuklider ligger langt under internationale sikkerhedsgrænser. På et møde i sidste uge under Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation-topmødet i San Francisco præsenterede premierminister Fumio Kishida et ønske om ophævelse af importforbuddet over for Kinas præsident Xi Jinping, men resultatet blev blot en vag aftale om videre dialog. Tekniske eksperter fra begge lande skal nu mødes og drøfte spørgsmålet, men der er ikke sat tid på et eventuelt ophævelse. Den japanske regering har oprettet en hjælpefond for at hjælpe fiskeeksportører til at finde nye markeder, samt iværksat kampagner der skal fremme fiskeforbrug og støtte Fukushimas fiskeri. TEPCO yder erstatning for det rygtab, der har ramt fiskerisektoren, og 580 erstatningsansøgninger er blevet sendt ud. Det udledte spildevand behandles for at fjerne radioaktivitet, så det lever op til lovens krav, og fortyndes derefter med havvand. TEPCO og japanske embedsmænd forsikrer, at processen er sikker, men nogle forskere advarer om, at kontinuerlige udledninger fra beskadigede reaktorer er uden fortilfælde og kræver nøje overvågning. Med den netop afsluttede tredje udledning er 23.400 tons spildevand nu sluppet ud. Den fjerde udledning er planlagt inden marts 2024. Trods anstrengelserne tømmes kun ca. 10 ud af de ca. 1.000 tanke på anlægget, eftersom produktionen af spildevand fortsætter. Tankene rummer nu mere end 1,3 millioner tons vand, hvoraf det meste stadig skal behandles, før det kan udledes. Myndigheder og ledelsen på værket mener, at havudledning er nødvendig for at frigøre plads og muliggøre afviklingen af kraftværket.

article_content: HARARE, Zimbabwe – Zimbabwe’s main opposition party, the Citizens Coalition for Change (CCC), boycotted President Emmerson Mnangagwa's State of the Nation address on Tuesday in protest of his disputed reelection in August, highlighting political tensions in the country amid allegations of a post-election crackdown on critics. CCC spokesperson Promise Mkwananzi said the party’s lawmakers skipped the address because they view Mnangagwa as 'illegitimate.' The CCC accuses the president, 81, of fraudulently winning a second term and using violence and intimidation, including by arresting some opposition officials. ZANU-PF, which has been in power since Zimbabwe's independence from white minority rule in 1980, retained its parliamentary majority after the late August elections. Observers from Western and African organizations questioned the polls’ credibility, mentioning a climate of intimidation. Mnangagwa delivered his speech at the $200 million Chinese-built Parliament building in Mt. Hampden, about 18 kilometers (11 miles) from Harare, launching the new legislative term. He called the elections 'credible, free, fair and peaceful,' but did not reference the boycott. His legislative agenda includes finalizing a bill viewed by critics as restricting the work of critical non-governmental organizations. Mnangagwa said the economy is 'on an upward trajectory' despite 'illegal sanctions imposed by our detractors,' referring to penalties from the United States over alleged human rights abuses during the rule of late former President Robert Mugabe. Mugabe was removed in a 2017 coup and replaced by Mnangagwa, his one-time ally. Mugabe died in 2019. Citing agricultural recovery, better power supply, mining sector growth, increased tourist arrivals, and improved infrastructure, Mnangagwa pointed to signs of economic progress. Zimbabwe previously suffered one of the world’s worst economic crises and hyperinflation 15 years ago. Many remaining formal businesses in the country of 15 million struggle with an ongoing currency crisis. The International Monetary Fund reports that more than two-thirds of working-age Zimbabweans rely on informal jobs like street vending to get by. Persistent problems with sanitation and access to clean water contribute to repeated cholera outbreaks. The Ministry of Health and Child Care recorded 12 cholera deaths in southeastern Zimbabwe since a late August outbreak. On Tuesday, Harare authorities confirmed five cases in some of the capital’s poorest neighborhoods, with no associated deaths.

CCC’s talsmand, Promise Mkwananzi, sagde, at partiets parlamentsmedlemmer ikke deltog i talen, fordi de anser Mnangagwa for 'illegitim'. CCC anklager præsidenten, 81 år, for at have opnået sin anden valgsejr gennem svindel, vold og intimidering, herunder anholdelser af oppositionsmedlemmer. ZANU-PF, der har haft magten siden Zimbabwes uafhængighed fra hvidt mindretalsstyre i 1980, beholdt sit parlamentariske flertal efter valget i slutningen af august. Observatører fra vestlige og afrikanske organisationer har sået tvivl om valgets troværdighed og nævnt et klima af frygt og intimidering. Mnangagwa holdt sin tale i den kinesiskbyggede parlamentsbygning til 200 millioner dollars i Mt. Hampden, cirka 18 kilometer vest for Harare, hvilket markerede begyndelsen på den nye lovgivningsperiode. Han kaldte valget 'troværdigt, frit, fair og fredeligt', men nævnte ikke, at oppositionen boykottede. Han fremlagde blandt andet planer om at færdiggøre et lovforslag, som kritikere ser som et forsøg på at begrænse kritiske ikke-statslige organisationers arbejde. Mnangagwa sagde, at økonomien er 'på vej op ad bakke', trods 'ulovlige sanktioner pålagt af vores modstandere', og henviste til amerikanske sanktioner grundet formodede menneskerettighedskrænkelser under den tidligere præsident Robert Mugabe, der blev afsat i et kup i 2017 og var Mnangagwas tidligere allierede. Mugabe døde i 2019. Præsidenten pegede på forbedringer inden for landbrug, el-forsyning, minesektor, turisme og infrastruktur som tegn på vækst. Zimbabwe var for 15 år siden ramt af en af verdens værste økonomiske kriser og hyperinflation. Mange formelle virksomheder i landet med 15 millioner indbyggere kæmper stadig med valutakrise. Ifølge Den Internationale Valutafond er over to tredjedele af arbejdsdygtige zimbabwere afhængige af uformelle jobs som gadesælger for at klare sig. Dårlig sanitet og mangel på rent vand fører til gentagne koleraudbrud. Ifølge Sundhedsministeriet har et koleraudbrud, der begyndte i slutningen af august, kostet 12 livet i det sydøstlige Zimbabwe. Myndigheder i Harare bekræftede tirsdag fem tilfælde af kolera i nogle af byens fattigste kvarterer, men ingen dødsfald.

article_content: At the Cricket World Cup, Glenn Maxwell steered Australia into the semi-finals with an astonishing double century against Afghanistan. Chasing a hefty 292-run target in Mumbai, Australia was in deep trouble at 91 for 7. Maxwell emerged as the hero, staying unbeaten on 201 runs from 128 balls. Despite suffering from intense cramps, Maxwell teamed up with skipper Pat Cummins for an unbroken 202-run stand. Their partnership clinched a dramatic three-wicket victory for Australia, with 19 balls remaining. The performance drew widespread praise from the cricket world, including a shout-out from Virat Kohli on social media calling Maxwell a ‘freak’ for his one-of-a-kind innings. Maxwell acknowledged he had a bit of luck with some missed catches but felt proud to make the most of his opportunities. He underscored Australia’s never-say-die attitude, stating that even earlier setbacks couldn’t shake their belief, which is now stronger than ever.

På trods af voldsomme kramper kæmpede Maxwell sammen med kaptajn Pat Cummins i et ubrudt partnerskab på 202 point. Deres samarbejde sikrede Australien en dramatisk sejr på tre wickets med 19 bolde i overskud. Præstationen høstede lovord fra hele cricketverdenen, blandt andet et shoutout fra Virat Kohli på sociale medier, hvor han kaldte Maxwell en 'freak' for denne helt usædvanlige indsats. Maxwell indrømmede, at han havde held med et par fejlede greb, men var stolt over at udnytte sine chancer. Han understregede Australiens stærke vilje og sagde, at holdet aldrig mistede troen – og at denne sejr nu kun gør dem stærkere.

article_content: Sterecycle (Rotherham) Limited, a recycling company in South Yorkshire, has been fined £500,000 after being found guilty of corporate manslaughter in connection with the death of an employee. Michael Whinfrey, a 42-year-old father of three, died in January 2011 when an autoclave door—part of the company’s high-pressure waste processing equipment—exploded at the Rotherham plant. The explosion caused fatal head injuries and blew a hole in a factory wall. Another colleague sustained serious, life-changing injuries. An investigation by the Health and Safety Executive (HSE) and South Yorkshire Police determined that the incident was entirely preventable. The inquiry found the company had ignored ongoing problems with autoclave doors, failed to perform necessary repairs, and neglected staff training. Safety features were reportedly bypassed to maintain production, addressing only surface issues instead of fixing root causes. At Sheffield Crown Court, the company was convicted and fined. Sterecycle’s former maintenance manager, Kevin Goss, was found not guilty of perverting the course of justice. Michael Whinfrey’s partner, Margaret Crofts, described the profound loss the family experienced. HSE Inspector Carol Downes condemned the company’s disregard for safety rules, and Detective Sergeant Rob Platts expressed hope that the verdict offers some closure to Whinfrey’s family.

Michael Whinfrey, en 42-årig far til tre, døde i januar 2011, da en autoklavedør – en del af virksomhedens højttryksudstyr til affaldsbehandling – eksploderede på fabrikken i Rotherham. Eksplosionen medførte dødelige hovedskader og sprængte et hul i fabrikkens væg. En anden kollega pådrog sig alvorlige, livsændrende skader. En undersøgelse fra Health and Safety Executive (HSE) og South Yorkshire Police slog fast, at hændelsen var helt og holdent undgåelig. Undersøgelsen viste, at virksomheden havde ignoreret tilbagevendende problemer med autoklavedøre, undladt at udbedre nødvendige reparationer og forsømt træningen af de ansatte. Sikkerhedsfunktioner blev angiveligt koblet fra for at holde produktionen kørende, mens man kun forsøgte at afhjælpe overfladiske problemer uden at løse de egentlige årsager. Ved Sheffield Crown Court blev virksomheden kendt skyldig og idømt bøden. Sterecycles tidligere vedligeholdelseschef, Kevin Goss, blev frifundet for at have forsøgt at fordreje retfærdigheden. Michael Whinfreys partner, Margaret Crofts, beskrev den dybe sorg familien har følt. HSE-inspektør Carol Downes fordømte virksomhedens tilsidesættelse af sikkerheden, og kriminalassistent Rob Platts udtrykte håb om, at dommen giver familien en vis afklaring.

article_content: SAO PAULO: Brazil's Formula One Grand Prix at Sao Paulo's Interlagos circuit will remain on the calendar until at least 2030, following a five-year contract extension announced by the sport on Friday. The previous contract for what is now called the Sao Paulo Grand Prix was set to expire in 2025. Interlagos nearly lost the Grand Prix in 2019 when former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro proposed building a new circuit in Rio de Janeiro. However, that plan failed, and the new circuit was never constructed. Alan Adler, chief executive of the Sao Paulo Grand Prix, credited F1 CEO Stefano Domenicali with securing the event's future at Interlagos. 'In 2019, Sao Paulo was far from signing a new contract with Formula One, but in 2020, Stefano arrived and his first decision was to reconnect with Sao Paulo,' Adler said at a press conference. Interlagos, officially named the Autodromo Jose Carlos Pace after the 1975 Brazilian race winner, hosted its first world championship Grand Prix in 1973. The iconic circuit has witnessed major moments in Formula One history, including Ayrton Senna’s emotional home win in 1991, Kimi Raikkonen’s 2007 championship victory for Ferrari, and Lewis Hamilton winning his first title there in 2008 with McLaren after a dramatic last-lap overtake. Jenson Button also secured the 2009 championship at Interlagos with Brawn GP, while Fernando Alonso clinched his 2005 and 2006 titles at the venue. The venue has seen recent renovations, including a new paddock, and has hosted music festivals. Sao Paulo Mayor Ricardo Nunes reported that 160 million reais ($32.7 million) have been invested so far, with an estimated 210 million reais needed for the next phase of upgrades. He noted the Grand Prix generates 1.5 billion reais in annual revenue for the city, and the contract terms with Formula One remain unchanged. F1 CEO Domenicali praised the 'wonderful atmosphere' created by Brazilian fans. 'Brazil has a rich racing heritage, and this iconic circuit is a favorite among drivers and fans worldwide,' he said. 'It embodies everything great about racing, and we look forward to its development in the coming years to enhance the experience for everyone.' ($1 = 4.8959 reais) (Writing by Alan Baldwin in London, editing by Christian Radnedge)

Interlagos var tæt på at miste Grand Prix’et i 2019, da den daværende brasilianske præsident Jair Bolsonaro foreslog at bygge en ny bane i Rio de Janeiro. Interlagos, officielt kaldet Autodromo Jose Carlos Pace efter den brasilianske vinder fra 1975, lagde for første gang asfalt til et verdensmesterskabs Grand Prix i 1973. Den ikoniske bane har været rammen om store øjeblikke i Formel 1-historien, herunder Ayrton Sennas følelsesladede hjemmesejr i 1991, Kimi Raikkonens mesterskabstitel i 2007 for Ferrari og Lewis Hamiltons første verdensmesterskab i 2008 med McLaren efter en dramatisk sidste-omgangs-overhaling. 'Den indbegreber alt det bedste ved motorsport, og vi ser frem til udviklingen i de kommende år for at skabe endnu bedre oplevelser for alle.' article_content:
The US military has delivered more than one million rounds of Iranian ammunition to Ukraine, which were seized last year from a vessel accused of transporting weapons from Iran to Yemen. According to the US Central Command, these munitions were confiscated from a ship believed to be smuggling arms to Yemen's Houthi rebel group and were officially transferred to Ukrainian forces on Monday. The US government assumed ownership of the ammunition on July 20, 2023, through civil forfeiture by the Department of Justice.

This move comes amid heightened tensions between Tehran and Washington, with Iran’s support for both Russia’s war in Ukraine and the Houthi rebels in Yemen contributing to the strain. While the shipment may not substantially impact Ukraine’s battlefield capabilities, as the country prioritizes longer-range and air defense systems, it demonstrates continued US military support.

However, debate over further military assistance to Ukraine is growing in the US, particularly among conservative members of the Republican Party, who have pledged to restrict more funding. Increasing skepticism about Western support is also visible in Europe; for instance, a Slovak presidential candidate opposed to aid for Ukraine recently won an election.

Support for Ukraine has further complicated US congressional negotiations over government spending. Recent short-term funding bills omitted additional Ukraine aid, leaving future military support uncertain. The Pentagon has stated that previously approved resources will allow the US to continue its current support for a limited period, but congressional approval is needed to sustain assistance long-term. Since Russia’s full-scale invasion in February 2022, the US has contributed over $43 billion in military aid to Ukraine, making up more than half of all international military support.

Den amerikanske regering overtog ejerskabet af ammunitionsforsendelsen den 20. juli 2023 gennem civil konfiskation via Justitsministeriet.

Denne handling sker midt i stigende spændinger mellem Teheran og Washington, da Irans støtte til både Ruslands krigsførelse i Ukraine og Houthi-oprørerne i Yemen bidrager til konflikten. Selvom leverancen næppe væsentligt styrker Ukraines kampkraft, da landet har fokus på langdistance og luftforsvar, viser det fortsat amerikansk militær støtte.

Debatten om yderligere militær hjælp til Ukraine vokser dog i USA, især blandt konservative medlemmer af det Republikanske Parti, som har lovet at begrænse midlerne. Skepsis over for vestlig støtte breder sig også i Europa; for eksempel vandt en slovakisk præsidentkandidat, der var imod støtte til Ukraine, for nylig valget.

Støtten til Ukraine har desuden gjort de amerikanske kongresforhandlinger om statsbudgettet mere komplekse. De seneste midlertidige finanslove udelod ekstra hjælp til Ukraine, hvilket gør fremtidig militær støtte usikker. Pentagon har udtalt, at tidligere godkendt støtte vil gøre det muligt for USA at fortsætte med det nuværende niveau i en begrænset periode, men kongressens godkendelse er nødvendig for fortsat hjælp på lang sigt. Siden Ruslands fuldskala invasion i februar 2022 har USA ydet over 43 milliarder dollars i militær støtte til Ukraine, hvilket udgør mere end halvdelen af al international militær bistand.

article_content: A 23-year-old Indian student, Om Brahmbhatt, has been arrested and charged with allegedly murdering his grandparents and uncle inside a condominium in South Plainfield, New Jersey, according to police and US media reports. The victims—his grandparents, Dilipkumar Brahmbhatt, 72, and Bindu Brahmbhatt, 72, as well as their son, Yashkumar Brahmbhatt, 38—were identified by the South Plainfield Police Department and the Middlesex County Prosecutor’s Office. Officers responded to a home on Coppola Drive at the Traditions condo complex after a neighbor reported hearing gunshots around 9 a.m. on Monday. Upon arrival, they found two men and a woman, all with gunshot wounds. Dilipkumar and Bindu were found deceased in the second-floor apartment, while Yashkumar was transported to a hospital but later died from his injuries. At the scene, officers took Om Brahmbhatt—who had recently moved to New Jersey and resided with the victims—into custody for questioning. He was later charged with three counts of first-degree murder and second-degree weapon possession. Om is currently held at the Middlesex County Adult Correctional Center pending a pre-trial detention hearing. It is unclear whether he has an attorney, and no contact information was available for him. According to the complaint, Om allegedly committed the crime using a handgun he claims to have purchased online. During a court appearance, he appeared calm. Police reported that Om himself called 911 on the morning of the incident and, when questioned, reportedly stated, 'It might be me.' The motive behind the shootings remains unclear, though a neighbor mentioned that police had previously responded to the condo for a domestic violence call. Residents expressed concern about the incident and noted the complex’s extensive security camera coverage, which they hope will assist the investigation. Authorities have determined that the shootings were not random acts and that there is no ongoing threat to the public. The investigation, led by the South Plainfield Police Department and the Middlesex County Prosecutor’s Office, is ongoing. Anyone with information is encouraged to contact the authorities.

Ofrene—hans bedsteforældre, Dilipkumar Brahmbhatt, 72, og Bindu Brahmbhatt, 72, samt deres søn, Yashkumar Brahmbhatt, 38—blev identificeret af South Plainfield Police Department og Middlesex County Prosecutor’s Office. Politiet rykkede ud til en bolig på Coppola Drive i Traditions-lejlighedskomplekset, efter at en nabo rapporterede høje skud omkring kl. 9 om morgenen mandag. Ved ankomsten fandt de to mænd og en kvinde, alle med skudskader. Dilipkumar og Bindu blev fundet døde i lejligheden på anden sal, mens Yashkumar blev kørt til hospitalet, hvor han senere døde af sine skader. På stedet tog politiet Om Brahmbhatt – som for nylig var flyttet til New Jersey og boede sammen med ofrene – i forvaring til afhøring. Han blev senere sigtet for tre tilfælde af mord af første grad samt for ulovlig våbenbesiddelse af anden grad. Om er i øjeblikket varetægtsfængslet i Middlesex County Adult Correctional Center, mens han afventer et retsmøde. Det er uklart, om han har en advokat, og der var ingen kontaktoplysninger til ham. Ifølge anklageskriftet har Om angiveligt begået forbrydelsen med en pistol, som han hævder at have købt online. Under et retsmøde fremstod han rolig. Politiet oplyste, at Om selv ringede 112 den morgen, og at han til politiet angiveligt sagde: 'Det kunne være mig.' Motivet bag skyderierne er fortsat uklart, selvom en nabo nævnte, at politiet tidligere har været kaldt ud til lejligheden i forbindelse med en voldsepisode i hjemmet. Beboerne udtrykte bekymring og bemærkede, at der er omfattende videoovervågning i komplekset, hvilket de håber vil hjælpe efterforskningen. Myndighederne har fastslået, at skyderierne ikke var tilfældige handlinger, og at der ikke er nogen umiddelbar trussel for offentligheden. Efterforskningen, som ledes af South Plainfield Police Department og Middlesex County Prosecutor’s Office, er stadig i gang. Enhver med oplysninger opfordres til at kontakte politiet.

article_content: The 2024 theatrical release calendar continues to expand, which is a good sign considering the effects of the lengthy SAG-AFTRA strike have not yet been fully realized. Focus Features has set the horror comedy 'Lisa Frankenstein,' written by Oscar winner Diablo Cody, for a February 9, 2024, theatrical release. Sony will also release 'It Ends With Us,' starring Blake Lively and Justin Baldoni, based on the novel by Colleen Hoover, during the same weekend. 'Lisa Frankenstein' marks Zelda Williams’ debut as a feature director. The story centers on a misunderstood teenager and her high school crush, a reanimated corpse. After a series of comedic and macabre events bring him back to life, the pair go on a murderous journey to find love, happiness, and a few missing body parts. The movie stars Kathryn Newton, Cole Sprouse, Liza Soberano, Henry Eikenberry, Joe Chrest, and Carla Gugino. Producers Mason Novick and Diablo Cody, who previously worked together on films such as 'Tully,' 'Young Adult,' 'Jennifer’s Body,' and the Oscar-winning 'Juno,' are reunited. Jeffrey Lampert serves as executive producer. Universal is handling overseas distribution. Focus Features will also release Ethan Coen’s 'Drive-Away Dolls,' featuring Beanie Feldstein, Geraldine Viswanathan, and Margaret Qualley, on February 23. The film’s release date was moved from September 2023 due to the actors’ strike.

article_content: A 4,000-year-old burial chamber has been uncovered by archaeologists in southern Georgia, shedding light on the elaborate funerary customs of ancient nomadic peoples from the Eurasian steppes. The Early Bronze Age site was found near Lagodekhi inside a large burial mound, or kurgan, standing about 12 meters (39 feet) tall. Within the chamber, archaeologists discovered two chariots with wheels, an intricately carved wooden armchair, decorative clay and wooden vessels, flint arrowheads, beads made from carnelian and amber, and 23 gold artifacts. The remains of seven people were identified, three of whom were inside one of the chariots. Experts believe the site was looted twice, but the collapse of the roof protected many grave goods from theft. Researchers suggest that the burial signifies the wealth and status of local chiefs, and that those buried alongside may have been family members or attendants, with some evidence pointing to possible ritual sacrifice. The discovery of a valuable necklace and other treasures accentuates the high standing of those buried. Historically, between about 3400 BC and 2000 BC, Georgia gained economic stability through livestock farming, enabling regional leaders to amass great wealth. Artifacts from these mounds reflect Middle Eastern cultural influences, indicating ongoing cultural exchange between nomadic and farming communities. Key ancient cultures, such as the Colchian in the west and the Trialeti Kurgan in the east, thrived during this period. Although horses were not domesticated in the area at the time, the chariots likely would have been pulled by oxen. The presence of the wooden armchair within the burial is seen as a sign of leadership. Zurab Makharadze, head of the Centre of Archaeology at the Georgian National Museum, reported that restoration work is ongoing, revealing that the bones had been preserved in honey—a method reminiscent of ancient balsam practices. Researchers hope that continued study of this site will yield new information about Georgia's Early Bronze Age societies.

Stedet fra den tidlige bronzealder blev fundet nær Lagodekhi i en stor gravhøj, en såkaldt kurgan, som er cirka 12 meter (39 fod) høj. Inde i kammeret fandt arkæologerne to vogne med hjul, en fint udskåret armstol af træ, dekorative ler- og trækar, flintpilehoveder, perler lavet af karneol og rav samt 23 guldfund. Der blev identificeret syv menneskelige skeletter — tre af dem lå i en af vognene. Eksperter mener, at stedet blev plyndret to gange, men at loftets sammenstyrtning beskyttede mange af gravgaverne mod at blive stjålet. Forskere vurderer, at graven signalerer rigdom og status for lokale høvdinge, og at dem, der er begravet sammen med dem, kan være familiemedlemmer eller tjenere — og der er tegn på muligt rituel ofring. Fundet af et værdifuldt halskæde og andre skatte fremhæver de gravlagtes høje rang. Historisk set opnåede Georgien økonomisk stabilitet mellem cirka 3400 f.Kr. og 2000 f.Kr. via husdyrbrug, hvilket gav områdets ledere mulighed for at samle store rigdomme. Gravfundenes genstande bærer præg af mellemøstlig kulturel indflydelse og viser, at der var kontakt mellem nomader og landbrugssamfund. Vigtige oldtidskulturer, såsom Colchian i vest og Trialeti Kurgan i øst, blomstrede i denne periode. Selvom heste endnu ikke var domesticerede i området, mener forskerne, at vognene sandsynligvis blev trukket af okser. Det, at der blev fundet en træarmstol i graven, tolkes som et tegn på lederskab. Zurab Makharadze, leder af Center for Arkæologi ved Georgiens Nationalmuseum, fortæller, at restaureringsarbejdet fortsætter og har afsløret, at knoglerne blev konserveret i honning — en metode, der minder om oldgammel balsamering. Forskerne håber, at fortsatte undersøgelser af stedet vil bringe ny viden om Georgiens samfund i den tidlige bronzealder.

article_content: Phylicia Rashad, who portrayed Clair Huxtable on NBC's 'The Cosby Show,' has publicly voiced her support for Bill Cosby amidst recent allegations against the comedian. In an interview with Showbiz 411, Rashad maintained that she never observed any behavior similar to the accusations brought forward by more than 20 women. Cosby faces accusations of harassment, drugging, and sexual assault. However, no criminal charges have been filed to date, and his attorneys continue to vigorously deny the claims. Rashad stated, 'Forget these women. What you're seeing is the destruction of a legacy, and I think it's orchestrated. I don't know why or who's doing it, but it's the legacy. And it's a legacy that is so important to the culture.' Cosby's public image has taken a significant hit, including a canceled television project and the suspension of the Cosby Chair for the Humanities at Spelman College, an institution supported by Bill and Camille Cosby. Attorney Gloria Allred recently introduced three more accusers—Linda Kirkpatrick, Lynn Neal, and Kacey (a pseudonym)—who allege they were sexually assaulted by Cosby after being drugged. Kirkpatrick and Neal cite incidents from the early 1980s, while Kacey dates hers to the 1990s. Allred responded to Rashad's comments, stating, 'Phylicia, you should be supporting these women rather than joining Cosby's paid defenders who are trying to undermine them.' She noted that Cosby’s legal team has not responded to her previous settlement offers. Rashad—who also played Cosby's wife in the CBS sitcom 'Cosby'—asserted that the current backlash represents a coordinated effort to remove Cosby from television. 'Someone is determined to keep Bill Cosby off TV,' she said. 'And it's worked. All his contracts have been canceled.' Rashad defended both Cosby and his wife, Camille, insisting Camille would never accept such actions from her husband of 50 years. Speaking to Roger Friedman, Rashad described Camille as 'a tough woman, a smart woman. She's no pushover.' Rashad also highlighted the significance of 'The Cosby Show,' remarking, 'This show represented America to the outside world. This was the American family. And now you're seeing it being destroyed. Why?' When asked why Cosby has not more publicly addressed the allegations—aside from his advice that the black media approach the story neutrally—Rashad suggested his pride prevents him from doing so. 'If he spoke now, what do you think the media would do with it?' she asked.

article_content: Kevin Pietersen's forthcoming autobiography delivers a sharp rebuke of England cricket's internal culture, accusing the team of promoting bullying and intimidation under the leadership of coach Andy Flower and vice-captain Matt Prior. Pietersen contends that Flower managed through fear rather than teamwork and accuses Prior of using his influence to undermine teammates. In a Daily Telegraph interview, Pietersen recounted that he repeatedly brought up concerns about the toxic environment with team captains Andrew Strauss and Alastair Cook. He describes a dressing room atmosphere in which bowlers were emboldened to demand apologies for mistakes, a dynamic he found deeply troubling. Pietersen candidly admits regret over sending inappropriate text messages about Strauss to South African opponents, explaining that at the time he was under severe emotional stress and affected by harassment from a parody account. He details a moment of breakdown and his subsequent apology to Strauss and his wife. While abstaining from harsh criticism of Alastair Cook, whom he describes as good-natured yet reserved, Pietersen saves his strongest words for Prior, alleging that he targeted other players and acted as Cook's vocal advocate. Pietersen also alleges that Andy Flower developed a personal vendetta against him for resisting authority, constructing an environment focused on obedience over teamwork. He further claims that Flower failed to act when Pietersen tried to raise the issue of teammate Jonathan Trott's mental health. Nevertheless, Pietersen maintains he remains passionate about English cricket and, despite being away from first-class cricket, expresses his hope of a return under new leadership to mentor young players and help the team succeed.

Sarah Palin and Donald Trump generated significant buzz at a major Republican campaign event in Iowa over the weekend. Their appearances reignited speculation about possible presidential runs, though evidence suggests both are more interested in media attention than serious candidacies. At Congressman Steve King's event, an impressive lineup of likely 2016 GOP candidates—including Chris Christie, Rick Perry, Ted Cruz, Rick Santorum, Carly Fiorina, and Mike Huckabee—tested their early campaign messages.

Palin delivered a rambling speech, criticizing Hollywood, the political left, President Barack Obama, and addressing social media controversy involving her family. Though she suggested she might consider returning to politics, there is no sign she is taking substantive steps toward a presidential run, such as engaging major donors or forming a campaign team. Some conservative commentators, like Byron York and Erick Erickson, expressed concern or indifference about her relevance. Meanwhile, Democrats welcomed her remarks, with the Democratic National Committee and the pro-Clinton group Ready for Hillary responding with statements and fundraising efforts.

Trump similarly used the event to reignite his political presence, strongly criticizing party establishment figures Jeb Bush and Mitt Romney, both of whom did not attend. Trump's comments contrasted with party leaders' attempts to maintain a serious tone for the upcoming primaries. The article notes the tradition of long-shot candidates boosting their profiles through campaign appearances, even when victory is unlikely. Several politicians have used unsuccessful runs to advance their careers, including Tom Vilsack, Dennis Kucinich, Ron Paul, and Joe Biden.

In conclusion, Palin and Trump appear more focused on public attention and maintaining their personal brands than launching viable campaigns, making their participation notable more for spectacle than substance.

Heather McCartney, a 26-year-old Scottish model residing on the Gold Coast, drew widespread attention after she stripped naked in a corporate box during Saturday's AFL Grand Final at the Melbourne Cricket Ground. The act, which took place as the Hawthorn Hawks defeated the Sydney Swans, was reportedly the result of a bet McCartney had made if Hawthorn won. Her actions were witnessed by thousands and rapidly provoked social media commentary.

Police responded to complaints and, during the arrest attempt, McCartney resisted by reportedly striking and biting officers before being taken into custody. She spent the night in a police cell and was fined $300 for acting in an indecent manner.

After her release, McCartney explained her actions as the outcome of a bet and described her experience as positive on social media. Additionally, some reports suggested she may have been offered extra pay to perform the stunt. Officials at the MCG have launched investigations, with MCC spokesman Shane Brown stating the organization is taking the incident seriously and working with police to establish the full circumstances.

AFL officials expressed disappointment, and AFL Fans Association spokesman Brian Clarke criticized the incident as contrary to the values of the sport. Melbourne Magistrates Court Magistrate Alan Spillane referred to her conduct as 'pretty nasty offending,' particularly noting her aggression toward police. In court, it was explained that alcohol and prescribed medication impaired McCartney's judgment and that she had not anticipated police involvement.

The incident and its aftermath spread widely online, resulting in increased social media attention for McCartney. She pleaded guilty to several charges and was released from custody following her court appearance.

The Color of Medieval Life, an exhibition presented by the specialist medieval art dealer Les Enluminures during New York Jewelry Week, challenges the notion that the Middle Ages were simply the 'Dark Ages.' The centerpiece is the first U.S. solo exhibition of British artist-jeweler Joy BC, whose works draw on Classical history and mythology, rendered in recycled precious metals and gemstones using ancient techniques.

Joy BC’s pieces are displayed in conversation with medieval manuscripts and jewelry curated by Les Enluminures. Her collection, Deconstructed Classics – Seeing Life in Color, organizes the works by symbolic colors reflecting those found in medieval manuscripts: white (femininity and the moon), red (blood and courage), yellow (sun, radiance, hope), and blue (inspiration and dreams). Photographs by artist Olivia Rose showcase the jewelry, including the Artemis necklace and Colonna bracelet.

Notably, the exhibition features pieces such as the Hypatia ring (recycled 22ct gold and sapphires), the Artemis necklace (recycled 18ct gold and fine 999 silver), the Precious Tears ring (22ct gold and sapphire), and the Medusa Comb brooch (bronze, recycled gold, and Fuli peridot), each inspired by classical and mythological motifs. Joy BC’s jewelry art reinterprets themes of transformation, power, and emotion, often employing ancient fabrication methods like wax casting.

Les Enluminures, established in 1991 by Dr. Sandra Hindman, maintains galleries in Paris, Chicago, and New York, contributing actively to the international art world and working with institutions such as the Louvre, the Nelson-Atkins Museum, and the Swiss National Museum.

A graduate of the Glasgow School of Art and the Royal College of Art, Joy BC has been recognized for her work, including a grant from the Queen Elizabeth Scholarship Training Fund, commissioning projects with Giovanni Corvaja. Her practice responds to classical antiquity’s legacy, emphasizing both social and emotional narratives.

The exhibition runs from November 13 to 19, 2023, by appointment only, at 23 East 73rd Street, 7th Floor Penthouse, New York, NY 10021.

Udstillingens højdepunkt er den første soloudstilling i USA med den britiske smykkekunstner Joy BC, hvis værker trækker på klassisk historie og mytologi, skabt i genanvendte ædelmetaller og ædelsten ved hjælp af gamle teknikker.

Joy BC’s smykker vises i dialog med middelalderhåndskrifter og smykker kurateret af Les Enluminures. Hendes kollektion, Deconstructed Classics – Seeing Life in Color, organiserer værkerne efter symbolske farver, der afspejler dem, der findes i middelalderlige manuskripter: hvid (femininitet og månen), rød (blod og mod), gul (sol, stråleglans, håb) og blå (inspiration og drømme). Fotografier af kunstneren Olivia Rose fremviser smykker, heriblandt Artemis-halskæden og Colonna-armbåndet.

Bemærkelsesværdigt er udstillingen med smykker som Hypatia-ringen (genanvendt 22ct guld og safirer), Artemis-halskæden (genanvendt 18ct guld og fin 999 sølv), Precious Tears-ringen (22ct guld og safir) samt Medusa Comb-broschen (bronze, genanvendt guld og Fuli peridot), alle inspireret af klassiske og mytologiske motiver. Joy BC’s smykkekunst fortolker transformation, kraft og følelser og benytter ofte gamle fremstillingsteknikker som voksstøbning.

Les Enluminures, grundlagt i 1991 af Dr. Sandra Hindman, har gallerier i Paris, Chicago og New York, og bidrager aktivt til den internationale kunstverden og samarbejder med institutioner som Louvre, Nelson-Atkins Museum og Swiss National Museum.

Joy BC, uddannet på Glasgow School of Art og Royal College of Art, er anerkendt for sit arbejde, herunder et legat fra Queen Elizabeth Scholarship Training Fund og projekter med Giovanni Corvaja. Hendes praksis forholder sig til klassisk antikvitet og fremhæver både sociale og følelsesmæssige fortællinger.

Udstillingen finder sted fra 13. til 19. november 2023, kun efter aftale, på 23 East 73rd Street, 7. sal Penthouse, New York, NY 10021.

article_content: Our efforts to create helpful digital assistants and self-driving vehicles may have unexpected outcomes. Professor Stephen Hawking has once again warned that humanity faces an uncertain future as technology becomes capable of independent thought and adaptation. At an event in London, the physicist told the BBC: 'The development of full artificial intelligence could spell the end of the human race.' This comment echoes earlier warnings from Hawking, who described AI as potentially 'the biggest event in human history,' though he added it might also be the last. He argued that advancements in digital assistants like Siri, Google Now, and Cortana are steps in an ongoing technological race, but are minor compared to what the coming decades may bring. Professor Hawking recognized that AI could also deliver major benefits, such as eradicating war, disease, and poverty. During the London event, Hawking unveiled a new communications platform, the Assistive Context Aware Toolkit (ACAT), developed by Intel. This platform uses a cheek sensor detected by an infrared switch on his glasses, which allows him to select characters on a computer. SwiftKey software predicts his next words, letting him type less than 20% of the characters he previously needed, greatly improving communication speed. These selections are sent to a speech synthesizer, enabling him to communicate through his laptop. Previously, tasks like web searches required multiple steps. The new system automates these processes. According to Intel, Hawking’s typing speed is now twice as fast, and productivity in browsing and document management has increased tenfold. Hawking, who has a form of motor neurone disease related to ALS, said, 'Medicine has not been able to cure me, so I rely on technology for communication and daily life. This system has the potential to improve the lives of disabled people globally and breaks down previous communication barriers.' The ACAT platform took three years to develop. Earlier this year, Elon Musk, founder of Tesla and SpaceX, also warned of the potential dangers of AI, describing it as possibly more dangerous than nuclear weapons and comparing its development to 'summoning the demon.' He called for regulatory oversight at both national and international levels. Musk recommended Nick Bostrom’s book 'Superintelligence,' warning about risks of a robot uprising, and has expressed concerns that humanity could become a 'biological boot loader for digital superintelligence.' He has invested in AI companies like Vicarious, together with Mark Zuckerberg and Ashton Kutcher, to monitor the technology's development.
translated_content: Vores bestræbelser på at skabe hjælpsomme digitale assistenter og selvkørende køretøjer kan få uventede konsekvenser. Professor Stephen Hawking har endnu engang advaret om, at menneskeheden står overfor en usikker fremtid, efterhånden som teknologien bliver i stand til at tænke og tilpasse sig uafhængigt. Ved en begivenhed i London sagde fysikeren til BBC: 'Udviklingen af fuld kunstig intelligens kunne betyde enden for menneskeheden.' Denne bemærkning gentager tidligere advarsler fra Hawking, som har beskrevet AI som muligvis 'den største begivenhed i menneskets historie', men også bemærket, at det måske kunne være den sidste. Han argumenterede for, at fremskridt i digitale assistenter som Siri, Google Now og Cortana er skridt i et igangværende teknologisk kapløb, men små sammenlignet med, hvad fremtiden kan bringe. Professor Hawking anerkendte, at AI også kan bringe store fordele, såsom at udrydde krig, sygdom og fattigdom. Under arrangementet i London præsenterede Hawking en ny kommunikationsplatform, Assistive Context Aware Toolkit (ACAT), udviklet af Intel. Platformen bruger en kind-sensor, der registreres af en infrarød kontakt på hans briller, så han kan vælge tegn på computeren. SwiftKey-softwaren forudsiger hans næste ord, så han kan skrive under 20% af de tegn, han tidligere skulle, hvilket markant øger kommunikationshastigheden. Disse valg sendes til hans stemmesyntese, så han kan kommunikere via sin laptop. Tidligere krævede opgaver som websøgninger flere trin, men det nye system automatiserer disse. Ifølge Intel er Hawkings skribenthastighed nu dobbelt så hurtig, og produktiviteten i browsing og dokumenthåndtering er tidoblet. Hawking, der har en form for motorneuronsygdom relateret til ALS, udtalte: 'Medicinen har ikke kunnet kurere mig, så jeg er afhængig af teknologi for at kommunikere og leve. Dette system har potentiale til at forbedre livet for handicappede globalt og nedbryder de tidligere kommunikationsbarrierer.' Udviklingen af ACAT-platformen tog tre år. Tidligere i år advarede Elon Musk, grundlægger af Tesla og SpaceX, også om mulige farer ved AI og beskrev teknologien som måske farligere end atomvåben. Han sammenlignede det med at 'fremmane dæmonen' og opfordrede til regulering både nationalt og internationalt. Musk anbefalede Nick Bostroms bog 'Superintelligence', advarede om risikoen for et robotoprør, og har udtrykt bekymring for, at menneskeheden kunne blive 'biologisk boot loader for digital superintelligens.' Han har investeret i AI-virksomheder som Vicarious sammen med Mark Zuckerberg og Ashton Kutcher for at følge udviklingen tæt.

Joe D'Auria, a resident of Brookline in Pittsburgh, has gained local attention for his elaborate and eerie Halloween yard displays. For the past 20 years, he has transformed his front yard each season with blood-splattered dolls, severed plastic heads, and a handmade 'cannibal bunny.'

Although some neighbors feel the display is too graphic and have asked for its removal, many community members look forward to it. D'Auria says he sources decorations from stores, flea markets, and online, and also creates many of his ghoulish figures by hand. His latest setup features chained skeletons, hanging heads, unsettling baby dolls with 'Help me' signs, and a large pink bunny with a bloody mouth. Painted tombstones bearing family members' names also add to the spooky scene.

D'Auria reports that his display attracts up to 200 children annually, far surpassing the turnout to other houses in the neighborhood. He emphasizes the decorations are for fun—not to offend—and that he and his wife make sure not to frighten very young visitors.

According to the city's regulations, holiday decorations like his are allowed for up to 90 days. D'Auria notes that most feedback has been positive, with only an occasional complaint about certain aspects of the display.

Selvom nogle naboer mener, at dekorationerne er for voldsomme og har bedt om at få dem fjernet, ser mange i lokalsamfundet frem til dem. D'Auria fortæller, at han finder pynt i butikker, på loppemarkeder og online, og at han ofte selv fremstiller mange af de skumle figurer. Hans nyeste samling har lænkede skeletter, hængende hoveder, uhyggelige babydokker med skilte, hvor der står 'Hjælp mig', samt en stor lyserød kanin med blod omkring munden. Malede gravsten med familiens navne giver også et ekstra uhyggeligt touch.

D'Auria siger, at hans pynt tiltrækker op til 200 børn hvert år, langt flere end naboernes huse. Han understreger, at det hele er for sjov og ikke for at skræmme eller fornærme nogen, og at han og hans kone altid sørger for ikke at forskrække de mindste børn.

Byens regler tillader denne slags udsmykning i op til 90 dage. D'Auria fortæller, at det meste feedback har været positiv, selvom der har været en enkelt klage over dele af udsmykningen.

Two experienced skiers lost their lives in separate avalanches in Wyoming last weekend, marking the first avalanche fatalities of the winter season. Elizabeth 'Liza' Benson, 28, died after being swept into a tree by an avalanche near Clause Peak while backcountry skiing with her boyfriend, Jason Ray, and two friends—including a physician—west of Bondurant. Ray, a seasonal administrator for Sublette County Search & Rescue, and the physician quickly provided aid, but Benson sadly succumbed to her injuries. Benson, who was studying to become a physician’s assistant, was remembered by her family and friends for her passion for the outdoors and her love for Ray, with whom she had recently planned a future.

In a separate incident nearly 60 miles away, Nick Gillespie, 30, a Grand Teton National Park seasonal employee, died after being caught in an avalanche on Survey Peak. Gillespie was with three companions who attempted to resuscitate him but were unsuccessful. Due to remote terrain and communication challenges, authorities were not notified until later that night, and recovery efforts could not begin until the following day.

Avalanche danger in the region was rated as low Sunday morning but increased to moderate by the afternoon at elevations between 9,000 and 10,500 feet. Recent significant snowfall after a prolonged period of cold, dry weather resulted in an unstable snowpack, heightening the risk of human-triggered avalanches, especially on the west side of the Tetons, where up to 18 inches of snow fell.
translated_content:
To erfarne skiløbere mistede livet i separate laviner i Wyoming i sidste weekend, hvilket markerer de første lavinedødsfald i vintersæsonen. Elizabeth 'Liza' Benson, 28, døde, efter hun blev ført ind i et træ af en lavine nær Clause Peak, mens hun kørte offpiste med sin kæreste, Jason Ray, og to venner – heriblandt en læge – vest for Bondurant. Ray, som er sæsonbestyrer hos Sublette County Search & Rescue, samt lægen forsøgte hurtigt at hjælpe, men det lykkedes desværre ikke at redde Benson. Benson, der var ved at tage en uddannelse som lægeassistent, blev husket af familie og venner for sin passion for friluftsliv og sin kærlighed til Ray, som hun for nylig havde planer om en fremtid sammen med.

I en anden hændelse næsten 100 km derfra døde Nick Gillespie, 30, en sæsonansat i Grand Teton National Park, efter at være blevet fanget i en lavine på Survey Peak. Gillespie var sammen med tre følgesvende, der forsøgte at genoplive ham, men uden held. På grund af det afsidesliggende terræn og kommunikationsvanskeligheder blev myndighederne først informeret senere på aftenen, og redningsaktion kunne først indledes dagen efter.

Lavinefaren i området blev vurderet som lav søndag morgen, men steg til moderat i løbet af eftermiddagen i højder mellem 2.700 og 3.200 meter. Større snefald efter en længere kuldeperiode havde gjort snelaget ustabilt og øget risikoen for menneskeskabte laviner, især på vestsiden af Tetons, hvor der faldt op til 45 cm sne.

article_content: Ron Horniblew, known as Santa Ron, has brought seasonal joy to Luton every Christmas since 1964. Now 77, he is considered Britain's longest-serving Father Christmas. Santa Ron began by delivering Christmas gifts to his son in 1964 and enjoyed it so much that he started visiting friends' children too. He eventually became known for his appearances as Santa at department store grottoes and for raising money for charity. Over nearly fifty years, Ron has listened to countless children's Christmas wishes, delivered many gifts, and raised thousands of pounds for charity. He’s visited children in the Bahamas and attended Santa conferences and competitions in Sweden, Norway, and Denmark. In 2004, he was named World's Best Santa. He has received a 40-Year-Service award and is among the few Britons allowed to wear the official Santa badge, authorized by Santa Claus of Greenland. Ron shares, 'It began when my son Graham was young, and friends soon asked me to visit their children as Santa. I loved seeing the joy it brought.' On Christmas mornings, Ron visits several families, starting early and returning in time for dinner. He rings his bell as he arrives, collects the presents left by parents, and delivers them to children—spending time talking and taking photos, making Christmas extra magical. He holds both bronze and gold medals from Santa competitions, and says the highlight of his work was visiting appreciative children at an orphanage in the Bahamas. Though now too old for competitions, Santa Ron still refuses to be photographed out of costume and continues his Christmas Day visits, helping to raise funds for his local church. Ron has founded his own Santa school to teach others. He believes being Santa means listening to children and making each one feel special. He emphasizes always being enthusiastic and cheerful, never using inappropriate language, smoking, or drinking while in costume, and making sure every child feels the magic. He hopes to officially launch his training soon, eager to pass on his knowledge and continue the Santa legacy.

Santa Ron begyndte med at give julegaver til sin søn i 1964 og nød det så meget, at han også begyndte at besøge sine venners børn. Han blev senere kendt for sine optrædener som julemand i stormagasiner og for at samle penge ind til velgørenhed. I næsten halvtreds år har Ron lyttet til utallige børns juleønsker, delt mange gaver ud og samlet tusindvis af pund ind til velgørenhed. Han har besøgt børn på Bahamas og deltaget i julemandskonferencer og konkurrencer i Sverige, Norge og Danmark. I 2004 blev han kåret til Verdens Bedste Julemand. Han har modtaget en 40-års tjenestepris og er blandt de få briter, der må bære det officielle julemandsbadge, godkendt af Julemanden fra Grønland. Ron fortæller: 'Det begyndte, da min søn Graham var lille, og snart bad venner mig om at besøge deres børn som julemand. Jeg elskede at se glæden det bragte.' Julemorgen besøger Ron flere familier, starter tidligt og er hjemme i tide til middag. Han ringer med sin klokke, når han ankommer, samler gaverne op, som forældrene har lagt frem, og deler dem ud til børnene—han bruger tid på at snakke og tage billeder og gør julen ekstra magisk. Han har både bronzemedalje og guldmedalje fra julemandskonkurrencer og siger, at højdepunktet i hans arbejde var at besøge taknemmelige børn på et børnehjem på Bahamas. Selvom han nu er for gammel til konkurrencer, nægter Santa Ron stadig at blive fotograferet uden sit kostume og fortsætter sine julebesøg, hvor han hjælper med at samle penge ind til sin lokale kirke. Ron har grundlagt sin egen julemandsskole for at lære andre op. Han mener, at det at være julemand handler om at lytte til børnene og få dem til at føle sig specielle. Han understreger, at man altid skal være entusiastisk og glad, aldrig bande, ryge eller drikke i kostumet og sørge for, at hvert barn føler magien. Han håber snart officielt at kunne starte sin træning og ser frem til at videreføre julemandsarven.

article_content: Stakeholders at a validation workshop in Abuja have called on the Nigerian National Assembly to expedite the passage of the 2019 National Food Safety and Quality Bill. The workshop, which focused on the revised 2023 National Policy on Food Safety and Quality and its implementation plan, emphasized the need for legal backing to enforce updated safety standards. John Atanda, National Coordinator of Food and Safety at the Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare, stated that the Bill is essential for implementing the revised policy, which was originally developed in 2015 to modernize Nigeria’s food safety systems. Atanda explained that the National Food Safety and Health Committee created the Bill, which moved through federal channels and was sent to President Muhammadu Buhari, but was not signed before his term ended. Olubunmi Aribeana, Director of Food and Drug Services, highlighted that research shows food poisoning and contamination cause more than 200,000 deaths annually in Nigeria, underscoring the urgent need for stronger and comprehensive food safety laws. She was represented by Adeola Olufowobi-Yusuf at the event. Aribeana noted that improved collaboration and revised strategies are vital for protecting public health. The federal government, together with food sector stakeholders, established the original National Policy on Food Safety in 2015 to align with international standards. The current review of the policy aims to address existing gaps and strengthen coordination among agencies responsible for food quality and safety. Michael Eveshoyan from USAID’s Advancing Nutrition Project emphasized that safe food underpins good nutrition. He expressed hope that validating the policy will soon translate into practical action, helping ensure safer meals for Nigerians.
translated_content: Interessenter på en valideringsworkshop i Abuja har opfordret det nigerianske nationalforsamling til at fremskynde vedtagelsen af 2019-loven om fødevaresikkerhed og -kvalitet. Workshoppen, som fokuserede på den reviderede nationale politik om fødevaresikkerhed og -kvalitet fra 2023 og dens implementeringsplan, understregede nødvendigheden af lovgivningsmæssig opbakning for at gennemføre de nye sikkerhedsstandarder. John Atanda, national koordinator for fødevaresikkerhed hos Sundhedsministeriet, udtalte, at lovforslaget er afgørende for implementeringen af den reviderede politik, som oprindeligt blev udarbejdet i 2015 for at modernisere Nigerias fødevaresikkerhedssystemer. Atanda forklarede, at Nationalkomiteen for Fødevaresikkerhed og Sundhed udarbejdede lovforslaget, som derefter gennemgik de føderale kanaler og blev sendt til præsident Muhammadu Buhari, men ikke blev underskrevet inden afslutningen på hans embedsperiode. Olubunmi Aribeana, direktør for Fødevarer og Lægemidler, fremhævede, at forskning viser, at mere end 200.000 mennesker årligt dør af madforgiftning og forurening i Nigeria og understregede behovet for stærkere og mere omfattende fødevaresikkerhedslovgivning. Hun blev repræsenteret af Adeola Olufowobi-Yusuf ved arrangementet. Aribeana påpegede, at forbedret samarbejde og opdaterede strategier er vigtige for at beskytte folkesundheden. Regeringen etablerede sammen med interessenter fra fødevaresektoren den oprindelige nationale politik for fødevaresikkerhed i 2015 for at opfylde internationale standarder. Den nuværende revision af politikken har til formål at lukke de eksisterende huller og styrke koordinationen mellem de myndigheder, der er ansvarlige for fødevarekvalitet og -sikkerhed. Michael Eveshoyan fra USAID’s Advancing Nutrition Project understregede, at sikker mad er fundamentet for god ernæring. Han udtrykte håb om, at når politikken godkendes, vil det hurtigt føre til konkrete handlinger for at sikre mere sikker mad til nigerianerne.

Steven Haugen, 54, and Jeanette Bauman, 56, set out on June 30, 2005, for an overnight camping trip in Oregon’s Willamette National Forest with their Labrador retriever, Caesar. Tragically, all three were found shot to death at their campsite the next day. The murders remain unsolved after four years, with the killer still at large. The case is reminiscent of a similar double homicide involving a mother and daughter in neighboring Washington state a year later — both incidents occurred in remote, public land settings, and the victims’ vehicles were left behind, according to the Lane County Sheriff's Office.

Authorities say there is no clear motive in either case. Haugen was a school counselor and track coach, while Bauman taught business. They had no known enemies. Investigators report that some camping gear and the license plate from their 1997 GMC Jimmy SUV were missing. Lt. Randy Smith of the Lane County Sheriff's Office mentioned, “It’s not clear what the reasoning is. Is it a robbery? With FBI assistance, we have developed a profile of the killer or killers. One theory is that it could be a territorial crime.”

As the fourth anniversary approaches, police continue to consider the possibility that Bauman and Haugen were chosen at random, possibly by someone angered that campers were in ‘his woods.’ Authorities have observed an increase, though still rare, in territorial disputes in forested areas. Gary Bauman, Jeanette’s son, believes his mother and Steven were simply in the wrong place at the wrong time. He’s uncertain if either was armed, noting his mother did not own a gun, though Steven might have kept a handgun for protection against wildlife.

The sheriff’s office is currently monitoring a group of individuals who fit an investigative profile and may have been in the area at the time, but no suspects have been officially named. The public is urged to provide any information that could lead to the arrest or conviction of the person or persons responsible. Tips can be submitted to the Lane County Sheriff's Office tip line at 541-682-4167. A $5,000 reward is offered.

Steven Haugen, 54, og Jeanette Bauman, 56, tog den 30. juni 2005 på en overnatningstur i Oregons Willamette National Forest sammen med deres labrador, Caesar. Tragisk nok blev alle tre fundet skudt og dræbt på deres lejrplads dagen efter. Mordene er stadig uopklarede efter fire år, og gerningsmanden er stadig på fri fod. Sagen minder om et lignende dobbeltmord, der et år senere fandt sted i nabostaten Washington – begge hændelser fandt sted i afsidesliggende skovområder på offentlig jord, og ofrenes køretøjer blev efterladt, ifølge Lane County Sheriff's Office.

Myndighederne siger, at der ikke er noget klart motiv i nogen af sagerne. Haugen var skolevejleder og atletiktræner, mens Bauman underviste i erhvervsøkonomi. De havde ingen kendte fjender. Efterforskere rapporterer, at noget campingudstyr og nummerpladen fra deres 1997 GMC Jimmy SUV manglede. Politiløjtnant Randy Smith fra Lane County Sheriff's Office udtalte: “Det er uklart, hvad motivet er. Er det et røveri? Med FBI’s hjælp har vi udviklet en profil af gerningsmanden eller gerningsmændene. En teori er, at det kan være en territorial forbrydelse.”

I takt med at fireårsdagen nærmer sig, arbejder politiet fortsat ud fra muligheden for, at Bauman og Haugen blev udvalgt tilfældigt – måske af en person, der var vred over, at der var campister i ‘hans skov’. Myndighederne har set en stigning, om end sjælden, i territoriale konflikter i skovområder. Gary Bauman, Jeanettes søn, mener, at hans mor og Steven blot var på det forkerte sted på det forkerte tidspunkt. Han ved ikke, om nogen af dem var bevæbnede, men oplyser, at hans mor ikke ejede et skydevåben, selvom Steven måske havde en pistol med for at beskytte mod vilde dyr.

Sheriffkontoret holder i øjeblikket øje med en gruppe personer, der passer til en undersøgelsesprofil og muligvis befandt sig i området på gerningstidspunktet, men der er ikke udpeget officielle mistænkte. Offentligheden opfordres til at komme frem med oplysninger, der kan føre til anholdelse eller domfældelse af den eller de ansvarlige. Tip kan indgives til Lane County Sheriff's Office tiplinje på 541-682-4167. Der tilbydes en dusør på $5.000.

article_content: Lewis Pugh is renowned for undertaking extreme swims in some of the world's coldest waters to highlight the effects of climate change. In 2007, he became the first person to complete a 1 km swim at the North Pole—a place typically covered by ice—to draw attention to global warming and shrinking Antarctic ice. At age 39, Pugh was a former maritime lawyer who switched careers six years earlier to focus full-time on environmental causes and adventure swimming. He has since swum long distances in all five oceans, becoming the world’s most accomplished cold-water swimmer. Born in England and raised in South Africa, Pugh sees himself following the footsteps of British explorers. Unlike most, he seeks to use his expeditions to shed light on environmental damage he observes firsthand. In 2006, aiming to highlight both global warming and severe drought in England, Pugh swam the length of the River Thames (except for the first 26 miles, which had dried up). Along the way, he met with then-Prime Minister Tony Blair at 10 Downing Street to discuss climate action. The next year, Pugh was the first to swim the 87-mile width of the Maldives. The 10-day feat aimed to spotlight how climate change threatens to submerge low-lying island nations. Pugh is best known for his North Pole swim, which lasted 19 minutes in water close to minus 2 degrees Celsius. Normally, such conditions lead to rapid drowning, but Pugh has a strategy identified by Professor Tim Noakes as 'anticipatory thermogenesis,' where he can voluntarily raise his body temperature. To prepare, Pugh uses intense visualization, recalling vivid experiences, and sometimes listens to Eminem's music to reach a state of focus that boosts his body heat. He dedicates daily time to both cold-water training and mental preparation, visualizing every stage of his swim. Pugh’s swims are designed to raise global awareness and prompt climate action. In 2008, he founded the Polar Defense Project to protect the Arctic and urge leaders to prevent resource exploitation. He strongly advocates for an Arctic treaty, saying after his historic swim, 'I’m relieved it’s over. Now the real work begins.'

Siden da har han gennemført lange svømmeture i alle fem oceaner og er blevet verdens mest kendte koldtvandssvømmer. Født i England og opvokset i Sydafrika ser Pugh sig selv som arvtager til britiske opdagelsesrejsende.
