article_content: On Wednesday morning, the Adamawa State Police Headquarters in Jimeta, Yola North, suffered an attack that caused alarm throughout the community. Police spokesperson SP Suleiman Nguroje confirmed the incident, stating that officers managed to repel the attackers, but the individuals responsible have not yet been identified. There is speculation, mainly from anonymous sources, suggesting the attackers might be military personnel seeking revenge for the alleged killing of a soldier by police. Nonetheless, this claim has not been independently verified, and the police are actively investigating the motive and the perpetrators. This event follows a separate confrontation that took place last Friday in Kaduna, involving the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) and Nigerian Air Force (NAF) personnel. Reports indicate that NAF members stormed the EFCC’s Kaduna Zonal Command in an attempt to free their colleagues who had been detained after a sting operation targeting suspected internet fraudsters. The EFCC arrested five individuals—Favour Itung, Rachael Ande, Zuleiman Haruna, Abubakar Ismaila, and Solomon Olobatoke—at an eatery in Barnawa, Kaduna, following credible intelligence on alleged internet fraud. During and after the arrests, four air force personnel and two students from the Nigerian Air Force Institute of Technology allegedly tried to forcibly release the suspects, leading to their own detention for breaching security. EFCC spokesperson Dele Oyewale shared that there were discussions between the EFCC and air force leadership to address the issue. However, efforts to mediate broke down on November 17, when more NAF officers attempted a forceful rescue at the EFCC office. The EFCC emphasized that it responded with restraint and later handed the detained officers over to the NAF provost after they were properly processed. The commission reiterated its ongoing commitment to tackling economic and financial crimes, regardless of the challenges faced.

Ifølge rapporter forsøgte NAF-medlemmer at befri deres kollegaer, der var blevet tilbageholdt af EFCC efter en indsats mod mistænkte internetbedragere. During a UN Human Rights Council review meeting, India took the initiative in urging Canada to bolster its efforts to protect places of worship and combat hate speech. Bangladesh recommended that Canada intensify measures to reduce carbon emissions and address the effects of climate change. Diplomats from Bangladesh and Sri Lanka also pressed Canada to improve responses to racism, hate speech, hate crimes, and discrimination against migrants and Muslim minorities. Indian diplomat Mohammed Hussain referenced Canadian laws such as the National Housing Strategy Act and the Accessible Canada Act during the session.

Bangladeshi diplomat Abdullah Al Forhad called for increased Canadian initiatives to counter racism and discrimination, especially against migrants and Muslim minorities. Sri Lankan diplomat Thilini Jayasekara encouraged Canada to ratify the Convention on the Protection of the Rights of All Migrant Workers, enhance strategies to fight racial discrimination against immigrants, tackle misinformation targeting minorities, and strengthen mechanisms for reporting and following up on international human rights recommendations. Jayasekara acknowledged Canada's cooperation during UN visits on contemporary forms of slavery and Indigenous peoples’ rights, emphasizing the need to avoid discriminatory policies in areas like immigrant health.

Meanwhile, diplomatic tensions between India and Canada have risen. Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau accused India of violating the Vienna Convention after more than 40 Canadian diplomats left India at New Delhi’s request. Trudeau cautioned that if powerful nations disregard international norms without consequence, global security could be threatened. India denied involvement in Nijjar’s killing, asserting such actions are not its policy and criticizing Canada for hosting individuals it describes as terrorists. India has partially resumed visa services in Canada after suspensions linked to the diplomatic dispute.

Jayasekara anerkendte Canadas samarbejde under FN-besøg om nutidige former for slaveri og oprindelige folks rettigheder og understregede betydningen af ikke-diskriminerende politikker, især angående immigranters sundhed.

Samtidig er de diplomatiske spændinger mellem Indien og Canada vokset. article_content: Serena Williams has strongly criticized Russian tennis chief Shamil Tarpischev for making 'insensitive, sexist, and racist' remarks about her and her sister Venus, referring to them as the 'Williams brothers' on a late-night TV show. Williams gave her first public response to Tarpischev's comments while speaking to reporters ahead of the WTA Tour Finals in Singapore. The WTA banned Tarpischev for a year and fined him $25,000. He made a public apology, describing his comment as a 'small joke,' but this did not satisfy 18-time Grand Slam champion Williams. Williams said, 'I think the WTA did a great job of taking initiative and immediate action in response to his comments. They were very insensitive, extremely sexist and racist.' She added, 'I felt the remarks were a form of bullying. The WTA and USTA did a wonderful job making sure that, in 2014, someone in his position is held accountable for such unacceptable remarks.' World number two Maria Sharapova, who has played on Russian FedCup teams captained by Tarpischev, also condemned the comments, saying, 'They were very disrespectful and uncalled for, especially given his responsibilities in sport and as part of the Olympic Committee. It was irresponsible on his part.' The controversy has become a distraction ahead of the season-ending finals, where Williams is seeking a third consecutive title. She will open the tournament against former world number one Ana Ivanovic, hoping to overcome recent injury and illness. 'I wasn't sure if I would make it to this tournament,' Williams admitted. 'But I'm here and feeling better than I did in China. I'm improving each day.' On the men's ATP Tour, the competition for places in the season-ending ATP Finals in London is heating up. Andy Murray boosted his chances by defeating David Ferrer 5-7, 6-2, 7-5 to win the Austrian Open in Vienna, also surpassing Ferrer in the rankings. Both players are set to compete in Valencia next. Top seed Tomas Berdych won the Stockholm Open, beating defending champion Grigor Dimitrov 5-7, 6-4, 6-4. Berdych sits seventh in the standings, just ahead of Murray, while Dimitrov's chances for London have diminished. Marin Cilic, who has already qualified for the London event, won the Kremlin Cup in Moscow by defeating Roberto Bautista-Agut. Tarpischev serves as chairman of the Kremlin Cup. Following his comments about the Williams sisters, the WTA is demanding he step down from this position.

article_content: A British man living as an Apache Indian is facing legal proceedings after illegal badger paws and eagle wings were found in his home. Mangas Colaradas, 60, has lived according to Native American traditions for 20 years, despite being born and raised in Swansea. He was arrested following the discovery of the animal parts among his Apache collection. Colaradas appeared in court wearing ceremonial dress and was charged under the Protection of Badgers Act and the Wildlife and Countryside Act. He pleaded not guilty, arguing the items are part of his heritage and central to his lifestyle. His defense lawyer, Anne Griffiths, stated that he identifies with a Native American Apache tribe and has spent time within those communities. The Apache people, numbering about 30,000 in the United States, primarily live in Arizona, New Mexico, and Texas, mostly in reservation areas. The name 'Apache' originally came from enemy tribes but is now widely used. After Colaradas' release on bail, he described his Apache-inspired lifestyle at his home in Swansea. He rejects modern living and prioritizes respect for nature, stating, 'I dress like this all the time—it's not a costume.' He adopted his new lifestyle after his divorce in the early 1990s, taking his name from a famous Apache chief. In 1997, he tried to live on a Native American reservation in the US, but was refused. He later lived in a tipi in Spain near Torremolinos. Colaradas makes tomahawks, bows, and arrows, and runs educational snake shows. He claims to have helped thousands overcome their fear of snakes, and emphasizes his belief in not wasting animal remains, reflecting Native traditions. He awaits trial in August.

article_content: The 2023/24 NFL season marks the first year NFL Sunday Ticket is available on YouTube and YouTube TV. Despite experiencing a significant outage last Sunday, the service’s initial season has been considered successful overall. For those who haven’t yet subscribed, NFL Sunday Ticket is now being offered at a substantial discount for the remainder of the season. Pricing depends on your platform of choice: On YouTube TV, the rest of the season is $174, or $194 if you want NFL RedZone included. On YouTube via Primetime Channels, it’s $224 for just NFL Sunday Ticket, and $244 if you opt for both Sunday Ticket and NFL RedZone. This means you can get access to half the NFL season—as it’s just about to begin Week 9 of 18—for roughly half the usual price. Plus, YouTube TV subscribers who sign up now will receive an additional two months of Max (formerly HBO Max) for free. It’s important to note that standard blackout restrictions still apply, so certain games may not be available in your area. Additionally, all sales are final—no refunds will be issued. NFL Sunday Ticket only covers the Sunday lunchtime and afternoon games. Sunday Night Football, Thursday Night Football, and Monday Night Football are not included. The multiview feature allows viewers to watch multiple games at once, which has been well received. Google has not released subscriber numbers for NFL Sunday Ticket on YouTube or YouTube TV, but executives stated in a third-quarter earnings call that YouTube TV continues to grow, partially due to the addition of NFL Sunday Ticket. Previously, Google reported that YouTube TV had around 5 million subscribers as of mid-2022, making it the largest service of its kind in the U.S.

På YouTube via Primetime Channels er prisen $224 for kun NFL Sunday Ticket, og $244 hvis du vælger både Sunday Ticket og NFL RedZone. Det betyder, at du kan få adgang til halvdelen af NFL-sæsonen – da vi lige er ved at begynde uge 9 ud af 18 – til cirka halv pris. Derudover får YouTube TV-abonnenter, der tilmelder sig nu, to ekstra gratis måneder med Max (tidligere HBO Max). Det er vigtigt at bemærke, at standard blackout-regler stadig gælder, så visse kampe måske ikke er tilgængelige i dit område. Desuden er alle køb endelige – der gives ingen refunds. NFL Sunday Ticket dækker kun søndagens frokost- og eftermiddagskampe. Sunday Night Football, Thursday Night Football og Monday Night Football er ikke inkluderet. Multiview-funktionen gør det muligt for seerne at se flere kampe på én gang, hvilket har fået en positiv modtagelse. Google har ikke offentliggjort abonnementstal for NFL Sunday Ticket på YouTube eller YouTube TV, men ledere udtalte i et regnskabsopkald for tredje kvartal, at YouTube TV fortsat vokser, delvist takket være tilføjelsen af NFL Sunday Ticket. Tidligere har Google oplyst, at YouTube TV havde omkring 5 millioner abonnenter i midten af 2022, hvilket gør det til den største tjeneste af sin slags i USA.

article_content: Inspector General of Police, Kayode Egbetokun, commended police officers, military personnel, and other security agencies for their dedication in facilitating peaceful elections in Bayelsa, Imo, and Kogi states. In a statement issued by Force Public Relations Officer ACP Olumuyiwa Adejobi on the police force’s X account, the IGP highlighted the importance of these security personnel in maintaining public order, protecting the electoral process, and ensuring citizens’ safety. Egbetokun noted that, despite prior security concerns, elections in the three states took place smoothly. He acknowledged the exceptional efforts of security teams to sustain a secure environment throughout the elections. At the same time, the IGP addressed isolated incidents that arose during the process. He directed the Electoral Offences Desk Officers, supervised by the Deputy Inspector-General of Police at the Force Criminal Investigation Department, to initiate prompt investigations. In Kogi State, it was confirmed that three police officers arrested by soldiers had violated orders by escorting a VIP during the elections—a clear breach of regulations. Other officers found escorting VIPs will also be subject to disciplinary action. The IGP expressed gratitude for the combined work of all security agencies and urged officers to uphold the highest standards of professionalism, integrity, and adherence to established guidelines to reinforce Nigeria’s democratic institutions.
translated_content: Inspektørgeneralen for Politiet, Kayode Egbetokun, har rost politibetjente, militærpersonale og andre sikkerhedsstyrker for deres dedikation i forbindelse med de fredelige valg i Bayelsa, Imo og Kogi stater. I en udtalelse offentliggjort af politiets pressetalsmand, ACP Olumuyiwa Adejobi, på politiets X-konto fremhævede inspektørgeneralen vigtigheden af sikkerhedsstyrkernes indsats for at opretholde ro og orden, beskytte valghandlingen og sikre borgernes tryghed. Egbetokun bemærkede, at trods tidligere bekymringer om sikkerhed, forløb valgene i de tre stater uden større problemer. Han anerkendte det enestående arbejde, som sikkerhedsfolkene har udført for at holde valget sikkert. Samtidig påpegede inspektørgeneralen enkelttilfælde af hændelser, der opstod under processen. Han har pålagt valgforbrydelsesenhedens betjente under viceinspektørgeneralen i politiets kriminalafdeling at starte hurtige undersøgelser. I Kogi-staten blev det bekræftet, at tre politifolk anholdt af soldater havde overtrådt reglerne ved at eskortere en VIP under valget – et klart brud på retningslinjerne. Andre betjente, der blev opdaget i at eskortere VIP'er, vil også blive disciplineret. Inspektørgeneralen udtrykte taknemmelighed over sikkerhedsstyrkernes samarbejde og opfordrede betjentene til fortsat at opretholde høj professionalisme, integritet samt overholdelse af retningslinjer for at styrke demokratiske institutioner i Nigeria.
post_content: IGP Egbetokun praises police & security teams for keeping the Bayelsa, Imo, & Kogi elections safe and smooth! Some incidents under investigation, but overall a win for democracy. 👮🇳🇬 #NigeriaElections #SecurityFirst

article_content: Maud Elizabeth Daphne Marina, the daughter of Lord Freddie Windsor and Sophie Winkleman, is the newest member of the Royal Family. Just two weeks old, Maud was photographed peacefully sleeping for her first public photo shoot. Her proud grandparents, Prince Michael of Kent and Princess Michael of Kent, joined the family portrait and were dressed to celebrate Maud's arrival. Prince Michael's unbuttoned pink shirt revealed a gold crucifix, possibly inspired by the style of Los Angeles, where Maud was born on August 15, 2013. Sophie Winkleman shared plans to introduce Maud to Prince George during a family gathering at Buckingham Palace this Christmas. She recounted a long and difficult labor at the Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Centre in Los Angeles. "By the end, I was begging for a caesarean, thinking I couldn’t do it anymore—but with wonderful doctors, midwives, and Freddie supporting me, I managed a natural birth. Their encouragement and American positivity helped me through," she told Hello! Magazine. Lord Freddie, 34, explained the inspiration behind Maud’s name: “We liked the idea of an old-fashioned English name; there are a couple of Princess Mauds in my father’s family from a century ago. One was the youngest daughter of Edward VII, who became Queen of Norway, and another was Edward VII’s granddaughter by his daughter Princess Louise. We also find it beautiful and elegant.” Elizabeth honors the Queen, Daphne is after Sophie’s grandmother, and Marina comes from Lord Freddie’s paternal grandmother. Reflecting on his role at the birth, Freddie was called brave by Sophie, who joked about wanting to throw a saucepan at him when he read her a crossword clue mid-labor. Prince Michael expressed the family's delight: "We are absolutely thrilled by the arrival of our beautiful first granddaughter, Maud. We are both besotted with her. Not only does she have the prettiest blue eyes and adorable tiny feet, but she is also remarkably well-behaved." Princess Michael mentioned they hadn’t met Prince George yet due to holidays and being busy with Maud's arrival, but hope to do so at Christmas. Sophie Winkleman, who has appeared in TV series including Peep Show and Two And A Half Men, married Lord Windsor in September 2009. She said, “Perhaps we’ll introduce the babies at Buckingham Palace for the Christmas lunch; that would be very sweet.” The full photo shoot and interview can be found in the latest issue of HELLO! Magazine.
translated_content: Maud Elizabeth Daphne Marina, datter af Lord Freddie Windsor og Sophie Winkleman, er det nyeste medlem af kongefamilien. Kun to uger gammel blev Maud fotograferet, mens hun sov fredeligt til sin første offentlige fotosession. Hendes stolte bedsteforældre, prins Michael af Kent og prinsesse Michael af Kent, medvirkede i familiebilledet og var klædt på for at fejre Mauds ankomst. Prins Michaels åbne lyserøde skjorte viste et guldkors, måske inspireret af stilen i Los Angeles, hvor Maud blev født den 15. august 2013. Sophie Winkleman delte planer om at introducere Maud for prins George ved en familiesammenkomst på Buckingham Palace denne jul. Hun fortalte om en lang og svær fødsel på Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Centre i Los Angeles. "Til sidst bad jeg om kejsersnit og tænkte, at jeg ikke kunne mere—men med fantastiske læger, jordemødre og Freddie ved min side klarede jeg en naturlig fødsel. Deres opmuntring og amerikanske positivitet hjalp mig igennem," fortalte hun til Hello! Magazine. Lord Freddie, 34, forklarede inspirationen bag Mauds navn: “Vi kunne lide ideen om et gammeldags engelsk navn; der er flere prinsesse Maud'er i min fars familie fra omkring hundrede år siden. En var den yngste datter af Edward VII, som blev dronning af Norge, og en anden var Edward VII’s barnebarn gennem hans datter prinsesse Louise. Vi synes også, det er smukt og elegant.” Elizabeth ærer Dronningen, Daphne er til ære for Sophies bedstemor, og Marina er fra Lord Freddies farmor. Om fødslen kaldte Sophie Freddie modig og nævnte for sjov, at hun havde lyst til at kaste en gryde efter ham, da han læste et krydsord op midt under fødslen. Prins Michael udtrykte familiens glæde: "Vi er meget lykkelige over ankomsten af vores smukke første barnebarn, Maud. Vi er begge helt betagede af hende. Hun har ikke bare de smukkeste blå øjne og søde små fødder, men hun er også usædvanligt velopdragen." Prinsesse Michael nævnte, at de endnu ikke havde mødt prins George på grund af ferie og travlhed med Mauds ankomst, men håber at gøre det til jul. Sophie Winkleman, der har medvirket i tv-serier som Peep Show og Two And A Half Men, giftede sig med Lord Windsor i september 2009. Hun sagde: “Måske introducerer vi babyerne på Buckingham Palace til julefrokosten – det ville være meget sødt.” Det fulde fotoshoot og interview kan findes i det seneste nummer af HELLO! Magazine.

article_content: The FBI has joined local authorities in searching for Jasmine Leighlin Baker, a 12-year-old who went missing Tuesday morning in Perry Hall, Maryland. Jasmine left her home around 7:30 a.m. to walk the half-mile to Perry Hall Middle School, but she never arrived. Her parents, Tina and Robert Baker, only found out she was missing after she failed to come home from school and the school told them Jasmine had been absent all day. Tina spoke about her heartbreak, urging anyone with information to help bring her daughter home. Jasmine’s usual route is along the 4200 block of Soth Ave, turning onto Deborah Ave, and then crossing Joppa Road to the school. Volunteers and neighbors have been handing out fliers, and the FBI has put up billboards with her photo around Baltimore. The Baltimore County Police Crimes Against Children Unit is leading the investigation. Police emphasized that, at this time, there is no evidence Jasmine was abducted and therefore an Amber Alert was not issued. Jasmine is white, about 5'5" tall, weighs 175 pounds, has blue eyes, and long brown hair with blond and red highlights. She was last seen in blue jeans and a brown jacket. Authorities are appealing for any information that might help find Jasmine. Tips can be submitted to the Baltimore FBI (410-265-8080) or Baltimore County Police (410-307-2020). The community continues its efforts to locate her.

Hendes forældre, Tina og Robert Baker, opdagede først hendes forsvinden, da hun ikke kom hjem fra skole, og skolen fortalte dem, at Jasmine havde været fraværende hele dagen. Tina har udtrykt sin hjertesorg og opfordrer alle med informationer til at hjælpe med at få hendes datter hjem. Jasmines normale rute går langs 4200-blokken af Soth Ave, hvor hun drejer ad Deborah Ave og krydser Joppa Road for at komme til skolen. Frivillige og naboer deler løbesedler ud, og FBI har sat plakater med hendes foto op rundt om i Baltimore. Efterforskningen ledes af Baltimore County Police Crimes Against Children Unit. Politiet understreger, at der på nuværende tidspunkt ikke er beviser for, at Jasmine er blevet bortført, og derfor er der ikke udsendt Amber Alert. Jasmine beskrives som kaukasisk, cirka 170 cm høj, vejer 79 kg, har blå øjne og langt brunt hår med blonde og røde striber. Hun blev sidst set iført blå jeans og en brun jakke. Myndighederne opfordrer alle med oplysninger til at kontakte FBI i Baltimore på 410-265-8080 eller Baltimore County Police på 410-307-2020. Lokalsamfundet fortsætter intenst eftersøgningen.

article_content: Bitcoin has surged in recent months, driven by speculation that BlackRock—the world’s largest asset manager—could soon lead a Wall Street push into cryptocurrencies, especially if it receives approval for a bitcoin spot ETF. Some also point to a potential change in Federal Reserve policy as a contributing factor. BlackRock’s possible involvement has sparked optimism throughout the crypto market. In October, bitcoin exceeded $35,000 for the first time since early 2022, also boosting ethereum, XRP, and the broader digital asset sector. However, there are rising concerns that institutional dominance, especially by firms like BlackRock, could introduce new risks to the crypto ecosystem. Arthur Hayes, co-founder of BitMex, has warned that the market could be heading for a 'massive calamity' if BlackRock’s bitcoin ETF accumulates too much BTC, effectively making large amounts of bitcoin inactive and challenging bitcoin’s decentralized nature. Amidst these trends, the Biden administration has increased its focus on cryptocurrency regulation. According to the Wall Street Journal, officials claim that cryptocurrency was used to help finance Hamas’s October 7 attack on Israel, prompting calls for new Congressional authority to counter illicit use. Deputy Treasury Secretary Wally Adeyemo stressed during a financial industry conference that concerns around criminal use of crypto are growing. He called for both legislative and industry-led actions, highlighting recent steps against cryptocurrency mixers that obscure transaction details. These moves have heightened fears in the crypto industry that US authorities are executing 'Operation Choke Point 2.0,' reminiscent of a 2013 Department of Justice initiative targeting risky industries by restricting their banking access—now believed by some to be targeting crypto firms. Recent crypto-linked bank failures have intensified these concerns. Anticipation continues to grow following Grayscale’s legal victory to convert its bitcoin trust into a spot ETF, alongside ongoing SEC considerations of several ETF applications, including BlackRock’s. Grayscale, a Digital Currency Group company, holds roughly 650,000 BTC, making it the largest known bitcoin owner; Michael Saylor’s MicroStrategy is another leading holder. Hayes has indicated that if traditional finance heavyweights like BlackRock, under CEO Larry Fink, secure a large percentage of bitcoin through ETF products, they could exert influence on bitcoin’s governance and potentially create ETFs linked to mining. He noted this could bring short-term benefits but increase systemic risks. Binance CEO Changpeng 'CZ' Zhao has expressed similar worries, referencing current regulatory efforts as a new 'Operation Choke Point.' The debate continues as to whether increased government and institutional involvement in crypto represents needed oversight, or if it threatens the sector's foundational independence.

Nogle peger også på mulige ændringer i den amerikanske centralbankpolitik som medvirkende faktor. Udsigten til BlackRocks mulige engagement har skabt optimisme i kryptomarkedet. I oktober oversteg bitcoin $35.000 for første gang siden tidligt i 2022, hvilket samtidig løftede ethereum, XRP og det bredere digitale aktivmarked. Dog vokser bekymringerne om, at institutionel dominans—særligt fra firmaer som BlackRock—kan introducere nye risici for kryptoområdet. Arthur Hayes, medstifter af BitMex, har advaret om, at markedet kan være på vej mod en 'stor katastrofe', hvis BlackRocks bitcoin ETF samler for meget BTC, hvilket reelt kan gøre store mængder bitcoin inaktive og udfordre bitcoins decentrale karakter. Midt i disse tendenser har Biden-administrationen øget sit fokus på kryptoregulering. Ifølge Wall Street Journal påstår embedsmænd, at kryptovaluta blev brugt til at finansiere Hamas' angreb den 7. oktober på Israel, hvilket har ført til opfordringer om ny lovgivende myndighed til at bekæmpe ulovlig anvendelse. Vicefinansminister Wally Adeyemo understregede under en finansindustri-konference, at bekymringer om kriminel brug af krypto vokser. Han efterlyste både lovgivningsmæssig og brancheselvregulerende handling og fremhævede nylige tiltag mod kryptomixere, der skjuler transaktionsoplysninger. Disse tiltag har forstærket bekymringerne i kryptosektoren om, at amerikanske myndigheder udfører en 'Operation Choke Point 2.0', der minder om en DOJ-indsats fra 2013 mod risikofyldte industrier ved at begrænse deres adgang til banker—nu opfattet af nogle som målrettet kryptovirksomheder. Nylige bankkrak forbundet med krypto har forstærket disse bekymringer. Forventningerne stiger fortsat efter Grayscales juridiske sejr i forsøget på at omdanne deres bitcoin trust til en spot ETF, samtidig med at SEC overvejer flere ETF-ansøgninger, blandt andet BlackRocks. Hayes har udtalt, at hvis traditionelle finansgiganter som BlackRock under direktør Larry Fink får fat i en stor andel af bitcoin gennem ETF-produkter, kan de få indflydelse på bitcoins styring og potentielt lancere ETF’er relateret til mining. Han påpegede, at dette kan give kortsigtede fordele men øge de systemiske risici. Binance-direktøren Changpeng 'CZ' Zhao har givet lignende udtryk for bekymring og refereret til de nuværende reguleringstiltag som en ny 'Operation Choke Point'. Debatten fortsætter om, hvorvidt øget statslig og institutionel involvering i krypto er nødvendig regulering eller truer sektorens grundlæggende uafhængighed.

article_content: Sir Antony Jay, who co-created the hit comedy Yes Minister and formerly worked as a BBC producer, has sharply criticized the BBC, alleging bias on issues such as climate change. Speaking at the launch of a report by the Global Warming Policy Foundation, Jay called for a major reduction of the BBC’s size and influence, proposing to keep only Radio 4 and BBC One, and to eliminate its other radio and TV stations. He argued that the BBC as an organization opposes private enterprise and the monarchy, and questioned the existence of such a powerful state-funded broadcaster in a free country. Jay noted that the BBC dominates national communications and is the world’s largest broadcasting organization. Although he acknowledged that the BBC produces quality programming, he questioned the need for multiple channels and suggested a slimmed-down BBC would suffice. Recounting his own time as a BBC staffer, Jay recalled a prevailing skepticism towards private profit, the monarchy, and the military, alongside support for public services such as the National Health Service and state welfare. He stated that if the broadcasting landscape were designed today, the BBC would not be as large as it is, and that reducing its size could lead to a considerable reduction in license fees, benefiting households. He wrote the foreword for the GWPF’s report alleging BBC climate change bias, further outlining his proposals for downsizing the broadcaster. Jay’s celebrated work, Yes Minister, co-written with Jonathan Lynn and starring Paul Eddington, Nigel Hawthorne, and Derek Fowlds, gained significant popularity in the 1980s and was notably admired by Margaret Thatcher. Jay worked as a BBC producer and editor during the 1950s and 1960s, where he helped establish the Tonight programme.
translated_content: Sir Antony Jay, som var medskaber af den populære komedieserie Yes Minister og tidligere arbejdede som BBC-producer, har kraftigt kritiseret BBC og anklaget dem for at være partiske, især i spørgsmål om klimaforandringer. Ved lanceringen af en rapport fra Global Warming Policy Foundation opfordrede Jay til en markant reduktion af BBC’s størrelse og indflydelse, hvor han foreslog kun at bevare Radio 4 og BBC One og nedlægge de øvrige radio- og tv-kanaler. Han hævdede, at BBC som organisation er imod privat virksomhed og monarki, og han stillede spørgsmålstegn ved, hvorfor et så magtfuldt statsfinansieret mediehus eksisterer i et frit land. Jay bemærkede, at BBC dominerer de nationale kommunikationsmedier og er verdens største tv-selskab. Selvom han anerkendte, at BBC producerer kvalitetsindhold, satte han spørgsmålstegn ved behovet for talrige kanaler og foreslog, at en slankere BBC ville være tilstrækkelig. Med udgangspunkt i sin egen tid på BBC fortalte Jay om en udbredt skepsis over for privat profit, monarkiet og militæret – og en positiv indstilling til offentlige ydelser som NHS og social velfærd. Han udtalte, at hvis medielandskabet blev udviklet i dag, ville BBC ikke være nær så stor, og at en mindre BBC kunne føre til en betydelig reduktion af licensafgiften til fordel for husholdningerne. Han skrev forordet til GWPF’s rapport, som anklager BBC for klimabias, og uddyber her sine forslag om at skære ned på BBC. Jays anerkendte arbejde, Yes Minister, skrevet sammen med Jonathan Lynn og med Paul Eddington, Nigel Hawthorne og Derek Fowlds i hovedrollerne, opnåede stor popularitet i 1980’erne og var særligt værdsat af Margaret Thatcher. Jay arbejdede som BBC-producer og redaktør i 1950’erne og 1960’erne, hvor han var med til at etablere programmet Tonight.

article_content: Julius Baer has announced the promotion of Kunal Sumaya to Market Head Global NRI (Non-Resident Indians), effective January 1, 2024. Based in Singapore, Sumaya will oversee NRI markets in Singapore, Dubai, and Zurich. In his new role, he will report to Rahul Malhotra, who will join the Executive Board of Julius Baer Group Ltd. and become Head of Emerging Markets from January 1, 2024. Currently, Sumaya serves as Group Head Global India & Japan Singapore. Over his 13-year tenure at Julius Baer, he has played a key role in expanding the Global India & Developed Markets businesses, particularly from Singapore and Dubai. Sumaya’s strategic vision and ability to engage across all levels are highlighted as assets for his new global leadership position. Commenting on his appointment, Sumaya expressed his eagerness to drive growth, mentor talent, and strengthen Julius Baer’s presence in key NRI markets. He emphasized the importance of a unified strategy to boost the bank’s connectivity with India. Rahul Malhotra remarked that Sumaya’s promotion reflects Julius Baer’s commitment to nurturing talent and pursuing sustainable growth in critical regions, particularly along the global India corridor. Umang Papneja will continue as CEO of Julius Baer India, leading the bank’s transformation strategy in the country.

Sumaya fungerer i øjeblikket som Group Head Global India & Japan Singapore. article_content: TechBoston Academy in Boston’s Dorchester neighborhood stands out among urban schools for its impressive college acceptance rate—about 95% of its students go on to higher education, even though 90% qualify for free or subsidized lunches. Founded in 2002 as a collaboration between the public school system, private businesses, and philanthropists, TechBoston Academy has grown from 75 students to over 800, spanning grades 6 through 12. Headmaster Mary Skipper emphasizes the school’s team effort, crediting dedicated teachers and a strong partnership ethos for its achievement. She views the school’s metal detectors not only as security measures but also as symbols of a focused learning environment: 'They keep the street in the street and the school in the school.' Technology is integrated into every aspect of education at TechBoston. Every student receives a laptop, and classrooms are equipped with interactive SMART boards. Major tech companies—including Microsoft, Apple, Dell, and Cisco—support the school by providing resources and ongoing training for teachers. The school’s partnership model extends beyond donations; companies also foster real-world skills by offering job-shadowing opportunities so students can envision future careers. Many TechBoston students are first in their families to pursue college. The school’s success has gained national recognition. President Barack Obama, Melinda Gates, and Education Secretary Arne Duncan were scheduled to tour TechBoston and highlight the importance of innovation and investment in education. Coinciding with this visit, the White House announced a $90 million grant competition to support innovative teaching with technology. article_content: Drug manufacturer Cipla received a warning from the United States Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) following an inspection at its Pithampur facility earlier this year. The USFDA conducted a routine inspection at the facility in February. According to a statement from Cipla, the company received a warning letter dated November 17, 2023, from the USFDA regarding the routine current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) inspection held at the Pithampur facility between February 6 and February 17, 2023. The USFDA warned Cipla about lapses in procedures and controls at the facility that did not comply with prescribed cGMP regulations. The letter included detailed guidance on required corrections. Cipla stated it will work closely with the USFDA to address the identified issues, respond to the agency within the stipulated timelines, and ensure sustained compliance. "Quality and compliance are of utmost importance to us, and we remain committed to meeting cGMP quality standards," Cipla added. Cipla's shares closed at Rs 1,234.80 on Friday, November 17, 2023.

Ifølge en udtalelse fra Cipla modtog virksomheden et advarselsbrev dateret 17. november 2023 fra USFDA vedrørende den rutinemæssige inspektion af Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), som blev udført på Pithampur-anlægget mellem 6. februar og 17. februar 2023. USFDA advarede Cipla om mangler i procedurer og kontroller på anlægget, som ikke overholder de foreskrevne cGMP-regler. Brevet indeholdt detaljerede anvisninger om nødvendige korrektioner. Cipla oplyste, at de vil arbejde tæt sammen med USFDA for at løse de identificerede problemer, svare myndigheden inden for de fastsatte tidsfrister og sikre vedvarende overholdelse. article_content: The United States will provide over $550 million in funding for a new deep-sea container terminal at Sri Lanka’s Port of Colombo, according to officials. The initiative is widely seen as a response to China’s increasing influence in the Indian Ocean, where Sri Lanka occupies a strategic position on some of the world’s busiest shipping routes connecting the Middle East and East Asia. The new Colombo West International Terminal, led by India’s Adani Group, will measure 1.4 kilometers in length and 20 meters in depth and is expected to handle 3.2 million containers annually. The $700 million project is located directly next to a similar Chinese-run terminal at the bustling Colombo port. The US government’s International Development Finance Corporation (DFC) is offering $553 million in financing for the Adani-led venture. This investment, supported by private loans, aims to upgrade Sri Lanka’s logistics infrastructure, potentially transforming Colombo into a world-class shipping hub at the crossroads of major trade routes and emerging markets, DFC said. ‘Sri Lanka is one of the world’s key transit points, with half of all container ships passing through its waters,’ stated DFC chief Scott Nathan during a visit to Colombo. The US-backed financing arrives as Sri Lanka is attempting to recover from severe financial and economic challenges. The DFC, established five years ago, was partly intended to address China’s global Belt and Road Initiative, through which Beijing has invested tens of billions of dollars annually in roads, railways, ports, and airports in developing nations. Some of these projects, such as Sri Lanka’s Hambantota Port, have sparked controversy. Sri Lanka borrowed significant sums from China to construct Hambantota Port as well as an airport and a new city on reclaimed land. When the projects struggled to generate sufficient revenue, Sri Lanka leased Hambantota Port to a Chinese company in 2017 under a 99-year lease agreement, fueling concerns about so-called ‘debt traps’ used to extend China’s influence. China’s maritime activities near Sri Lanka have also raised concerns in India, particularly after Chinese submarines visited the Chinese-run terminal next to the Adani project in 2014, despite opposition from New Delhi. India and the US have both voiced concerns that China’s presence in Hambantota could provide Beijing with a military vantage point in the Indian Ocean. Last year, a Chinese research vessel docked at the port—a move which India alleged was for espionage purposes. The Sri Lankan government, however, maintains it will not allow its ports to be used for military operations against any other nation.

Den nye Colombo West International Terminal, ledet af Indiens Adani Group, bliver 1,4 kilometer lang og 20 meter dyb og forventes at kunne håndtere 3,2 millioner containere årligt. Det 700 millioner dollars dyre projekt ligger lige ved siden af en lignende, kinesiskdrevet terminal i den travle Colombo havn. Den amerikanske statsdrevne International Development Finance Corporation (DFC) giver 553 millioner dollars i finansiering til Adani-projektet. Investeringen, der understøttes af private lån, har til formål at opgradere Sri Lankas logistikinfrastruktur og kan potentielt forvandle Colombo til et shipping-knudepunkt i verdensklasse placeret ved korsvejen mellem vigtige handelsruter og vækstmarkeder, ifølge DFC. ’Sri Lanka er et af verdens vigtigste transithubs, hvor halvdelen af alle containerskibe sejler gennem dets farvande,’ udtalte DFC-direktør Scott Nathan under et besøg i Colombo. Den amerikansk-støttede finansiering kommer, mens Sri Lanka forsøger at komme sig over store økonomiske og finansielle vanskeligheder. DFC, som blev etableret for fem år siden, blev delvist oprettet som svar på Kinas globale Belt and Road Initiative, hvor Beijing har investeret milliardbeløb i årlige projekter med veje, jernbaner, havne og lufthavne i udviklingslande. Nogle af disse projekter, såsom Hambantota-havnen i Sri Lanka, har vakt debat. Sri Lanka optog store lån fra Kina for at bygge Hambantota-havnen samt en lufthavn og en ny by på opfyldt land. Da projekterne ikke indbragte tilstrækkelige indtægter, udlejede landet Hambantota-havnen til et kinesisk selskab i 2017 på en 99-årig kontrakt – og det har givet anledning til bekymring for såkaldte ‘gældsfælder’, hvor Kina får øget indflydelse. Både Indien og USA har udtrykt bekymring for, at Kinas tilstedeværelse i Hambantota kan give Beijing en militær fordel i Det Indiske Ocean. Sidste år lagde et kinesisk forskningsskib til ved havnen – ifølge Indien for at spionere. Det srilankanske styre insisterer dog på, at man ikke vil tillade, at landets havne bruges militært mod andre nationer.

article_content: Gaza's fields, once famed for their abundant strawberry harvests, now lie in ruins as conflict devastates the area—particularly Beit Lahia, known for its fertile land, is deeply affected by ongoing violence. Indonesian humanitarian volunteer Fikri Rofiul Haq, working with MER-C, has decided to stay at the Indonesia Hospital in Gaza despite increasing dangers. Along with two colleagues, he continues to provide medical support as attacks draw ever closer. Haq notes that basic food supplies have become scarce. While staff once had access to local produce, now meals rely on deliveries from the nearby Al-Shifa Hospital, with breakfast and dinner reduced to only simple foods like biscuits or dates. According to Dr Mohammad Abu Salmiya, director at Al-Shifa, the hospital can no longer care for the influx of wounded due to severe shortages of fuel and medical resources. The inability to store bodies properly has led to mass burials nearby. Atef al-Kahlot, who heads the Indonesia Hospital, says his facility is operating at just 30–40 percent capacity. He urges international actors to help deliver fuel and supplies to Gaza's hospitals. Earlier, volunteers could venture out in ambulances to collect supplies, but intense bombardments now make it impossible. Haq recalls one particularly dangerous mission where bombs landed just 200 meters away—an ordeal that left him deeply shaken but committed. Haq and the MER-C volunteers now remain inside hospital grounds for safety, enduring frequent tremors as explosions hit the surrounding area. On one occasion, part of the hospital’s roof collapsed from nearby blasts. Their work schedules fluctuate based on critical needs, often stretching through day and night as they care for the injured and document bombardments. Built through Indonesian charity efforts in 2011 and opened in 2016, the Indonesia Hospital now serves as both a lifeline for patients and a testament to the mounting crisis. Despite evacuation opportunities, Haq and his team have chosen to remain, motivated by a strong sense of duty to assist Gaza’s civilians with vital aid. With over 11,000 reported deaths in Gaza amid intensifying attacks, there has been no recent contact with Haq since Friday at midnight, leaving his current status unknown.

article_content: The 60th anniversary of the first successful ascent of Mount Everest was marked with a remarkable achievement: the highest leap ever made from a mountain. On May 5, Russian daredevil Valery Rozov, 48, jumped from the north side of Everest wearing a specially designed wingsuit. Rozov's leap set the record for the highest BASE jump in history, launching from an altitude of 23,687 feet (7,220 meters) above sea level. BASE stands for buildings, antennas, spans, and earth, describing the types of fixed objects used for such jumps. The experienced jumper, who has completed around 10,000 jumps in his career, spent two years preparing for this challenge, developing a specialized wingsuit and training intensively. A team of four Sherpas assisted him on the journey to the jump site. Rozov's descent lasted about one minute, reaching speeds of up to 125 miles per hour. He began his flight from Everest's north face on the Chinese side and landed safely on the Rongbuk glacier in Tibet at an altitude of 5,950 meters. Rozov is no stranger to extreme jumps. In 2009, he leaped into an active volcano on Russia's Kamchatka Peninsula. In 2010, he jumped from Ulvetanna, a 2,000-meter-high peak in Antarctica, and he also completed a jump from Shivling, a Himalayan mountain over 21,000 feet tall. Rozov considered Shivling a crucial step in preparing for the Everest jump. After returning home, Rozov admitted the challenge was greater than he anticipated. 'Only when I got back home did I see how hard it was for me both physically and psychologically,' he said. His record-breaking feat on Everest highlighted the combination of meticulous planning, technical skill, and personal endurance required for such daring accomplishments.

Rozovs spring satte rekord for det højeste BASE-jump i historien med afsæt i 7.220 meters højde over havets overflade (23.687 fod). BASE står for buildings (bygninger), antennas (antenner), spans (broer) og earth (jord), som er de typer faste objekter, man springer fra. Den erfarne jumper, som har udført omkring 10.000 spring i sin karriere, brugte to år på at forberede sig til denne udfordring med udvikling af sin specialsyede wingsuit og intens træning. Fire Sherpaer hjalp ham med at nå frem til hopstedet. Rozovs nedstigning varede cirka et minut, hvor han nåede hastigheder op til 200 kilometer i timen. Han startede sit spring fra Everests nordside på den kinesiske side og landede sikkert på Rongbuk-gletsjeren i Tibet i en højde af 5.950 meter. Rozov er ikke uvant med ekstreme spring. Rozov betragtede springet fra Shivling som et vigtigt skridt i forberedelserne til Everest-springet. Efter at være kommet hjem indrømmede Rozov, at udfordringen var større, end han havde forventet. 'Først da jeg kom hjem, indså jeg, hvor hårdt det havde været for mig både fysisk og psykisk,' sagde han. Hans rekordbrydende bedrift på Everest fremhævede den nøjagtige planlægning, tekniske dygtighed og personlige udholdenhed, der kræves til sådanne vovede præstationer.

article_content: Candy Calderon, a Certified Brain Health Professional and Holistic Health & Wellness Coach, was inspired to change careers after her mother received a cancer diagnosis. Beyond the initial shock and fear of losing her mother – who was also her close friend and confidante – Calderon pursued studies at the Institute of Integrative Nutrition in New York. She holds a Bachelor’s in Business and a Master’s in International Business, but shifted her focus to learn about holistic health while her mother endured a challenging four-year battle with cancer. Utilizing her knowledge as a certified holistic nutrition and wellness coach, Calderon aimed to find healing strategies to support her mother's survival. However, after her mother was declared cancer-free, Calderon noticed troubling symptoms: her mother began to forget things and become agitated, which Calderon identified as 'chemo brain,' a form of cognitive decline related to chemotherapy. Motivated to help her mother recover and thrive, Calderon delved into research on cognitive decline and preventive measures, even as she managed a private practice and created wellness content. During this time, she realized that her own lifestyle increased her risk for similar health issues. As a certified Brain Health Professional, Calderon now understands how stress significantly affects both body and mind. Challenging hustle culture and ingrained beliefs about hard work, especially as an Afro-Caribbean woman and immigrant, Calderon decided to prioritize health over constant productivity. She now raises awareness of simple steps anyone can take to support brain health. Calderon highlights that millennials – especially women, who live longer and are more at risk for cognitive decline – should be mindful of brain health and longevity. Women make up 70% of new Alzheimer’s cases. Chronic stress, especially in the workplace, is a major contributor to health issues, with over 30% of U.S. employees reporting frequent job-related stress. The economic impact of stress is enormous; in 2017, the American Psychological Association estimated these costs at $300 billion, and by 2050, the cost of cognitive decline illnesses like Alzheimer’s could rise to $750 billion yearly. Calderon founded CEO Wellness Club, a health program for leaders and executives, to address holistic and brain health in the workplace. Her coaching and programs, which gamify brain improvement practices, have reached thousands worldwide. As a Dominican-American, Calderon also advocates for diversity in the wellness industry and has been featured by prominent brands and media. She offers three main tips for optimizing brain health: nourishing the brain with a balanced diet (rich in omega-3s, fiber, and probiotics), exercising both physically and mentally, and improving sleep quality. Calderon recommends making environmental adjustments for better sleep and consulting experts when needed.

article_content: A search is ongoing for Aaron Pennington, a 33-year-old Massachusetts man suspected of killing his wife, Breanne Pennington, age 30. Police have described Pennington as 'armed and dangerous.' Breanne was found dead at their Gardner home on Sunday, according to Massachusetts State Police. Pennington's car, a white BMW 320, was discovered by a hunter in a wooded area in Gardner on Monday evening after a police alert. Multiple law enforcement agencies, including canine and aviation units, are currently searching the area. Gardner Police Chief Eric McAvene Jr. stated during a press briefing that authorities assume Pennington is still alive and evading capture. First responders went to the Penningtons' home Sunday morning after their four children told a neighbor they could not find their father and their mother was in her bedroom crying. The neighbor then called 911. According to a criminal complaint, Breanne was found dead in an upstairs bedroom from an apparent gunshot wound to the face. Officers found no other individuals or visible weapons in the home. Investigators learned Breanne had planned to move to Texas with the children due to concerns about Aaron Pennington, who was reportedly dealing with mental health issues. While Breanne was known to possess a firearm for protection, neither she nor Aaron had a license to carry firearms in Massachusetts. Aaron Pennington faces charges of unlawful possession of a firearm. The area being searched is described as a heavily wooded campground used by Boy Scouts and churches, and authorities are conducting a large-scale grid search. Worcester County District Attorney Joseph Early Jr. encouraged local residents to check any surveillance footage, including trail cameras. Pennington served in the U.S. Air Force from 2015 to 2022, attaining the rank of senior airman. He transferred to the Air Force Reserve in mid-2022 and separated from military service in February 2023. Authorities are investigating what survivorship training Pennington may have received during his military service. The public is advised not to approach Pennington but to call 911 if he is seen. He is described as white, 6'2" tall, approximately 175 pounds, with blond hair and blue eyes. Anyone with information should contact Massachusetts State Police at 508-829-8236 or Gardner Police Department at 978-632-5600.

Offentligheden advares mod at tage kontakt til Pennington, men opfordres til straks at kontakte politiet på 112, hvis han ses. Han beskrives som hvid, 188 cm høj, cirka 80 kilo, med blondt hår og blå øjne. Personer med oplysninger bedes kontakte Massachusetts State Police på 508-829-8236 eller Gardner Police Department på 978-632-5600.

article_content: The chief economist of the International Monetary Fund has urged Chinese authorities to implement strong policies to address the ongoing challenges in China's property sector. During a press conference on Tuesday in Marrakesh, Morocco, Pierre-Olivier Gourinchas cautioned that if decisive action is not taken, the problems could spread beyond troubled real estate developers. "Clearly what this is calling for is forceful action by the authorities," Gourinchas stated, according to Bloomberg. Two of China's largest property developers, Evergrande and Country Garden, have been in the news this summer, each facing significant debt burdens. This week, bond investors in Evergrande warned that the company — which filed for Chapter 15 bankruptcy protection in August — could face an "uncontrolled collapse," potentially affecting the entire property sector. Gourinchas recommended that Beijing support the restructuring of struggling developers to prevent growing financial instability, keep risks contained within the property market, and restore household confidence. These comments came as the IMF lowered its economic forecast for China, and reports circulated that China may increase its budget deficit for 2023 amid discussions of new stimulus measures. The IMF revised its 2023 growth forecast for China from 5.2% to 5%, and its 2024 forecast from 4.5% to 4.2%, citing the property sector as a key challenge.
translated_content: Den administrerende cheføkonom for Den Internationale Valutafond (IMF) har opfordret de kinesiske myndigheder til at gennemføre stærke politiske tiltag for at imødegå de aktuelle udfordringer i Kinas ejendomssektor. På en pressekonference tirsdag i Marrakesh, Marokko, advarede Pierre-Olivier Gourinchas om, at hvis der ikke træffes afgørende handlinger, risikerer problemerne at brede sig ud over de nødlidende ejendomsudviklere. "Det er tydeligt, at dette kræver kraftfulde tiltag fra myndighedernes side," sagde Gourinchas ifølge Bloomberg. To af Kinas største ejendomsudviklere, Evergrande og Country Garden, har været i mediernes søgelys denne sommer, begge med betydelige gældsbyrder. I denne uge advarede obligationsinvestorer i Evergrande om, at virksomheden — som indgav konkursbegæring under Chapter 15 i august — kan stå over for et "ukontrolleret sammenbrud," der potentielt kan give problemer i hele ejendomssektoren. Gourinchas anbefalede, at Beijing hjælper de nødlidende udviklere med at omstrukturere for at forhindre øget finansiel ustabilitet, holde risiciene begrænsede til ejendomsmarkedet og genoprette husstandenes tillid. Udtalelserne kom, samtidig med at IMF nedjusterede sine økonomiske prognoser for Kina, mens der kom rapporter om, at Kina overvejer at øge sit budgetunderskud for 2023 i lyset af mulige nye stimulustiltag. IMF har nedjusteret sin vækstprognose for Kina i 2023 fra 5,2% til 5% og i 2024 fra 4,5% til 4,2% og angiver ejendomssektoren som en væsentlig udfordring.

article_content: Sahra Wagenknecht, a well-known figure in Germany’s left-wing political scene, has unveiled her intention to form a new party called the 'Sahra Wagenknecht Alliance – for Reason and Fairness.' The official launch is planned for January, just before the European Parliament elections in June and several key state elections in eastern Germany. Wagenknecht’s platform blends progressive economic views—like higher wages and strong social programs—with a more restrictive stance on immigration. She has criticized the German government’s approach to supplying arms to Ukraine and the sanctions on Russia, arguing that these tactics have resulted in higher energy costs for Germany without practical alternatives. She also questions current environmental policies, suggesting that some measures are ineffective and drive up living costs without making meaningful climate progress. Wagenknecht advocates for focusing instead on developing technologies that support a sustainable, climate-friendly future. Highlighting problems within the education sector, she argues that uncontrolled immigration has added to existing difficulties in German schools. Political analysts observe that this new party could appeal to voters frustrated with established parties, especially in eastern Germany where economic struggles and support for the Alternative for Germany (AfD) party are more widespread. Wagenknecht is clear that her party won’t partner with AfD, aiming instead to provide a credible alternative for those dissatisfied with the current choices—including former Left Party supporters—without turning to the far right. Her party emerges at a moment when public approval of Olaf Scholz’s coalition government is waning, and opinion polls place conservatives and AfD ahead. Wagenknecht and fellow lawmaker Amira Mohamed Ali, along with eight others, left the Left Party due to ongoing disagreements over policies like migration and climate change, putting the future of the party at increased risk.
translated_content: Sahra Wagenknecht, en velkendt skikkelse på den tyske venstrefløj, har annonceret sin hensigt om at danne et nyt parti ved navn 'Sahra Wagenknecht-alliancen – for fornuft og retfærdighed.' Den officielle lancering er planlagt til januar, lige før valget til Europa-Parlamentet i juni samt flere vigtige delstatsvalg i det østlige Tyskland. Wagenknechts program kombinerer progressive økonomiske synspunkter – som højere lønninger og stærke velfærdsordninger – med en mere restriktiv tilgang til immigration. Hun har kritiseret den tyske regerings tilgang til våbenleverancer til Ukraine og sanktionerne mod Rusland og mener, at disse beslutninger har ført til højere energipriser i Tyskland uden brugbare alternativer. Hun sætter også spørgsmålstegn ved den nuværende miljøpolitik og hævder, at nogle tiltag er ineffektive og fordyrer hverdagen uden markant effekt på klimaet. I stedet opfordrer Wagenknecht til at investere i teknologier, der kan understøtte en bæredygtig og klimavenlig fremtid. Hun fremhæver desuden problemer i uddannelsessystemet og hævder, at ukontrolleret immigration har forværret udfordringerne i tyske skoler. Politiske analytikere vurderer, at det nye parti kan tiltrække vælgere, der er frustrerede over de etablerede partier, især i Østtyskland, hvor økonomiske problemer og opbakning til Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) er større. Wagenknecht slår fast, at hendes parti ikke vil samarbejde med AfD. I stedet ønsker hun at tilbyde et reelt alternativ til dem, der mangler tillid til de nuværende muligheder – blandt andet tidligere Venstreparti-vælgere – uden at skulle vælge den yderste højrefløj. Partiet dannes på et tidspunkt, hvor opbakningen til Olaf Scholz’ regeringskoalition er lav, og meningsmålinger placerer både de konservative og AfD i spidsen. Wagenknecht og Amira Mohamed Ali samt otte andre parlamentsmedlemmer har forladt Venstrepartiet efter uenigheder om blandt andet migration og klima, hvilket svækker partiets position.

article_content:
No amount of economic growth guarantees employment if you are unfairly caught by inaccuracies in the FBI's background check system. Mistakes in FBI files can also cause you to lose a job. After 33 years of incident-free work at a Philadelphia port, Russ F. lost his job when a post-9/11 security clearance check uncovered an arrest from 1971—though he had never been charged or prosecuted. The nearly 40-year-old arrest appeared on his FBI background check without further details, forcing him to spend months proving he had not been convicted or charged before he could return to work.

A National Employment Law Project report found that the FBI carried out a record 16.9 million employment background checks—six times more than a decade ago—for a variety of jobs, from child care workers to truck drivers. While background checks can enhance workplace safety, inaccuracies in the FBI database prevent about 600,000 qualified Americans yearly from securing work. This barrier to employment needs urgent correction.

The main problem is that FBI records often lack information about the final outcome of arrests. Cases might have been dismissed or charges reduced, but these results often fail to appear on reports to potential employers. The Bureau of Justice Statistics reports that about one-third of felony arrests do not end in convictions, and many others are lessened to misdemeanors. According to the Justice Department, about 50% of FBI background checks are incomplete, missing crucial final outcomes. Correcting such records is difficult and costly, with only a small fraction of job seekers succeeding. Those who cannot fix their records may face long-term unemployment and poverty—a cycle U.S. Attorney General Eric Holder criticized in a recent speech.

For example, Raquel Vanderpool, a nurse’s aide in Michigan, lost her job after an erroneous FBI background check reported an old conviction that had actually been dismissed and sealed. She spent four years out of work, exhausting unemployment benefits, relying on food assistance, losing her vehicle, and eventually having to short-sell her home before clearing her record. Now reemployed, she faces years of financial recovery.

These errors particularly harm African Americans and Latinos, who are already disproportionately impacted by the criminal justice system. Faulty records extend periods of unemployment for these groups as they attempt to correct their records.

What solutions exist? The FBI, which gathers data from states, should provide complete and current information to employers. The Brady Handgun Violence Prevention Act offers a model: for firearm checks, the FBI gathers any missing disposition data within three days, significantly reducing errors. Implementing a similar system for employment checks could help about 390,000 workers annually. Legislation to clean up FBI employment background checks, proposed by Rep. Bobby Scott and Rep. Keith Ellison, is currently pending.

In addition to new laws, the FBI could improve practices immediately by accepting more updated records from federal and state agencies. The FBI seal is supposed to represent trustworthy information, but until improvements are made, these records continue to create unacceptable barriers for workers.

Økonomisk vækst garanterer ikke, at du får et job, hvis du uretfærdigt bliver fanget af fejl i FBI’s baggrundstjek-system. Fejl i FBI’s filer kan også koste dig jobbet. En rapport fra National Employment Law Project viser, at FBI gennemførte rekordmange 16,9 millioner baggrundstjek til ansættelser—seks gange flere end for ti år siden—for alt fra børnepasning til lastbilchauffører. Denne uretfærdige barriere kræver akut handling.

Problemet er, at FBI’s registre ofte mangler oplysninger om den endelige afgørelse på anholdelser. Sager kan være blevet droppet eller ændret til mildere sigtelser, men det fremgår ofte ikke i rapporterne til arbejdsgivere. Bureau of Justice Statistics vurderer, at cirka en tredjedel af alle anholdelser for alvorlige forbrydelser ikke ender med domfældelse, og mange omklassificeres til forseelser. Ifølge Justitsministeriet er omkring 50 % af FBI’s baggrundstjek ufuldstændige og mangler afgørende oplysninger om sagens udfald. Det er svært og dyrt at få rettet disse fejl, og kun få jobsøgende lykkes med det. Dem, der ikke kan rette fejlene, risikerer langvarig ledighed og fattigdom—en ond cirkel, som USA’s justitsminister Eric Holder for nylig påpegede.

Et eksempel er Raquel Vanderpool, en social- og sundhedshjælper fra Michigan, der mistede sit job efter et fejlagtigt FBI-baggrundstjek viste en gammel dom, som egentlig var blevet droppet og forseglet. Hun var fire år uden arbejde, brugte dagpenge op, var afhængig af madkuponer, mistede sin bil og måtte sælge sit hus, før hun fik renset sin sag. Nu har hun arbejde igen, men det vil tage år at genoprette sin økonomi.

Fejl som disse rammer især afroamerikanere og latinoer, der i forvejen er hårdt ramt af retssystemet. Forkerte oplysninger forlænger ledighed for disse grupper, mens de prøver at få oplysningerne rettet.

Hvad kan gøres? FBI, der indsamler data fra delstaterne, bør give arbejdsgivere fuldstændige og opdaterede oplysninger. Brady-loven om våbenkontrol er et forbillede: Her indhenter FBI manglende oplysninger på tre dage, hvilket nedbringer fejl markant. Keith Ellison.

Foruden ny lovgivning kunne FBI straks forbedre praksis ved at acceptere opdaterede oplysninger fra føderale og statslige myndigheder. FBI’s stempel skal stå for troværdighed, men indtil det sker, udgør disse registre fortsat en uacceptabel barriere for arbejdstagere.

article_content: As Morocco faces the aftermath of a catastrophic earthquake totaling nearly $12 billion in damages, the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and World Bank have shifted their attention to Africa in an effort to stabilize the global economy during challenging times of conflict, inequality, and climate change. For the first time in fifty years, these annual meetings are being held in Africa, in Marrakech, against a backdrop of criticism over the limited representation of lower-income countries, especially African nations, in these institutions. Both the IMF and the World Bank have now pledged to expand African representation on their executive boards. Kristalina Georgieva, Managing Director of the IMF, addressed the conference with African entrepreneurs, underlining the focus on Africa even as specific plans remain to be formulated. Traditionally seen as lenders of last resort, the IMF and World Bank issue substantial loans to distressed economies—loans that often come with requirements for fiscal reforms or subsidy reductions. African leaders have long argued that such conditions can force governments into difficult decisions, such as sacrificing basic services or infrastructure development to receive financial aid. Morocco’s Finance Minister, Nadia Fettah, highlighted the problem of limited resources, emphasizing that nations should not have to choose between servicing debt and ensuring food security or investing in climate resilience and external growth. She asserted that emerging economies need comprehensive support, and that Africa’s development is essential for future global growth. From Egypt to Ghana, resistance has mounted over the difficult trade-offs required by these financial institutions. Critics maintain that the governance of the IMF and World Bank systematically disadvantages the world’s most vulnerable nations, a situation that became especially clear during the COVID-19 pandemic when rich countries shielded their economies as poorer nations took on extra debt. Iskander Erzini Vernoit from Morocco’s Imal Initiative for Climate and Development drew attention to the huge financing gaps faced by developing countries and the affordability of international loans. The impact of global shocks—such as surging prices caused by the war in Ukraine—has exacerbated hardships in regions like Africa, where countries often spend more repaying debt than on healthcare or education. There are increasing calls for the IMF and World Bank to better integrate climate change adaptation into their lending approach. After last month's earthquake, Morocco received a $1.3 billion loan from the IMF to help boost disaster readiness. As a frequent borrower, Morocco has relied on loans to soften economic blows, with the IMF pushing for budget discipline and continued increases in interest rates. While Moroccan cities feature striking new infrastructure, including renovated airports, improved roads, and a new high-speed rail system, progress is far less apparent in rural communities. Conference attendees were welcomed by a video showcasing Morocco’s rapid growth, but in earthquake-affected mountain villages, locals contend with unpaved roads, water shortages, and unemployment. Brahim Ait Brahim, an unemployed miner in the village of Anerni near the quake's epicenter, describes the stark contrast: Marrakech embodies Morocco's image and tourism appeal, while people in remote areas continue to suffer and wait for promised assistance weeks after the disaster. This disparity reflects broader issues in achieving equitable progress across the country.
translated_content: Mens Marokko kæmper med følgerne af et ødelæggende jordskælv, der forårsagede skader for næsten 12 milliarder dollars, har Den Internationale Valutafond (IMF) og Verdensbanken rettet blikket mod Afrika i forsøget på at stabilisere verdensøkonomien i en tid præget af konflikter, ulighed og klimaforandringer. For første gang i 50 år afvikles de årlige møder i Afrika, nærmere bestemt Marrakech, midt i kritik af den begrænsede repræsentation af lavindkomstlande – især afrikanske nationer – i institutionerne. Både IMF og Verdensbanken har nu lovet at øge Afrikas repræsentation i deres bestyrelser. Kristalina Georgieva, chef for IMF, understregede Afrikas betydning under en paneldebat med afrikanske iværksættere, selvom konkrete tiltag endnu ikke er fastlagt. IMF og Verdensbanken har traditionelt fungeret som sidste udvej for økonomisk pressede lande og ydet store lån med krav om økonomiske reformer eller nedskæringer i subsidier. Afrikanske ledere påpeger, at sådanne betingelser kan tvinge regeringer til hårde valg mellem grundlæggende services og økonomisk støtte. Marokkos finansminister Nadia Fettah pegede på ressourcemangel og insisterede på, at lande ikke bør tvinges til at vælge mellem gældsafdrag og fødevaresikkerhed eller klimamæssig robusthed og ekstern vækst. Hun understregede, at udviklingsøkonomier har brug for helhedsorienteret støtte, og at Afrikas fremgang er vigtig for global vækst. Fra Egypten til Ghana er modstanden mod de hårde krav fra finansinstitutionerne stigende. Kritikere mener, at styringsstrukturen i IMF og Verdensbanken gør verdens fattigste lande svagere – noget der blev tydeligt under COVID-19, hvor de rige beskyttede deres økonomier, mens fattigere lande optog mere gæld. Iskander Erzini Vernoit fra Imal Initiative for Climate and Development i Marokko fremhævede de enorme finansieringshuller udviklingslandene står overfor og satte spørgsmålstegn ved tilgængeligheden af internationale lån. Verdensomspændende kriser – som de stigende priser grundet krigen i Ukraine – har øget presset, især i Afrika, hvor gældsbetalinger ofte overstiger udgifter til sundhed og uddannelse. Presset vokser for, at IMF og Verdensbanken skal tænke klimatilpasning bedre ind i deres politikker. Efter jordskælvet i sidste måned modtog Marokko et IMF-lån på 1,3 milliarder dollars for at styrke beredskabet for fremtidige katastrofer. Marokko har ofte lånt til at modvirke økonomisk tilbagegang, og IMF opfordrer landet til fortsat budgetdisciplin og renteforhøjelser. Marokkos storbyer viser slående moderne infrastruktur som renoverede lufthavne, bedre veje og højhastighedstog, men mange landområder er ikke fulgt med i udviklingen. På konferencen viste en velkomstvideo Marokkos fremgang, mens folk i de jordskælvsramte bjerglandsbyer fortsat kæmper med jordveje, vandmangel og arbejdsløshed. Brahim Ait Brahim, en arbejdsløs minearbejder fra Anerni nær epicentret, beskriver modsætningerne: Marrakech står som Marokkos turistby, mens tilværelsen i mere fjerntliggende områder fortsat er præget af nød og venten på hjælp længe efter katastrofen. Denne forskel illustrerer de store udfordringer med at sikre lige udvikling i hele Marokko.

article_content: Greece has emerged as a key ally of Israel in the Eastern Mediterranean—an alignment difficult to imagine a decade ago and seemingly at odds with Greek public opinion. On October 23, as the Middle East conflict escalated, Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis visited Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in Tel Aviv, declaring, “I come here not just as an ally but as a true friend.” He reiterated Greece’s support for Israel’s right to defend itself in accordance with international law. Unlike some other European leaders, Mitsotakis did not visit Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas, a move that may not resonate with the two-thirds of Greeks who support neutrality in the conflict. According to a Star Channel poll following Mitsotakis’s visit, only 18.4 percent of Greeks support a pro-Israel stance while 11.5 percent back a pro-Palestinian position. Despite advocating humanitarian aid for Palestinians in Gaza, Greece abstained from a United Nations General Assembly vote on October 27 that called for an immediate humanitarian truce between Israel and Hamas—a resolution supported by 120 countries. Eight EU nations voted in favor, but Greece was not among them, noted Dimitris Papadimoulis, a European Parliament member from the opposition Syriza party. Papadimoulis argued that a more balanced approach would better preserve Greece’s relations with the Arab world and promote peace. Nonetheless, Greece joined a European Council call for “safe and unhindered humanitarian access” in Gaza, including pauses and corridors for aid. Beyond official statements, Greece has supported Israel logistically, with U.S. military transport aircraft stationed at American facilities in Crete and near Athens, reportedly for a possible evacuation of U.S. citizens from Israel. Greece’s current foreign policy, now supported by both right- and left-leaning parties, contrasts sharply with its Cold War-era pro-Palestinian stance when Greece lacked full diplomatic relations with Israel. In 1982, Greek ships helped Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat reach safety in Athens during the Israeli invasion of Lebanon, and pro-Palestinian protests were common in Athens. At that time, maintaining good relations with Arab states was important for shipping interests and to secure diplomatic support, especially concerning the Cyprus issue after Turkey’s 1974 intervention. Formal diplomatic ties with Israel were established in 1990 by then-Prime Minister Konstantine Mitsotakis. Israel’s close ties with Turkey in the 1990s complicated Greek-Israeli relations, as Greece had to balance regional alignments. Relations shifted dramatically in 2010 after a flotilla incident involving Turkey and Israel, leading to a break in Turkish-Israeli ties. Greece quickly strengthened its partnership with Israel as Israel sought to improve its relations with the European Union. Over the past 15 years, cooperation between Greece and Israel has grown. Following Israel’s discovery of the Leviathan gas field in 2010, they pursued joint energy projects, such as the EastMed pipeline. Greek and Israeli firms have collaborated on energy and defense initiatives, including undersea pipelines, a floating gas platform (Energean), and joint ventures in the defense industry. Security ties have been bolstered, with Greece acquiring Israeli drones, anti-drone systems, and missile defense technology. The two countries have signed cybersecurity agreements and Israel has invested in Greek defense industries, including the joint flight training center in Kalamata and takeover of Hellenic Vehicles Industry. Meanwhile, relations between Turkey and Israel have become strained, with Turkey supporting Hamas and providing its leaders sanctuary, setting Ankara apart from Greece and the U.S. The Turkish-Israeli split has helped push Greece and Israel closer, as observed by Israeli ambassador Noam Katz. These shifting alliances highlight how energy, defense, and regional politics are shaping Greece's foreign policy today.
translated_content: Grækenland er blevet en vigtig allieret for Israel i det østlige Middelhav—en udvikling, der for bare et årti siden ville have været utænkelig og tilsyneladende også strider imod den græske offentlige mening. Den 23. oktober, samtidig med optrapningen af konflikten i Mellemøsten, besøgte den græske premierminister Kyriakos Mitsotakis den israelske premierminister Benjamin Netanyahu i Tel Aviv og erklærede: “Jeg kommer her ikke kun som en allieret, men som en sand ven.” Han gentog Grækenlands støtte til Israels ret til at forsvare sig i overensstemmelse med international lov. I modsætning til nogle andre europæiske ledere besøgte Mitsotakis ikke den palæstinensiske præsident Mahmoud Abbas—et træk, der måske ikke falder i god jord hos de to tredjedele af grækerne, der foretrækker neutralitet i konflikten. Ifølge en Star Channel-måling efter Mitsotakis’ besøg støtter kun 18,4 procent af grækerne en pro-israelsk linje, mens 11,5 procent bakker op om en pro-palæstinensisk holdning. Selvom Grækenland har udtalt sig for humanitær hjælp til palæstinenserne i Gaza, undlod landet at stemme ved FN’s generalforsamlingsafstemning den 27. oktober om en øjeblikkelig humanitær våbenhvile mellem Israel og Hamas—en resolution, der blev støttet af 120 lande. Otte EU-lande stemte for, men Grækenland var ikke blandt dem, pointerede Dimitris Papadimoulis fra oppositionspartiet Syriza i Europa-Parlamentet. Papadimoulis argumenterede, at en mere balanceret tilgang bedre ville bibeholde Grækenlands forhold til den arabiske verden og fremme fred. Ikke desto mindre deltog Grækenland i en opfordring fra Det Europæiske Råd om “sikker og uhindret humanitær adgang” i Gaza, herunder pauser og korridorer for nødhjælp. Ud over officielle udtalelser har Grækenland støttet Israel logistisk ved at tillade amerikanske transportfly at opholde sig på amerikanske baser på Kreta og nær Athen, angiveligt for at muliggøre en eventuel evakuering af amerikanske statsborgere fra Israel. Den nuværende græske udenrigspolitik, som har opbakning fra både højre- og venstrefløjspartier, står i skærende kontrast til den tidligere udtalte pro-palæstinensiske linje under den kolde krig, hvor landet ikke havde fulde diplomatiske forbindelser til Israel. I 1982 hjalp græske skibe den palæstinensiske leder Yasser Arafat i sikkerhed til Athen under den israelske invasion af Libanon, og pro-palæstinensiske demonstrationer var hyppige i Athens gader. På det tidspunkt var et godt forhold til arabiske lande vigtigt for rederiernes interesser og for at sikre diplomatisk støtte, især vedrørende Cypern-problematikken efter Tyrkiets intervention i 1974. Formelle diplomatiske forbindelser med Israel blev først etableret i 1990 af daværende premierminister Konstantine Mitsotakis. Israels tætte bånd til Tyrkiet i 1990’erne vanskeliggjorde et græsk-israelsk samarbejde, da Grækenland skulle balancere sine regionale relationer. Forholdet ændrede sig markant i 2010 efter en dramatisk konfrontation med den tyrkiske nødhjælpsflotille, hvilket førte til brudte diplomatiske forbindelser mellem Tyrkiet og Israel. Herefter styrkede Grækenland hurtigt partnerskabet med Israel, samtidig med at Israel ønskede at forbedre relationerne til EU. I de seneste 15 år er samarbejdet mellem Grækenland og Israel vokset betydeligt. Efter opdagelsen af Leviathan-gasfeltet i 2010 har landene forfulgt fælles energiprojekter som EastMed-gasledningen. Græske og israelske virksomheder har samarbejdet om energi- og forsvarsinitiativer, herunder undersøiske rørledninger, Energeans flydende gasplatform og fælles forsvarsprojekter. Sikkerhedssamarbejdet er blevet styrket med Grækenlands indkøb af israelske droner, anti-dronesystemer og missilforsvarsteknologier. Landene har indgået cybersikkerhedsaftaler, og Israel har investeret i græsk forsvarsindustri, blandt andet med et fælles flyvetræningscenter i Kalamata og overtagelse af Hellenic Vehicles Industry. Imens er relationerne mellem Tyrkiet og Israel blevet mere anspændte; Tyrkiet støtter nu Hamas og giver ledelsen ophold, hvilket placerer Ankara i modstrid med Grækenland og USA. Den tyrkisk-israelske splittelse har således bragt Grækenland og Israel tættere sammen, bemærker Israels ambassadør Noam Katz. Disse skiftende alliancer understreger, hvordan energi, forsvar og regionalpolitik former Grækenlands udenrigspolitik i dag.
