article_content: A Swiss train traveling from Bern to Basel was evacuated on Wednesday morning after a passenger spotted a snake on board during rush hour, prompting immediate action by staff. The non-venomous black garter snake, about 19.5 inches (50 cm) long, was found in one of the carriages. Upon being alerted by a passenger, train staff contacted the police, who arrived to handle the situation. All 450 passengers were safely evacuated, according to Donatella Del Vecchio, spokeswoman for Switzerland's national rail company (SBB). Passengers were transferred to another train, which departed approximately 30 minutes later. Police searched the train and eventually found the snake hiding in a ventilation shaft. Authorities believe the snake was most likely brought on board by a passenger and have ruled out the possibility of it entering the train on its own. Incidents involving snakes on Swiss trains have happened before: in 2006, a three-foot snake escaped from its owner on a train in western Switzerland. In that instance, the snake disappeared into the train's roof and was never recovered, despite efforts to lure it out.

Den ikke-giftige sorte strømpebåndsslange, cirka 50 cm lang, blev fundet i en af vognene. Da personalet blev advaret af en passager, tilkaldte de straks politiet, som hurtigt ankom for at håndtere situationen. Alle 450 passagerer blev evakueret sikkert, oplyser Donatella Del Vecchio, talskvinde for det schweiziske togselskab (SBB). Passagererne blev overført til et andet tog, som afgik cirka 30 minutter senere. Politiet gennemsøgte toget og fandt til sidst slangen gemt i en ventilationskanal. Myndighederne mener, at slangen sandsynligvis blev bragt ombord af en passager og afviser, at den selv kunne være kommet ind i toget. Der har tidligere været lignende episoder med slanger i schweiziske tog: I 2006 slap en 90 cm lang slange fra sin ejer på et tog i det vestlige Schweiz. Dengang forsvandt slangen op i togets tag uden nogensinde at blive fundet, trods forsøg på at lokke den frem.

article_content: British public life is dominated by a privileged private school elite, Education Secretary Michael Gove admitted yesterday. He agreed with former Prime Minister Sir John Major, who spoke out about the significant influence held by a small elite. Sir John’s comments created discomfort for current Prime Minister David Cameron, who attended Eton, as his Cabinet is mostly comprised of former private school students. Downing Street insisted that what matters is not background but ambition and progress, echoing the Prime Minister's belief: 'What counts is not where you come from but where you are going.' Michael Gove called Sir John’s comments 'an inescapable fact,' supporting the idea that British society is dominated by those from privileged backgrounds. Sir John has recently become more vocal, calling for a windfall tax on energy companies, action to assist the 'silent have-nots,' and warning about stagnant social mobility. Sir John’s remarks were seen as a subtle critique of the backgrounds of many in Cameron's government, contrasted with his own upbringing in a rented flat in Brixton, South London. During a speech to the South Norfolk Conservative Association, Sir John said: 'In every single sphere of British influence, the upper echelons of power are overwhelmingly held by the privately educated or the affluent middle class. To me, from my background, that's truly shocking.' The government rejected this criticism, saying policies to support progress are more important than politicians' backgrounds. But Michael Gove, who was adopted as a baby, emphasized the need to ensure that vulnerable children are not left behind and that opportunities are more fairly distributed. He added that the government is reforming the school system to spread opportunities more evenly, echoing the Prime Minister’s goal to create a more aspirational nation. Additionally, some Conservatives have suggested returning to grammar schools to help children from less privileged backgrounds. Sir John's recent statements have highlighted concerns about the disconnect between wealthy politicians and the needs of the poor. He blamed Labour for a decline in social mobility and criticized Ed Miliband’s claim of leading a 'one-nation party,' saying the party left society divided. Sir John, who grew up in a rented Brixton flat and attended a comprehensive school, used his own background as an example of social mobility. Many in Cameron’s Cabinet, including David Cameron, George Osborne, Nick Clegg, and Boris Johnson, attended private schools. Sir John called for a system where hard work can bring success, rather than privilege: 'Our education system should help children rise above the circumstances they are born into, not lock them in.'

Sir Johns bemærkninger skabte ubehag for den nuværende premierminister David Cameron, der gik på Eton, da hans kabinet hovedsageligt består af tidligere privatskoleelever. Downing Street insisterede på, at det vigtige ikke er ens baggrund men ambitioner og fremskridt, og bekræftede premierministerens tro: ‘Det, der tæller, er ikke, hvor du kommer fra, men hvor du er på vej hen.’ Michael Gove kaldte Sir Johns udtalelser ‘et uomgængeligt faktum’ og støttede ideen om, at det britiske samfund er domineret af folk med privilegeret baggrund. Han tilføjede, at regeringen er i gang med at reformere skolesystemet for at sprede mulighederne mere jævnt, i tråd med premierministerens mål om at skabe et mere aspirerende samfund. Desuden har nogle konservative foreslået at genindføre grammarskoler for at hjælpe børn fra mindre privilegerede hjem. Han bebrejdede Labour for faldende social mobilitet og kritiserede Ed Milibands påstand om at stå i spidsen for et ‘one-nation party’, idet han sagde, partiet efterlod samfundet splittet. Sir John, som voksede op i en lejet lejlighed i Brixton og gik på en folkeskole, brugte sin egen baggrund som et eksempel på social mobilitet. Sir John opfordrede til et system, hvor hårdt arbejde kan føre til succes i stedet for privilegier: ‘Vores uddannelsessystem skal hjælpe børn op over de vilkår, de er født i – ikke fastlåse dem i dem.’

article_content: With assembly polls approaching, Madhya Pradesh’s Budhni constituency—where BJP’s Shivraj Singh Chouhan faces Congress candidate and actor Vikram Mastal—shows a subdued campaign atmosphere. The contest remains low-key, even with the entry of Samajwadi Party’s Vairagyanand Giri (Mirchi Baba), who has made infrequent visits from Bhopal. BJP flags are prominent across Budhni, while Congress symbols are rare in this constituency, considered Chouhan’s stronghold. Chouhan, who has won the seat multiple times since 1990, has not visited since filing his nomination on October 30, according to Rajesh Kumar Balavi, sarpanch of Jait village. Posters and hoardings welcoming Shivraj Singh Chouhan are seen at key locations. Many supporters believe that electing Chouhan again could secure his fifth term as chief minister, even though the BJP has not officially projected any CM candidate this time. The focus has shifted to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, highlighting the slogan linking Modi with Madhya Pradesh. Vikram Mastal, best known for playing Lord Hanuman on TV, remains confident in his campaign and references local dissatisfaction with Chouhan’s performance. Mastal’s campaign includes supporters chanting slogans, carrying party flags, and using Hanuman-themed symbols. In Chouhan’s absence, his wife Sadhana Singh, son Kartikeya, and other relatives are actively campaigning. Kartikeya motivates party workers to strive for a record victory, stating that Budhni has about 272,000 voters and that government schemes have benefited many residents. Residents like Kamla Bai Kewat, who receives government assistance, express strong support for Chouhan. Others suggest Congress could have run a stronger candidate. Avinash Bhargava credits Chouhan with local development, such as new industries and schools. Mirchi Baba, recently acquitted in a legal case, accuses the Chouhan government of framing him, and asks voters to support him with promises to build ghats on the Narmada river. Chouhan is widely recognized for his long tenure as chief minister, aside from 15 months of Congress rule after 2018. He holds the distinction of being the country’s longest-serving BJP chief minister. The article also notes India’s industrial growth slowed to 5.8% in September, Ranjan Pai’s investment of Rs 1,400 crore in Aakash Institute, and business trends involving young professionals.

article_content:
Recent research suggests that footballers with wider faces—measured by a higher facial-width-to-height ratio (FWHR)—tend to have greater on-field success but may also be more likely to commit fouls. The study, led by Dr. Keith Welker from the University of Colorado at Boulder, analyzed the FWHRs of 1,000 players from 32 countries who participated in the 2010 FIFA World Cup. The FWHR is determined by dividing the width of the face (distance between cheekbones) by its height (distance from the mid-brow to the upper lip).

According to the findings, players with higher FWHRs, particularly midfielders and forwards, were statistically more likely to score goals and receive fouls. Notable footballers such as Wayne Rooney, Mario Balotelli, and Frank Lampard are cited as having higher FWHRs. For instance, Rooney, who will soon celebrate 100 appearances for England, has accumulated six red cards in his career, while Balotelli has scored 33 international goals but also received 50 yellow cards.

The study's results were published in the journal Adaptive Human Behaviour and Physiology. Previous research indicates that wider-faced individuals tend to be perceived as more dominant and aggressive. For example, men with higher FWHRs reportedly earn higher bonuses, but may face challenges in business negotiations and are less likely to be preferred for long-term relationships.

Researchers suggest FWHR may be influenced by exposure to testosterone during puberty, which can impact a range of physical traits, including facial structure. While most prior studies focused on athletes in the US and Canada, Dr. Welker’s research aims to provide a more global perspective by analyzing players from diverse backgrounds.

The implications of these findings extend beyond football and may be relevant to other sports such as rugby and cycling. Athletes like James Haskell (rugby) and Chris Hoy (cycling) are also mentioned as examples. Scientists continue to explore how facial structure might relate to aggression and athletic performance.

Studiet, ledet af Dr. Keith Welker fra University of Colorado at Boulder, analyserede FWHR på 1.000 spillere fra 32 lande, som deltog i VM i fodbold 2010. article_content: Anna Taylor, 33, from Worthing, West Sussex, used a sunbed almost daily for three years, often spending up to an hour each night in her spare room. After over 900 hours of tanning, she switched to fake tan products and avoided sunbathing to prevent wrinkles, but the damage was already done. In January last year, doctors found a small cancerous spot on her face. Surgeons removed a tumor the size of a 5p coin from beside her nose, which required 29 stitches and left a prominent scar running from her eye to her mouth. Anna said she used to feel confident about her looks, but her lifelong scar now serves as a daily reminder of the consequences of using sunbeds. Anna began using sunbeds at 18 and eventually bought one for her home, thinking they were less harmful than sunlight—a belief she now rejects. She wants to warn others, especially young women, that sunbeds are not worth the risk. She first rented a sunbed for a holiday at 18, later purchasing her own, and used it nearly every night except Sundays, stopping in her early 20s. Years later, after noticing a persistent spot by her nose in 2010, a doctor diagnosed her with basal cell carcinoma in January last year. Basal cell carcinoma is a common type of non-melanoma skin cancer, mainly caused by UV exposure. It typically presents as a lump or patch that does not heal. While rarely fatal, it can cause significant disfigurement. About 100,000 new cases are diagnosed annually in the UK, with risk factors including fair skin, family history, and high levels of UV exposure. Anna underwent two thirty-minute surgeries under local anaesthetic at Royal Alexandra Hospital, Sussex, to remove the tumor and some surrounding healthy tissue. Surgeons then stretched skin from below her eye to her mouth to close the wound and create a flat scar. Anna described the experience as traumatic and initially damaging to her confidence, but she is learning to live with her scar and hopes to persuade others to avoid sunbeds. She encourages the use of self-tanning products as a safer alternative. Now, Anna is committed to raising awareness about the dangers of sunbeds and urges others to make safer choices to avoid the consequences she now faces.

article_content: The Khoja Shia Ishnaashari (KSI) Jamaat, a close-knit global community, is conducting a significant internal survey to understand the social and economic backgrounds of its people. While they refer to it informally as a 'census,' the initiative is a comprehensive data-gathering effort organized by the community itself. The results will help both local Jamaats and the World Federation of KSI, based in London, better support members in healthcare, housing, and education. At a recent event in Mumbai where educational scholarships were presented for the years 2020–2023, community leaders stressed how essential it is for everyone to participate in the survey. Held at Kaiser Baug, the gathering included notable leaders, politicians, parents, and scholarship recipients, and focused on the importance of submitting information through the KSI Jamaat online portal. Ali Akbar Shroff, president of the KSI Mumbai Jamaat, shared that the survey collects details about education, employment, living arrangements, and health needs, plus basic identification. He estimated the global Khoja Shia population at 125,000 to 135,000, with about 50,000 in India and 20,000 in Mumbai. Leaders said that accurate data will allow them to address community issues effectively. For instance, construction is planned for new housing in Palghar and Neral to benefit families currently living in overcrowded city neighborhoods. The survey is also designed to spread awareness about relevant government assistance programs. Distinguished guests, both local and international, praised the community's achievements while highlighting the need to identify and help those still facing difficulties. Shaikh Safdar Jaffer, president of the World Federation of KSIMC, traveled in from London specifically to encourage community members to complete the survey. Women actively participated in the event, from following proceedings to helping organize the survey. Local politicians commended the Jamaat for its focus on women’s empowerment and its commitment to broader community service via schools and hospitals. To motivate younger members, volunteers offered incentives to those who filled out the survey forms at the event. Mohammed Raza Nathani, representing the World Federation Youth Task Force in India, observed a strong response from young attendees. Acclaimed snooker champion Yasin Merchant, recognized for his contributions to both the community and India, encouraged all members to participate, emphasizing that unity and collective action are key to progress.

Fremtrædende gæster, både lokale og internationale, roste fællesskabets resultater, men påpegede også behovet for at identificere og hjælpe dem, der stadig har det svært. For at engagere de unge blev der uddelt præmier til dem, der udfyldte undersøgelsen ved begivenheden. Mohammed Raza Nathani, der repræsenterer World Federations ungdomsteam i Indien, bemærkede en stor opbakning blandt de unge deltagere. Snooker-stjernen Yasin Merchant, der regnes som en stolt repræsentant for både fællesskabet og Indien, opfordrede alle til at deltage i undersøgelsen og understregede, at fælles indsats er vejen til fremgang.

article_content: A widely reported story in the tech world claimed that Google had acquired ICOA, a Wi-Fi provider, for $400 million. Major news organizations, including The Associated Press and tech blogs like TechCrunch, published the story after a press release distributed by PR Web. Subsequently, both Google and ICOA denied the acquisition, confirming the story was false. PR Web acknowledged that the release was fraudulently submitted by someone posing as an ICOA representative. This incident highlighted the risks of misinformation in fast-paced web journalism, where the desire to publish quickly can lead to insufficient fact-checking. Kelly McBride of the Poynter Institute and other experts criticized both PR Web and the journalists involved for failing to spot errors in the press release, which contained grammatical mistakes and lacked basic company information. The hoax temporarily inflated ICOA’s stock price before trading was frozen. Vocus, PR Web’s parent firm, apologized for the incident and promised improvements in its review process. Afterward, several media outlets, including the AP and TechCrunch, issued corrections or apologies. The event underscores the ongoing challenges of ensuring accuracy and accountability in digital journalism.

Efterfølgende afviste både Google og ICOA opkøbet og bekræftede, at historien var falsk. PR Web indrømmede, at udmeldingen var blevet sendt af en person, der udgav sig for at være ICOA-repræsentant. Hændelsen synliggjorde risikoen for misinformation i hurtig webjournalistik, hvor ønsket om hurtig publicering kan føre til mangelfuldt faktatjek. Kelly McBride fra Poynter Institute og andre eksperter rettede kritik mod både PR Web og journalisterne for ikke at opdage fejlene i pressemeddelelsen, som indeholdt grammatiske fejl og manglede basale virksomhedsoplysninger. Svindlen fik kortvarigt ICOAs aktiekurs til at stige, indtil handlen blev stoppet. Vocus, PR Web’s moderselskab, undskyldte episoden og lovede at forbedre deres kontrolprocesser. Derefter udsendte flere medier, blandt andet AP og TechCrunch, rettelser eller undskyldninger. Begivenheden understreger de udfordringer, der stadig består med at sikre nøjagtighed og ansvarlighed i digital journalistik.

article_content:
George Ford scored 24 points as Bath strengthened their position near the top of the Aviva Premiership with a commanding 39-16 win over rivals Gloucester. Ford was outstanding, successfully kicking six penalties and converting both a penalty try and two tries by Matt Garvey. This victory marked Bath’s largest-ever Premiership win at Kingsholm.

Although Gloucester exerted early pressure, they could only manage three penalties through scrum-half Greig Laidlaw and a late try from substitute Dan Robson, which fly-half James Hook converted. Despite rumors ahead of the match suggesting Bath and Saracens are under investigation for potential Premiership salary cap breaches—rumors which remain unconfirmed—the Bath squad focused on the task at hand in this key West Country derby.

Sam Burgess, Bath’s marquee signing of the season, was named on the bench after starting the previous week in the European Challenge Cup. In front of a sell-out crowd, Gloucester had early control, but Bath’s disciplined play and George Ford’s precise kicking turned the tide. Even though Ford made a rare first-half handling error, his overall performance was exceptional.

Intense defense from both teams kept the score tight for much of the first half, and missed penalty attempts by both Laidlaw and Billy Twelvetrees meant Gloucester couldn’t capitalize on their dominance. Ford kept Bath in front with five penalties in the first half alone, many from significant distance.

The pattern continued in the second half, with Gloucester attacking but Bath’s formidable defense withstanding the pressure. A penalty try was awarded to Bath after Gloucester were penalized and Sila Puafisi was sent to the sin bin. Matt Garvey added his second try shortly before Sam Burgess was introduced, cementing Bath’s lead.

Dan Robson finally crossed for Gloucester’s only try, which Hook converted, but it was too late. Garvey’s second converted try in the final moments sealed a memorable Bath victory.

På trods af rygter før kampen om, at Bath og Saracens skulle være under efterforskning for mulige brud på Premiership's lønloft—rygter, der endnu ikke er bekræftet—fokuserede Bath-truppen på opgaven i dette vigtige West Country-derby.

Mønstret fortsatte efter pausen, hvor Gloucester pressede på, men Baths stærke forsvar holdt stand. article_content: A shadowy organization called the Islamic Resistance in Iraq has posted videos on Telegram showing Iranian-backed militia drones launching from the desert, along with messages threatening further strikes and warning Iraqis to avoid U.S. military bases in Iraq and Syria. Although TIME could not independently verify the locations, metadata from the videos matches the dates of confirmed attacks on U.S. bases. For over six months, Iranian-backed groups had paused attacks against U.S. troops in Iraq and Syria; this lull ended after Hamas’s Oct. 7 assault on Israel, which killed over 1,400 people. Since then, attacks have surged: U.S. forces in Iraq and Syria were targeted 13 times in a single week, according to Pentagon spokesperson Pat Ryder on Oct. 24. Most attacks were intercepted, but 24 U.S. troops were injured, and a U.S. contractor died from cardiac arrest during a false alarm. The U.S. has long aimed to reduce its military presence in the Middle East, but these repeated attacks complicate its position and raise the risk of further escalation. Pentagon spokesperson Ryder stated on Oct. 23 that the U.S. lacks proof Iran explicitly ordered these attacks, but officials suggest Iran encourages its proxies. One defense official noted an uptick in such activities shows 'Iranian fingerprints.' Iran supports a network of proxy groups across Lebanon, Syria, Iraq, Yemen, Gaza, and Bahrain. These groups receive training, weapons, and funding from Iran, strengthening Tehran’s regional influence. The Islamic Resistance in Iraq claims at least 11 attacks on U.S. troops so far, serving as an umbrella group for various Iranian-backed militias aiming to show unity while obscuring individual responsibility, according to expert Michael Knights. Experts estimate there are at least 10 to 20 Iranian-backed groups operating between Iraq and Syria, mainly threatening 2,500 U.S. troops in Iraq and 900 in Syria. The Righteous Promise Brigades, an Iraqi militia, has even threatened U.S. forces in Kuwait and the UAE. Recent escalations are linked to U.S. support for Israel; Kataib Hezbollah spokesman Jaafar al Hussein accused the U.S. of enabling the deaths of people in Gaza. These attacks form the largest wave since Iran's response to General Soleimani's 2020 assassination, but have so far involved small-scale rockets or drones rather than large-scale assaults. Experts warn further escalation could be deadly. Secretary of Defense Lloyd Austin warned that significant escalation is possible. Should attacks intensify, tactics could include targeting U.S. helicopters or a return to deadly roadside bombs. On Oct. 19, the USS Carney intercepted missiles and drones from Houthi rebels in the Red Sea, believed to be aimed at Israel. Houthi leader Abdel-Malek al-Houthi warned his group would retaliate against U.S. involvement in Gaza. Despite being over 1,400 miles from the conflict, the Houthis have advanced strike capabilities, enhancing their threat in the Red Sea and Bab-el-Mandeb, according to Behnam Ben Taleblu. In response, the U.S. is reinforcing air defenses and increasing security at regional bases, sending ships—including two aircraft carriers—and more fighter jets to deter Iran and its allies. Secretary of State Anthony Blinken told the UN Security Council on Oct. 24 that the U.S. does not seek conflict with Iran but will defend its people and security if attacked.
translated_content: En skyggefuld organisation kaldet Den Islamiske Modstand i Irak har lagt videoer op på Telegram, hvor iransk-støttede militsdroner ses lette fra ørkenen. Beskederne truer med yderligere angreb og advarer irakere om at holde sig væk fra amerikanske militærbaser i Irak og Syrien. Selvom TIME ikke kunne verificere locations uafhængigt, viser metadata fra videoerne, at de svarer til datoerne for bekræftede angreb på amerikanske baser. I over et halvt år havde iransk-støttede grupper lagt angreb mod amerikanske styrker i Irak og Syrien på is; denne pause sluttede efter Hamas’ angreb på Israel den 7. oktober, hvor mere end 1.400 personer blev dræbt. Siden da er angrebene taget til: Amerikanske styrker i Irak og Syrien blev mål for 13 angreb på én uge, ifølge Pentagons talsmand Pat Ryder den 24. oktober. De fleste angreb blev afværget, men 24 amerikanske soldater blev såret, og en amerikansk kontraktansat døde af hjertestop under en falsk alarm. USA har længe forsøgt at reducere sin militære tilstedeværelse i Mellemøsten, men gentagne angreb gør situationen mere kompleks og øger risikoen for optrapning. Pentagons talsmand Ryder sagde den 23. oktober, at USA ikke har beviser for, at Iran direkte beordrede disse angreb, men embedsmænd antyder, at Iran opmuntrer sine allierede. En forsvarsembedsmand sagde, at den øgede aktivitet viser 'iranske fingeraftryk'. Iran støtter et netværk af proxygrupper i Libanon, Syrien, Irak, Yemen, Gaza og Bahrain. Grupperne får træning, våben og penge fra Iran, hvilket styrker Teherans indflydelse i regionen. Den Islamiske Modstand i Irak har taget ansvar for mindst 11 angreb på amerikanske tropper og fungerer som en paraplygruppe for iransk-støttede militser, der ønsker at vise enhed og skjule individuelt ansvar, ifølge eksperten Michael Knights. Eksperter anslår, at mindst 10 til 20 iransk-støttede grupper opererer mellem Irak og Syrien – de udgør især en trussel mod 2.500 amerikanske soldater i Irak og 900 i Syrien. Righteous Promise Brigades har endda truet amerikanske styrker i Kuwait og De Forenede Arabiske Emirater. De seneste optrapninger kobles til USA’s støtte til Israel. Kataib Hezbollahs talsperson, Jaafar al Hussein, har beskyldt USA for at bidrage til drabene i Gaza. Disse angreb er den største bølge siden Irans reaktion på general Soleimanis drab i 2020, men hidtil har det hovedsagelig været små raket- og droneangreb. Eksperter advarer, at situationen kan optrappes yderligere. Forsvarsminister Lloyd Austin advarede om udsigt til betydelig eskalering. Hvis angrebene forstærkes, kan det inkludere angreb på amerikanske helikoptere eller en tilbagevenden til dødbringende vejsidebomber. Den 19. oktober opsnappede USS Carney missiler og droner fra Houthi-oprørere i Det Røde Hav, formodentlig rettet mod Israel. Houthi-leder Abdel-Malek al-Houthi har advaret om at slå igen mod amerikansk indblanding i Gaza. Selvom Houthierne er mere end 2.200 kilometer fra konflikten, har de avancerede angrebsevner og udgør en større trussel mod Det Røde Hav og Bab-el-Mandeb, ifølge Behnam Ben Taleblu. Som svar styrker USA luftforsvars-systemer og skærper sikkerheden ved deres baser, og sender skibe – herunder to hangarskibe – samt flere jagerfly til regionen for at afskrække Iran og dets allierede. Udenrigsminister Anthony Blinken sagde til FN’s Sikkerhedsråd den 24. oktober, at USA ikke ønsker konflikt med Iran, men vil forsvare sit folk og sin sikkerhed, hvis de angribes.

article_content:
Sixteen-year-old Norwegian footballer Martin Odegaard generated the second highest number of tweets during the January transfer window, after joining European champions Real Madrid. This either speaks to Odegaard’s rising star status or suggests a notably quiet transfer period. The most discussed transfer on Twitter was Juan Cuadrado’s move from Fiorentina to Chelsea, followed by Victor Valdes signing for Manchester United.

Both Cuadrado and Valdes saw substantial increases in their Twitter followers after their moves—Cuadrado gained 100,000 followers and Valdes 145,000. Despite having tweeted only 80 times, Odegaard already boasts 102,000 followers.

Contrary to predictions of a flurry of last-minute deals, this January’s transfer window saw spending remain at last year’s level, totaling £130 million ($195 million), which is significantly below the record of £225 million ($338 million) set in 2010/11.

Despite modest January activity, it has been a record-breaking season overall in England’s Premier League. The league’s 20 clubs collectively spent an estimated £950 million ($1.4 billion) on player recruitment this season, up from last season’s record of £760 million ($1.1 billion), according to Deloitte Sport. This spending surge is attributed to substantial revenue from domestic and overseas television rights. The current three-year TV deal, worth £6.2 billion ($9.4 billion), contributed to a Premier League revenue record of £2.7 billion ($4.19 billion) in the 2012-13 season.

Deloitte’s annual list of the world’s richest clubs highlights English dominance, with five teams in the top ten, eight in the top twenty, and all twenty Premier League clubs represented in the top forty. Manchester United ranks second only to Real Madrid with £399 million ($602 million) in revenue, while Manchester City, Chelsea, Arsenal, and Liverpool also appear in the top ten.

During the summer transfer window, Premier League spending reached £835 million ($1.25 billion), with Manchester United spending about £150 million ($226 million), including £59.7 million ($90 million) for Angel di Maria alone. That figure marked a 30% increase from the previous high, when £630 million ($949 million) was spent.

While August’s transfer window brought excitement and big-money signings, January was comparatively quiet. "Given the record level of spending in the summer, it’s not surprising we haven’t seen a new January record," said Dan Jones of Deloitte. "However, given club revenues, we might have expected more major deals this window. Still, 2014/15 is a record season for Premier League spending. Last season was the first time spending exceeded £700 million, and revenue growth has allowed a combined transfer spend of over £950 million this season."
translated_content:
Den 16-årige norske fodboldspiller Martin Odegaard genererede det næsthøjeste antal tweets under januarens transfervindue, efter at være skiftet til de europæiske mestre Real Madrid. Dette vidner enten om Odegaards stigende stjernestatus eller om et særligt stille transfervindue. Den mest omtalte transfer på Twitter var Juan Cuadrados skifte fra Fiorentina til Chelsea, efterfulgt af Victor Valdes’ kontrakt med Manchester United.

Både Cuadrado og Valdes oplevede markante stigninger i deres følgerskarer på Twitter efter deres skift—Cuadrado fik 100.000 nye følgere og Valdes 145.000. Selvom Odegaard kun har tweetet 80 gange, har han allerede 102.000 følgere.

Trods forventninger om en bølge af store, sene handler, forblev januarens transfervindue på niveau med sidste år, i alt 130 millioner pund (195 millioner dollars), hvilket er betydeligt under rekorden på 225 millioner pund (338 millioner dollars) sat i sæsonen 2010/11.

På trods af lav januar aktivitet har det været en rekordbrydende sæson i Premier League. Ligaens 20 klubber brugte samlet set anslået 950 millioner pund (1,4 milliarder dollars) på spillere denne sæson, en stigning fra sidste års rekord på 760 millioner pund (1,1 milliarder dollars), ifølge Deloitte Sport. Udviklingen skyldes især store indtægter fra nationale og internationale tv-rettigheder. Det nuværende treårige tv-aftale, til en værdi af 6,2 milliarder pund (9,4 milliarder dollars), bidrog til Premier Leagues rekordomsætning på 2,7 milliarder pund (4,19 milliarder dollars) i sæsonen 2012-13.

Deloittes årlige liste over verdens rigeste klubber understreger engelsk dominans med fem hold i top ti, otte i top tyve og alle 20 Premier League-klubber i top fyrre. Manchester United indtager andenpladsen kun overgået af Real Madrid, med en omsætning på 399 millioner pund (602 millioner dollars), mens Manchester City, Chelsea, Arsenal og Liverpool også er i top ti.

I sommerens transfervindue brugte Premier League-klubberne 835 millioner pund (1,25 milliarder dollars), med Manchester United som topspender på cirka 150 millioner pund (226 millioner dollars), hvoraf 59,7 millioner pund (90 millioner dollars) gik til købet af Angel di Maria. Det var en stigning på 30 % sammenlignet med forrige rekord, hvor forbruget var 630 millioner pund (949 millioner dollars).

Mens augusts transfervindue bød på spænding og store handler, var januar langt mere stille. "Givet det rekordhøje forbrug i sommer, er det ikke overraskende, at vi ikke har set en ny januarekord," sagde Dan Jones fra Deloitte. "Med alle Premier League-klubber med rekordomsætninger kunne man dog have forventet flere store handler denne gang. Alligevel er 2014/15 stadig et rekordår for Premier League-forbrug. Sidste sæson var første gang, at forbruget oversteg 700 millioner pund, og indtægtsvæksten har muliggjort samlede transferudgifter på over 950 millioner pund denne sæson."
post_content: Premier League spending is at an all-time high! While January was quiet, young Martin Odegaard’s Real Madrid move blew up Twitter. Big TV deals mean even bigger transfers—#FootballMoney #PL #TransferWindow

article_content: Manchester United are in discussions with former Barcelona goalkeeper Victor Valdes. Manager Louis van Gaal has offered the 32-year-old a chance to complete his knee injury rehabilitation and regain match fitness with the club. Valdes, currently a free agent, will have his recovery overseen by Manchester United medical staff before training with the first team, as he aims to return to full fitness. After not renewing his contract with Barcelona at the end of last season, Valdes became a free agent. During his 12-year career at Barcelona, Valdes made 535 appearances and won numerous honors, including the 2009 European Cup – defeating Manchester United in the final in Rome. He has also earned 20 caps for Spain since 2010. Though Valdes was initially expected to join Liverpool, manager Brendan Rodgers recently dismissed this possibility, reportedly due to Valdes’s reluctance to undertake a four-day trial before signing. Earlier, Valdes’s serious knee ligament injury had scuppered a proposed move to Monaco. He is now fit again and seeking a club that matches his ambitions. Valdes visited United’s Carrington training headquarters with his representatives to explore opportunities. Manchester United want to assess his recovery before committing to any contract, evaluating his fitness closely. While Manchester United are negotiating a new deal with current goalkeeper David de Gea, they are keen to enhance competition in the squad. Valdes’s experience and impressive career credentials make him a strong candidate. Elsewhere, midfielder Michael Carrick is set to continue his recovery from ankle ligament damage by playing for United’s U21s against West Ham United at Rush Green. The 33-year-old, sidelined since July, was an unused substitute during United’s recent 2-2 draw with West Bromwich Albion and is expected to be on the bench against Chelsea at Old Trafford. The tight fixture schedule may mean Carrick appears as a substitute rather than in the starting lineup against Jose Mourinho’s title-chasing Chelsea side. Robin van Persie, United’s Dutch striker, anticipates an intense contest against Chelsea. Despite some recent criticism of his form, van Persie looks forward to such high-stakes matches, noting the heightened excitement and tension among both players and fans.
translated_content: Manchester United er i samtaler med den tidligere Barcelona-målmand Victor Valdes. Manager Louis van Gaal har tilbudt den 32-årige muligheden for at fuldføre sin genoptræning efter en knæskade og genvinde sin kampform i klubben. Valdes, der i øjeblikket er uden kontrakt, vil få sin genoptræning overvåget af Manchester Uniteds lægestab, inden han træner med førsteholdet, mens han arbejder på at vende tilbage til fuld styrke. Efter ikke at have forlænget sin kontrakt med Barcelona ved sidste sæsons afslutning, er Valdes blevet fri på markedet. I løbet af sine 12 år i Barcelona spillede han 535 kampe og vandt adskillige titler, herunder Champions League-trofæet i 2009, hvor Barcelona besejrede Manchester United i finalen i Rom. Han har også opnået 20 landskampe for Spanien siden 2010. Selvom Valdes oprindeligt var ventet at skifte til Liverpool, har manager Brendan Rodgers for nylig afvist muligheden, angiveligt fordi Valdes ikke ønskede en fire dages prøvetræning før kontrakten. Tidligere satte en alvorlig knæskade en stopper for et planlagt skifte til Monaco. Nu er Valdes fit igen og leder efter en klub, der matcher hans ambitioner. Manchester United ønsker at vurdere hans genoptræning, før klubben indgår en kontrakt, og vil nøje evaluere hans form. Kieran Stott, a 16-year-old from Birkenhead, has been issued an Anti-Social Behaviour Order (ASBO) that prohibits him from entering the town centre unless he is accompanied by his mother. Stott is accused of being part of a group of up to 30 young people who engaged in activities such as throwing fireworks at cars and verbally abusing passersby, causing significant alarm among local shoppers and businesses, particularly McDonald's and Bargain Booze. In one incident, witnesses stated Stott appeared to revel in the disruption after a fire hydrant was set off, making the street resemble what was described in court as a 'New York ghetto.'

Stott has been involved in at least 36 reported incidents, including intimidating and harassing members of the public and causing property damage. Magistrates lifted reporting restrictions and made Stott's identity public, emphasizing the need to reassure the community that steps were being taken to address anti-social behaviour.

On social media, Stott has posted provocative images and messages, sometimes displaying imitation weapons and expressing negative sentiments towards police. He refers to himself as a member of the self-styled 'Birkenhead Boyz.'

In court, Stott admitted to some involvement but denied being the ringleader or committing the most serious offences such as throwing fireworks. His mother, Tracie Stott, acknowledged his wrongdoing but argued he is being unfairly portrayed as the main instigator. She described her efforts to discipline him at home and expressed frustration at the impact of the publicity.

Prosecutor Ali Bayatti presented a dossier of 36 incidents attributed to Stott and maintained that his behaviour was sufficiently severe to warrant the ASBO. The ban restricts Stott from parts of Birkenhead, including Grange Road and Grange Road West, unless he is with his mother or using public transport, and also prohibits him from associating publicly with eight named individuals, unless invited by authorities.

Local shopkeeper Mohammed Rizhi described Stott as disruptive and abusive, reporting repeated shoplifting and harassment. Labour Councillor George Davies welcomed the ASBO, stating it sends a clear message that anti-social behaviour will not be tolerated in the community.

Ved én hændelse fortalte vidner, at Stott tilsyneladende nød uroen, efter at en brandhane var blevet åbnet, hvilket ifølge retten fik gaden til at ligne en 'New York ghetto.'

Stott har været involveret i mindst 36 rapporterede hændelser, herunder trusler, chikane af offentligheden og hærværk. Dommerne ophævede anonymiteten og offentliggjorde Stotts identitet for at betrygge lokalsamfundet om, at der blev taget hånd om den asociale opførsel.

article_content: Each year, more than 2.2 million flights cross UK skies, with peaks reaching up to 8,000 flights a day. NATS (formerly National Air Traffic Services) manages this airspace, covering over 180 public and private airports, military training centers, and helipads. To visualize this complex traffic, NATS released ‘UK 24,’ its third air traffic visualisation, offering a guided look at UK airspace. The visualisation depicts around 7,000 daily flight movements, showing the flow from early transatlantic arrivals and European flights to initial UK airport departures, as well as the main air routes and busy hubs like London, Manchester, and central Scotland. Holding stacks—flight patterns used to delay landings while keeping aircraft within controlled airspace—are shown above London, especially Heathrow, the world’s busiest dual-runway airport with 1,350 daily movements. Heathrow processes over £133 billion in goods per year, exceeding the combined value managed at Felixstowe and Southampton, the UK’s largest ports. The visualisation covers other major airports, NATS' control centers at Swanwick and Prestwick, general aviation, military training flights involving RAF jets, and helicopter trips between Aberdeen and North Sea oil and gas rigs. Brendan Kelly, NATS’ head of operational policy, says the aim is to explore more deeply what enables UK aviation, following earlier projects like Europe 24 and North Atlantic Skies. The visualisation was crafted by 422 South, which used 24 hours of UK radar data, mapped by proprietary software as luminous dots on satellite images of the country. An earlier visualisation, North Atlantic Skies, illustrated 2,524 cross-Atlantic flights daily—1,273 passing through the Shanwick Oceanic Control Area managed by Prestwick—which can handle up to 1,500 flights on peak days. NATS’ Europe visualisation combined UK radar data from June 21, 2013, with European flight plans from July 28 of the same year. On June 21, 2013, 5,675 flights left or arrived at UK airports—including 1,041 at Heathrow, 847 at Gatwick—and 1,532 were classified as overflights. On a typical July day, about 30,000 flights cross European airspace, with approximately one quarter flying through UK-managed airspace, covering 25 million nautical miles—the equivalent of circling Earth 998 times or traveling to the Moon 104 times. For clarity, the NATS visualisation plays at 1,440 times real speed to reveal the day’s patterns and complexity. Brendan Kelly summarizes, 'We hope this offers a new perspective on the complexity and elegance of UK airspace, the invisible infrastructure keeping everything moving.'

article_content: Armenia's parliament voted on Tuesday to join the International Criminal Court (ICC), further straining the country’s ties with its longtime ally Russia. This move follows the ICC's issuance of an arrest warrant for Russian President Vladimir Putin over events related to Ukraine. Last month, Moscow called Armenia's step towards joining the ICC an 'unfriendly act' and summoned the Armenian ambassador. Armenia argues that this decision is not directed at Russia, but is instead a response to aggression from Azerbaijan. States that have signed and ratified the Rome Statute, which established the ICC, are obligated to arrest Putin—accused of war crimes involving the deportation of Ukrainian children—should he visit their territories. Armenian lawmakers approved the ratification of the Rome Statute by a vote of 60 to 22. The country’s president must still sign the decision, which would then become effective 60 days after the vote. Relations between Armenia and Russia have deteriorated in recent years. In 2020, Russia brokered a ceasefire between Armenia and Azerbaijan, resulting in Armenia ceding territories to Azerbaijan in and around Nagorno-Karabakh, a region predominantly populated by ethnic Armenians. Russia deployed about 2,000 peacekeepers to the area, but Armenia has accused these troops of not preventing Azerbaijan’s recent takeover of the region. The Kremlin, in turn, has blamed Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan for acknowledging Azerbaijan's sovereignty over Nagorno-Karabakh. Moscow also accuses Yerevan of weakening bilateral ties by aligning more closely with the West, such as conducting joint military exercises with U.S. forces. It is uncertain whether Armenia will continue to participate in the Moscow-led Collective Security Treaty Organization (CSTO) and other Russian alliances. Armenia also hosts a Russian military base, and Russian border guards assist in patrolling its frontier with Turkey. Ahead of the parliamentary vote, Kremlin spokesperson Dmitri Peskov stated that Moscow would consider Armenia’s decision to join the ICC as an 'extremely hostile' act toward Russia.

Armenien hævder, at beslutningen ikke er rettet mod Rusland, men er et svar på aggression fra Aserbajdsjan. Stater, der har underskrevet og ratificeret Rom-statutten, som oprettede ICC, er forpligtet til at arrestere Putin—anklaget for krigsforbrydelser vedrørende deportation af ukrainske børn—hvis han besøger deres territorier. Det armenske parlament godkendte ratificeringen af Rom-statutten med 60 stemmer mod 22. Rusland indsatte omkring 2.000 fredsbevarende soldater i området, men Armenien har anklaget tropperne for ikke at have forhindret Aserbajdsjans nylige kontrolovertagelse af regionen. article_content:
At an AI Safety Summit hosted by UK Prime Minister Rishi Sunak at Bletchley Park, government leaders and major tech firms agreed to create an international advisory group on artificial intelligence. This panel, inspired by the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC), would regularly evaluate developments, potential risks, and policy options for AI, making findings accessible to governments worldwide. Part of the arrangement is for leading tech companies to submit their latest AI models to government-led testing before they’re released, marking a step toward coordinated international oversight.

Nonetheless, there are growing concerns about this approach, echoing some of the criticisms made against the IPCC, such as claims of one-sided outlooks, downplaying uncertainties, and dampening dissenting views in the name of consensus. The fear is that an international panel on AI might become politicized, prioritize a narrow set of worries (like apocalyptic risks), and shut out broader views—problems that have surfaced even in the summit’s discussions.

The article compares this trend to historic examples where elite groups restricted the sharing of knowledge or set the terms of scientific progress. It warns that heavy reliance on select committees risks mixing science and policy in unhelpful ways, which can stifle genuine debate and innovation.

As an alternative, the author suggests letting countries experiment with different AI policies shaped by their own unique values and approaches to risk. Strict, globally standardized rules might block beneficial advancements, especially if they’re based on the most pessimistic projections. The piece concludes that addressing clear, direct problems while promoting open discussion and learning from multiple perspectives is a better path forward than concentrating control with a small expert group.

På et AI-sikkerhedstopmøde arrangeret af Storbritanniens premierminister Rishi Sunak på Bletchley Park blev regeringsledere og store teknologifirmaer enige om at oprette en international rådgivningsgruppe om kunstig intelligens. Panelet, inspireret af FN’s klimapanel (IPCC), skal løbende vurdere udviklingen, potentielle risici og politiske muligheder inden for AI og gøre resultaterne tilgængelige for regeringer globalt. Som led i aftalen skal de førende teknologivirksomheder underlægge deres nyeste AI-modeller regeringsledet testning, før modellerne lanceres, hvilket markerer et skridt mod koordineret international overvågning.

Der er dog voksende bekymring over denne tilgang, idet nogle kritikere drager paralleller til de problemer, IPCC har måttet håndtere – såsom skæve vurderinger, underkendelse af usikkerhed og nedtoning af alternative perspektiver. Frygten er, at et internationalt AI-panel kan blive politiseret, fokusere snævert på katastrofescenarier og ekskludere forskellige synspunkter – problemer som allerede er blevet tydelige under topmødet.

Artiklen sammenligner dette med historiske eksempler, hvor elitære grupper har begrænset adgangen til viden eller sat rammerne for videnskabelig udvikling. Den advarer om, at en alt for stor afhængighed af ekspertpaneler nemt kan blande videnskab og politik på en måde, der bremser reelle debatter og innovation.

I stedet foreslår forfatteren, at landene bør eksperimentere med forskellige AI-regler, der passer til deres egne værdier og risikovilligheder. Strikse, globalt fastsatte regler kan bremse gavnlige fremskridt, især hvis de bygger på de mest pessimistiske antagelser. Artiklen afslutter, at det er bedre at løse konkrete problemer, fremme åben debat og lære af et bredt spektre af synspunkter – frem for at overlade styringen til en lille kreds af eksperter.

Britain faces a significant threat from terrorist attacks inspired by ISIS, Foreign Secretary Philip Hammond warned ahead of a counter-terrorism summit in London. He urged continued vigilance and cautioned against complacency in the efforts to disrupt plots before they can be carried out.

Global leaders gathered in London, including US Secretary of State John Kerry and French Foreign Minister Laurent Fabius, to discuss strategies to combat ISIS and prevent tragedies similar to those seen in Paris. Prime Minister David Cameron met with Iraqi Prime Minister Haider al-Abadi at Downing Street, reaffirming the UK's commitment to halt the flow of foreign fighters to ISIS and prevent further chaos.

Hammond, hosting the Small Group of the Global Coalition to Counter ISIS at Lancaster House, stressed the ongoing risk posed by individuals in the UK radicalized by events in Iraq and Syria. He told the BBC that ISIS currently represents the greatest immediate threat to Britain's national security, and praised the tireless work of security agencies in monitoring and disrupting terror threats. He insisted that continual vigilance is necessary, as threats persist.

Cameron acknowledged the UK’s support in strengthening Iraq’s security, though he noted that Iraqi forces need more time to be ready for major operations against ISIS fighters, who have seized large parts of Iraq. Despite substantial investment by the UK and US, Iraq's security forces require further reorganization, training, and equipment to be able to reclaim territory.

Hammond stated that UK-led airstrikes and those of allies have been effective in containing ISIS, but emphasized that rebuilding the Iraqi armed forces is essential for a long-term solution. The key question remains when Iraqi forces will be prepared to begin major operations to drive ISIS out of their country.
translated_content:

Han opfordrede til fortsat årvågenhed og advarede mod selvtilfredshed i bestræbelserne på at afværge planer, før de kan udføres.

Internationale ledere samledes i London, herunder USA's udenrigsminister John Kerry og Frankrigs udenrigsminister Laurent Fabius, for at drøfte strategier til at bekæmpe ISIS og forhindre tragedier som dem i Paris. Premierminister David Cameron mødtes med Iraks premierminister Haider al-Abadi i Downing Street, hvor han bekræftede Storbritanniens engagement i at stoppe strømmen af udenlandske krigere til ISIS og forhindre yderligere kaos.

Hammond, der var vært for Small Group of the Global Coalition to Counter ISIS i Lancaster House, understregede den vedvarende risiko fra personer i Storbritannien, der er blevet radikaliseret af begivenhederne i Irak og Syrien. Han udtalte til BBC, at ISIS på nuværende tidspunkt udgør den største umiddelbare trussel mod Storbritanniens nationale sikkerhed, og roste de sikkerhedsmyndigheder, der arbejder utrætteligt for at overvåge og stoppe terrortrusler. Han understregede, at konstant årvågenhed er nødvendig, da truslerne er vedvarende.

article_content: Think of your credit score as your financial reputation—lenders look at it before deciding if you can borrow money. A higher score suggests you're less of a risk. Wondering how having more than one credit card affects your score? It's not automatically bad, but there are some key things to remember. If your credit cards are all recently opened, your credit score may take a dip because the average age of your accounts matters. The older your credit accounts, the better they reflect stability to lenders. Your credit score comes from five main ingredients: 1. Payment History (35%): The biggest piece! Paying on time across all your cards is crucial. Missing payments can seriously drag down your score. 2. Credit Utilization (30%): This is how much of your total credit you're using. Going above 30% of your available limit can hurt your score—even if you have more cards. 3. Length of Credit History (15%): Lenders like to see accounts that have been open a long time. Getting several new cards at once will drop the average age and may lower your score. 4. Credit Mix (10%): It's good to have different types of credit, not just multiple credit cards. Having only cards, with no loans or other credit types, may be less favorable. 5. New Credit (10%): Opening lots of new accounts in a short time can look risky to lenders, causing a temporary drop in your score. Bottom line: Don't rush to open multiple cards at the same time—it shortens your average account age and can lower your score. If you already have a bunch, keep the oldest ones open, use just one or two for regular spending, always pay on time, and keep your spending below 30% of your credit limit. Keep an eye on your credit—responsible habits can lead to a stronger credit score.

Overvejer du, hvordan flere kreditkort påvirker din score? Det er ikke nødvendigvis dårligt, men der er nogle vigtige ting at være opmærksom på. Jo ældre dine kreditkonti er, desto mere stabil fremstår du for långiverne. Din kreditvurdering beregnes ud fra fem hovedfaktorer: 1. Betalingshistorik (35%): Den vigtigste faktor! At betale til tiden på alle dine kort er afgørende. Manglende betalinger kan virkelig skade din score. 2. Kreditudnyttelse (30%): Det er, hvor meget af din samlede kredit du bruger. Bruger du over 30% af din kreditgrænse, kan det skade din score—even hvis du har flere kort. 3. Længde på kredithistorik (15%): Långivere foretrækker konti, der har været åbne i lang tid. Når du får flere nye kort på én gang, falder den gennemsnitlige alder og dermed også din score. 4. Kreditmix (10%): Det er en fordel at have forskellige typer kredit, ikke kun kreditkort. Kun at have kort og ingen lån eller andre kredittyper kan være mindre optimalt. 5. Nye kreditkonti (10%): Åbner du mange nye konti hurtigt, kan det ses som risikofyldt af långivere og midlertidigt sænke din score. Kort og godt: Undgå at åbne mange kreditkort på én gang—det forkorter din gennemsnitlige kontohistorik og kan sænke din score. Hvis du allerede har flere kort, så behold de ældste åbne, brug et til to til daglig, betal altid til tiden, og hold dig under 30% af din kreditgrænse. Hold øje med din kredit—gode vaner giver en stærkere kreditvurdering.

article_content: Rescuers in northern India began manually digging on Monday in an effort to reach 41 construction workers who have been trapped inside a collapsed mountain tunnel for more than two weeks. According to state government spokesperson Kirti Panwar, a team of a dozen men is taking turns using hand-held drilling equipment, with hopes that this will be the final phase of the rescue. They have progressed nearly one meter (3.2 feet), with up to 11 more meters (36 feet) left to dig. Officials also reported that a vertical escape channel is being created with a new drilling machine, after previous horizontal drilling attempts were thwarted by difficult, mountainous terrain, leading to repeated breakdowns and eventual irreparable damage to the earlier machine on Friday. The ongoing operations aim to establish a passage for evacuating the trapped workers. Rescue teams have inserted pipes into dug-out corridors and welded them together to allow the workers to be extracted on wheeled stretchers. Overnight, rescuers removed parts of the broken drilling machine that were stuck inside the pipes, enabling manual digging to resume, according to disaster management official Devendra Patwal. The workers became trapped on November 12th, when a landslide in Uttarakhand state caused a section of the 4.5-kilometer (2.8-mile) tunnel they were constructing to collapse about 200 meters (650 feet) from the entrance. What began as a rescue expected to last a few days has now extended into weeks, with officials hesitant to provide a completion timeline. The vertical digging, which began on Sunday, requires excavating approximately 106 meters (347 feet) of earth—almost double the 60 meters (196 feet) previously needed for horizontal drilling. Rescuers may face similar challenges as before, such as machine damage while cutting through rocky material. Authorities have warned that high-intensity vibrations from drilling could destabilize the site further. Despite these obstacles, Patwal said the team is prepared for any eventuality. 'We do not know exactly what material lies ahead—loose soil or hard rock—but we are ready,' he stated. As the rescue effort entered its 16th day, uncertainty and anxiety among locals and families have grown. Many relatives of the workers have set up camp near the site, hoping for updates and reunions. Some locals have conducted Hindu prayers at the tunnel entrance. Medical teams, including psychiatrists, are monitoring the health and well-being of those trapped. The workers, most of whom are migrant laborers from various regions of India, are being provided with hot meals through a 6-inch (15-centimeter) pipe, after initially surviving on dry food sent via a narrower pipe. Oxygen is being supplied separately. The tunnel is part of the Chardham all-weather road project, intended to link several Hindu pilgrimage destinations. Some experts have raised concerns that such infrastructure work could worsen fragile Himalayan conditions, given that many towns are built atop landslide debris. The region receives a substantial influx of pilgrims and tourists, a trend that has been increasing with ongoing construction.
translated_content: Redningsarbejdere i det nordlige Indien begyndte mandag at grave manuelt i et forsøg på at nå de 41 bygningsarbejdere, der har været fanget i en sammenstyrtet bjergtunnel i mere end to uger. Ifølge statens talsmand Kirti Panwar tager et hold på et dusin mænd skiftevis fat med håndholdte boreværktøjer i håb om, at dette vil være den sidste fase af redningsaktionen. De har gravet næsten én meter, og der mangler op til 11 meter endnu. Myndighederne oplyser også, at der etableres en lodret redningskanal med en ny bore-maskine, efter at tidligere forsøg på horisontal boring blev stoppet af det vanskelige, bjergrige terræn, hvilket førte til gentagne maskinnedbrud og til sidst uoprettelig skade på den første maskine fredag. Operationen sigter mod at skabe en udgang for de fangede arbejdere. Redningshold har indsat rør i de udgravede korridorer og svejset dem sammen, så arbejderne kan blive hentet ud på hjulbårer. Om natten fjernede redningsfolk dele af den ødelagte bore-maskine, der sad fast i rørene, så manuel gravning kunne genoptages, fortæller katastrofehåndterings-official Devendra Patwal. Arbejderne har været fanget siden 12. november, da et jordskred i delstaten Uttarakhand fik en del af den 4,5 km lange tunnel, de byggede, til at kollapse cirka 200 meter fra indgangen. Hvad der begyndte som en redningsaktion forventet at tage få dage, har nu varet uger, og myndighederne tøver med at sætte en slutdato på indsatsen. Den lodrette udgravning, der begyndte søndag, kræver, at omkring 106 meter jord skal fjernes—næsten dobbelt så meget som de cirka 60 meter, de tidligere måtte grave horisontalt. Redningsfolkene kan møde lignende udfordringer som tidligere, fx skade på maskinerne ved passage gennem hårdt materiale. Myndighederne har advaret om, at kraftige vibrationer fra boringen kan gøre stedet mere ustabilt. På trods af forhindringerne siger Patwal, at holdet er forberedt på alt. 'Vi ved ikke præcis, hvad der venter—løs jord eller sten—men vi er klar,' udtaler han. Efterhånden som redningsaktionen gik ind i sin 16. dag, vokser usikkerhed og bekymring blandt lokale og familier. Mange pårørende har slået lejr nær tunnelen i håb om opdateringer og snarlige gensyn. Nogle lokale har holdt hinduistiske bønner foran tunnelindgangen. Medicinske teams, inklusive psykiatere, overvåger de fangede arbejderes helbred. Arbejderne, hvoraf de fleste er migrantarbejdere fra hele Indien, får varme måltider leveret gennem et 15-centimeters rør efter oprindeligt kun at have fået tørkost leveret gennem et smallere rør. Oxygen bliver leveret separat. Tunnelen er en del af Chardham all-weather road-projektet, der skal forbinde flere hinduistiske pilgrimssteder. Nogle eksperter har udtrykt bekymring for, at sådanne infrastrukturprojekter kan forværre de skrøbelige forhold i Himalaya, hvor flere byer er bygget på jordskredsjord. Regionen modtager et stort antal pilgrimme og turister, et tal der er steget med fortsat byggeri.

article_content: Avaya CEO Alan Masarek highlighted that India is a critical driver of growth for the company, witnessing strong demand from domestic clients and partners. Avaya is seeing rapid adoption of its customer experience solutions, especially AI-powered offerings, among Indian enterprises. Key Indian clients include Airtel, the State Bank of India, and the Government of India. Avaya’s solutions underpin essential services such as National Emergency Response (100, 112) and the Aadhaar system. "Our progress in India propels global growth, as local businesses and government agencies trust Avaya for customer experience and communications technology," said Masarek. He also acknowledged the company’s R&D teams in Bengaluru, Pune, Hyderabad, and Gurugram for driving AI innovation, with one-third of Avaya’s 1,700 engineers based in India. Masarek noted that Indian companies, similar to global peers, increasingly view contact centers as key to delivering differentiated customer experiences. The Avaya Experience Platform, which provides AI-powered contact center services, is growing in popularity for its flexibility and pace of innovation. Avaya recently introduced the Avaya Experience Platform Connect, enabling organizations to retain their on-premises infrastructure for functions like voice routing and call handling, while leveraging cloud-based omnichannel and AI capabilities. In its commitment to community development and youth empowerment, Avaya partnered with Magic Bus India Foundation, a leading education NGO, investing over Rs 5 million to set up a youth skilling center in Hyderabad. This initiative aims to train 200 underprivileged adolescents for careers in customer experience via a dedicated 'CX Academy'. article_content: Qualcomm has discontinued plans to launch a satellite SOS feature for Android phones that was designed to compete with Apple’s emergency SOS capability on recent iPhones. Announced in January through a partnership with satellite communications provider Iridium, the Snapdragon Satellite project has ended after just 10 months. According to Iridium, Qualcomm opted to terminate their agreement because no smartphone manufacturer committed to using the feature, despite it being successfully developed and demonstrated. In a statement to CNBC, Qualcomm noted that it will continue collaborating with Iridium on standards-based satellite connectivity solutions, moving away from the proprietary system they had built. This suggests Qualcomm may still pursue satellite connectivity for Android phones in the future, though the initial lack of interest indicates such features may not appear soon. One possible obstacle was cost—someone would need to pay Iridium for satellite access, and Qualcomm’s central role in managing the service might have discouraged phone makers. For comparison, Apple introduced its Emergency SOS feature in 2022 with the iPhone 14, using the Globalstar satellite network. The service is currently free, but Apple plans to charge users for satellite connectivity starting next year, with pricing yet to be announced. Google, meanwhile, is working on integrating emergency satellite services into Android. While satellite connectivity is standard on all new iPhones, Apple has not yet demonstrated clear demand for the service, as the company continues to cover the costs. The real level of consumer interest will become clearer once users have to pay for access. Iridium remains optimistic, with spokesperson Jordan Hassin stating to The Verge that the company is reconnecting with smartphone makers, chip manufacturers, and operating system developers, and is seeking new partners for the satellite connectivity feature.

Ifølge Iridium valgte Qualcomm at afslutte aftalen, fordi ingen smartphone-producent havde forpligtet sig til at bruge funktionen, selvom den var blevet succesfuldt udviklet og demonstreret. Qualcomm udtalte til CNBC, at de fortsat vil samarbejde med Iridium om standardbaserede satellitforbindelsesløsninger og vælger at droppe det proprietære system, der var udviklet. Det tyder på, at Qualcomm stadig kan forfølge satellitforbindelse til Android-telefoner i fremtiden, selvom den manglende interesse indtil videre antyder, at sådanne funktioner ikke lanceres foreløbig. En mulig forhindring var prisen – nogen skulle betale Iridium for adgang til satellitterne, og Qualcomms centrale rolle i håndteringen af tjenesten kan have afskrækket telefonproducenter. Til sammenligning introducerede Apple sin nød-SOS-funktion i 2022 med iPhone 14 ved brug af Globalstar-satellitnetværket. article_content: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and European Parliament President Roberta Metsola arrived in Israel around midday on Friday to express support after the recent Hamas attacks. Posting on X, von der Leyen stated she was in Israel with Metsola to demonstrate solidarity with Israelis following the deadly incident by Hamas. Metsola called the attacks Israel’s worst terrorist incident in years, emphasizing the need to stop Hamas and address humanitarian needs. Their visit took place six days after Hamas launched coordinated attacks in Israel by land, sea, and air, leaving over 1,300 people dead since October 7, according to Israeli officials. Among the victims are about 900 civilians and 245 soldiers. In addition, more than 3,200 people have been injured in Israel. On Friday, Israel instructed all civilians in northern Gaza and Gaza City to move south within 24 hours. Gaza health authorities report at least 1,500 Palestinians have been killed in Israeli airstrikes so far, including around 500 children. The conflict has displaced hundreds of thousands across the Gaza Strip. Hamas also said two of its officials were killed earlier this week in airstrikes. German Foreign Minister Annalena Baerbock is expected to arrive in Israel later on Friday. Meanwhile, US Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin arrived in Tel Aviv to meet with Israeli leaders and observe US weapons and support recently provided to Israel, such as interceptor missiles for the Iron Dome and other munitions. Austin follows Secretary of State Antony Blinken, who visited the region on Thursday, both working to prevent broader conflict. Blinken also met with Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas in Amman, Jordan, discussing the recent attacks, efforts to free hostages, and humanitarian assistance for Gaza civilians during Israeli military operations. According to the Jordanian royal palace, King Abdullah highlighted the importance of opening humanitarian corridors into Gaza for medical aid and civilian protection while working to de-escalate tensions. Blinken next heads to Doha for talks with Qatari officials on prisoner and hostage exchanges. His schedule includes visits to Bahrain and Saudi Arabia—key players in regional diplomacy, though normalization of Saudi-Israeli relations is paused. Over the weekend, he plans to visit the United Arab Emirates and Egypt.

Metsola kaldte angrebet det værste terrorangreb i Israel i flere år og understregede behovet for at stoppe Hamas og tage hånd om de humanitære behov. Deres besøg fandt sted seks dage efter, at Hamas lancerede koordinerede angreb i Israel via land, hav og luft, hvilket siden 7. oktober har efterladt over 1.300 døde ifølge israelske embedsmænd. Blandt ofrene er cirka 900 civile og 245 soldater. Derudover er mere end 3.200 personer blevet såret i Israel. Fredag beordrede Israel alle civile i det nordlige Gaza og Gaza City til at bevæge sig sydpå inden for 24 timer. Ifølge Gazas sundhedsmyndigheder er mindst 1.500 palæstinensere blevet dræbt i israelske luftangreb indtil nu, herunder omkring 500 børn. Konflikten har fordrevet hundredtusinder over hele Gazastriben. Hamas har også oplyst, at to af deres embedsmænd blev dræbt tidligere på ugen i luftangreb. Tysklands udenrigsminister Annalena Baerbock forventes at ankomme til Israel senere fredag. Austin følger efter udenrigsminister Antony Blinken, der besøgte regionen torsdag, hvor begge arbejder på at forhindre en bredere konflikt. Blinken mødtes også med den palæstinensiske præsident Mahmoud Abbas i Amman, Jordan, hvor de diskuterede de nylige angreb, indsatsen for at frigive gidsler og humanitær bistand til civile i Gaza under israelske militæroperationer. Ifølge det jordanske kongehus understregede kong Abdullah vigtigheden af at åbne humanitære korridorer til Gaza for medicinsk hjælp og beskyttelse af civile, samtidig med at han arbejdede for at dæmpe spændingerne. Blinken rejser derefter til Doha for samtaler med qatariske embedsmænd om udveksling af fanger og gidsler. article_content: Following rumors about a possible marriage between Pakistani politician Imran Khan and TV news anchor Reham Khan, Reham and her family have faced online abuse. Hate pages have been set up on Facebook targeting Reham, with users making personal attacks, including false claims and alleged compromising photos. She has been criticized for her appearance, party attendance, and personal choices, and her daughter has also been targeted. One claim involves a photo that reportedly shows Reham Khan in a sex shop in the UK, but the validity of this photo is unconfirmed. Aleema Khan stated that the family asked Imran directly and he denied being married to Reham, suggesting these rumors were spread by political opponents. She expressed that the family would support him marrying a good person, but as a public figure, such a decision is significant for the country as well. Rumors of the marriage have caused a strong backlash on social media, especially among conservative groups in Pakistan. Trolls have criticized Reham Khan for her attire, dancing, and attending parties, with some users sharing purported images in attempts to shame her. Sources close to both Reham and Imran suggest they may have had a personal relationship, but Imran Khan has publicly denied the marriage rumors. A former colleague at Reham’s TV station stated she had good access to Imran, but political concerns may have caused distance between them. Imran Khan has been single since divorcing Jemima Goldsmith, who recently reverted to her maiden name amid rumors of his remarriage. Commentators such as Dr. Shahid Masood have noted that Imran neither confirmed nor denied the marriage rumors, and some believe Reham could be interested in political involvement. Reham Khan, who was born in Libya to Pakistani parents, is a divorced mother of three and a news anchor at AAJ TV. These rumors have ignited social and political debate, highlighting the challenges public figures in Pakistan face regarding privacy and social media scrutiny.

Hun er blevet kritiseret for sit udseende, festdeltagelse og personlige valg, og hendes datter er også blevet ramt af angrebene. Et af rygterne handler om et billede, der angiveligt viser Reham Khan i en sexbutik i Storbritannien, men billedets ægthed er ikke bekræftet. Imran Khan, tidligere cricketspiller og nu politiker samt leder af partiet Tehreek-e-Insaf, blev rygtes at skulle giftes med Reham, men hans søster Aleema Khan har afvist beskyldningerne og kaldt dem fabrikerede for at skade hans omdømme. Aleema Khan har udtalt, at familien spurgte Imran direkte, og han benægtede at være gift med Reham. Hun mener, at rygterne er startet af politiske modstandere. Hun understregede også, at familien ville støtte ham, hvis han giftede sig med en god person, men at beslutningen også har national betydning, da han er en offentlig figur. Rygterne om ægteskabet har ført til kraftig modstand på sociale medier, især blandt mere konservative grupper i Pakistan. Trolls har kritiseret Reham Khan for hendes påklædning, dans og festdeltagelse, med nogle, der deler påståede billeder for at udskamme hende. Kilder tæt på både Reham og Imran antyder, at de kan have haft et personligt forhold, men Imran Khan har offentligt benægtet ægteskabsrygterne. En tidligere kollega fra Rehams tv-station sagde, at hun havde god adgang til Imran, men politiske hensyn kan have skabt afstand mellem dem. Imran Khan har været single siden sin skilsmisse fra Jemima Goldsmith, som for nylig genoptog sit pigenavn på grund af rygterne om hans kommende ægteskab. Kommentatorer som Dr. Shahid Masood har påpeget, at Imran hverken har bekræftet eller benægtet rygterne, og nogle mener, at Reham måske ønsker at engagere sig politisk. Reham Khan, der er født i Libyen af pakistanske forældre, er fraskilt mor til tre og nyhedsvært på AAJ TV. Rygterne har skabt samfundsmæssig og politisk debat og sætter fokus på de udfordringer, offentlige personer i Pakistan står overfor i forhold til privatliv og sociale medier.

article_content: Underwater explorer Barry Clifford, from Massachusetts, claims to have found the wreck of Christopher Columbus's flagship, the Santa Maria, off the coast of Haiti in 2003. Clifford reports that artifacts—including a large cannon he photographed in May 2003—have gone missing, suggesting they may have been taken by looters. He believes the evidence strongly points to the wreck being the Santa Maria, which sank after striking a reef on Christmas Day, 1492, off Haiti. Clifford has begun discussions with the Haitian government and President Michel Martelly to obtain permission to recover and conserve artifacts. He suggests some ballast rocks at the site may have come from a quarry near Columbus's home port in southwestern Spain. The Santa Maria's anchor is on display in Haiti, as it was salvaged before the ship sank. Roger C. Smith, an underwater archaeologist, observes that identifying the wreck is difficult due to extensive time and environmental factors. Clifford's expedition is funded by the History Channel. La Isabela, founded by Columbus on his second voyage in 1493 in present-day Dominican Republic and named after Queen Isabella I of Castile, was the first permanent European settlement in the Americas. Recent research on 27 skeletons found at La Isabela signifies that settlers suffered from severe scurvy, a key factor in the colony's failure within four years. Historical records and skeletal analysis indicate vitamin C deficiency led to many early deaths, likely worsened by the lengthy sea voyage. La Isabela was ultimately abandoned in 1496 due to disease, hunger, and deprivation.
translated_content: Undervandseksperten Barry Clifford fra Massachusetts hævder, at han i 2003 fandt vraget af Christopher Columbus’ flagskib, Santa Maria, ud for Haitis kyst. Clifford rapporterer, at genstande – herunder en stor kanon, han fotograferede i maj 2003 – er forsvundet, hvilket antyder, at de kan være blevet taget af plyndrere. Han mener, at beviserne stærkt tyder på, at vraget er Santa Maria, som sank efter at have ramt et rev ved Haiti juledag 1492. Clifford har indledt forhandlinger med Haitis regering og præsident Michel Martelly om at få tilladelse til at bjærge og bevare genstande. Han foreslår, at nogle af ballaststenene på stedet kan stamme fra et stenbrud nær Columbus’ hjemby i det sydvestlige Spanien. Santa Marias anker udstilles i Haiti, da det blev reddet før skibets forlis. Roger C. Smith, en undervandsarkæolog, påpeger, at identificering af vraget er vanskelig på grund af dets alder og miljøforhold. Cliffords ekspedition er finansieret af History Channel. La Isabela, grundlagt af Columbus på hans anden rejse i 1493 i det nuværende Den Dominikanske Republik og opkaldt efter dronning Isabella I af Castilla, var den første permanente europæiske bosættelse i Amerika. Ny forskning på 27 skeletter fundet i La Isabela antyder, at bosætterne led af alvorlig skørbug, hvilket var en væsentlig faktor i koloniens sammenbrud efter kun fire år. Historiske kilder og knogleanalyser indikerer, at mangel på C-vitamin forårsagede mange tidlige dødsfald, sandsynligvis forværret af den lange sørejse. La Isabela blev til sidst forladt i 1496 på grund af sygdom, sult og afsavn.

article_content: A Libyan military aircraft crashed in Tunisia's Nabeul province on Friday, resulting in the deaths of all 11 people on board, Libyan authorities confirmed. The plane carried five crew members, a doctor, three patients, and two accompanying individuals. Among those killed was Sheikh Muftah Mabrook al Dwadi, a prominent Islamist leader and deputy minister of Libya's Ministry of Martyrs' Affairs. Colonel Ali Sheikhi, the Libyan military spokesperson, stated that the crash took place under unclear circumstances. According to the Libyan air force, one of the plane's engines caught fire as it descended towards Tunis Carthage airport, with the pilot making an attempt to land before the crash occurred. The culture minister, acting as a government representative, announced that all 11 were confirmed dead and that an initial investigation indicated the engine fire spread, causing the crash. The culture minister posted on the interim government's official Twitter account that another plane would be dispatched to repatriate the victims' bodies. The director of Libya's civil aviation authority was sent to Tunis to assist in the public inquiry alongside Tunisian officials. The minister also extended condolences to the families and hoped the joint investigation would determine the exact cause. The crashed plane was an Antonov An-26, which had departed from Mitiga Airport in Libya and was utilized as an air ambulance. Due to insufficient healthcare in Libya, many patients are transported abroad for treatment. The accident occurred near Grombalia, about 60 kilometers from Tunis. Military, medical, and civil protection personnel responded to the crash site. Libya and Tunisia share a border in North Africa.
