article_content: How was the air breathed by Caesar, the Prophet Mohammed, or Christopher Columbus? A giant freezer in Copenhagen may hold the answer, storing blocks of ancient ice with stories from thousands of years ago. The Ice Core Archive, located in Copenhagen, houses 25 kilometers (15 miles) of ice drilled primarily from Greenland. This collection helps scientists understand climate changes across millennia. Professor Jorgen Peder Steffensen, a glaciologist at the University of Copenhagen, says, "What we have in this archive is a record of prehistoric climate and human activities over the last 10,000 years." Steffensen’s passion for ice cores has spanned 43 years. He met his wife and fellow paleoclimatologist, Dorthe Dahl-Jensen, while drilling into Greenland’s ice sheet. Since 1991, Steffensen has managed the archive, one of the world’s largest, containing 40,000 blocks of ice, neatly packed on shelves. These ice samples are unique—they are compressed snow, not ordinary frozen water. The air once trapped between snowflakes is preserved as bubbles, making the bubbles the same age as the surrounding ice. The archive includes an antechamber resembling a library reading room, where researchers quickly examine cores at -18°C (-0.4°F), much warmer than the -30°C (-22°F) storage room. Steffensen demonstrates a block with visible air bubbles, formed from snow that fell over two thousand years ago, sometimes referred to as 'Christmas snow.' The first ice cores arrived in Denmark in the 1960s from Camp Century, a secret US military base in Greenland. The newest cores, extracted this summer, come from bedrock 2.6 km deep in eastern Greenland and contain ice as old as 120,000 years, dating back to a period when Greenland’s temperatures were 5°C higher than today. The archive’s recent collections are critical for understanding sea level rise, which is driven by both shrinking ice caps and rapidly melting 'ice streams' within the ice sheet. Steffensen hopes that studying these ice streams will improve predictions of sea level rise within 100 years, reducing the uncertainty margin from 70 cm to just 15 cm. Ice cores are the only way to determine the state of the planet’s atmosphere before man-made pollution. They show how greenhouse gases like CO2 and methane have evolved and reveal the effects of burning fossil fuels. A separate project, the Ice Memory foundation, collects ice cores from 20 global sites for long-term preservation at the Concordia research station in Antarctica. The goal is to safeguard them for future researchers before climate change causes irreversible losses. Jerome Chappellaz, head of the foundation, praises Denmark’s efforts but warns that industrial freezer storage can be vulnerable to technical problems, funding issues, or conflict. For example, in 2017 a freezer failure at the University of Alberta exposed 13 percent of its ancient ice samples to damaging warmth. At Concordia Station, with an average annual temperature of -55°C, storage is more secure for centuries to come. Chappellaz calls the ice cores a 'treasure,' urging Denmark to join the international preservation effort. "We must protect this treasure and, as far as possible, ensure it becomes part of mankind’s world heritage," he says.
translated_content: Hvordan var luften, som Cæsar, Profeten Muhammed eller Christoffer Columbus indåndede? Et kæmpe fryserum i København kan have svaret, da det gemmer på blokke af ældgammel is med fortællinger fra tusindvis af år tilbage. Iskernearkivet i København rummer 25 kilometer is, hovedsageligt indsamlet fra Grønland. Denne samling hjælper forskere med at forstå klimaforandringer gennem tusinder af år. Professor Jørgen Peder Steffensen, glaciolog ved Københavns Universitet, siger: "Det, vi har i dette arkiv, er en optegnelse over forhistorisk klima og menneskelig aktivitet gennem de sidste 10.000 år." Steffensens passion for iskerner har varet i 43 år. Han mødte sin kone og med-paleoklimatolog, Dorthe Dahl-Jensen, mens de borede i den grønlandske indlandsis. Siden 1991 har Steffensen ledet arkivet, et af verdens største, med 40.000 isblokke, pænt opstillet på hylder. Disse prøver er unikke – de består af sammenpresset sne, ikke almindeligt frosset vand. Luften, der engang befandt sig mellem snefnuggene, er bevaret som bobler, og boblernes alder svarer til isens alder. Arkivet har et forkammer, der minder om et bibliotekslæserum, hvor forskere hurtigt undersøger iskerner ved minus 18°C – væsentligt varmere end i opbevaringsrummet, som holder minus 30°C. Steffensen viser en isblok med synlige luftbobler – dannet af sne, der faldt for over to tusind år siden, også kaldet ‘julesne’. De første iskerner ankom til Danmark i 1960’erne fra Camp Century, en skjult amerikansk militærbase i Grønland. De nyeste blev hentet denne sommer dybt i østgrønlandsk grundfjeld i 2,6 kilometers dybde og indeholder is, der er op til 120.000 år gammel – fra en periode, hvor det var 5°C varmere end i dag. De nyeste samlinger i arkivet er afgørende for forståelsen af havniveaustigning, som skyldes både smeltende iskapper og hurtige, smeltende ‘isstrømme’ i isen. Steffensen håber, at studier af disse isstrømme kan forbedre forudsigelserne for havniveaustigninger de næste 100 år, så usikkerheden reduceres fra 70 cm til bare 15 cm. Iskerner er den eneste måde at bestemme atmosfærens tilstand før menneskeskabt forurening. De viser, hvordan drivhusgasser som CO2 og metan har udviklet sig og afslører konsekvenserne af brugen af fossile brændstoffer. Projektet Ice Memory indsamler iskerner fra 20 steder i verden til langtidsopbevaring på forskningsstationen Concordia i Antarktis. Målet er at bevare dem for fremtidens forskere, før klimaforandringer gør det umuligt. Jerome Chappellaz, fondens leder, roser de danske indsatser, men advarer om, at opbevaring i industrielle frysere kan være sårbar overfor tekniske problemer, økonomiske udfordringer eller konflikt. For eksempel blev 13% af de ældgamle isprøver skadet ved varme under et frysernedbrud på University of Alberta i 2017. Ved Concordia-basen, hvor årsgennemsnittet er minus 55°C, er opbevaringen langt mere sikker mange år ud i fremtiden. Chappellaz kalder iskernerne en ‘skat’ og opfordrer Danmark til at gå med i den internationale bevaringsindsats. "Vi skal beskytte denne skat og, så vidt muligt, sikre, at den bliver en del af menneskehedens verdensarv," siger han.

article_content: DreamWorks Animation has released the third film in the Trolls franchise, 'Trolls Band Together.' The movie centers on Branch (voiced by Justin Timberlake), who, despite his heroic efforts to save the Troll world, secretly longs to be reunited with his four older brothers. The brothers were once in a popular boy band, a plot device that the film uses to reference famous groups and musical puns. However, after a failed performance, the brothers decided to pursue solo paths, leaving a young Branch mostly alone—a detail that feels incongruent in the story.  The movie’s antagonists, Velvet (voiced by Amy Schumer) and her brother Veneer (voiced by Andrew Rannells), are standout characters. They have imprisoned Branch’s brother Floyd inside a diamond bauble and are draining his singing talents to boost their own fame. This event drives Branch and his brothers to reunite and create the 'perfect family harmony,' which is said to have the power to shatter diamonds and ultimately save Floyd. Poppy (voiced by Anna Kendrick), Branch’s girlfriend, is a supportive and enthusiastic sidekick.  Velvet and Veneer embody modern ideas of fame being fleeting and often unrelated to real talent. Velvet is highly aware of this, dragging a hesitant Veneer along in her scheme to exploit Floyd. These characters provide some of the movie’s best moments.  There’s a notable cameo from 'NSYNC, the boy band Timberlake was part of, who perform their first song together in 20 years. Despite these features, the film’s backstory and overall plot are weak, with only the villains providing real entertainment. Directed by Walt Dohrn and Tim Heitz, and featuring a cast including Justin Timberlake, Anna Kendrick, Zooey Deschanel, Amy Schumer, Andrew Rannells, and Eric André, 'Trolls Band Together' ultimately earns a rating of 1.5 stars.

Brødrene var tidligere med i et populært boyband – et plotpunkt, som filmen bruger til at referere til berømte grupper og musikalske jokes. Efter en fiasko-optræden gik brødrene dog hver til sit for at forfølge solokarrierer og efterlod en ung Branch mest alene – en detalje, der føles usammenhængende i historien.  Filmens skurke, Velvet (med stemme af Amy Schumer) og hendes bror Veneer (med stemme af Andrew Rannells), er bemærkelsesværdige karakterer. De har spærret Branch’ bror Floyd inde i et diamantvedhæng og dræner hans sangtalent for at fremme deres egen berømmelse. Denne begivenhed får Branch og hans brødre til at forsøge at genforene sig og skabe 'den perfekte familieharmoni', som angiveligt kan knuse diamanter og dermed redde Floyd. article_content: Former Haryana Congress chief Ashok Tanwar and former minister Ram Gopal Bairwa joined the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) in Jaipur on Saturday, ahead of Rajasthan's state assembly elections scheduled for November 25. Ashok Tanwar is a former MLA who represented Chaksu. Along with other associates, the duo joined the BJP at the party's media centre, in the presence of state BJP president CP Joshi, Member of Parliament Rajyavardhan Singh Rathore, and election management committee convenor Narayan Panchariya. During the event, CP Joshi criticized the Congress-led Rajasthan government’s record on women’s safety, referencing an incident in Dausa where a police sub-inspector allegedly raped a young woman. Joshi stated that the government has failed to protect women and that such events erode public trust when those responsible for protection themselves become perpetrators. Commenting on the defections, Joshi remarked that discontent with the 'lawlessness' in the state led these Congress leaders to join the BJP. Elsewhere, India’s industrial growth dropped to a three-month low of 5.8% in September from 10.3% in August, due to an unfavorable base effect and excess rainfall, which disrupted output. In business news, Ranjan Pai, chairman of the Manipal Education and Medical Group, invested ₹1,400 crore (around $168 million USD) in Aakash Institute, a subsidiary of leading edtech company Byju's. Manufacturing companies are increasingly hiring students from the 2024 batch, valuing their up-to-date digital skills and ability to contribute to digital transformation initiatives, according to Dilip Pattanayak, Chief Human Resources Officer at JSW Group.

Ashok Tanwar er en tidligere MLA, der repræsenterede Chaksu. Sammen med andre kolleger sluttede duoen sig til BJP på partiets mediecenter i nærvær af statens BJP-præsident CP Joshi, parlamentsmedlem Rajyavardhan Singh Rathore og valgkomitéens koordinator Narayan Panchariya. Under arrangementet kritiserede CP Joshi den Congress-ledede Rajasthan-regerings indsats for kvinders sikkerhed og henviste til en hændelse i Dausa, hvor en politibetjent angiveligt voldtog en ung kvinde. Joshi udtalte, at regeringen ikke har formået at beskytte kvinder, og at sådanne begivenheder underminerer den offentlige tillid, når dem der skal beskytte, selv bliver gerningsmænd. Joshi kommenterede også partiskiftene og udtalte, at utilfredshed med 'lovløshed' i staten fik disse Congress-ledere til at slutte sig til BJP. Andre steder faldt Indiens industrivækst til et tre-måneders lavpunkt på 5,8% i september fra 10,3% i august, blandt andet på grund af en ugunstig baseeffekt og for meget regn, som forstyrrede produktionen. I erhvervsnyt har Ranjan Pai, formand for Manipal Education and Medical Group, investeret ₹1.400 crore (ca. 168 millioner USD) i Aakash Institute, en dattervirksomhed til den førende edtech-virksomhed Byju's. Produktionsvirksomheder ansætter i stigende grad studerende fra årgang 2024, fordi de værdsætter deres opdaterede digitale færdigheder og evne til at bidrage til digitale transformationsinitiativer, udtaler Dilip Pattanayak, Chief Human Resources Officer hos JSW Group.

Retail inflation for agricultural and rural labourers in India rose in October 2023 to 7.08% and 6.92% respectively, from 6.70% and 6.55% in September. This rise is mainly attributed to increasing prices of staple food items such as rice, wheat flour, pulses, vegetables, milk, onions, green chillies, and mixed spices, according to the Ministry of Labour.

On a year-on-year basis, inflation measured by the Consumer Price Index for Agricultural Labourers (CPI-AL) and for Rural Labourers (CPI-RL) was 7.22% and 7.34% in October 2022, slightly higher than in October 2023. Food inflation in October 2023 stood at 8.42% for CPI-AL and 8.18% for CPI-RL, up from 8.06% and 7.73% in September 2023, and 7.05% and 7.00% a year earlier.

Nationally, the CPI-AL and CPI-RL indices rose by 15 and 14 points to 1,241 and 1,251 points in October 2023. In September 2023, these values were 1,226 and 1,237 points. All states reported increases in these indices. For agricultural labourers, five states observed a rise between 1 and 10 points, 13 states saw increases between 11 and 20 points, and two states witnessed rises over 20 points. Tamil Nadu had the highest CPI-AL index at 1,427 points, while Himachal Pradesh was lowest with 960 points.

For rural labourers, five states reported rises between 1 and 10 points, 13 saw increases of 11 to 20 points, and two had more than 20 points rise. Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu shared the highest CPI-RL index at 1,415 points, whereas Himachal Pradesh was lowest at 1,011 points.

Jammu & Kashmir recorded the greatest surge in both CPI-AL (32 points) and CPI-RL (29 points) due to rising prices for rice, wheat flour, onion, and spinach. Kerala had the smallest increase, with both indices rising by only 1 point.

Dr. Pam Spurr addresses the common challenge of emotional eating, noting that around 70% of people turn to comfort food for emotional reasons. Over 90% of diets fail, often due to a return to emotional eating habits. Emotional eaters often share certain behaviors: seeking food to ease stress or distress, feeling guilt afterwards, and getting caught in a cycle that is hard to break.

Dr. Spurr explains that childhood experiences can strongly influence how we relate to food. Many people are taught from a young age that food can make you feel better when upset, with examples like receiving treats after a fall or being cheered up with snacks after a hard day at school. Seeing parents soothe their own emotions with food can also reinforce these habits, not because of bad parenting but because family patterns often go unrecognized.

Celebrations such as Christmas or successes like passing an exam can encourage overeating, transforming food into a source of comfort and reward. This ingrained connection can make emotional eating an unconscious habit.

To break the cycle, Dr. Spurr advises becoming aware of emotional triggers and focusing on mindfulness. Taking a one-day-at-a-time approach, paying attention to what and why you eat, and appreciating your meals can help reduce stress and put you back in control. She recommends not eating on 'autopilot,' chewing slowly, and being present during meals.

Dr. Spurr also suggests practical strategies: planning how to respond to daily stresses without turning to food, removing unhealthy snacks from your environment, and substituting with healthy options like fruit, nuts, or vegetables. She advises recognizing your personal 'danger zones'—such as visiting a staff café after a tough meeting—and preparing alternative responses like messaging a friend or taking a walk. Bringing healthy, pre-portioned food to work, carrying only needed cash, and shopping with a list can all support better choices.

Understanding the roots of emotional eating may start with your family, but it’s possible to manage and overcome it. Dr. Pam Spurr’s book, The Emotional Eater’s Diet, provides further guidance and is available on Amazon. She also shares advice on Twitter @drpamspurr.

Dr. Pam Spurr tager fat på det udbredte problem med følelsesmæssig overspisning og bemærker, at omkring 70 % af folk tyr til trøstemad af følelsesmæssige årsager. Over 90 % af slankekure slår fejl, ofte fordi man falder tilbage til følelsesbetinget spisning. Personer med følelsesmæssig overspisning har ofte visse fællestræk: De søger mad for at lindre stress eller ubehag, føler skyld bagefter og sidder fast i en cyklus, der er svær at bryde.

Dr. Spurr forklarer, at barndomsoplevelser kan have stor indflydelse på vores forhold til mad. Mange lærer tidligt, at mad kan få én til at få det bedre, når man er ked af det – for eksempel at få en godbid efter et fald eller snacks efter en dårlig dag i skolen. At se sine forældre bruge mad til at lindre egne følelser forstærker også de her vaner, ikke fordi de er dårlige forældre, men fordi familiemønstre ofte ikke bliver genkendt.

Fejringer som jul eller succesoplevelser, f.eks. at bestå en eksamen, kan opmuntre til overspisning og gøre mad til en form for trøst eller belønning. Denne dybtliggende forbindelse kan gøre følelsesspisning til en ubevidst vane.

For at bryde denne cyklus anbefaler Dr. Spurr, at man bliver opmærksom på sine følelsesmæssige triggere og fokuserer på nærvær i nuet. At tage én dag ad gangen, lægge mærke til hvorfor og hvad du spiser, og nyde dine måltider kan hjælpe med at reducere stress og give dig kontrol. Hun foreslår, at man ikke spiser på autopilot, tygger langsomt og er til stede under måltidet.

Dr. Spurr giver også praktiske råd: Planlæg på forhånd, hvordan du vil håndtere dagligdagens stress uden at ty til mad, fjern usunde snacks fra hjemmet og arbejdspladsen, og vælg i stedet sunde alternativer som frugt, nødder eller grøntsagsstænger. Kend dine personlige "farezoner" – for eksempel at du går i kantinen, når du er frustreret – og forbered andre måder at reagere på, fx at skrive til en ven eller gå en tur. Tag sunde, forudmålte portioner med på arbejde, medbring kun de penge, du skal bruge, og hav en indkøbsliste klar, når du køber ind, så du holder dig til dine sunde valg.

Selvom følelsesmæssig spisning kan have rødder i familien, kan du lære at forstå og håndtere det. Dr. Pam Spurrs bog, The Emotional Eater’s Diet, giver yderligere vejledning og kan købes på Amazon. Du kan også finde mere fra hende på Twitter @drpamspurr.

article_content: On a cold Monday morning in Walpole, Massachusetts, Marc Mertz, a 44-year-old high school forestry teacher, was seen walking nude around his driveway. Despite temperatures near freezing, neighbors reported he wore only a ski hat and goggles, and soon gave up even his towel. Multiple local residents witnessed Mertz’s unsettling behavior and contacted police after seeing him unclothed. One observer noted that Mertz also behaved inappropriately at his mailbox. Police charged Mertz with open and gross lewdness, citing the witnesses’ shock and alarm. Authorities also revealed Mertz faced a similar allegation of public exposure in Natick in 2012. Employed at Norfolk County Agricultural High School, Mertz is now on administrative leave as the case is investigated. Parents, surprised by the news, described their previously positive experiences with him as a teacher. The investigation continues, and Mertz’s job remains uncertain as the legal process unfolds.

article_content: Gabby Giffords, the former Congresswoman still recovering from her 2011 gunshot injuries, has released a personal video message urging Arizona voters to back Representative Ron Barber’s re-election. In the video, she highlights Barber’s independence and courage, saying, "We expect our leaders to fight for us, not special interests. Ron Barber is independent, courageous, and truly represents Arizona." This video is part of a campaign by Americans for Responsible Solutions—a PAC Giffords founded with her husband Mark Kelly—to promote stronger gun control. Earlier ads from this group criticized Republican Martha McSally for previously not supporting laws to ban those convicted of misdemeanor stalking from buying guns. Barber, who was Giffords’ aide and was also wounded in the 2011 shooting, won a special election to fill her seat in 2012 and has served since then. He faces a close race against McSally, a retired Air Force colonel, in Arizona’s 2nd Congressional District—a contest analysts rate as a toss-up. Gun violence and campaign advertising remain central issues in this campaign. Americans for Responsible Solutions aired ads, including one that told the story of a mother whose daughter was killed by a stalker, sparking claims that the ads were inflammatory. After criticism, McSally’s campaign announced she now supports laws to prevent those convicted of misdemeanor stalking from purchasing firearms, while revealing McSally herself has experienced stalking. Barber, however, noted McSally still does not back broader background checks. Recent debates between McSally and Barber further highlighted their differing views on gun policy and campaign tactics. McSally, who supports the National Rifle Association, said gun violence must be addressed but labeled some campaign ads as ‘disgraceful.’ Barber defended the role of Americans for Responsible Solutions and emphasized Giffords’ respected advocacy against gun violence. The National Republican Congressional Committee has also launched ads suggesting Barber is less independent than Giffords, referencing times she broke with party leadership. In response, Giffords released a statement opposing groups that claim to speak for her and reaffirming her view of Barber as an independent, committed leader for Arizona.

article_content: Jimeet Modi, CEO of Samco Ventures, emphasizes that price is the most significant factor in investing. Drawing an analogy to sports, he notes that England, the 2019 ICC World Cup defending champions, have underperformed in the 2023 tournament. Similarly, in capital markets, strong prior performance does not guarantee future success. Many factors can affect the performance of both cricket teams and investment portfolios. Despite England retaining most of its 2019 squad, this year’s results have faltered—potentially due to age, agility, or changing conditions. In investing, portfolios face headwinds such as interest rates, inflation, management quality, market growth, and competition. Because performance drivers change over time, relying solely on past results can mislead investors. This common tendency is known as trend-chasing or extrapolation bias. Research shows that investing purely on historical performance is unreliable. To combat this bias, education is crucial. Understanding fundamentals and conducting research helps investors overcome triggers like fear of missing out, leading to more independent and rational decisions. The dot-com and housing bubbles exemplify how chasing trends carries risks. Evaluating thematic investments for their risks—and not just past gains—is essential. A diversified portfolio helps mitigate both systematic and unsystematic risk. Prudent allocation across asset classes offers resilience during volatile markets and rare 'Black Swan' events. Investors should also be mindful of peer pressure and avoid following the crowd or recommendations blindly. Consulting certified professionals is advised if needed. Adopting contrarian strategies—identifying undervalued assets out of favor—can be fruitful. Likewise, quantitative analysis helps filter out market noise. Sometimes, holding cash is preferable to joining overheated trends, and regular portfolio rebalancing is important. As with switching cricket teams, success in investing requires flexibility, risk management, and a solid strategy. article_content: After experiencing a stroke and then a transient ischaemic attack (mini-stroke), 53-year-old Deborah Ballard from Eastbourne, East Sussex, discovered her voice had changed to resemble a Welsh accent. Deborah first became aware of her unusual accent when calling her pets, and her friends and family quickly noticed something was different. Her son initially thought she was playing a trick on him. Her doctors identified her condition as foreign accent syndrome, a rare disorder where brain trauma—such as a stroke—causes a permanent change in speech patterns. Despite being born in London and raised in Kent, Deborah began speaking with a Welsh-sounding accent. Initially, Deborah felt embarrassed and upset, watching herself speak in the mirror, unsure of how to process the change. However, warm reactions from people around her—who described her new voice as 'sweet'—helped her accept it. She is currently on medication for her stroke and an earlier knee operation, and she continues to visit the local stroke unit for medical support. While Deborah found the unexpected change in her voice distressing at first, she is thankful to retain her ability to speak and move, aiming to remain optimistic through her recovery. Foreign accent syndrome is exceptionally rare, typically occurring after strokes or brain injuries. It affects how a person sounds when they speak but doesn't bestow new language abilities—only alters their native accent. Deborah's case echoes other rare instances globally, where patients unexpectedly adopt a new accent after neurological trauma. She is now focusing on taking life a day at a time and appreciates the encouragement of her family and friends.
translated_content: Efter hun fik et slagtilfælde og dernæst et mindre slagtilfælde (TIA), opdagede 53-årige Deborah Ballard fra Eastbourne, East Sussex, at hendes stemme pludselig lød walisisk. Deborah blev først opmærksom på sin usædvanlige accent, da hun kaldte på sine kæledyr, og hendes venner og familie bemærkede hurtigt, at noget var ændret. Hendes søn troede i begyndelsen, at hun lavede sjov. Lægerne konstaterede, at hun led af 'foreign accent syndrome', en sjælden lidelse hvor hjerneskade – for eksempel efter et slagtilfælde – giver en varig ændring af ens talemønster. Selvom Deborah er født i London og opvokset i Kent, begyndte hun at tale med walisisk accent. I starten følte Deborah sig flov og ked af det, og hun betragtede sig selv i spejlet for at prøve at forstå ændringen. Men hendes nærmeste reagerede positivt og beskrev hendes nye stemme som 'sød', hvilket hjalp hende til at acceptere den. Hun er lige nu i medicinsk behandling for sit slagtilfælde samt for en tidligere knæoperation, og hun fortsætter med at gå til kontrol på stroke-enheden. Selvom den uventede stemmeforandring først gjorde Deborah ked af det, er hun taknemmelig for fortsat at kunne tale og bevæge sig, og hun forsøger at forblive optimistisk gennem sin genoptræning. 'Foreign accent syndrome' er ekstremt sjælden og opstår typisk efter slagtilfælde eller hjerneskader. Tilstanden ændrer måden, man lyder på, men giver ikke evnen til at tale et fremmedsprog – det er kun ens nuværende accent, der påvirkes. Deborahs tilfælde ligner andre sjældne historier verden over, hvor patienter uventet har fået en ny accent efter neurologiske skader. Hun forsøger nu at tage en dag ad gangen og sætter stor pris på støtten fra familie og venner.

At Eden Gardens during Sunday’s Cricket World Cup match, South African spinner Keshav Maharaj produced a moment of brilliance that took the crowd—and the Indian team—by surprise. In the 11th over, Maharaj bowled a delivery that landed just outside Shubman Gill’s leg stump, turned sharply, and brushed the bails to dismiss the Indian opener. Gill was momentarily confused about how he was out, but a video replay confirmed the ball had lightly touched the bails, making for a memorable wicket.

Earlier in the game, India, having won the toss, opted to bat first in their penultimate group-stage match. Australia is preparing for a summer threatened by extreme heat and bushfires, but the fossil gas industry is simultaneously driving a huge new fracking project in the Beetaloo Basin, Northern Territory.

A recent CSIRO-backed report suggested Beetaloo could be developed without adding to Australia’s net emissions by employing mitigation and carbon offset strategies. Using these findings, the Northern Territory government granted approval for the project, claiming emissions could be controlled or eliminated accordingly.

Independent analysts, however, argue the report is based on overly positive assumptions regarding emission reductions and offsets, underestimating real impacts. Their own estimates show up to 1.2 billion tons of greenhouse gases could come from Beetaloo by 2050—about 45% more than presented in the original modeling.

Beetaloo is a sizable gas basin, larger than any existing gas field on Western Australia’s North-West Shelf. Annual emissions from Beetaloo’s fracking and processing at Darwin’s Middle Arm industrial zone could reach 49 million tons of CO2 equivalent—around 11% of Australia’s entire 2021 emissions. This single project’s output risks overwhelming the country’s reduction targets established in recent climate policies.

Scrutiny of the CSIRO report found domestic emissions underestimated by up to 84%, with even greater underestimates for upstream and LNG production emissions. The report’s reliance on offsets is particularly contentious; numerous experts note that offsets often fall short of genuine emission reductions and the scale required is enormous—offsetting Beetaloo could need land equivalent to 12 times the size of the Australian Capital Territory.

CSIRO maintains confidence in its analysis, affirming thorough technical assessment and peer review. Nonetheless, concerns persist regarding the application of blue hydrogen, touted as a cleaner use for Beetaloo’s gas. Actual carbon capture rates for blue hydrogen are far below the 90% assumed in the report, and experts expect green hydrogen to be less costly by 2030 and far less carbon-intensive.

If the Beetaloo project expands as proposed, its emissions could equal those from millions more cars on Australian roads, undermining efforts like the shift to electric vehicles. The International Energy Agency underscores the necessity of dramatically slashing fossil fuel usage by 2050. Critics maintain that moving forward with the Beetaloo project threatens to undo national climate action, as the climate’s response depends on actual emitted greenhouse gases—not idealized modeling or offset accounting.

På baggrund af rapporten godkendte regeringen i Northern Territory projektet og påstod, at udledningerne kunne styres eller elimineres.

Men uafhængige analytikere mener, at rapporten bygger på alt for optimistiske forudsætninger om reduktion og kompensation, og de reelle miljøpåvirkninger er betydeligt undervurderet. Egen analyse viser, at Beetaloo kan føre til hele 1,2 milliarder ton drivhusgasser frem til 2050 – omkring 45% mere end det oprindeligt blev vurderet.

Beetaloo er et af verdens største gasfelter, endda større end nogen på Western Australias North-West Shelf. Årlige udledninger fra Beetaloo-fracking og processering i Darwins Middle Arm-område kan ramme 49 millioner ton CO2-ækvivalenter – cirka 11% af hele Australiens 2021-udledning. Det betyder, at ét projekt kan opsluge landets reduktionsmål fra den nyeste klimapolitik.

CSIRO-rapportens beregninger undervurderer udledninger ved næsten alle led, nogle gange med op til 84% nationalt og over 100% fra upstream-aktiviteter og LNG-produktion. Afhængigheden af CO2-kompensation kritiseres bredt, da mange eksperter påpeger, at sådanne kompensationer sjældent skaber reelle klimaforbedringer. At kompensere Beetaloo vil kræve land svarende til tolv gange det australske hovedstadsterritorium.

CSIRO fastholder troen på deres forskning, som de fremhæver som grundigt peer-reviewet. Bekymringer består dog, især fordi blå brint – udset som en grønnere løsning med Beetaloo-gas – i praksis er langt mere klimabelastende, end rapporten forudsætter. Ingen verdensanlæg for blå brint har nået, hvad der bliver antaget, og grøn brint forventes at blive både billigere og renere inden 2030.

Hvis projektet og de planlagte udvidelser fortsætter, kan udledningerne svare til millioner flere biler på de australske veje, hvilket kan underminere elbil-initiativer. Det Internationale Energiagentur slår fast, at fossile brændstoffer skal reduceres markant frem mod 2050. Kritikere frygter derfor, at Beetaloo kan sætte Australiens klimaambitioner over styr, da klimaet reagerer på de faktiske udslip – ikke på velmenende modeller eller kompensation.

article_content: A London tour bus driver mounted the pavement to block two cyclists before shouting at them to 'get a Highway Code.' Ali Choudhry, 19, and a friend were cycling through central London using marked cycle lanes when they encountered an open-topped double-decker bus. Approaching the Tower of London on Lower Thames Street, road markings directed the cyclists onto a shared pavement. The bus driver then overtook them and pulled onto the pavement, blocking their path. He exited the bus, opened the bus door, and yelled at the cyclists, telling them to 'get a Highway Code.' The incident, which took place around 6pm on August 2, 2014, was recorded by a helmet-mounted camera. Mr. Choudhry, from Ilford, Essex, later described the driver as displaying 'road rage,' claiming the driver tailgated them and became angry after being delayed briefly. Choudhry stated that while the driver referenced having a bus full of witnesses, he considered his camera a more reliable source. Choudhry sent the footage to bus operator Golden Tours and is awaiting their response, expressing hope that the situation will be addressed appropriately. The Metropolitan Police have not been contacted. A spokesperson for Golden Tours reported that, upon review of the evidence and the bus's CCTV footage, the driver was dismissed immediately on August 4, 2014. Golden Tours stated that incidents like these help them maintain high standards and professionalism among their staff. After the confrontation, the driver drove away, and no further action has been reported.

article_content: Brooke Kinsella, a former EastEnders actress, endured a three-month stalking ordeal from Paul Mason, 40, who was convicted of stalking her at Bexley Magistrates' Court. Mason became fixated on Kinsella, sending her numerous unwanted messages, buying her gifts—including a wedding dress—and visiting the grave of her murdered brother, Ben Kinsella. He repeatedly referred to her as 'pumpkin' and attended events connected to her or her brother, sometimes bringing gifts and attempting close contact. Mason obtained Kinsella’s number from a website and sent disturbing texts, including promises to see her and references to her performing arts school, True Stars Academy. The Home Office initially warned Kinsella about Mason, intensifying her concerns for her safety. Police discovered evidence of Mason's obsession at his home, including a poster of Kinsella on his wall and hand-written love letters. Bexley Magistrates' Court heard testimony from Kinsella and Abigail Kegg, manager of the Ben Kinsella Trust. Mason was arrested in April following a particular incident in which he hugged Kinsella at an event. His trial revealed further unsettling behavior, including attempts to justify his actions as part of an autobiography. He was found guilty of stalking Kinsella between January 1 and April 4 of the previous year and will be sentenced on December 10.

Over recent years, pediatrician and neurologist Dr. William D. Graf has witnessed a surge in healthy children being prescribed stimulant medications purely to sharpen their academic performance. Both anecdotal accounts and research data point to a marked increase in prescriptions where there is no medical necessity. Troubled by this development, Dr. Graf and five fellow physicians published a position paper in the American Academy of Neurology’s journal, focusing on the ethics of giving 'study drugs' to children without ADHD or similar conditions.

The paper recommends that doctors refrain from prescribing such drugs for neuroenhancement in otherwise healthy young people. It highlights the risks involved—such as potential addiction and serious side effects—including social and professional consequences. According to Dr. Graf, parental pressure and growing societal competitiveness have contributed to the trend, but he warns these drugs carry significant dangers if used recreationally or without a clinical diagnosis.

Supporting the concern, a 2004 study revealed that in certain US school districts, the number of boys taking methylphenidate (a common ADHD drug) surpassed what would be expected based on ADHD prevalence. On some campuses, studies show up to 16% of students are using prescription stimulants as academic aids. Greg Eells, who leads mental health services at Cornell University, attributes increased demand in part to changing attitudes driven by pharmaceutical advertising and a culture of self-diagnosis. He also notes the risks associated with obtaining such medications illegally from peers.

Dr. Mark Wolraich from the American Academy of Pediatrics supports the ethical guidance but emphasizes that families shouldn’t be deterred from seeking treatment for diagnosed ADHD, as these medications can bring real benefits. He points out increased ADHD diagnoses could also reflect a better understanding that symptoms may persist into adolescence and beyond.

Despite ongoing debates about neuroenhancement, Dr. Graf and his colleagues argue for a clear ethical line: prescribing enhancement drugs to healthy youth is unjustifiable, now and going forward.

Både historier og forskning peger på en øget udskrivning af sådanne recepter uden medicinsk behov. Bekymret over udviklingen offentliggjorde Dr. Graf og fem kolleger en holdningsartikel i American Academy of Neurology’s tidsskrift, hvor de tager fat på de etiske spørgsmål ved at give 'studie-piller' til børn uden ADHD eller lignende diagnoser.

Artiklen anbefaler, at læger undlader at udskrive disse midler til unge, der ikke har en medicinsk lidelse. Den fremhæver risici som afhængighed og alvorlige bivirkninger samt sociale og professionelle følger. En undersøgelse fra 2004 afslørede, at i nogle amerikanske skoledistrikter får flere drenge methylphenidat (ADHD-medicin), end man kunne forvente ud fra diagnoser med ADHD. Sri Lanka Cricket (SLC) and its broadcast partners will have some positive news in mid-2024 as the Indian cricket team is scheduled to tour Sri Lanka for a six-match white-ball series, announced by SLC on Wednesday. While SLC remains suspended by the International Cricket Council (ICC) due to government interference—the same reason the U-19 World Cup was moved to South Africa—Sri Lanka’s men’s and women’s national teams will continue to fulfill their bilateral commitments.

SLC’s 2024 calendar confirms that India will visit for three ODIs and three T20Is during July and August, aligning with Sri Lanka’s main cricket season. The men’s national team is set to play 52 international matches in 2024, including 10 Tests, 21 ODIs, and 21 T20Is. T20I matches played at the T20 World Cup are additional to this count.

Key fixtures for Sri Lanka in 2024 include an away three-Test series against England (as part of the World Test Championship) and a two-Test series against South Africa in November.

Elsewhere, India’s stock market benchmark, Nifty, closed above 20,000 for the first time since mid-September, buoyed by easing concerns about US rate hikes. Meanwhile, Byju’s parent Think & Learn is under investigation by the Enforcement Directorate (ED) for alleged foreign exchange violations, including delayed documentation and export proceeds. The HCL Group is also progressing towards setting up a semiconductor assembly and testing facility in Karnataka.
translated_content:
Sri Lanka Cricket (SLC) og deres tv-partnere kan se frem til lidt positivt nyt i midten af 2024, når det indiske cricketlandshold besøger Sri Lanka til en seks-kamps white-ball serie, ifølge SLC’s udmelding onsdag. Selvom SLC stadig er suspenderet af International Cricket Council (ICC) på grund af regeringsindblanding – hvilket også bevirkede, at U-19 VM blev flyttet til Sydafrika – kan Sri Lankas herre- og kvindelandshold fortsat opfylde deres bilaterale forpligtelser.

SLC’s 2024-kalender bekræfter, at Indien kommer på besøg til tre ODI’er og tre T20I’er i juli og august, hvilket falder sammen med Sri Lankas hovedcricketsæson. Herrernes landshold forventes at spille 52 internationale kampe i 2024, inklusive 10 Test, 21 ODI og 21 T20I. T20I-kampe, der spilles under T20 World Cup, tæller ikke med i det samlede antal.

Vigtige opgør for Sri Lanka i 2024 inkluderer en udgående tre-Test-serie mod England (en del af World Test Championship) samt en to-Test-serie mod Sydafrika i november.

Andre steder lukkede det indiske aktieindeks Nifty over 20.000 for første gang siden september, hjulpet på vej af mindre bekymring om amerikanske rentestigninger. Samtidig er Byju’s moderselskab Think & Learn under efterforskning af Enforcement Directorate (ED) for påståede overtrædelser af valutalovene, inklusive forsinket dokumentation og indførsel af eksportindtægter. HCL Group er desuden i gang med at etablere en halvleder-samle- og testfabrik i Karnataka.
post_content: India is heading to Sri Lanka for a white-ball cricket series in 2024 – that’s some good news for SLC fans amid ICC drama! Plus, big moves in business: Nifty hits 20k+, Byju’s in the spotlight, and HCL’s bringing chips to Karnataka. #CricketNews #Stocks #Tech
translated_post: Indien besøger Sri Lanka til en white-ball cricketserie i 2024 – endelig lidt godt nyt for SLC midt i ICC-balladen! Også store nyheder i erhvervslivet: Nifty når 20.000+, Byju’s undersøges, og HCL bringer chips til Karnataka. #CricketNyt #Aktier #Tech

article_content: Kelly Bayer Rosmarin, the CEO of Australian telecom provider Optus, has resigned after a nationwide network failure earlier this month. The decision follows three challenging years at the helm, which included managing a significant data breach in 2022. The recent disruption cut mobile and internet access for about 10 million people across Australia for over 12 hours, impacting hospitals, transportation, payment systems, and emergency calls. In her announcement, Bayer Rosmarin expressed gratitude for her time at Optus but said moving on was best for the company. Chief Financial Officer Michael Venter will take over as interim CEO while a permanent successor is found. Yuen Kuan Moon, the CEO of parent company Singtel Group, praised her leadership through tough periods and improvements in financial performance amid the pandemic but emphasized that Optus must now prioritize rebuilding customer trust. Bayer Rosmarin has received strong criticism for her handling of both the outage and the data breach. During a recent Senate inquiry, she reported that thousands are pursuing compensation, and the company faces a class action from over 100,000 customers related to last year’s breach, one of Australia’s largest. While Optus blamed a sophisticated cyberattack, government officials have argued that the company’s lax security left it vulnerable.
translated_content: Kelly Bayer Rosmarin, administrerende direktør for det australske teleselskab Optus, har trukket sig tilbage efter et landsdækkende netnedbrud tidligere på måneden. Beslutningen følger tre udfordrende år i spidsen for Optus, hvor hun blandt andet håndterede et betydeligt datalæk i 2022. Det seneste nedbrud satte omkring 10 millioner australiere uden mobil- og internetforbindelse i mere end 12 timer og ramte hospitaler, transport, betalingssystemer og nødopkald. I sin udmelding udtrykte Bayer Rosmarin stor taknemmelighed for sin tid hos Optus, men mente, at det nu var bedst for selskabet, at hun træder tilbage. Finansdirektør Michael Venter overtager midlertidigt posten, mens der søges efter en permanent direktør. Yuen Kuan Moon, direktør for moderselskabet Singtel Group, roste hendes lederskab i svære perioder og for forbedringer i økonomien gennem pandemien, men understregede, at Optus nu skal prioritere at genvinde kundernes tillid. Bayer Rosmarin er blevet stærkt kritiseret for sin håndtering af både netnedbruddet og datalækket. På en nylig høring i senatet oplyste hun, at tusindvis af kunder kræver kompensation, og at virksomheden står over for et gruppesøgsmål fra over 100.000 personer relateret til sidste års læk, et af de største i Australien. Optus har forklaret lækket med et avanceret cyberangreb, men myndigheder har kritiseret selskabet for mangelfuld sikkerhed.
post_content: Optus CEO Kelly Bayer Rosmarin resigns after a major outage left millions without service across Australia! The company faces big challenges, including legal drama over last year’s data breach. Will Optus win back customer trust? #Optus #AusNews #Telco

article_content:
Ruth Madoff has spoken publicly for the first time about the immense hardship she and her husband, Bernie Madoff, endured after the revelation of his $60 billion Ponzi scheme. She revealed that on Christmas Eve 2008, overwhelmed by public outrage and relentless abuse, the couple attempted suicide by taking pills, but survived and awoke the next morning. Ruth explained that the plan was impulsive and stemmed from the unbearable pressure and hostility, including hate mail and threatening phone calls, they received after Bernie confessed to orchestrating the world’s largest financial fraud.

Bernie Madoff is now serving a 150-year sentence in a North Carolina prison. The scandal had devastating consequences for the family, most notably the suicide of their son Mark Madoff, who took his own life in December 2010 on the second anniversary of Bernie's arrest. Mark and his brother, Andrew, were the ones who reported their father’s crimes to authorities, but the subsequent negative publicity proved too much for Mark to bear.

Mark’s widow, Stephanie Madoff Mack, recently released a memoir, 'The End Of Normal,' providing an insider’s account of the family turmoil. She describes ongoing anger toward Bernie Madoff and details complex family dynamics, depicting Ruth Madoff as obsessive about dieting and household behaviors.

Following Bernie Madoff’s imprisonment, Ruth Madoff has moved to a modest apartment in Florida, where she receives support from relatives and volunteers by helping feed the homeless. The family’s vast wealth is gone, and Ruth now drives a 14-year-old car. While the legal process has enabled more than 1,200 victims to recover some funds—splitting $316 million from an estimated $9 billion so far—it represents only a fraction of what was lost. The impact of the Madoff scandal continues to affect victims and the family alike.
translated_content:
Ruth Madoff har for første gang talt offentligt om de store udfordringer, hun og hendes mand, Bernie Madoff, stod overfor efter afsløringen af hans Ponzi-bedrageri på 60 milliarder dollars. Hun fortalte, at parret juleaften 2008, overvældet af offentlig vrede og konstant chikane, forsøgte at begå selvmord ved at tage piller, men overlevede og vågnede næste morgen. Ruth forklarede, at planen var impulsiv og udsprang af et uudholdeligt pres og fjendtlighed, blandt andet i form af hadefulde breve og truende opkald, som de modtog efter Bernies tilståelse af verdens største finansielle bedrageri.

Bernie Madoff afsoner nu en dom på 150 år i et fængsel i North Carolina. Skandalen havde ødelæggende konsekvenser for familien, især med sønnen Mark Madoffs selvmord i december 2010 på årsdagen for Bernies anholdelse. Mark og hans bror, Andrew, var dem, der indgav anmeldelsen mod deres far, men den efterfølgende negative medieomtale blev for meget for Mark at håndtere.

Marks enke, Stephanie Madoff Mack, har for nylig udgivet en erindringsbog, 'The End Of Normal', som giver et indblik i familiens kaos. Hun udtrykker fortsat vrede mod Bernie Madoff og beskriver komplekse familiedynamikker, hvor Ruth Madoff fremstår som meget optaget af diæter og hverdagsrutiner.

Efter Bernie Madoffs fængsling er Ruth Madoff flyttet til en simpel lejlighed i Florida, hvor hun modtager støtte fra sin familie og frivilligt hjælper med at servere mad til hjemløse. Familiens formue er væk, og Ruth kører nu rundt i en 14 år gammel bil. Selvom mere end 1.200 ofre har fået udbetalt nogen erstatning—de har delt 316 millioner dollars ud af cirka 9 milliarder dollars indtil videre—udgør det kun en lille del af det samlede tab. Madoff-skandalens konsekvenser præger stadig både ofre og familien.

article_content: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi has called for urgent international action to halt the unfolding humanitarian disaster in Gaza. Speaking to a visiting delegation of diplomats from Arab and Muslim-majority countries on Monday, Wang emphasized the need for swift collaboration to de-escalate the situation and restore peace in the Middle East. Wang described the crisis in Gaza as a humanitarian catastrophe that impacts the global community, challenging notions of right, wrong, and the boundaries of humanity. He urged the international community to act decisively to prevent further escalation and suffering. The delegation visiting Beijing includes foreign ministers from the Palestinian Authority, Indonesia, Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Jordan, and the secretary-general of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation. China announced the talks would focus on promoting a de-escalation of the conflict, protecting civilians, and achieving a fair resolution to the Palestinian issue. The current conflict is rooted in the October 7 attacks by Hamas, according to Israel, which resulted in about 1,200 deaths and 240 hostages taken. In response, Israel launched extensive airstrikes and ground operations in Gaza. According to Gaza's Hamas government, more than 13,000 people have been killed. Most casualties on both sides are reported to be civilians. Wang reaffirmed China's position as a longstanding supporter of Arab and Muslim countries, emphasizing its commitment to defending their legitimate rights and interests, and supporting the Palestinian people's pursuit of their legitimate national rights.

Under et møde med en delegation af diplomater fra arabiske og muslimsk dominerede lande mandag fremhævede Wang behovet for hurtigt samarbejde for at nedtrappe situationen og genoprette freden i Mellemøsten. Wang beskrev krisen i Gaza som en humanitær katastrofe, der berører hele verdenssamfundet og udfordrer vores forståelse af ret og uret samt menneskelighedens grænser. Han opfordrede det internationale samfund til at handle beslutsomt for at forhindre yderligere eskalering og lidelse. Delegationen, der besøger Beijing, inkluderer udenrigsministre fra den Palæstinensiske Myndighed, Indonesien, Egypten, Saudi-Arabien, Jordan og generalsekretæren for Organisationen for Islamisk Samarbejde. Kina har oplyst, at formålet med møderne er at fremme deeskalering af konflikten, beskytte civile og opnå en retfærdig løsning på det palæstinensiske spørgsmål. Den nuværende konflikt udspringer ifølge Israel af Hamas’ angreb den 7. oktober, som medførte cirka 1.200 døde og 240 gidseltagninger. Som svar satte Israel gang i omfattende luftangreb og landoperationer i Gaza. Ifølge Gazas Hamas-styrede regering er mere end 13.000 blevet dræbt. De fleste ofre på begge sider oplyses at være civile. Wang bekræftede endnu engang Kinas rolle som stærk støtte for arabiske og muslimske lande og understregede landets engagement i at forsvare deres legitime rettigheder og støtte det palæstinensiske folks kamp for deres retmæssige nationale rettigheder.

article_content:
Ogenyi Onazi has revealed that a conflict between former Super Eagles captains Joseph Yobo and Mikel Obi at the 2013 Africa Cup of Nations helped fuel the team's drive to victory. Under the guidance of the late coach Stephen Keshi, Nigeria started with two draws against Burkina Faso and Zambia but picked up momentum with a crucial win over Ethiopia, courtesy of Victor Moses' brace, sending them into the quarter-finals.

Their next challenge was a tough match against favorites Ivory Coast, where Nigeria was widely regarded as the underdogs. Despite the odds, the Eagles pulled off an unexpected 2-1 win, with Emmanuel Emenike scoring first, Cheikh Tiote leveling the score shortly after halftime, and Sunday Mba netting the decisive goal twelve minutes from time.

Nigeria went on to defeat Mali 4-1 in the semi-finals, with contributions from Elderson Echiejile, Ahmed Musa, Ideye Brown, and an own goal by Momo Sissoko. In the final held in Johannesburg, Mba once again made the difference, securing a 1-0 victory against Burkina Faso and earning Nigeria its third African title.

Onazi recounted to Soccernet a significant moment before the quarter-final, when Yobo, despite personal issues with Mikel, addressed the team after a meeting led by Keshi. Yobo emphasized putting aside their differences, focusing on the importance of teamwork, and playing for national pride. Mikel echoed these sentiments, encouraging the team to settle internal conflicts among themselves and focus on overcoming their opponents.

Nigeria is set to compete in Group A of the 2023 AFCON, facing the host nation Ivory Coast, Equatorial Guinea, and Guinea Bissau from January 13 to February 11, 2024. Coincidentally, the last time Ivory Coast hosted the tournament 39 years ago, Nigeria also reached the finals.
translated_content:
Ogenyi Onazi har afsløret, at en konflikt mellem de tidligere Super Eagles-kaptajner Joseph Yobo og Mikel Obi under Africa Cup of Nations i 2013 var med til at motivere holdet til sejr. Under træneren Stephen Keshi startede Nigeria med to uafgjorte mod Burkina Faso og Zambia, men kom i gang med en vigtig sejr over Etiopien takket være to mål af Victor Moses, hvilket sendte dem i kvartfinalen.

Herefter stod de over for storfavoritterne Elfenbenskysten, hvor Nigeria var udråbt som underdogs. Alligevel leverede Eagles en overraskende 2-1-sejr: Emmanuel Emenike scorede først, Cheikh Tiote udlignede lige efter pausen, og Sunday Mba sikrede sejren tolv minutter før tid.

Nigeria slog derefter Mali 4-1 i semifinalen med scoringer fra Elderson Echiejile, Ahmed Musa, Ideye Brown og et selvmål fra Momo Sissoko. I finalen i Johannesburg var det igen Mba, der afgjorde kampen med et enkelt mål til 1-0 over Burkina Faso og sikrede Nigeria den tredje kontinentale titel.

Onazi fortalte til Soccernet om et vigtigt øjeblik inden kvartfinalen, hvor Yobo – på trods af personlige problemer med Mikel – talte til holdet efter et møde med Keshi. Yobo understregede, at de skulle lægge uenigheder til side og fokusere på samarbejdet og national stolthed. Mikel bakkede op om budskabet og opfordrede holdet til at løse interne konflikter, så de kunne fokusere på at overvinde deres modstandere sammen.

Nigeria deltager i Gruppe A ved AFCON 2023 og møder værtslandet Elfenbenskysten, Ækvatorialguinea og Guinea-Bissau fra 13. januar til 11. februar 2024. Det er værd at bemærke, at sidste gang Elfenbenskysten arrangerede turneringen for 39 år siden, nåede Nigeria også finalen.
post_content: Throwback to the 2013 AFCON: a locker room clash between Yobo and Mikel actually fired up the Super Eagles to claim their third African title! Now, Nigeria’s getting ready to take on Group A at AFCON 2023. 🇳🇬🔥 #SuperEagles #AFCON2023
translated_post: Tilbageblik til AFCON 2013: et opgør mellem Yobo og Mikel tændte Super Eagles til at vinde deres tredje afrikanske mesterskab! Nu venter Gruppe A i AFCON 2023. 🇳🇬✨ #SuperEagles #AFCON2023

article_content: Willie Nelson announced on Friday that he had canceled his concert at SeaWorld, citing increasing public pressure and his own convictions regarding SeaWorld's treatment of animals. He told CNN’s Brooke Baldwin, 'I don’t agree with how they treat their animals. It wasn’t a tough choice for me.' Nelson's decision came after SeaWorld Orlando spokesman Nick Gollattscheck stated the cancellation was due to scheduling conflicts. Nelson contradicted this, clarifying he withdrew because of how SeaWorld manages orcas and other marine animals, a concern heightened by the CNN-aired documentary ‘Blackfish.’ The Barenaked Ladies, a Canadian band, also backed out of a SeaWorld performance for similar reasons. Their move came after public conversation online and an online petition prompted by the documentary. SeaWorld has faced growing public criticism over its captive orcas, especially after ‘Blackfish.’ Nelson noted he had received petitions, including one connected to his own grandchild and another started by Danielle Legg on Change.org that gained over 9,000 signatures. Legg emphasized Nelson’s longstanding activism as a reason for him to withdraw. After hearing of Nelson’s and the Barenaked Ladies' cancellations, Legg expressed hope that more musicians would decline to play at SeaWorld, since 'at least they have the choice—unlike the animals there.' Nelson maintained that, while public campaigns contributed, his main motive was doing what he believed was right. He also voiced criticism of animal captivity in many zoos, suggesting it may be cruel unless animals are in natural habitats. 'What happens at SeaWorld isn’t OK,' Nelson said. CNN’s Jane Caffrey contributed to this report.
translated_content: Willie Nelson meddelte fredag, at han havde aflyst sin koncert i SeaWorld, grundet stigende offentligt pres og sine egne overbevisninger om SeaWorlds behandling af dyr. Han sagde til CNN’s Brooke Baldwin: 'Jeg er ikke enig i, hvordan de behandler deres dyr. Det var ikke et svært valg for mig.' Nelsons beslutning blev truffet, efter SeaWorld Orlandos talsmand Nick Gollattscheck havde udtalt, at aflysningen skyldtes kalenderkonflikter. Nelson afviste dette og gjorde det klart, at han trak sig på grund af SeaWorlds behandling af spækhuggere og andre havdyr – især efter at have set CNN-dokumentaren ‘Blackfish’. Det canadiske band Barenaked Ladies valgte også at aflyse deres koncert i SeaWorld af lignende grunde. Deres beslutning kom efter debat på sociale medier og en underskriftsindsamling udløst af dokumentaren. SeaWorld har mødt voksende offentlig kritik af deres forhold for spækhuggere, især efter ‘Blackfish’. Nelson nævnte, at han havde modtaget flere underskriftsindsamlinger, herunder en med forbindelse til hans barnebarn og en anden startet af Danielle Legg på Change.org, der fik over 9.000 underskrifter. Legg påpegede, at Nelsons mangeårige engagement for dyr gjorde det vigtigt, at han aflyste. Efter Nelsons og Barenaked Ladies’ aflysninger udtrykte Legg håb om, at flere kunstnere vil fravælge SeaWorld, da 'de i det mindste har et valg – det har dyrene ikke.' Nelson understregede, at selvom offentlige kampagner spillede ind, var det vigtigste for ham at gøre det rigtige. Han kritiserede også dyrehold i mange zoologiske haver og mente, at det kan være grusomt, medmindre dyrene lever i naturlige omgivelser. 'Det, der sker i SeaWorld, er ikke okay,' sagde Nelson. CNN’s Jane Caffrey bidrog til denne rapport.

article_content: MOSCOW: Russian President Vladimir Putin has signed amendments to the law governing presidential elections that introduce new restrictions on media coverage, local news agencies reported on Tuesday. The changes come ahead of a presidential election scheduled for March, in which Putin, who has led Russia for 24 years, is expected to seek another six-year term. Putin, 71, has not officially announced his candidacy, stating he will do so only after parliament formally sets the election date. According to the approved amendments, only journalists with contracts at officially registered media organizations will be allowed to attend election commission meetings, potentially excluding freelancers and independent reporters. The amendments also restrict coverage of election commission activities on military bases or in areas under martial law, unless permission is granted by the relevant regional and military authorities. Additionally, the changes ban campaign activity on 'blocked resources.' As part of a wider clampdown on opposition and information flow, Russia has blocked numerous websites and services, including Facebook and Instagram. Many users access these sites with VPNs to circumvent the bans.

Ændringerne sker forud for et præsidentvalg i marts, hvor Putin, der har ledet Rusland i 24 år, forventes at søge endnu en seksårig periode. Putin, 71, har ikke officielt meldt sit kandidatur ud og siger, at han først vil gøre det, når parlamentet formelt har fastsat valgdatoen. Ifølge de godkendte ændringer må kun journalister, der er ansat ved kontrakt i officielt registrerede medieorganisationer, deltage i valgkommissionsmøder, hvilket kan udelukke freelancere og uafhængige journalister. Ændringerne begrænser også dækning af valgkommissionens aktiviteter på militærbaser eller i områder under undtagelsestilstand, medmindre de relevante regionale og militære myndigheder har givet tilladelse. Derudover forbyder ændringerne kampagneaktiviteter på 'blokerede ressourcer'. Som led i en bredere indsats mod opposition og informationsstrøm har Rusland blokeret adskillige hjemmesider og tjenester, herunder Facebook og Instagram. Mange benytter VPN for at omgå blokkeringerne.

article_content: Former AC Milan and Italy midfielder Demetrio Albertini believes Fernando Torres can soon regain his goal-scoring form. Torres, who joined Milan on a two-year loan from Chelsea during the summer, has not matched the success he had at Atletico Madrid and Liverpool. So far, the Spanish striker has scored just one goal in 10 Serie A appearances for Milan and has not started in the team's last three league matches. Albertini told the Turin-based sports newspaper Tuttosport, 'If you want to see the real Nino (Torres), you have to wait. The current Torres is not the one we all knew. He is coming off two seasons with little playing time, so it's not easy to find one's form again.' 'Fernando must recognize what he has experienced, and he needs to regain self-confidence, not just with words but through actions. Also, football in Spain and England offers more space than in Italy, so a striker might have four or five chances per game there. Serie A is completely new for him.' Albertini, who played with Torres at Atletico in the 2002-03 season, thinks the 30-year-old needs time to adapt in Milan. He is confident, though, that Torres can follow his compatriot Fernando Llorente’s example and succeed in Italy's top league. Llorente initially struggled after moving to Juventus from Athletic Bilbao in 2013 but eventually became a regular player. 'Llorente is a great example,' Albertini said. 'After two or three months he adapted to the Italian style and rhythm, but he joined a team that had just won the Scudetto and only he and Carlos Tevez were new additions. The challenges are greater for Torres, as he must adjust to a team that has changed significantly under new coach Filippo Inzaghi.' 'When you change five or six players in a starting lineup, it naturally creates fewer guarantees and makes it harder for newcomers. It’s easier to adapt when joining a settled team. If you change the squad’s structure every summer, adaptation becomes difficult.' Albertini concluded that Torres may spend more time on the bench as he adapts, stressing it is up to coach Inzaghi and Torres to decide the best path forward.
translated_content: Den tidligere AC Milan- og italienske midtbanespiller Demetrio Albertini mener, at Fernando Torres snart kan genfinde sin målfarlighed. Torres, som kom til Milan på en toårig lejeaftale fra Chelsea i sommer, har endnu ikke haft samme succes, som han havde hos Atletico Madrid og Liverpool. Indtil nu har den spanske angriber kun scoret ét mål i 10 Serie A-kampe for Milan og har ikke startet i holdets seneste tre ligakampe. Albertini sagde til den torinske sportsavis Tuttosport: 'Hvis du vil se den rigtige Nino (Torres), må du vente. Den nuværende Torres er ikke den, vi alle kendte. Han kommer fra to sæsoner med meget lidt spilletid, så det er ikke nemt at finde formen igen.' 'Fernando skal erkende, hvad han har været igennem, og han skal genfinde selvtilliden – ikke kun med ord, men gennem handlinger. Desuden giver fodbold i Spanien og England flere rum end i Italien, så en angriber kan have fire eller fem chancer pr. kamp der. Serie A er helt nyt for ham.' Albertini, der spillede sammen med Torres i Atletico i sæsonen 2002-03, mener, at den 30-årige har brug for tid til at falde til i Milan. Han er dog overbevist om, at Torres kan følge sin landsmand Fernando Llorentes eksempel og få succes i Italiens bedste række. Llorente havde det svært, da han først kom til Juventus fra Athletic Bilbao i 2013, men blev efterhånden fast mand. 'Llorente er et godt eksempel,' sagde Albertini. 'Efter to-tre måneder vænnede han sig til den italienske spillestil og rytme, men han kom til et hold, der netop havde vundet Scudettoen, og kun han og Carlos Tevez var nye. Udfordringerne for Torres er større, fordi han skal finde sig til rette på et hold, der har ændret sig meget under den nye træner Filippo Inzaghi.' 'Når man skifter fem-seks spillere i startopstillingen, er der naturligt færre garantier, og det bliver sværere for de nye at falde til. Det er lettere at tilpasse sig et veletableret hold. Hvis man ændrer holdets struktur hver sommer, bliver tilpasningen svær.' Albertini sluttede med at sige, at Torres måske skal bruge mere tid på bænken, mens han tilpasser sig, og at det er op til Inzaghi og Torres at finde den bedste løsning fremadrettet.

article_content: On Friday, as she went to pick up her New York City Marathon bib, longtime New Yorker Lauren Mandel doubted whether running the race was the right thing to do. Four days after Superstorm Sandy hit, she felt uneasy approaching the runners’ convention center. "Walking past generators warming tents for meals, knowing people close by haven't had a hot meal in days, made me feel this is wrong," she said. Like Mandel, many across New York and the nation felt conflicted after Mayor Michael Bloomberg said Wednesday that the marathon would continue as planned. The decision brought criticism from local leaders and residents, led to a boycott campaign on Facebook, and trended on Twitter as people called to postpone the race. By Friday, after growing public backlash, city and race officials canceled the marathon for the first time in its 42-year history. The mayor’s statement noted the race was "a source of controversy and division." Deputy Mayor Howard Wolfson said the marathon "was going to be divisive." Since 1970, the marathon has drawn about 47,000 runners, 12,000 volunteers, and 2.5 million spectators each year, winding through all five boroughs. The Staten Island starting line—an area hard-hit by Sandy—became a focus of criticism. At least 20 people there died, and many homes were destroyed. On Staten Island, residents pleaded for essentials. U.S. Rep. Michael Grimm, who represents the area, said the city had misplaced priorities. "We're still pulling bodies out, and the mayor is worried about marathon runners," he said. Images of devastation were widely shared online. Some runners created a Facebook boycott group, vowing to help with recovery in Staten Island while wearing their race bibs. The New York Post highlighted the use of generators at marathon tents in Central Park while many New Yorkers were without power. After the marathon's cancellation, many quickly reacted on social media. "Canceling the NYC Marathon was 100% the right decision," tweeted Parth Desai. Runner Karim Lebhour, though disappointed, said, "nobody really was in the mood." Dean Karnazes, a runner from California, agreed and encouraged others to volunteer instead. Links to Race2Recover.com began circulating, urging runners to donate hotel rooms to those displaced by Sandy. For many who had traveled internationally, the sudden cancellation was frustrating, especially after time and money spent training and qualifying. "It's a huge frustration," said Juan Carlos Arevalo, who flew in from Argentina. Neil Robbins of Scotland had planned to run for cancer research, but said, "Sandy has put an end to my dream. I'll try again next year, maybe." Mayor Bloomberg previously emphasized the marathon's importance to small businesses. Councilman Domenic Recchia, whose Brooklyn district was hard-hit, said it was wrong to host the event during a crisis. Bloomberg cited city resilience after 9/11 as his rationale for considering the marathon. In the end, city and race officials decided not to postpone or shorten the event, agreeing it wouldn’t be a celebration. The announcement came Friday afternoon. Mike Denton, a New Yorker set to run, said months of training now felt pointless. Some worried about the city losing the economic and charitable benefits the marathon brings. Paula Radcliffe, Olympic marathoner and former champion, tweeted the city "needs the solidarity and economic boost" from Marathon Sunday. Coach Tony Ruiz cautioned the cancellation could severely impact the city. The marathon raises millions annually for charities—over $34 million in 2011. New York Road Runners, the organizing group, gave $1 million to the Hurricane Sandy Relief Fund and encouraged others to donate. After the disappointment, many runners turned to volunteering. Mandel, who had already chosen not to run, said, "It's a wonderful experience. I've done it before. It's just not the right time." CNN's Melissa Gray, Heather Butler, Eden Pontz, and Chris Kokenes contributed to this report.

"At gå forbi generatorer, der opvarmer telte til måltider, når folk i nærheden ikke har fået et varmt måltid i dagevis, fik mig til at tænke, at det er forkert," sagde hun. Ligesom Mandel følte mange i New York og landet over sig splittede, efter at borgmester Michael Bloomberg onsdag meddelte, at maratonløbet ville fortsætte som planlagt. Fredag, efter voksende offentligt pres, aflyste kommunen og løbsarrangørerne maratonet for første gang i dets 42-årige historie. Borgmesterens erklæring anførte, at løbet var "en kilde til kontrovers og splittelse." Viceborgmester Howard Wolfson sagde, at maratonet "ville blive splittende." Siden 1970 har maratonet tiltrukket cirka 47.000 løbere, 12.000 frivillige og 2,5 millioner tilskuere årligt. Ruten går gennem alle fem bydele. Starten på Staten Island — hårdt ramt af Sandy — blev et fokus for kritik. Mindst 20 mennesker omkom der, og mange hjem blev ødelagt. På Staten Island tryglede beboerne om nødvendigheder. Den amerikanske kongresmedlem Michael Grimm, som repræsenterer området, mente, byen havde forkerte prioriteter. "Vi leder stadig efter omkomne, og borgmesteren bekymrer sig om maratonløbere," sagde han. Billeder af ødelæggelser blev delt vidt og bredt online. Nogle løbere oprettede en boykotgruppe på Facebook og lovede at hjælpe med genopbygningen på Staten Island iført deres startnumre. Forsiden på New York Post fremhævede brugen af generatorer til maraton-telte i Central Park, mens mange newyorkere manglede strøm. Efter aflysningen reagerede mange straks på sociale medier. "At aflyse NYC Marathon var 100% den rigtige beslutning," tweetede Parth Desai. Løber Karim Lebhour sagde, at selvom han var skuffet, "var der alligevel ingen, som rigtig var i stemning." Dean Karnazes, en løber fra Californien, var enig og opfordrede andre til at melde sig som frivillige i stedet. Links til Race2Recover.com begyndte at cirkulere og opfordrede løbere til at donere deres hotelværelser til personer, der var fordrevet af Sandy. For internationale deltagere var den pludselige aflysning frustrerende — især efter investering af tid og penge på kvalifikation og rejsen. "Det er meget frustrerende," sagde Juan Carlos Arevalo, der rejste fra Argentina. Neil Robbins fra Skotland havde planlagt at løbe for kræftforskning, men sagde: "Sandy satte en stopper for min drøm. Måske prøver jeg igen næste år." Borgmester Bloomberg havde tidligere understreget maratonets betydning for små virksomheder. Byrådsmedlem Domenic Recchia, hvis distrikt i Brooklyn blev hårdt ramt, mente, begivenheden var upassende i en krisetid. Bloomberg sammenlignede modstanden mod afvikling af maratonet med situationen efter 9/11 og fremhævede behovet for byens fortsatte aktivitet. I sidste ende besluttede kommunen og løbsledelsen ikke at udsætte eller forkorte løbet, idet de blev enige om, at det ikke ville være en fejring. Beslutningen blev annonceret fredag eftermiddag. Mike Denton fra New York, der skulle løbe, sagde, at flere måneders træning nu føltes forgæves. Nogle var bekymrede for, at byen skulle miste det økonomiske og velgørende udbytte, som maratonet bringer. Paula Radcliffe, olympisk maratonløber og tidligere vinder, tweetede, at byen "har brug for det sammenhold og det økonomiske løft", som Marathon Sunday giver. Træner Tony Ruiz advarede om, at aflysningen kunne ramme byen hårdt. Maratonet samler årligt millioner ind til velgørenhed — over 34 millioner dollars i 2011. New York Road Runners, arrangørerne, donerede $1 million til Hurricane Sandy Relief Fund og opfordrede andre til også at bidrage. Efter skuffelsen valgte mange løbere at blive frivillige. Mandel, der allerede havde besluttet sig for ikke at løbe, sagde: "Det er en fantastisk oplevelse. Jeg har gjort det før. Men det er bare ikke det rigtige tidspunkt." CNN's Melissa Gray, Heather Butler, Eden Pontz og Chris Kokenes bidrog til denne rapport.

article_content: A heated congressional hearing was convened to scrutinize the General Services Administration’s (GSA) handling of a lavish 2010 conference in Las Vegas that cost taxpayers $800,000. Jeff Neely, the GSA executive who organized the controversial event, repeatedly invoked his Fifth Amendment right and declined to answer lawmakers’ questions, after which he was excused from the session. Martha Johnson, the former GSA administrator who resigned amid the scandal, expressed deep regret to Congress for how the situation unfolded and mourned the loss of her public service career. Rep. Darrell Issa, chairman of the Oversight Committee, denounced the GSA’s excessive spending, characterizing it as symptomatic of wider government waste and questioning the growth of federal bureaucracy. Lawmakers from both parties sharply rebuked the GSA after an inspector general’s report uncovered not only extravagant spending but also violations of contracting rules and agency policies. The abuses detailed included purchases of expensive commemorative coins, a costly team-building exercise, entertainment by a mind reader, bypassing in-house event planners in favor of outside consultants, and personal perks offered to friends. Johnson explained that upon joining the GSA, she found significant mismanagement and decided to resign after reviewing a draft of the inspector general’s findings to send a clear message that such behavior was unacceptable. Other officials questioned at the hearing included Mike Robertson, GSA Chief of Staff, and David Foley, a deputy commissioner, who both appeared in videos making light of oversight and spending. The political drama intensified as Issa sought clarity on when the White House was briefed about the investigation, with Robertson eventually naming Kimberley D. Harris in the counsel’s office as the contact, months prior to previously acknowledged timelines. The controversy escalated following the release of videos showing inappropriate conduct at the conference, amplifying debate over federal spending during both the Obama and Bush administrations. Rep. Trey Gowdy demanded criminal indictments rather than just reports, and criticized GSA leaders for betraying the public’s trust. Ultimately, committee members from both parties agreed that such misuse of tax dollars should not be tolerated and called for major reforms to restore faith in government stewardship.
translated_content: En ophedet kongreshøring blev afholdt for at undersøge General Services Administration’s (GSA) håndtering af en ekstravagant konference i Las Vegas i 2010, der kostede skatteyderne 800.000 dollars. Jeff Neely, GSA-lederen der organiserede det omstridte arrangement, påkaldte sig gentagne gange sin ret til ikke at udtale sig og nægtede at svare på lovgivernes spørgsmål, hvorefter han blev undskyldt fra høringen. Martha Johnson, den tidligere GSA-administrator, der trak sig på grund af skandalen, udtrykte stor fortrydelse til Kongressen over, hvordan sagen udviklede sig, og sørgede over tabet af sin offentlige karriere. Rep. Darrell Issa, formand for Udvalg for Oversight, fordømte GSA’s overdrevne forbrug og beskrev det som et symptom på et bredere problem med spild i regeringen og satte spørgsmålstegn ved den offentlige sektors vækst. Lovgivere fra begge partier kritiserede skarpt GSA, efter at en rapport fra generalinspektøren afslørede ikke kun ekstravagant forbrug, men også brud på kontrakt- og agenturregler. De nævnte misbrug omfattede dyre erindringsmønter, en kostbar teambuilding-øvelse, underholdning med en tankelæser, brug af eksterne konsulenter frem for interne planlæggere, samt personlige fordele tilbudt til venner. Johnson forklarede, at hun ved sin tiltræden fandt betydelige ledelsesproblemer, og besluttede at gå af efter at have læst et udkast til generalinspektørens rapport for at signalere, at denne adfærd ikke var acceptabel. Andre indkaldte embedsmænd inkluderede Mike Robertson, GSA’s stabschef, og David Foley, vicekommissær, som begge optrådte i videoer, hvor de gjorde grin med tilsyn og forbrug. Det politiske drama voksede, da Issa søgte klarhed over, hvornår Det Hvide Hus blev informeret om undersøgelsen. Robertson identificerede til sidst Kimberley D. Harris fra rådgiverstaben som kontaktperson – flere måneder før tidligere anerkendt. Sagen voksede, da videoer af upassende opførsel ved konferencen kom frem, hvilket skabte debat om offentlige udgifter under både Obama- og Bush-administrationen. Rep. Trey Gowdy krævede egentlige anklager frem for blot rapporter og kritiserede GSA’s ledere for at svigte offentlighedens tillid. Til sidst var der enighed blandt udvalgsmedlemmerne fra begge partier om, at sådanne misbrug af skattekroner ikke kan tolereres, og at der er behov for større reformer for at genoprette tilliden til det offentlige.
