article_content: A 20-year-old footballer for Russian club Anzhi Makhachkala, Gasan Magomedov, was shot and killed near his home in Russia's North Caucasus region. Magomedov was driving into his home village on Saturday night when his car came under machine-gun fire. He died from his injuries while being taken to the hospital, according to a statement from Anzhi. No arrests have been made, and the motive for the attack is unclear. Magomedov was a regular midfielder on Anzhi's youth and reserve teams, and the club expressed its deepest condolences on his death. 'One thing can be said with confidence - Magomedov could not have provoked anything like this in any way,' the club stated. The attack took place in Dagestan, where Anzhi is based. The region has experienced a long-running Islamist insurgency, and clashes between rebels and Russian security forces occur from time to time. In recent years, Anzhi Makhachkala competed for the Russian Premier League title but was relegated to the second division last season. For some time, the club housed its star players, such as Samuel Eto'o and Willian, in Moscow to avoid the security risks in Dagestan.
translated_content: En 20-årig fodboldspiller for den russiske klub Anzhi Makhachkala, Gasan Magomedov, blev skudt og dræbt nær sit hjem i Ruslands Nordkaukasus-region. Magomedov var lørdag aften på vej ind i sin hjemby, da hans bil blev beskudt med maskinpistol. Han døde af sine kvæstelser under transporten til hospitalet, ifølge en udtalelse fra Anzhi. Der er ikke foretaget nogen anholdelser, og motivet for angrebet er uklart. Magomedov var fast midtbanespiller på Anzhis ungdoms- og reserveteam, og klubben udtrykte deres dybeste kondolencer over hans død. 'En ting kan siges med sikkerhed – Magomedov kunne på ingen måde have provokeret noget som dette,' udtalte klubben. Angrebet fandt sted i Dagestan, hvor Anzhi har base. Regionen har i længere tid oplevet et islamistisk oprør, og sammenstød mellem oprørere og russiske sikkerhedsstyrker forekommer af og til. I de senere år kæmpede Anzhi Makhachkala om mesterskabet i den russiske Premier League, men blev rykket ned i anden division sidste sæson. I en periode boede klubbens stjernespillere, såsom Samuel Eto'o og Willian, i Moskva for at undgå sikkerhedsrisiciene i Dagestan.

article_content:
Tunisia announced on Monday that it would reject a tranche of funds from the European Union intended to help the debt-stricken country patrol the Mediterranean Sea amid a surge in migrant boat crossings. President Kais Saied accused the EU of failing to honor agreements made earlier this year regarding border patrols, combating smuggling, and supporting Tunisia’s federal budget. Calling the payment "a small amount," Saied stressed that the issue was not its size but the perceived lack of respect, emphasizing, "The treasures of the world are not equal to a single grain of our sovereignty." In a statement shared by the official Tunisian press agency (TAP), Saied asserted, "Tunisia, which is open to cooperation, will not accept anything that resembles charity or handouts."

European officials have not commented on Tunisia’s decision. The disputed funds are part of a broader deal, announced in Rome in July, in which the EU pledged more than €1 billion ($1.1 billion) to Tunisia—of which €105 million ($110 million) were allocated for migration control.

This year, Tunisia has become a primary departure point for migrants—many fleeing conflict and poverty—trying to reach Europe. Most of the roughly 127,000 migrants arriving in Italy this year have landed on Lampedusa, an island closer to North Africa than the Italian mainland. Following multiple arrivals in recent months, the European Commission announced an initial disbursement of €127 million ($133 million) to Tunisia, with more than half earmarked for combating smuggling, reinforcing law enforcement, and facilitating return of migrants to their countries of origin.

While Italian Prime Minister Georgia Meloni and other supporters have promoted the EU-Tunisia agreement as a regional model, critics—such as Germany—have questioned its effectiveness and voiced concern it could inadvertently support Saied’s government as Tunisia’s economy struggles and political dissent is suppressed.

Since coming to power in 2019, President Saied has depicted sub-Saharan African migrants as violent and a threat to Tunisia. Although he has denied accusations of anti-Black racism, these remarks have coincided with a rise in anti-Black violence within Tunisia, prompting international condemnation from trade partners and organizations like the World Bank. Saied has also insisted he does not intend for Tunisia to serve as Europe’s border guard and has criticized proposals that would relocate to Tunisia migrants expelled from Europe.

The recent rejection of EU funds comes less than a month after Tunisia refused entry to a European Parliament delegation, stating it would not allow interference in its domestic affairs.
translated_content:
Tunesien meddelte mandag, at landet ville afvise en portion af midler fra EU, som skulle hjælpe det gældsplagede land med patruljering af Middelhavet, mens migranternes bådkrydsninger stiger markant. Præsident Kais Saied anklagede EU for ikke at leve op til de aftaler, der tidligere på året blev indgået om grænsebevogtning, bekæmpelse af smugling og støtte til Tunesiens statsbudget. Saied kaldte udbetalingen for "et lille beløb" og understregede, at det ikke handler om summen, men om en oplevet mangel på respekt: "Verdens skatte er ikke værd en eneste korn af vores suverænitet," sagde han. I en erklæring fra det officielle tunesiske nyhedsbureau TAP understregede Saied: "Tunesien er åbent for samarbejde, men accepterer ikke noget, der ligner velgørenhed eller almisser."

De europæiske embedsmænd har ikke kommenteret Tunesiens beslutning. Midlerne indgår i en større aftale, der blev annonceret i Rom i juli, hvor EU lovede mere end 1 milliard euro (ca. 8 mia. kr.) til Tunesien – hvoraf 105 millioner euro (ca. 780 mio. kr.) var øremærket migration.

I år er Tunesien blevet et væsentligt afgangssted for migranter – mange på flugt fra krig og fattigdom – der søger mod Europa. Flertallet af de omkring 127.000 migranter, som i år er ankommet til Italien, er gået i land på øen Lampedusa, der ligger tættere på Nordafrika end på det italienske fastland. Efter flere ankomster i de seneste måneder annoncerede Europa-Kommissionen en første udbetaling på 127 millioner euro (ca. 940 mio. kr.) til Tunesien, hvor over halvdelen var afsat til at bekæmpe smugling, støtte de tunesiske myndigheder og hjælpe med at sende migranter tilbage til oprindelseslandene.

Mens Italiens premierminister Georgia Meloni og andre tilhængere har præsenteret EU-Tunesien aftalen som et regionalt forbillede, har kritikere såsom Tyskland sat spørgsmålstegn ved dens effektivitet og udtrykt bekymring for, at den i praksis kan blive opfattet som støtte til Saieds regering i en tid, hvor Tunesiens økonomi er presset, og politiske modstandere fængsles.

Siden sin magtovertagelse i 2019 har præsident Saied beskrevet migranter fra det sydlige Afrika som voldelige og som en trussel mod Tunesien. Selvom han har afvist beskyldninger om antiracistisk diskrimination, er hans udtalelser faldet sammen med øget vold mod sorte i Tunesien, hvilket har udløst fordømmelse fra internationale samarbejdspartnere og Verdensbanken. Saied har tidligere slået fast, at han ikke ønsker, at Tunesien skal være Europas grænsevagt, og han har kritiseret forslag om at lade migranter udvist fra Europa bosætte sig i Tunesien.

Afvisningen af EU-midlerne kommer knap en måned efter, at Tunesien afviste en delegation fra Europa-Parlamentet adgang til landet med henvisning til, at man ikke vil have indblanding i landets interne anliggender.
post_content: Tunisia just turned down EU funds meant for border patrols, saying it’s about respect and sovereignty – not cash. Tensions up as migrant crossings surge and Europe debates the deal. #Tunisia #EU #Migration #Border #Lampedusa
translated_post: Tunesien siger nej til EU-penge for at beskytte deres grænse – det handler om respekt og suverænitet, ikke kroner og øre. Migrantbådene sejler fortsat, mens Europa diskuterer aftalen. #Tunesien #EU #Migration #Grænse #Lampedusa

article_content: Amitabh Bachchan recently addressed his fans’ curiosity after being seen with a bandaged hand for several days. Through his blog, he acknowledged the injury but chose not to disclose specific details. Bachchan apologized for his delayed blog updates, explaining that having his right hand bandaged had made writing and messaging difficult. He assured fans he would catch up once his hand healed. Reflecting on his time as host of Kaun Banega Crorepati 15, Bachchan shared that studio audience members often asked about his injury. With characteristic warmth, he would say that the bandage represented all the love from his supporters, wrapped around his wrist. He remarked that the dedication and patience of the audience, including people who waited decades to see him in person, deeply moved him. Bachchan described making an effort to connect personally with audience members, giving them individual attention after their long hours of waiting during recordings. He cherishes the heartfelt notes, handmade gifts, and kind words he receives, keeping these mementos nearby on set. Reaffirming his appreciation for his supporters, Bachchan advised that it is important never to distance oneself from those who show affection—or even criticism—as giving to others often brings much in return. Following his appearance in the film 'Ganapath', he is now preparing for his next project, the futuristic film 'Kalki 2898 AD', featuring Prabhas, Deepika Padukone, and Kamal Haasan.
translated_content: Amitabh Bachchan har for nylig taget fat på fansens nysgerrighed, efter han i flere dage er blevet set med en bandageret hånd. Via sin blog anerkendte han skaden, men valgte ikke at uddybe nærmere. Bachchan undskyldte for sine forsinkede blogopslag og forklarede, at det har været svært at skrive og sende beskeder på grund af bandagen på sin højre hånd. Han forsikrede fansene om, at han vil indhente det forsømte, når hånden er helet. Med tilbageblik på sin tid som vært for Kaun Banega Crorepati 15, fortalte Bachchan, at deltagerne i studiet ofte spørger ind til hans skade. Med sin velkendte varme siger han, at bandagen symboliserer al den kærlighed, hans fans har givet ham – som om deres omsorg er viklet om hans håndled. Han nævnte, at publikummets engagement og tålmodighed, herunder folk der har ventet i årtier på at møde ham, rører ham dybt. Bachchan beskrev, hvordan han bestræber sig på at skabe en personlig kontakt med publikumsmedlemmerne, og giver dem individuel opmærksomhed efter deres lange ventetid under optagelserne. Han sætter stor pris på de varme breve, hjemmelavede gaver og venlige ord, han modtager, og han gemmer disse minder tæt på sig på settet. Bachchan bekræftede igen, hvor meget han værdsætter sine fans, og understregede, hvor vigtigt det er aldrig at fjerne sig fra dem, der viser kærlighed – eller endda kritik – fordi det at give til andre ofte fører meget med sig retur. Efter sin rolle i filmen 'Ganapath' forbereder han sig nu på sit næste projekt, den futuristiske film 'Kalki 2898 AD', hvor også Prabhas, Deepika Padukone og Kamal Haasan medvirker.

article_content: Fortnite has not hosted a major, widely recognized concert event since Ariana Grande in 2021, but this could soon change. According to new leaks ahead of Fortnite's upcoming OG mode finale, Eminem will join the game as part of the event. Reports indicate Eminem's performance will be one segment within a larger finale, which will also feature a LEGO partnership, Rhythm Mode, and Racing Mode. Leaker HypeX notes that the event will be Fortnite's biggest by file size, at 1.5GB. Eminem, known for his influence in the early 2000s, last released an album, Curtain Call 2, in August 2022, but this crossover is not linked to an imminent new album. Players will be able to access three Eminem skins: a classic 'Slim Shady,' a modern Eminem resembling a mafia figure, and a special 'Magma' version for event attendees. This collaboration follows recent moves by Epic Games to include more celebrity skins, such as F1 legend Lewis Hamilton. Eminem is considered a rap legend, though the timing of his appearance has surprised some fans. Epic Games recently rolled back a new age-restriction system after concerns that it would exclude around 7% of all existing skins—primarily those featuring weapons or scary elements—from the event. Approximately 10 skins will remain permanently age-restricted due to their violent or frightening appearance. Eminem's skins are not affected by these restrictions. The official date for the OG finale event has not been announced, but it is widely predicted to take place on December 2, 2023.

Lækeren HypeX fremhæver, at begivenheden bliver Fortnites største nogensinde målt på filstørrelse, nemlig 1,5 GB. Spillere får adgang til tre Eminem-skins: en klassisk ‘Slim Shady’, en moderne Eminem med et mafia-look og en særlig ‘Magma’-version for deltagerne til eventet. article_content: A deadly shooting erupted at a Phoenix office building on Wednesday, leaving one person dead and two others injured. Police identified the suspected shooter as 70-year-old Arthur Douglas Harmon, who was later found dead from a self-inflicted gunshot wound in a nearby suburb. Authorities said Harmon entered a law office due to a contract dispute with Steve Singer, CEO of Fusion Contact Centers, who was killed in the attack. Police confirmed that the victims were specifically targeted. Attorney Mark Hummels was wounded while mediating for a client and remains in critical condition. A 32-year-old woman sustained non-life-threatening injuries. Emergency teams responded swiftly, securing the scene and searching for the suspect, who had initially escaped. Witnesses described panic and fear as shots were fired, and several people received treatment for stress-related issues. Records show Harmon had a history of civil litigation and was known for being confrontational. Police interviewed Harmon's wife and son to understand possible motives. A lawyer who previously dealt with Harmon commented on his anger issues and frequent involvement in lawsuits. The attack occurred shortly after former Congresswoman Gabrielle Giffords spoke at a Senate hearing supporting stricter gun control, highlighting ongoing discussions about gun violence following the Sandy Hook school shooting. The office complex contained several businesses, with employees locking themselves in offices until SWAT secured the area. Police later found Harmon's rental car abandoned near where his body was discovered, confirming he had targeted his victims.

Myndighederne oplyste, at Harmon gik ind på et advokatkontor på grund af en kontraktkonflikt med Steve Singer, direktør for Fusion Contact Centers, som blev dræbt under angrebet. Politiet bekræftede, at ofrene var specifikt udvalgt. Advokat Mark Hummels blev såret, mens han repræsenterede en klient i en mægling, og han er fortsat i kritisk tilstand. article_content: Recently, members of the British parliament from different political backgrounds came together, with an overwhelming 181 to 1 vote, to outlaw abortions carried out solely based on the baby's gender. This step is widely seen as a positive stride for justice and equality. Yet the troubling reality persists: in various parts of the world, baby girls face life-threatening discrimination through practices known as gendercide, which includes both abortion and neglect or homicide after birth. For many women, the decision to terminate a female fetus isn't truly their own—strong social and cultural biases toward sons often leave them little choice. Sex-selective abortion should not be viewed merely as a debate between 'pro-choice' and 'pro-life' advocates; rather, it represents a fundamental human rights issue. Every woman deserves the right to bring her daughter into the world. While many families welcome the news of a baby girl, in certain societies, such news can turn tragic. The United Nations estimates that up to 200 million women are 'missing' globally due to gender-targeted violence and neglect. China exemplifies these disparities, with approximately 100 girls born for every 118 boys and a surplus of around 37 million men. Strict population policies have exacerbated pressures on women to bear sons, sometimes resulting in forced abortions—even if not physically coerced, the weight of societal expectations can be overwhelming. The art installation 'Terracotta Daughters,' recently featured in New York City, visually commemorated the countless girls lost to gendercide, making the invisible casualties heartbreakingly tangible. China’s gender imbalance has fueled problems like human trafficking and sexual exploitation, impacts that reverberate beyond its borders. Compounding these issues, China also records the world’s highest female suicide rate, reportedly climbing to 590 women per day according to U.S. government reports—possibly linked to systemic pressures to avoid or abandon daughters. India, facing a sex birth ratio of 112 boys to 100 girls, sees girls disproportionately affected by disease and neglect. Women in poorer communities may be manipulated into sterilization—sometimes through mass procedures—which have led to fatal complications, as seen in recent deaths in Chhattisgarh. The deprivation of millions of women in China and India from the right to have daughters ranks among the gravest ongoing violations of women’s rights. While the global women's rights community has yet to mount a strong response, organizations like Women's Rights Without Frontiers are taking action. Their 'Save a Girl' initiative in rural China offers support and practical aid to mothers pressured to abort or abandon baby girls, helping more than 120 families thus far, with plans to expand into India. These efforts demonstrate that change is possible. Every mother who wishes to keep her daughter should get the support she needs. Collectively, we have the power to put an end to gendercide and consign sex-selective abortion to history.
translated_content: For nylig gik medlemmer af det britiske parlament fra forskellige politiske partier sammen og stemte med stort flertal, 181 mod 1, for at forbyde aborter udelukkende på baggrund af barnets køn. Dette ses bredt som et vigtigt skridt mod retfærdighed og ligestilling. Problemet eksisterer dog stadig: I mange dele af verden udsættes pigebørn for livstruende diskrimination gennem gendercide – altså kønsbaseret drab – som både dækker over aborter og forsømmelse eller drab efter fødslen. For mange kvinder er beslutningen om at abortere en pige ikke deres egen – stærke sociale og kulturelle forventninger om sønner lægger ofte enormt pres på dem. Kønsselektive aborter bør ikke kun ses som et spørgsmål mellem 'pro-choice' og 'pro-life'; det er et grundlæggende spørgsmål om menneskerettigheder. Enhver kvinde fortjener retten til at sætte sin datter i verden. Mens mange familier fejrer beskeden om en pige, kan den besked i visse samfund være tragisk. FN vurderer, at op til 200 millioner kvinder mangler globalt som følge af kønsbaseret vold og forsømmelse. Kina illustrerer denne skævhed, med cirka 100 piger født for hver 118 drenge og et overskud på cirka 37 millioner mænd. Strikse befolkningspolitikker har forstærket presset på kvinder for at få sønner og har til tider resulteret i tvangsaborter – ikke nødvendigvis med fysisk tvang, men enorme sociale forventninger. Kunstinstallationen 'Terracotta Daughters', der for nylig blev vist i New York, synliggjorde de mange piger, der er gået tabt som følge af gendercide, og gjorde de usynlige ofre meget nærværende. Kinas ubalance mellem kønnene har ført til problemer som menneskehandel og seksuel exploitation – problemer der også rammer nabolandene. Samtidig har Kina verdens højeste selvmordsrate blandt kvinder, angiveligt op til 590 kvinder om dagen ifølge amerikanske rapporter – muligvis relateret til systemisk pres om at abortere eller fravælge døtre. Indien har en fødselsrate på 112 drenge pr. 100 piger, og indiske piger er desværre mere udsat for sygdom og omsorgssvigt. Fattige kvinder bliver ofte manipuleret til sterilisering – nogle gange ved masseoperationer – som har ført til dødsfald, eksempelvis ved de nylige dødsfald i Chhattisgarh. At millioner af kvinder i Kina og Indien nægtes retten til at føde og beholde døtre, er en af verdens alvorligste krænkelser af kvinders rettigheder. Mens det globale ligestillingsmiljø stadig mangler at handle markant, tager organisationer som Women's Rights Without Frontiers ansvar. Deres 'Save a Girl'-kampagne i Kina giver støtte og konkret hjælp til mødre under pres for at abortere eller opgive deres døtre, og har indtil videre hjulpet over 120 familier, med planer om at udvide til Indien. Disse initiativer viser, at forandring er mulig. Hver mor, der ønsker at beholde sin datter, skal have støtte. Sammen kan vi standse gendercide og gøre kønsselektive aborter til fortid.

A video that appeared to show a wolf roaming the hallway of a Sochi hotel has been revealed as an elaborate prank orchestrated by television host Jimmy Kimmel and U.S. Olympic luger Kate Hansen. Hansen, who finished 10th in the luge event at the 2014 Sochi Olympics and gained popularity for her energetic warm-up dances to Beyoncé’s music, posted a 17-second clip online titled 'Epix#SochiFail: Wolf in my hall.' The video, uploaded to YouTube and viewed over a million times, showed what seemed to be a wild animal padding down a hotel corridor.

Viewers quickly voiced skepticism about the video’s authenticity, noting the animal appeared more like a husky or malamute than a wolf. YouTube commenters debated the creature’s species, with one stating, 'That is a husky not a wolf. A wolf would be much larger and more alert about its surroundings.' Another wrote, 'It can be one of three things: 1) a wolf (unlikely), 2) a husky, 3) an Alaskan malamute cross (probably).'

Sandy Caligiore, publicist for the United States Luge Association, later confirmed that the video was a hoax organized by Kimmel and Hansen. The stunt is expected to be discussed when Hansen appears via Skype on Kimmel’s late night show. Despite the deception, many viewers have expressed amusement at the joke, adding to Hansen’s growing popularity among fans.

Hansen, der blev nummer 10 i kælk ved vinter-OL 2014 i Sochi og er kendt for sine energiske opvarmningsdanse til Beyoncé-musik, lagde et 17 sekunder langt klip ud med titlen 'Epix#SochiFail: Wolf in my hall.' Videoen blev uploadet til YouTube og set over en million gange, og viste, hvad der så ud til at være et vildt dyr, der gik ned ad hotelgangen.

Seerne var hurtigt skeptiske over for videoens ægthed og bemærkede, at dyret lignede mere en husky eller malamute end en ulv. Kommentarer på YouTube diskuterede, hvad dyret kunne være, blandt andet: 'Det er en husky, ikke en ulv. En ulv ville være langt større og mere opmærksom på sine omgivelser.' En anden skrev: 'Det kan være en af tre ting: 1) en ulv (usandsynligt), 2) en husky, 3) en Alaskan malamute-blanding (formentlig).' 

Sandy Caligiore, presseansvarlig for det amerikanske kælkeforbund, bekræftede senere, at videoen var et prank organiseret af Kimmel og Hansen. Det forventes, at stuntet bliver diskuteret, når Hansen deltager via Skype i Kimmels talkshow. Trods fupnummeret har mange seere moret sig, hvilket har bidraget til Hansens voksende popularitet blandt fans.

article_content:
The OnePlus Pad Go is designed as an affordable tablet for media consumption, rather than productivity tasks. Priced at 20,000 INR, it forgoes support for dedicated keyboard cases and the OnePlus Stylo, clearly positioning itself for entertainment rather than work. Its design is similar to the original OnePlus Pad, with a camera module placed on the right side when held vertically, which makes it distinctive, though it can be prone to smudges. At 532 grams, the device is comfortable to hold with both hands, featuring a smooth, dual-tone polycarbonate back.

For those who often stream video content, the optional OnePlus Pad Go Folio case (1,399 INR) allows for hands-free use on flat surfaces. The tablet's controls include volume buttons on the right, a power button on the top-right corner, and a USB-C port at the bottom. LTE variants also offer a SIM card slot. The device is equipped with an 11.3-inch IPS display at 2.5K resolution and a 90Hz refresh rate. Brightness is suitable for indoor use but may be insufficient in direct sunlight. The display offers vibrant colors with deep blacks for an LCD, and the quad speakers with Dolby Atmos provide clear, rich sound, enhancing the overall media experience.

In everyday use, the Pad Go is powered by the MediaTek Helio G99 chipset, 8GB LPDDR4X RAM, and up to 256GB of UFS 2.2 storage. It features two 8MP cameras—one front, one rear—suitable for video calls and document scanning. The 8,000mAh battery supports 33W fast charging, lasting up to two days with moderate usage and minimal standby power consumption. A charger is included, with the device charging from 5% to 35% in 30 minutes.

The Pad Go runs OxygenOS 13.2 based on Android 13 and is promised two years of OS updates (Android 14 and 15). The interface is generally smooth, though some users may notice slow or choppy animations and Chrome tabs refreshing upon unlocking. Connectivity over 5GHz Wi-Fi is reliable.

In comparison to competitors, the Redmi Pad—priced lower at 15,000 INR—offers similar specs, but for multitasking, the 6GB RAM variant (16,500 INR) is recommended. The Lenovo Tab M10 5G is another contender but is pricier. For those wanting a tablet for productivity, the Xiaomi Pad 6 with its keyboard case is suggested, albeit at a much higher price. Overall, the budget-friendly OnePlus Pad Go delivers an enjoyable media streaming experience and is comfortable to use, making it an excellent choice for entertainment-focused users at its price point.

Designet minder om den oprindelige OnePlus Pad, hvor kameramodulet sidder på højre side i vertikal position. Dette gør den genkendelig, omend kameraet let får fingeraftryk. Til produktivitetsbehov anbefales Xiaomi Pad 6 med tastaturcover – dog til en væsentlig højere pris. Samlet set leverer OnePlus Pad Go god streaming og komfort til en lav pris, hvilket gør den til et solidt valg for underholdningsbrugere.

article_content: The collation of results for Kogi State’s governorship election is set to start at 10 a.m. on Sunday, November 12, according to INEC Resident Electoral Commissioner Dr. Gabriel Longpet. Voting occurred throughout the state’s 21 local government areas. INEC has reported receiving complaints of significant electoral violations, especially regarding result sheets allegedly completed before voting in several places. Because of this, elections have been suspended in Adavi, Ajaokuta, Ogori/Magongo, Okehi, and Okene. Ogori/Magongo experienced the most severe problems, with nine of its ten registration areas affected. INEC stressed that only results produced according to correct polling procedures will be accepted. Mohammed Kudu Haruna, an INEC National Commissioner, announced that voting in nine Ogori/Magongo wards—Eni, Okibo, Okesi, Ileteju, Aiyeromi, Ugugu, Obinoyin, Obatgben, and Oturu—has been suspended. Incidents in other areas are still being investigated, and INEC said it will announce further steps within the next 24 hours.
translated_content: Optællingen af stemmer fra guvernørvalget i Kogi State begynder kl. 10 søndag den 12. november, oplyser INEC’s resident electoral commissioner, Dr. Gabriel Longpet. Der blev stemt i samtlige af statens 21 lokale regeringsområder. INEC fortæller, at de har modtaget klager om alvorlige valgforseelser, især vedrørende udfyldelse af resultatark før afstemning flere steder. Derfor er valget blevet suspenderet i Adavi, Ajaokuta, Ogori/Magongo, Okehi og Okene. De alvorligste problemer var i Ogori/Magongo, hvor ni ud af ti registreringsområder var berørt. INEC understregede, at kun resultater produceret i overensstemmelse med korrekte afstemningsprocedurer vil blive accepteret. Mohammed Kudu Haruna, national kommissær i INEC, bekendtgjorde, at valget i ni af Ogori/Magongos afdelinger—Eni, Okibo, Okesi, Ileteju, Aiyeromi, Ugugu, Obinoyin, Obatgben og Oturu—er blevet suspenderet. Hændelser i andre områder undersøges fortsat, og INEC lover at melde yderligere ud inden for de næste 24 timer.

article_content: The U.S. government has tightened export restrictions on advanced chips, putting pressure on Nvidia, a leader in artificial intelligence. These new measures may force Nvidia to cancel billions of dollars’ worth of chip orders to China in the upcoming year, potentially slowing the progress of top Chinese tech firms in AI. Nvidia, headquartered in Santa Clara, California, had already completed chip shipments to China for the current year. According to The Wall Street Journal, Nvidia attempted to accelerate some 2024 deliveries before the new export rules were expected to take effect in mid-November. However, the U.S. government made these restrictions immediate with little warning, catching Nvidia by surprise. Major Chinese tech firms, including Alibaba, ByteDance, and Baidu, reportedly ordered more than $5 billion in chips for 2024. Due to the tighter regulations, these orders are now at risk. In response, Nvidia stated it is redirecting its advanced AI chips to customers outside China and does not anticipate significant short-term effects. Nonetheless, Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress expressed concerns about the long-term impact of these restrictions on the U.S. chip industry. Nvidia is widely recognized for its high-performance AI chips, which power popular applications like OpenAI’s ChatGPT. Intense demand for its technology has helped the company’s sales and valuation soar, exceeding $1 trillion earlier this year. After less-severe U.S. export controls last year, Chinese companies bought Nvidia’s A800 and H800 chips, which were adapted for China. The stricter rules announced on October 17 now require Nvidia to either cancel these orders or obtain special U.S. licenses. The latest measures not only affect Nvidia, but also American competitors like Intel and AMD. Chinese tech firms may increasingly turn to domestic solutions, such as Huawei’s Ascend 910 chip. However, U.S. regulations also stop leading foundries like TSMC from manufacturing many of these chips for Chinese clients.

article_content: Nigeria and other African countries are facing significant challenges in securing tech talent, according to a new report by Boston Consulting Group in collaboration with Elevandi titled 'Unlocking the FinTech Potential in Africa.' The report finds that Africa is struggling to retain local tech talent and attract foreign experts, largely because many skilled workers have been drawn overseas by higher salaries. This trend is further exacerbated by lengthy, strict visa processes and lower liveability scores, making Africa less attractive to foreign professionals. The report emphasizes the urgency of reversing these trends, noting that the current educational pipeline is expected to produce only about 50% of the skilled workers needed for the tech industry. While African FinTechs have shown promise, building companies with passionate founders and employees eager to support economic growth, the shortage of qualified talent threatens their ability to scale. To address these issues, the report recommends that talent development, attraction, and retention become top priorities for African countries. It suggests that in the interim, FinTechs explore innovative solutions such as generative AI (GenAI) to help mitigate the talent gap by supporting coding, translation, and market analysis. Nigeria recently announced a plan to train three million people in technology skills to strengthen its tech talent pipeline. The report also notes that almost half of Africa's 1,000 fintech companies were launched in the past six years and collectively have raised about $6 billion in equity funding since 2000. Despite this growth, the African FinTech ecosystem is still considered nascent. Approximately 80% of funding rounds since 2018 have been at the seed or angel stage, and only 4% of fintechs have reached series C funding or beyond, compared to 11% for startups globally. Most FinTech activity is concentrated in South Africa, Nigeria, Kenya, and Egypt, which together host 63% of Africa's fintech companies and receive nearly 80% of total investment. Pat Patel, Executive Director of Elevandi, commented that Africa's fintech market is attractive for new entrants, especially those seeking to serve untapped segments. However, he urged that more fintechs must scale across the continent, instead of operating only in isolated markets. Caio Anteghini, a Johannesburg-based partner with BCG, highlighted fintechs' significant role in advancing financial inclusion and economic development in their home countries. He added that improvements in digital infrastructure and policy alignment would allow fintechs to expand their impact both within their countries and across borders. The report concludes that continued growth will depend on tackling obstacles such as high operational costs and inconsistent regulations between markets.

Rapporten viser, at Afrika har svært ved at fastholde lokale tekniske eksperter og tiltrække udenlandske specialister, særligt fordi mange dygtige medarbejdere er blevet lokket til udlandet af højere lønninger. Tendensen forværres af lange og strenge visumprocedurer samt lave livskvalitetsvurderinger, hvilket gør Afrika mindre attraktivt for udenlandske specialister. Rapporten understreger nødvendigheden af at vende denne udvikling og bemærker, at det nuværende uddannelsessystem kun forventes at kunne levere cirka halvdelen af de nødvendige tekniske arbejdskraftressourcer. Selvom afrikanske fintech-virksomheder har vist potentiale og er grundlagt af passionerede iværksættere og medarbejdere, der gerne vil støtte økonomisk vækst, truer manglen på kvalificerede talenter deres muligheder for at skalere. For at løse dette anbefaler rapporten, at udvikling, tiltrækning og fastholdelse af talenter bør have højeste prioritet i afrikanske lande. Den foreslår, at fintechs i mellemtiden kan udforske innovative løsninger som generativ AI (GenAI) for at afhjælpe talentmanglen – eksempelvis med kodningsstøtte, oversættelse eller markedsanalyser. Nigeria har for nylig annonceret en plan om at træne tre millioner personer i teknologiske færdigheder for at styrke sin tech-talentpipeline. Rapporten nævner desuden, at næsten halvdelen af Afrikas 1.000 fintechs er grundlagt inden for de sidste seks år, og at de tilsammen har rejst cirka 6 milliarder dollars i egenkapital siden 2000. På trods af denne vækst vurderes det afrikanske fintech-økosystem fortsat som umodent. Cirka 80 % af finansieringsrunderne siden 2018 har været på seed- eller angel-niveau, og kun 4 % af fintechs har opnået serie C-finansiering eller mere, mod 11 % globalt. Mere end halvdelen af fintech-aktiviteten er koncentreret i Sydafrika, Nigeria, Kenya og Egypten, som tilsammen huser 63 % af Afrikas fintech-virksomheder og modtager næsten 80 % af alle investeringer. Pat Patel, administrerende direktør for Elevandi, bemærkede, at Afrikas fintech-marked allerede er attraktivt for nye aktører – især dem, der vil betjene oversete segmenter. Han understreger dog, at flere fintechs skal udvikle sig på tværs af kontinentet og ikke kun operere i afgrænsede markeder. Caio Anteghini, partner i BCG i Johannesburg, fremhævede fintechs' vigtige rolle i at fremme finansiel inklusion og økonomisk udvikling i deres hjemlande. Han tilføjede, at bedre digital infrastruktur og politisk harmonisering kan gøre det muligt for fintechs at udvide deres indflydelse både nationalt og på tværs af landegrænser. Rapporten konkluderer, at fortsat vækst afhænger af at overvinde udfordringer såsom høje driftsomkostninger og varierende reguleringer mellem markeder.

article_content: BRUSSELS — The European Union began taking steps on Thursday to limit the impact of the war between Israel and Hamas within its borders, amid heightened security concerns following a firebomb attack on a Berlin synagogue and deadly incidents in Belgium and France attributed to suspected Islamic extremists. Spain, currently holding the EU’s rotating presidency, activated a crisis mechanism to speed up decision-making and coordination among the 27 member states, the EU’s institutions, and major partners such as the United Nations and the United States. Officials across the EU have expressed concerns about a rise in antisemitic attacks, radicalization on the internet, extremists’ use of encrypted messaging, and the need to accelerate the deportation of individuals considered public threats. Still, calls for increased security across the board are causing unease. The proposed solutions could undermine the EU’s principles of free movement and the right to assemble. Italy has introduced border checks to counter potential unrest linked to the Israel-Hamas war, while Denmark and Sweden have implemented similar measures, citing terror threats. France plans to continue border checks until at least May 2024 due to “new terrorist threats and the external border situation.” Additional police have been deployed in Belgium, France, and Germany. EU foreign policy chief Josep Borrell said part of Europe’s response must involve diplomatic and financial efforts to help end the long-standing Israeli-Palestinian conflict. “We have learned from history that the hardest decisions come when we are on the edge of the abyss. I believe that is where we are now,” Borrell told EU lawmakers on Wednesday. "When I hear Muslim religious authorities speak in terms of inter-religious conflict and explicitly state that Europe is part of this conflict, I fear storm clouds are gathering," he added. Not all of Europe’s challenges are directly related to the war. Earlier Thursday, Sweden hosted ministers from eight countries—including Germany, Belgium, and France—to discuss responses to incidents where people have burned the Quran. Prosecutors are investigating whether such acts were a motive for a Tunisian man to shoot three Swedes—killing two—in Brussels on Monday before a Belgium-Sweden soccer match. While Quran burnings are not directly tied to the Israel-Hamas conflict, they illustrate deepening tensions between religious and other communities in Europe. The war that began on October 7 is the deadliest of the five Gaza wars for both Israelis and Palestinians. Over 5,000 people have died—including Israeli and Palestinian casualties—nearly 12,500 Palestinians have been wounded, and more than 200 people in Israel have been taken hostage. “We have to address multiple effects from the continuing Middle East crisis within the EU,” said European Commission Vice-President Margaritis Schinas. “That includes protecting our Jewish communities and also acting against a climate of Islamophobia, which has no place in our society,” he said in Luxembourg, where EU interior ministers were meeting. Pro-Palestinian rallies have occurred in several European cities, though France has banned them. Germany has also pledged tougher action against Hamas, which is already on the EU’s list of terrorist organizations. Chancellor Olaf Scholz told the German parliament that authorities must not allow gatherings where antisemitic slogans could be chanted, where deaths are glorified, or where unacceptable behavior occurs. In France, the Palace of Versailles—a major tourist site—and three airports were evacuated and temporarily closed Wednesday due to security concerns. These incidents are the latest in a series of evacuations over the past five days, and the government is threatening fines or jail for prank callers. The evacuations followed the killing of a teacher in northern France last Friday by a suspected Islamic extremist. French Interior Minister Gérald Darmanin pointed out that two foreign nationals were responsible for the recent attacks in Belgium and France, and emphasized the need for delayed EU asylum reforms. Europe must manage its borders, register arrivals, and conduct security interviews before considering asylum requests, he said. The EU has agreements with Turkey and Tunisia to prevent migrants from reaching Europe—and to return those who do—but these arrangements are not functioning effectively. Other deals, particularly with Egypt, are being planned. Only about one in four people refused entry actually return home. John Leicester in Paris and Geir Moulson in Berlin contributed to this report.
translated_content: BRUXELLES — Den Europæiske Union begyndte torsdag at tage skridt for at begrænse krigens mellem Israel og Hamas indvirkning på sine grænser, midt i øgede sikkerhedsbekymringer efter et brandbombeangreb på en synagoge i Berlin og dødelige hændelser i Belgien og Frankrig, der tilskrives formodede islamistiske ekstremister. Spanien, som i øjeblikket har EU’s roterende formandskab, aktiverede en krisemekanisme for at fremskynde beslutningstagning og koordinering mellem de 27 medlemslande, EU’s institutioner og vigtige partnere som FN og USA. Embedsmænd i hele EU har udtrykt bekymring over en stigning i antisemitiske angreb, radikalisering på internettet, ekstremisters brug af krypterede beskedtjenester samt behovet for at fremskynde udvisning af personer, der betragtes som en offentlig trussel. Alligevel vækker opfordringer til øget sikkerhed på tværs af EU bekymring. De foreslåede løsninger kan underminere unionens principper om fri bevægelighed og forsamlingsfrihed. Italien har indført grænsekontrol for at modvirke potentiel uro forbundet med krigen mellem Israel og Hamas, mens Danmark og Sverige har truffet lignende foranstaltninger med henvisning til terrortrusler. Frankrig planlægger at fortsætte grænsekontrollen frem til mindst maj 2024 på grund af “nye terrortrusler og situationen ved de ydre grænser.” Ekstra politi er indsat i Belgien, Frankrig og Tyskland. EU’s udenrigschef Josep Borrell sagde, at Europas svar skal omfatte diplomatiske og økonomiske tiltag for at hjælpe med at afslutte den langvarige konflikt mellem Israel og Palæstina. “Vi har lært af historien, at de sværeste beslutninger tages, når vi står på kanten af afgrunden. Jeg mener, at vi er der nu,” sagde Borrell til EU-parlamentarikere onsdag. "Når jeg hører muslimske religiøse ledere tale om mellemreligiøs konflikt og eksplicit erklærer, at Europa er en del af denne konflikt, frygter jeg, at stormskyerne trækker sammen," tilføjede han. Ikke alle Europas udfordringer er direkte relateret til krigen. Tidligere torsdag var Sverige vært for ministre fra otte lande—blandt andre Tyskland, Belgien og Frankrig—til drøftelse af håndtering af episoder, hvor folk har brændt Koranen. Anklagemyndigheder undersøger, om sådanne handlinger var et motiv for, at en tunesiske mand skød tre svenskere—hvoraf to blev dræbt—i Bruxelles mandag før en Belgien-Sverige fodboldkamp. Selvom koranbrændinger ikke er direkte forbundet med konflikten mellem Israel og Hamas, illustrerer de voksende spændinger mellem religiøse og andre samfundsgrupper i Europa. Krigen, som begyndte den 7. oktober, er den blodigste af de fem Gaza-krige for både israelere og palæstinensere. Over 5.000 mennesker er døde—including både israelske og palæstinensiske ofre—næsten 12.500 palæstinensere er blevet såret, og mere end 200 personer i Israel er taget som gidsler. “Vi må håndtere de mange konsekvenser af den fortsatte krise i Mellemøsten inden for EU,” sagde Europakommissionens vicepræsident Margaritis Schinas. “Det indebærer beskyttelse af vores jødiske samfund, men også, at vi bekæmper et klima af islamofobi, som ikke hører hjemme i vores samfund,” sagde han i Luxembourg, hvor EU’s indenrigsministre mødtes. Pro-palæstinensiske demonstrationer har fundet sted i flere europæiske byer, selvom Frankrig har forbudt dem. Tyskland har også lovet strengere tiltag mod Hamas, som allerede står på EU’s terrorliste. Forbundskansler Olaf Scholz sagde til det tyske parlament, at myndighederne ikke må tillade forsamlinger, hvor antisemitiske slogans kan råbes, hvor dødsfald glorificeres, eller hvor uacceptabel adfærd finder sted. I Frankrig blev slottet i Versailles—en stor turistattraktion—og tre lufthavne evakueret og midlertidigt lukket onsdag på grund af sikkerhedsbekymringer. Disse episoder er de seneste i en række evakueringer over de seneste fem dage, og regeringen truer prankopringere med bøder eller fængsel. Evakueringerne fandt sted efter drabet på en lærer i det nordlige Frankrig i fredags, begået af en formodet islamistisk ekstremist. Frankrigs indenrigsminister Gérald Darmanin påpegede, at to udenlandske statsborgere stod bag de seneste angreb i Belgien og Frankrig, og understregede behovet for længe ventede asylreformer i EU. Europa skal styre sine grænser, registrere tilrejsende og foretage sikkerhedsinterviews, før asylansøgninger behandles, sagde han. EU har aftaler med Tyrkiet og Tunesien om at forhindre migranter i at komme til Europa—og om at sende dem tilbage igen—men ordningerne fungerer ikke effektivt. Der er planer om yderligere aftaler, især med Egypten. Kun omkring hver fjerde, der nægtes indrejse, vender faktisk hjem. John Leicester i Paris og Geir Moulson i Berlin har bidraget til denne rapport.

article_content: Tata Technologies' initial public offering (IPO) is now open for pre-application, with shares drawing a strong grey market premium of Rs 340-345, approximately 70% above the issue price range of Rs 475-500 per equity share. The three-day subscription period begins Wednesday, November 22, marking the Tata Group’s first IPO in two decades. Pre-application enables investors to show interest before the public offer becomes officially live. Tata Technologies is a global engineering services company with notable expertise in automotive research and development. According to Prashanth Tapse, Senior Vice President Research at Mehta Equities, this presents a unique investment opportunity. At the issue's upper band of Rs 500, the company would have a market capitalization of about Rs 20,283 crore, with a price-to-earnings ratio (P/E) of 29x, based on annualized earnings and fully diluted post-IPO capital. This valuation is considered reasonable compared to sector peers trading at higher multiples, Tapse notes. He recommends subscribing to the issue. Brokerage Emkay highlights Tata Technologies’ strong focus on the automotive sector, prestigious client base, and reduced reliance on key clients as factors likely to drive steady performance. At the upper price band, the company is valued at 32x its FY23 earnings per share (EPS), compared to LTTS (40x), Tata Elxsi (69x), and KPIT (110x) based on FY23 EPS. Tata Technologies offers product development and digital solutions to global original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), including services such as concept design, benchmarking, vehicle architecture, chassis and body engineering, electronics, and diagnostics. The company employs over 11,000 people across 18 global delivery centers. The IPO consists entirely of an offer for sale (OFS), with promoter Tata Motors and other shareholders receiving all proceeds. Tata Motors will sell 4.62 crore shares, Alpha TC Holdings will offload 97.1 lakh shares, and Tata Capital Growth Fund will sell 48 lakh shares. The overall issue size has been reduced from 9.57 crore to 6.08 crore shares. Tata Technologies filed for its IPO with SEBI in March and received regulatory approval in June. The offering reserves 10% of shares for eligible shareholders of Tata Motors. According to the DRHP, Tata Motors acquired shares at an average cost of Rs 7.40 each, while Alpha TC Holdings and Tata Capital Growth Fund did so at Rs 25.10 each. The company was valued at about $2 billion (Rs 16,300 crore) when TPG Climate bought a 9% stake. For the nine months ended December 2022, revenue was Rs 3,052 crore (15% YoY growth), with 88% from services, and net profit stood at Rs 407 crore. Between FY2021 and FY2023, revenue grew at a 30% compound annual growth rate (CAGR), EBITDA at 46%, and profit after tax (PAT) at 61.5%. JM Financial, Citigroup Global Markets India, and BofA Securities India are the book-running lead managers. Link Intime India Private Limited is the registrar. article_content: MADISON, Wis. — Animal welfare advocates filed a lawsuit Wednesday seeking to overturn Wisconsin’s new wolf management plan, alleging that state wildlife officials violated the state’s open meetings law and ignored input from wolf researchers and supporters. The lawsuit illustrates the escalating debate over how wolves should be managed in Wisconsin. Farmers in northern parts of the state have long complained that the wolf population is increasing too quickly and attacking their livestock. Hunters argue that wolves are harming the deer population, while conservationists insist that the species needs protection to become firmly established in Wisconsin. The Great Lakes Wildlife Alliance, also known as Friends of the Wisconsin Wolf and Wildlife, filed the lawsuit in Dane County Circuit Court. The group describes itself as a statewide coalition of hunters, farmers, politicians, business owners, and animal welfare advocates who support science-based conservation. The suit claims Department of Natural Resources (DNR) policy board members continued to solicit feedback on the plan from favored interest groups after the public comment period ended in February. According to the lawsuit, board members attended closed-door discussions hosted by the Wisconsin Wildlife Federation, the Wisconsin Association of Sporting Dogs, and Wisconsin Wolf Facts in February, April, and July. The Great Lakes Wildlife Alliance was allegedly excluded from the April and July meetings; the suit does not specify whether the Alliance was barred from the February meeting. The complaint alleges that while a quorum of board members did not attend any single meeting, a sufficient number participated to exert influence over the wolf plan. DNR Secretary Adam Payne announced revisions were forthcoming after consulting with groups that support stricter wolf population controls. The Alliance asserts these actions violated open meetings statutes. Additionally, the lawsuit contends DNR officials gave minimal consideration to scientific studies challenging their wolf population estimates and warnings that hunting and trapping may not reduce human-wolf conflicts. The suit also claims the department failed to evaluate the risks of overharvesting wolves and was influenced by anecdotal reports of wolf aggression toward hunters, absent specific examples. DNR spokesperson Molly Meister declined to comment on the ongoing litigation. The DNR first adopted a wolf management plan in 1999 that set a population cap at 350 wolves. Current DNR estimates indicate Wisconsin’s wolf population is now about 1,000. A 2012 law passed by Republican lawmakers required the DNR to hold an annual wolf hunting season. Farmers and hunters have cited the 350-wolf cap as grounds for pushing high hunting quotas, leading to strong opposition from animal rights advocates. Last year, a federal judge reinstated federal endangered species protections for gray wolves in the lower 48 states, making wolf hunting illegal and limiting farmers to nonlethal measures like fencing or using guard dogs. In anticipation of possible federal delisting, the DNR has developed an updated management plan. The department’s board recently approved a plan that aims to keep the statewide wolf population around 1,000 without setting a firm numerical cap, instead allowing some flexibility above or below that number. While DNR officials call this a compromise, some farmers and hunters criticize the plan for lacking a specific population limit. Meanwhile, Republican lawmakers are advancing a bill to require a set figure in the wolf plan.
translated_content: MADISON, Wis. — Dyrevelfærdsforkæmpere indgav onsdag et søgsmål for at få omgjort Wisconsins nye forvaltningsplan for ulve. De hævder, at statens dyrelivsmyndigheder har overtrådt reglerne om åbne møder og ignoreret input fra ulveforskere og -tilhængere. Sagen illustrerer den optrappede debat om, hvordan ulve skal forvaltes i Wisconsin. Landmænd fra de nordlige dele af staten har længe klaget over, at ulvebestanden vokser for hurtigt og angriber deres husdyr. Jægere påstår, at ulvene påvirker hjortebestanden negativt, mens naturbeskyttere mener, at arten har brug for beskyttelse for at etablere sig i Wisconsin. Great Lakes Wildlife Alliance, også kendt som Friends of the Wisconsin Wolf and Wildlife, indgav søgsmålet til Dane County Circuit Court. Gruppen beskriver sig som en statslig koalition af jægere, landmænd, politikere, erhvervsfolk og dyrevelfærdsforkæmpere, der støtter videnskabsbaseret naturbeskyttelse. Søgsmålet påstår, at Department of Natural Resources’ (DNR) bestyrelsesmedlemmer fortsatte med at indhente feedback på planen fra udvalgte interessegrupper, efter den offentlige høringsperiode sluttede i februar. Ifølge sagen deltog bestyrelsesmedlemmer i lukkede møder arrangeret af Wisconsin Wildlife Federation, Wisconsin Association of Sporting Dogs og Wisconsin Wolf Facts i februar, april og juli. Great Lakes Wildlife Alliance blev angiveligt udelukket fra april- og julimøderne; sagen præciserer ikke, om alliancen var udelukket fra februarmødet. Sagen hævder, at selvom der ikke var et beslutningsdygtigt udvalg til stede ved møderne, deltog nok medlemmer til at kunne få indflydelse på ulveplanen. DNR’s sekretær Adam Payne annoncerede kommende ændringer efter samtaler med grupper, der ønsker en strammere regulering af ulvebestanden. Alliancen mener, at dette er et brud på reglerne om åbne møder. Derudover hævder søgsmålet, at DNR gav begrænset opmærksomhed til videnskabelige undersøgelser, der sætter spørgsmålstegn ved deres ulvebestandsestimater, samt advarsler om, at jagt og fælder muligvis ikke reducerer konflikter mellem mennesker og ulve. Sagen påstår også, at styrelsen ikke har vurderet faren ved overjagt og lod sig påvirke af uverificerede enkelttilfælde om ulveaggression over for jægere, uden konkrete eksempler. DNR’s talsperson Molly Meister afviste at kommentere den verserende retssag. DNR vedtog første gang en forvaltningsplan for ulve i 1999, hvor bestanden blev sat til maksimalt 350 ulve. DNR anslår nu, at ulvebestanden i Wisconsin er omkring 1.000. En lov fra 2012, vedtaget af republikanske politikere, pålagde DNR at afholde en årlig ulvejagt. Landmænd og jægere har brugt 350-ulvegrænsen som grundlag for at argumentere for høje jagtkvoter, hvilket har vakt stor modstand blandt dyrevelfærdsforkæmpere. Sidste år genindsatte en føderal dommer den føderale beskyttelse af grå ulve i det kontinentale USA, hvilket gør ulvejagt ulovlig og begrænser landmænd til ikke-dødelige metoder som hegn eller vogterhunde. For at være forberedt på en mulig ophævelse af beskyttelsen har DNR udarbejdet en opdateret forvaltningsplan. Bestyrelsen har for nyligt godkendt en plan, der sigter mod at holde ulvebestanden omkring 1.000 uden et fast tal, men med mulighed for at justere over eller under den grænse. DNR kalder dette for et kompromis, men nogle landmænd og jægere kritiserer planen for ikke at indeholde en klar grænse. Samtidig arbejder republikanske folketingsmedlemmer på et lovforslag, der skal kræve et fast antal ulve i planen.

article_content: Bill Kenwright has criticized Roy Keane for making 'some stupid remarks' after the Republic of Ireland assistant manager questioned Everton's handling of James McCarthy and Seamus Coleman regarding their availability for international matches. McCarthy wanted to play against Scotland last Friday but was left out, as Everton continued to request updates on his hamstring injury. The midfielder has missed Ireland's last three Euro 2016 qualifiers, and Coleman missed last month's game in Germany. Both played for Everton four days later. Roy Keane expressed concern that Everton may be putting pressure on players to withdraw from international duty. He suggested Ireland manager Martin O’Neill and Everton manager Roberto Martinez should have discussions to resolve the matter, stating, 'You always get the impression from Everton that Seamus and James are barely able to walk. So when they actually turn up walking, it’s like a miracle.' Keane added, 'I worry that McCarthy is under significant pressure, especially from Everton’s perspective. There needs to be a conversation. I don’t think Roberto has played at senior international level and may not appreciate the importance of these matches.' Everton chairman Bill Kenwright responded, 'I’m a big fan of Roy Keane but he does say some stupid things. That is completely unfair. We are always supportive of our players' international duties and never stand in their way. Roberto Martinez will be as surprised as anyone at Everton.' Martin O’Neill clarified, 'From my perspective, both players were unfit for the matches against Gibraltar and Germany in October, but played for Everton days later, which is understandable. I spoke with Seamus, and he wasn’t ready. I didn’t speak with James, but there was speculation he would play against Manchester United, but didn’t. I had no issue with it – this time James has a muscle injury. He came here wanting to try, but time was against us. I believe he’ll be fit for the weekend for Everton, and there’s little more to add.'

article_content: Elon Musk, CEO of Tesla Motors, has pledged $1 million to support the Tesla Science Center at Wardenclyffe in Shoreham, New York. This donation was inspired by an appeal from Matthew Inman, creator of The Oatmeal webcomic. Musk has also committed to installing a Tesla charging station at the future museum. Jane Alcorn, president of the Tesla Science Center, announced Musk’s contribution during Nikola Tesla’s 158th birthday celebration. She noted Musk’s encouragement for the center to use its funds efficiently and to continue pursuing more support to realize the museum’s completion. Matthew Inman, who previously led a successful Indiegogo fundraiser raising $1.3 million to purchase the site, expressed gratitude to Musk for his help. While the site is now owned by the foundation, an estimated $8 million is still required to finish restoring and opening the museum. Nikola Tesla, the Serbian-American inventor born in 1856, was renowned for his pioneering work in electricity and wireless technology at Wardenclyffe. Despite his contributions, Tesla spent his later years in relative obscurity and financial hardship, passing away in 1943. Interest in Tesla’s legacy has grown in recent years, with many now acknowledging his profound impact on technology and innovation. Though Tesla Motors honors his name, there is no direct association between the company and Tesla’s descendants.

Tickets for the NBA regular season game between the Milwaukee Bucks and the New York Knicks at London’s O2 Arena on January 15 sold out in record time—less than an hour after going on sale. The matchup, featuring two Eastern Conference teams, marks the fifth NBA game to be held at the O2 Arena since 2011. Tickets, which went on sale to the public at 9am on Friday, were all purchased within 60 minutes, highlighting the sport’s increasing popularity in the UK.

Benjamin Morel, NBA Senior Vice President for Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, expressed gratitude to fans, stating, "We are thrilled with these results and want to thank our fans for their ongoing support. Selling out faster than ever reflects the tremendous appetite for NBA basketball in the UK and across Europe." Morel also emphasized that fans could expect an authentic NBA experience when the teams arrive in London.

This London matchup will be the NBA’s second international fixture this season. Earlier, the Houston Rockets are set to face the Minnesota Timberwolves in Mexico City on November 12, as the league continues its efforts to expand basketball’s global reach.

Amar’e Stoudemire, of the Knicks, who scored 17 points in New York’s 102-87 win over the Detroit Pistons at the O2 Arena in January 2013, expressed his enthusiasm for playing abroad. Ahead of the ticket release, Stoudemire said, "I wish we could play in London every single season, but that decision is up to the commissioner. I truly enjoy playing in London."

Carmelo Anthony, Stoudemire’s teammate, echoed these sentiments. Anthony, who won Olympic gold with Team USA at the London 2012 Games, shared, "On behalf of my teammates and the entire Knicks organization, I’m excited to be returning to London for NBA Global Games 2015. I have fond memories of playing in London for both the Knicks and Team USA and appreciate the great fans there."

For the Milwaukee Bucks, this game marks the franchise’s first-ever appearance in England. Guard Brandon Knight described the trip as a unique experience, saying, "We are looking forward to coming to London for our first ever game in the UK. Playing in front of London fans and exploring a different city is something special for all of us."

Fans are encouraged to follow @NBAUK and NBA UK Facebook, as a limited number of tickets may become available closer to the game.

article_content: Andrew Kenny and Victoria Tracey, along with their children, enjoyed luxury holidays and had paid off the mortgage on their home despite being in their thirties. Their affluent lifestyle, including personalized car number plates and trips on cruise liners, raised no suspicion among their friends. However, it has emerged that their lifestyle was funded by a £65,000 benefit fraud—a crime for which they have now been jailed. The couple was prosecuted by Liverpool City Council after it was discovered that they had submitted false tenancy agreements. They claimed to the council that Kenny, 39, was the landlord, while Tracey, 33, was his tenant, allowing them to collect up to £1,200 per month for their home in Gateacre, Liverpool. In reality, Kenny and Tracey were a couple with two children together and a third child believed to be from another relationship. They used the fraudulent funds to pay their mortgage and take their children on luxury holidays, including a cruise on the Royal Caribbean ship Independence of the Seas to Spain, Portugal, the Canary Islands, and Madeira. Kenny tried to maintain the deception by denying he was the children’s father, until a fraud investigator referenced his tattoos with the children’s names and birth dates, leading him to admit the truth. During the court hearing, it was revealed that Tracey received £35,894 in housing benefit and income support from November 2008 over four years, while Kenny received £28,145 in the same period. Photographic evidence showed the couple enjoying several luxury holidays with their children. Defending Tracey, Phillip Tully described her as a respected community member who made a foolish decision and showed genuine remorse. He emphasized that she was not a professional fraudster. Judge Robert Warnock sentenced both Kenny and Tracey to nine months in prison. He stated, 'The best illustration of your greed and dishonesty is the use of defrauded public money to pay the remortgage on your property.' Liverpool City Council led the prosecution and acted on behalf of the Department for Work and Pensions. A council spokesperson stated, 'During these difficult economic times, it is more vital than ever that benefits go to those who are eligible. The message from this court case is clear – you could end up behind bars if you falsely claim benefits.'

Deres velhavende livsstil, inklusive personlige nummerplader og krydstogter, vakte ingen mistanke blandt deres venner. Det er dog kommet frem, at deres livsstil blev finansieret af et bedrageri med sociale ydelser på £65.000 – en forbrydelse, de nu er blevet fængslet for. Parret blev retsforfulgt af Liverpool Byråd, efter det blev opdaget, at de havde indsendt falske lejekontrakter. De påstod over for byrådet, at Kenny (39) var udlejer, mens Tracey (33) var hans lejer, hvilket gav dem mulighed for at modtage op til £1.200 om måneden for deres hjem i Gateacre, Liverpool. I virkeligheden var Kenny og Tracey et par med to fælles børn og et tredje barn, der menes at være fra et andet forhold. De brugte de ulovlige penge til at betale deres huslån og tage børnene med på luksusferier, inklusive et krydstogt med Royal Caribbean-skibet 'Independence of the Seas' til Spanien, Portugal, De Kanariske Øer og Madeira. Kenny forsøgte at fastholde bedraget ved at nægte, at han var børnenes far, indtil en efterforsker nævnte hans tatoveringer med børnenes navne og fødselsdatoer, hvorefter han indrømmede sandheden. Under retssagen kom det frem, at Tracey modtog £35.894 i boligstøtte og indkomststøtte fra november 2008 over fire år, mens Kenny modtog £28.145 i samme periode. Fotografisk bevis viste parret nyde flere luksusferier med deres børn. article_content: Indian External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar, during his visit to the United Kingdom, highlighted the significant transformations India has experienced over the past decade, attributing much of this progress to Prime Minister Narendra Modi's leadership. Addressing attendees at a Diwali reception in London, Jaishankar remarked that both the world and India have changed considerably, crediting Modi for India's dynamic evolution. Jaishankar outlined several major policy initiatives that have shaped India's growth trajectory, such as Beti Padhao Beti Bachao, Jandhan Yojana, Awas Yojana, Digital India, Startup India, and Skill India. He emphasized that the combined effect of these projects has sparked a widespread socioeconomic transformation. He also pointed out that nearly as many universities and colleges have been established in India over the past ten years as in the previous 65 years, reflecting the government’s focus on education and development. With the current government nearing the end of its second term, Jaishankar described the past decade as a period of remarkable change. Discussing India’s partnership with the UK, Jaishankar stressed the necessity to re-envision their relationship to align with the modern era and mutual changes both countries have undergone. He encouraged exploring new areas of collaboration to unlock untapped potential. Jaishankar's visit, which began on Saturday and ends on November 15, comes as both nations negotiate a Free Trade Agreement, with twelve rounds of talks already conducted since 2022. According to India's Ministry of External Affairs, the two countries continue to build on their Comprehensive Strategic Partnership and the India-UK Roadmap 2030, which was established in 2021. These frameworks aim to deepen cooperation and benefit both countries, with Jaishankar's current trip expected to strengthen the bilateral relationship.

Han påpegede også, at næsten lige så mange universiteter og højere læreanstalter er blevet etableret i Indien de seneste ti år, som i de foregående 65 år, hvilket vidner om regeringens fokus på uddannelse og udvikling. article_content: The latest United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) report warns that the world's top fossil fuel-producing nations plan to boost oil, gas, and coal output to levels that would jeopardize efforts to limit global warming. Such increases would drive global temperatures well beyond Paris Agreement goals of 1.5°C and 2°C, raising serious concerns for humanity's future. Fossil fuels will be a main point of contention at the upcoming COP28 climate conference, as leaders will need to act to uphold or strengthen existing climate targets. Despite net-zero emission pledges from major producers—such as the United States, China, Russia, Australia, India, and the United Arab Emirates—the UNEP's ‘Production Gap’ report shows their projected fossil fuel production defies these commitments. UNEP estimates that if current production plans are realized, by 2030 fossil fuel extraction will be 110% higher than what is compatible with a 1.5°C pathway, and 69% above levels consistent with a 2°C ceiling. This includes increases of 460% in coal, 82% in gas, and 29% in oil beyond what’s sustainable. UNEP Executive Director Inger Andersen criticized governments for expanding fossil fuel production, saying it undermines the global energy transition and endangers the future. She urged nations at COP28 to cooperate towards a fair and managed phase-out of coal, oil, and gas. The report highlights that burning fossil fuels is the largest driver of climate change, causing record temperatures, severe weather, and rising sea levels. However, governments have often avoided explicitly placing fossil fuels at the center of climate talks. UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres called the report a damning indictment of poor climate stewardship, and stressed that COP28 must declare the end of the fossil fuel era. The report points out that the US, since Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, has promoted increased oil and gas output and is forecast to maintain record high production through 2050. China, the world’s biggest emitter, produces over half the world’s coal, although it is also rapidly developing renewable energy sources. COP26 saw the first global agreement to reduce ‘unabated’ coal power, yet since then, fossil fuel use has reached new highs. Climate advocates like Harjeet Singh and Alex Rafalowicz accuse affluent nations of hypocrisy and call for just and equitable fossil fuel phase-outs. Despite COP28 president Sultan Al Jaber’s statement that fossil fuel phase-down is both necessary and inevitable, the UAE lacks clear policies for reducing its own output, with its state oil company ADNOC planning to expand capacity with a $150 billion investment. The UNEP report insists global leaders must recognize the need for a managed, equitable transition away from fossil fuels, warning that current production trends only make meeting climate targets more difficult.

Sådanne stigninger vil få de globale temperaturer langt over Parisaftalens mål om 1,5°C og 2°C og vækker alvorlig bekymring for menneskehedens fremtid. Fossile brændstoffer bliver et afgørende tema på det kommende COP28-klimatopmøde, hvor ledere skal handle for at opfylde eller styrke de eksisterende klimamål. På trods af løfter om netto-nul emissioner fra store producenter – såsom USA, Kina, Rusland, Australien, Indien og De Forenede Arabiske Emirater – viser UNEP’s ‘Production Gap’-rapport, at den forventede produktion af fossile brændstoffer ikke stemmer overens med disse forpligtelser. UNEP vurderer, at hvis de nuværende produktionsplaner realiseres, vil udvindingen af fossile brændstoffer i 2030 være 110% højere end det, der er foreneligt med en 1,5°C-stigning, og 69% over niveauerne for at holde temperaturstigningen på 2°C. Dette omfatter stigninger på 460% i kul, 82% i gas og 29% i olie ud over det bæredygtige. Rapporten understreger, at afbrænding af fossile brændstoffer er den største drivkraft bag klimaforandringer, hvilket medfører rekordhøje temperaturer, ekstremt vejr og stigende havniveauer. Dog har regeringer ofte undladt at placere fossile brændstoffer centralt i klimaforhandlingerne. Kina, verdens største udleder, producerer over halvdelen af verdens kul, selv om landet også satser kraftigt på vedvarende energi. Ved COP26 blev verdens lande første gang enige om at reducere 'uafhjulpet' kulkraft, men siden da er brugen af fossile brændstoffer steget til nye højder. Klimaforkæmpere som Harjeet Singh og Alex Rafalowicz beskylder velstående nationer for hykleri og kræver en retfærdig udfasning af fossile brændstoffer. Selvom COP28's præsident Sultan Al Jaber har erklæret, at udfasning af fossile brændstoffer er nødvendig og uundgåelig, mangler De Forenede Arabiske Emirater klare planer for at reducere deres egen produktion, mens olieselskabet ADNOC planlægger at udvide kapaciteten med en investering på 150 milliarder dollar. UNEP-rapporten understreger, at globale ledere må anerkende nødvendigheden af en retfærdig og styret omstilling væk fra fossile brændstoffer og advarer om, at nuværende produktionsniveauer kun gør det sværere at nå klimamålene.

article_content: In February 2004, five-year-old Nathania Ong sang the National Day favorite 'Home'—not just with her family, but on stage during a Total Defence Day event in front of a live audience that included the late President SR Nathan. If you visited London recently and caught the 2022-2023 season of the musical Les Miserables, you might not have realized that the actress playing Eponine was now 25-year-old Ong. Based in London, Ong is currently back in Singapore preparing for her next role: Cinderella in theatre company Pangdemonium’s production of Into The Woods by American composer Stephen Sondheim. Speaking to CNA Women in October, Ong shared insights about her journey to the global stage, which began simply with a love for the arts. A Childhood Filled with Music, On Stage and Off

article_content: Just a day after the CIA opted not to appoint a senior female officer, known as 'G', to lead the National Clandestine Service due to her association with controversial interrogation practices, the identity of another candidate appeared online. Francis Archibald, a former leader of the CIA's Latin America Division and experienced undercover operative, is now widely considered to be the agency's next chief spy. His name surfaced after a tweet by ex-Washington Post editor John Dinges, despite the need for secrecy surrounding his role. Archibald has a history of serving as a station chief in Pakistan and is linked to covert operations such as efforts to oust Serbian President Slobodan Milosevic. The leadership change follows public criticism of ‘G’s’ past oversight of a secret CIA prison in Thailand in 2002, where detainees Abu Zubaydah and Abd al-Nashiri underwent waterboarding and sleep deprivation. In addition to her role at the prison, ‘G’ was a senior manager at the CIA’s Counterterrorism Center, helping run major anti-terror operations and working with Jose Rodriguez on the destruction of waterboarding tapes—an action that prompted a Justice Department investigation but resulted in no charges. After Dinges’ tweet, journalist Jeff Stein confirmed Archibald as the likely new chief in AND Magazine, emphasizing Archibald's uncontroversial record. CIA officials have stated that ‘G’s’ association with counterterrorism and interrogation methods did not influence their decision. Director John Brennan is reported to have selected Archibald for unrelated reasons. Senator Dianne Feinstein, a leader on the Senate Intelligence Committee and critic of interrogation practices, personally advised Brennan not to elevate ‘G’, reflecting the ongoing debate around the agency's past. While the CIA still contends with public scrutiny over its former interrogation policies, it has not officially acknowledged Archibald's appointment as head of the National Clandestine Service.

Francis Archibald, tidligere leder af CIA's Latinamerika-division og erfaren undercover-agent, anses nu bredt for at blive bureauets næste spionchef. Hans navn blev offentliggjort efter et tweet fra den tidligere Washington Post-redaktør John Dinges, selv om der er behov for hemmeligholdelse omkring hans rolle. Lederskiftet følger offentlig kritik af ‘G’s’ tidligere ledelse af et hemmeligt CIA-fængsel i Thailand i 2002, hvor fangerne Abu Zubaydah og Abd al-Nashiri blev udsat for waterboarding og søvndeprivation. Ud over hendes rolle i fængslet var ‘G’ også chef i CIA’s Counterterrorism Center, hvor hun ledte store antiterror-operationer og sammen med Jose Rodriguez stod for destruktionen af optagelser af waterboarding—en handling, der udløste en undersøgelse fra Justitsministeriet uden sigtelser. Efter Dinges’ tweet bekræftede journalisten Jeff Stein i AND Magazine, at Archibald, uden nogen skandaler i bagagen, sandsynligvis bliver den nye chef. Selvom CIA stadig møder offentlig kritik af tidligere forhørsmetoder, har de ikke officielt anerkendt Archibald som leder af National Clandestine Service.

article_content: Businesswoman Jean Rasbridge has criticized JobCentre staff for directing around 100 applicants to her company, though none seemed genuinely interested in work. Rasbridge claims that government-run JobCentres are facilitating applications so the unemployed can fulfil requirements to keep their benefits, rather than assisting employers in finding committed staff. Her company, ecigarettedirect.co.uk, advertised a warehouse packer position paying £8 per hour via the Gorseinon, Swansea JobCentre. Although nearly 100 people applied, only two of seven shortlisted applicants attended interviews, and neither accepted the job. Following this experience, Rasbridge said her firm stopped using the JobCentre, arguing that many applicants only apply to satisfy benefit conditions. Jobseekers included individuals from a range of backgrounds and locations across the UK. Rasbridge believes stronger policies are needed to encourage genuine job-seeking efforts. A JobCentre spokesperson stated that advisers are committed to helping people find appropriate employment, and applicants are expected to pursue jobs that fit their skills under current guidelines.

Rasbridge hævder, at de statslige JobCentres hjælper arbejdsløse med at opfylde krav for at beholde deres ydelser, snarere end at hjælpe arbejdsgivere med at finde engagerede medarbejdere. article_content: India’s finance ministry is questioning whether subsidies for electric vehicles (EVs) should continue under the FAME (Faster Adoption and Manufacturing of Electric Vehicles) scheme after this financial year. Key officials say the biggest beneficiaries—electric two-wheeler manufacturers—may no longer need government aid. The Ministry of Heavy Industries wants to extend the subsidy plan as FAME III, with an even larger budget to promote EV and alternative fuel vehicle sales for another five years. FAME I, launched in 2015, allotted ₹895 crore over four years. FAME II, which covered 2019 to 2024, ramped that up to ₹10,000 crore. FAME III is expected to have a bigger allocation, but the target segments remain undecided. Some government members believe India’s EV market has matured, and point to other government incentives available for battery and auto part manufacturing. The final decision will depend on ongoing talks about how widely EVs have caught on and possible funding needs. FAME II has so far subsidized more than 753,000 electric two-wheelers as of August 1. The scheme focuses subsidies on public/shared transport, aiming for 7,090 e-buses, 500,000 electric three-wheelers, 55,000 electric cars, and 1 million two-wheelers overall. Only buses and two-wheelers have come close to these targets. Several electric vehicle makers were found breaking FAME II’s localization rules. Seven companies were barred after a probe, and had to return subsidy funds. In FAME I, subsidies helped about 278,000 EVs with ₹343 crore in incentives, and 465 buses were approved across different states.
