Ifølge centrale embedsmænd har producenterne af elektriske tohjulede – de største modtagere – måske ikke længere brug for statslig støtte. Ministeriet for tung industri vil dog gerne forlænge tilskudsordningen til FAME III med et endnu større budget for at øge salg af elbiler og andre alternative brændstofkøretøjer de næste fem år. FAME I, der udviklede i 2015, blev tildelt 895 crore ₹ over fire år. FAME II dækkede 2019 til 2024 med tilskud på 10.000 crore ₹. FAME III forventes at få endnu højere bevilling, men målgrupperne er endnu ikke besluttet. Regeringen overvejer nu, om elbilmarkedet er så modent, at man bør satse på andre former for støtte, f.eks. til batteri- og autodele-produktion. Den endelige beslutning tages efter igangværende forhandlinger om elbilernes udbredelse og behovet for økonomisk støtte. FAME II har pr. 1. august ydet tilskud til mere end 753.000 elektriske tohjulede. Ordningen har målrettet støtte til offentlig og delt transport med målet om 7.090 elbusser, 500.000 elektriske trehjulede, 55.000 elbiler og 1 million elektriske tohjulede. Nogle elbilproducenter blev udelukket fra FAME II-ordningen efter undersøgelse af overtrædelse af lokaliseringsreglerne og måtte betale beløb tilbage. Under FAME I blev omkring 278.000 elbiler støttet med tilskud på 343 crore ₹, og 465 busser blev godkendt til forskellige delstater.

article_content: India opener Shubman Gill retired hurt on 79 runs after suffering cramps in his left leg during the ICC Cricket World Cup semi-final against New Zealand at Wankhede Stadium on Wednesday. India had scored 165 for one after 23 overs when Gill left the field. The 24-year-old was in great form, hitting eight fours and three sixes in his 65-ball knock. His score became the fourth highest by an Indian in a World Cup semi-final. Gill played important partnerships with Rohit Sharma (47) and Virat Kohli, who was batting on 35 at the time. After Rohit was dismissed for a fast 29-ball 47, Gill joined Kohli for a second-wicket partnership of 101 runs before retiring hurt. Depending on his recovery, Gill could return to bat later in the innings. On the economic front, India's GDP is projected to expand by 6.7% in the July-September quarter, according to a median forecast of 10 economists polled by The Economic Times. This growth is attributed mainly to a robust performance by the services sector. In other news, telecom operators, chip makers, network providers, and handset manufacturers have raised concerns over the hasty implementation of direct-to-mobile TV technology, suggesting that the technology is not yet mature. Additionally, India is considering increasing the threshold for arrests and criminal prosecution in GST evasion cases to ₹3 crore, up from ₹2 crore. This move aims to reduce harassment and improve the business environment.

Japan achieved notable success at this year’s Asia Pacific Screen Awards (APSA), earning several top awards. German filmmaker Wim Wenders’ Tokyo-set film 'Perfect Days' won Best Film, while Ryusuke Hamaguchi’s new feature, 'Evil Does Not Exist', secured the Jury Grand Prize at the Australian event. Wim Wenders expressed his delight and gratitude in a video message, recognizing the collaboration with Japanese producers Takuma Takasaki and Koji Yanai, and commending Koji Yakusho’s portrayal of Hirayama—a Tokyo toilet cleaner whose simple but contented life gradually unfolds through unexpected encounters. 'Perfect Days' is Japan’s entry for the Oscars Best International Feature category.

'Evil Does Not Exist', directed by Hamaguchi, marks his second major APSA win following 'Drive My Car' in 2021. The film tells the story of Takumi and his daughter Hana, who live a traditional, nature-connected life in Mizubiki Village. Their way of life is threatened by a proposed glamping site that could disturb the local ecosystem. Producer Satoshi Takata accepted the Jury Grand Prize.

Other highlights included Celine Song’s win for Best Director for her debut film 'Past Lives', which she called a personal and meaningful honor from her own community. Mouna Hawa received Best Performance for her role in the Jordanian film 'Inshallah a Boy', portraying a mother navigating inheritance laws after her husband’s death. Hawa emphasized the importance of films that give voice to people in difficult times.

The international APSA jury consisted of Clara Law (Australia, President), Anna Katchko (Germany), Yeo Yann Yann (Malaysia), Hideho Urata (Japan/Singapore), and Faisal Baltyuor (Saudi Arabia).

Other main winners were:
- Best Youth Film: 'Bauryna Salu' (Kazakhstan)
- Best Animated Film: 'The Siren' (France, Germany, Luxembourg, Belgium)
- Best Documentary: 'Against the Tide' (India, France)
- Best Screenplay: Anthony Shim for 'Riceboy Sleeps' (Canada, South Korea)
- Best Cinematography: Azamat Dulatov for 'Qas' (Kazakhstan), Special Mention for Krum Rodriguez ('Citizen Saint', Georgia/France/Bulgaria)
- Best New Performer: Aibar Saly and Alisher Ismailov ('Brothers', Kazakhstan)
- Cultural Diversity Award: 'Rapture' (India, China, Qatar, Switzerland, Netherlands)
- Young Cinema Award: Phạm Thiên Ân ('Inside the Yellow Cocoon Shell', Vietnam/Singapore/France/Spain)
- FIAPF Award: Jeremy Chua (Singapore) for Outstanding Contribution to Asia Pacific Cinema.

Den tyske instruktør Wim Wenders’ Tokyo-baserede film 'Perfect Days' vandt prisen for Bedste Film, mens Ryusuke Hamaguchis nyeste værk 'Evil Does Not Exist' sikrede sig Juryens Hovedpris ved ceremonien i Australien. I en videohilsen udtrykte Wenders glæde og taknemmelighed over samarbejdet med de japanske producere Takuma Takasaki og Koji Yanai, og han fremhævede Koji Yakushos rolle som Hirayama – en ydmyg toiletmedarbejder, hvis enkle og tilfredse liv gradvist udfoldes gennem nye møder. 'Perfect Days' er Japans Oscar-bidrag for Bedste Internationale Film.

'Evil Does Not Exist', instrueret af Hamaguchi, er hans anden store APSA-sejr efter 'Drive My Car' i 2021. Filmen følger Takumi og hans datter Hana, som lever et traditionelt og naturforbundet liv i Mizubiki Village. Deres tilværelse trues af planer om luksuscamping, som kan forstyrre det lokale økosystem. Producer Satoshi Takata modtog prisen på vegne af holdet.

Andre højdepunkter var Celine Songs pris for Bedste Instruktør for debutfilmen 'Past Lives'. Hun beskrev anerkendelsen som både personlig og meningsfuld. Mouna Hawa modtog Bedste Præstation for sin rolle i den jordanske film 'Inshallah a Boy', hvor hun spiller en mor, der kæmper med arvereglerne efter sin mands død. Hawa understregede vigtigheden af film, der giver nogle en stemme i svære tider.

APSA’s internationale jury bestod af Clara Law (Australien, formand), Anna Katchko (Tyskland), Yeo Yann Yann (Malaysia), Hideho Urata (Japan/Singapore), og Faisal Baltyuor (Saudi-Arabien).

Andre hovedvindere:

Bradley Jansen, 24, from Grand Rapids, Michigan, orchestrated an elaborate marriage proposal to his college sweetheart, Emily Kaplan. With the help of about 90 friends and family members, Bradley created a lively lip dub performance to One Direction’s hit song 'One Thing'. The memorable proposal, which took place at Tunnel Park on Lake Michigan over Memorial Day weekend, was captured on video and titled 'Brad and Emily Get Engaged'. The video quickly became an online sensation, amassing over 150,000 views globally.

Emily, a teacher and Calvin College graduate, was completely surprised by the event. She recounted to MLive.com, 'I had no idea at all. My whole family was involved, and I had no clue.' Bradley, who runs Bradley Productions, spent the week before the proposal scouting locations and coordinating the participants to rehearse the choreographed routine. His careful planning paid off, as the event unfolded smoothly.

The video opens with Bradley and Emily driving when suddenly 'One Thing' begins to play on a handheld boom box. As they arrive at the park, Bradley turns to Emily and starts lip synching before pulling over. The camera reveals their friends and family performing the choreographed dance and lip dub. Bradley then leads Emily by the hand through a wooded area to the lakeshore.

At the beach, Emily is delighted to see her parents and friends emerge, dancing and singing along. After the performance, notes along the shoreline guided Emily to read cherished memories, culminating at the spot where Bradley would propose. Bradley had also compiled video messages from their loved ones expressing heartfelt sentiments. Following the moving video collage, Bradley appeared and proposed. To his relief, Emily said yes.

The newly-engaged couple have not set a wedding date yet, but they plan to marry in the summer of 2013. Their friends and family have expressed admiration for Bradley’s creativity and the joyful moment he created.

article_content: In Sutton Way, Sutton Hill, Telford, council workers were surprised to find a single ash tree overtaken by millions of caterpillars, leaving the tree completely bare. Experts believe these larvae belong to the ash moth species. Intriguingly, no similar infestations have been seen in other trees or areas nearby. Matthew Seabrook, Trees and Woodlands Officer for the council, reassured the public that this rare event does not threaten people’s safety and is unrelated to ash dieback disease. The council is taking samples to study the caterpillars throughout their development. Stuart Edmunds of the Shropshire Wildlife Trust remarked that such a large cluster of caterpillars is highly unusual, possibly due to limited ash trees in the area prompting many moths to lay eggs on the same tree. He advised against using insecticides, as these caterpillars are an important food source for birds, especially during nesting season. Authorities are closely monitoring the situation, and there is no evidence so far that other tree species are at risk.
translated_content: På Sutton Way i Sutton Hill, Telford, blev kommunens medarbejdere overraskede, da de fandt et enkelt asketræ fuldstændig dækket af millioner af larver, som havde efterladt træet helt nøgent. Eksperterne vurderer, at larverne stammer fra askemøllet. Interessant nok er der ingen lignende tilfælde observeret i andre træer eller områder i Telford. Matthew Seabrook, ansvarlig for kommunens træer og skove, forsikrer beboerne om, at denne usædvanlige hændelse ikke udgør nogen fare for offentligheden og ikke har forbindelse til sygdommen asketoptørre. Kommunen indsamler nu prøver for at følge larvernes udvikling. Stuart Edmunds fra Shropshire Wildlife Trust forklarer, at det er meget sjældent at finde så mange larver samlet ét sted, angiveligt fordi der kun er få asketræer i området, hvilket har fået mange askemøl til at lægge deres æg på samme træ. Han fraråder at bruge insektmiddel, da larverne er en vigtig fødekilde for fugle i yngletiden. Myndighederne overvåger udviklingen nøje, og der er ingen tegn på, at andre træarter i området er i fare.

article_content: Michael Tomlin, 31, from Oldham, and his bride Liz, 27, celebrated their marriage with an unusual theme: Vimto, their favorite soft drink. Instead of traditional champagne, the couple toasted with Vimto, and guests were invited to wear purple to match the drink. At St Gregory’s Church in Bollington, Cheshire, Michael and his ushers donned purple ties and cufflinks, while the priest wore a purple sash. The purple theme extended to the reception, where tables were decorated with matching vases, candle holders, and Vimto-flavored sweets. Michael’s affection for Vimto began in childhood, thanks to drinks made by his grandmother. He introduced Liz, originally from Poland, to Vimto when they met in 2005, and it quickly became her favorite as well. Their first date took place at the famous Vimto statue in Manchester city centre, and Michael later proposed to Liz at the same location. The best man playfully referenced Vimto in his speech, joking that the event was 'sponsored by Vimto.' During their honeymoon in Lanzarote, concerned that Vimto might not be available, Michael brought cartons of the drink with him. Reflecting on the day, Michael said, 'Vimto is at the centre of our hearts, so it was only fitting that it played a major part in our day.'

Princess Anne, President of World Horse Welfare, has called for stricter enforcement against the transport of live horses from Britain to European slaughterhouses, expressing concern that illegal trade is causing unnecessary suffering to hundreds of animals each week. Some dealers circumvent bans on exporting live horses for slaughter by falsely claiming the animals are being sent abroad as pets, for work, or for riding, while in reality, many are destined for meat. Horses may change hands multiple times, often enduring distressing four-day journeys in trucks before ending up in slaughterhouses in countries such as Italy or France.

Princess Anne urged greater checks at ports and the creation of a national database to protect vulnerable horses. She stated, ‘There should be a clear understanding that horses don’t travel live to slaughter from the UK overseas and that is something we should be able to maintain and stand by.’

World Horse Welfare has found cases of dealers flouting the rules due to a lack of routine inspections of lorries transporting horses from British ports. The Princess suggested that horse owners might unknowingly sell animals believing they will become pets, only for the horses to be slaughtered for meat. ‘I suspect there are a lot of innocent victims who think they are selling their horses appropriately... but they are going to market where slaughter buyers do attend,’ she said.

Thousands of horses are sold for meat across Europe. The trade received renewed attention last year when horsemeat was discovered in products labeled as beef in British stores. World Horse Welfare recommends that, if horses are to be sold for meat, they should be slaughtered in British abattoirs to avoid the suffering caused by long journeys.

Princess Anne, a former British eventing champion, added, ‘I really hope eventually that technology will make a difference. If we had a better form of identification it would give confidence to owners and dealers alike that they know where their horses were going.’

Thousands of unwanted horses are sold annually at UK markets like Kirkby Stephen (Cumbria), Henley-in-Arden (Warwickshire), and Llanybydder (Carmarthenshire). Dealers may purchase a pony for as little as £5 and sell the meat in Europe for up to £250, while larger horses may be bought for less than £75 and their meat sold for as much as £600.

Animal welfare advocates are particularly concerned about horses enduring long journeys—sometimes lasting up to four days—in cramped conditions. In two days last year, World Horse Welfare recorded 900 horses being transported through Dover alone, but it is unclear how many were ultimately slaughtered.

World Horse Welfare chief executive Roly Owers commented, ‘We are delighted the Princess supports our campaign for more checks at British ports to prevent horses suffering long journeys and maybe not getting a humane end to their lives.’

A spokesperson for the Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs said, ‘We have a rigorous system of inspections and checks to make sure that horses are healthy and fit for transport. Any evidence of illegal practice in relation to the welfare of horses is investigated with a view to prosecution.’
translated_content:
Prinsesse Anne, præsident for World Horse Welfare, har opfordret til strengere kontrol med transporten af levende heste fra Storbritannien til europæiske slagterier. Hun udtrykker bekymring for, at den ulovlige handel forårsager unødig lidelse for hundreder af dyr hver uge. Nogle handlende undgår forbuddet mod eksport af levende heste til slagtning ved fejlagtigt at påstå, at dyrene sendes til udlandet som kæledyr, arbejdsheste eller til ridning, selvom mange ender som kød. Hestene kan skifte ejer flere gange og bliver ofte tvunget ud på opslidende fire-dages lastbiltransporter, inden de slås ihjel i lande som Italien eller Frankrig.

Prinsesse Anne har opfordret til mere kontrol i havnene og ønsker en national database for at beskytte udsatte heste. Hun siger: 'Der bør være en klar forståelse af, at heste ikke sendes levende til slagtning fra Storbritannien til udlandet, og det bør vi kunne fastholde.'

World Horse Welfare har dokumenteret tilfælde, hvor reglerne omgås, blandt andet fordi der mangler rutinemæssige inspektioner af lastbiler med heste fra britiske havne. Prinsessen påpegede, at ejere kan komme til at sælge heste i god tro, hvorefter de ender i slagterier. 'Jeg tror, at der er mange uskyldige ofre, som mener, de sælger deres heste på en ordentlig måde... men de lander på et marked, hvor slagtekøbere også møder op,' sagde hun.

Tusindvis af heste sælges som kød over hele Europa. Handlen kom igen i fokus sidste år, da hestekød blev fundet i produkter mærket som oksekød i britiske butikker. World Horse Welfare anbefaler, at hvis heste skal sælges som kød, bør de slagtes på britiske slagterier, så de undgår lange og stressende transporter.

Prinsesse Anne, tidligere engelsk military-rytter, tilføjede: 'Jeg håber virkelig, at teknologien med tiden vil gøre en forskel. Med bedre identifikation kan både ejere og handlende være trygge ved, hvor hestene ender.'

Adskillige uønskede heste sælges hvert år ved markeder som Kirkby Stephen (Cumbria), Henley-in-Arden (Warwickshire) og Llanybydder (Carmarthenshire). Handlende kan købe en pony for så lidt som £5 og sælge kødet i Europa for op til £250, mens større heste kan købes for under £75 og give op til £600 for kødet.

Dyrevelfærdsforkæmpere er særligt bekymrede for heste, der må udholde lange ture – i nogle tilfælde op til fire dage – i trange transportforhold. På blot to dage sidste år registrerede World Horse Welfare 900 heste transporteret gennem Dover alene, men det er ukendt, hvor mange der til sidst blev slagtet.

World Horse Welfares direktør, Roly Owers, udtalte: 'Vi er glade for, at prinsessen støtter vores kampagne om flere kontroller i britiske havne, så færre heste lider under lange rejser og måske ikke får en værdig afslutning på livet.'

En talsmand for det britiske miljøministerium sagde: 'Vi har et strengt system af inspektioner og kontroller for at sikre, at heste er sunde og egnede til transport. Alting med tegn på ulovlighed i forhold til hestes velfærd efterforskes med henblik på retsforfølgelse.'
post_content: Princess Anne wants tougher rules to stop UK horses being shipped to Europe for slaughter. Huge numbers endure long, awful journeys just to end up as meat. More checks at ports needed! 🐴❌ #AnimalWelfare #HorseRights #StopTheCruelty
translated_post: Prinsesse Anne kræver mere kontrol mod eksport af britiske heste til slagtning i Europa. Alt for mange heste lider på lange ture. Tid til handling! 🐴❗️#Dyrevelfærd #Stophestetransport

article_content: Luton Town entered the Premier League with many doubting their survival chances, mainly due to the team’s modest background and stadium. Early in the season, pundits like Garth Crooks and Paul Merson quickly predicted Luton's relegation, criticizing their level after just a few matches. Bookmakers and analysts didn't give them much hope either. Despite this negative outlook, Luton's players demonstrated resilience. While the team suffered several losses early on, most were only by a single goal, and recent performances have shown improvement. A notable home draw against Liverpool and a first home win over Crystal Palace boosted their standing, moving them above the relegation zone. Everton’s point penalty helped, but Luton's efforts are impressive given their limited resources compared to other clubs. A key influence in Luton's campaign is manager Rob Edwards. Known for dynamic tactics from previous roles, Edwards decided to stick with Luton's well-established direct style, which had succeeded in the Championship. This approach has unsettled Premier League opponents, as noted by managers like Jurgen Klopp. While Burnley — another promoted club — tried copying the tactics of elite teams but have struggled in the league, Luton's more pragmatic strategy has brought better outcomes. Analysts such as Micah Richards have applauded their clear strategy and set-piece strengths. Even after victories, Edwards maintains a careful perspective, urging his team to enjoy successes but remain focused amidst tough fixtures ahead, including games against Brentford, Arsenal, and Manchester City. If they keep up their current momentum and spirit under Edwards, Luton Town might surprise even more critics this season.
translated_content: Luton Town gik ind i Premier League med mange, der tvivlede på deres chancer for overlevelse – især på grund af klubbens ydmyge rødder og stadion. Allerede tidligt i sæsonen forudsagde eksperter som Garth Crooks og Paul Merson hurtigt Lutons nedrykning og kritiserede deres niveau efter blot et par kampe. Bookmakere og analytikere havde heller ikke meget tiltro til dem. På trods af de lave forventninger har Lutons spillere udvist stor modstandskraft. Holdet led en række indledende nederlag, men de fleste kun med ét mål, og på det seneste har holdet vist fremskridt. Et bemærkelsesværdigt uafgjort resultat hjemme mod Liverpool og sæsonens første hjemmesejr over Crystal Palace gav dem et løft over nedrykningsstregen. Evertons pointstraf har haft betydning, men Lutons præstationer er alligevel bemærkelsesværdige, især set i lyset af klubbernes forskellige budgetter. Manager Rob Edwards har spillet en afgørende rolle i Lutons sæson. Han er kendt for en dynamisk tilgang fra tidligere job, men valgte i Luton at fastholde den direkte spillestil, som allerede havde været succesfuld i Championship. Denne stil har stillet modstanderne i store problemer, hvilket bl.a. er blevet bemærket af trænere som Jürgen Klopp. Mens Burnley – et anden oprykkerhold – har forsøgt sig med storholdenes taktik uden det store held, har Lutons mere jordnære tilgang skaffet dem bedre resultater. Analytikere som Micah Richards har særligt rost Lutons tydelige strategi og styrke på dødbolde. Edwards bevarer et roligt perspektiv efter sejrene og opfordrer sine spillere til at nyde resultaterne, men ikke miste fokus, især med svære kampe mod Brentford, Arsenal og Manchester City i vente. Hvis holdet fortsætter med denne indstilling og under Edwards' ledelse, kan Luton Town stadig overraske flere kritikere i løbet af sæsonen.

article_content: Dashcam video has surfaced of actress Reese Witherspoon’s arrest for disorderly conduct following a confrontation with police in Atlanta, Georgia, on April 19. The video, released by TMZ, shows Witherspoon slurring her words and raising her voice toward an officer after her husband, Jim Toth, was arrested for driving under the influence (DUI). Witherspoon disregarded several requests from both her husband and the officer to remain in the car. She exited the vehicle, challenged the officer's authority, and falsely claimed to be pregnant during the exchange. The officer ultimately arrested and handcuffed Witherspoon for not following instructions. Throughout the incident, Witherspoon invoked her rights as a U.S. citizen and asked whether the officer recognized her. Toth, a talent agent with CAA, apologized to the officer and asserted that he was not involved in her actions. Witherspoon was charged and later pleaded ‘no contest’ to physical obstruction, while Toth pleaded guilty to DUI. Toth was sentenced to 40 hours of community service, one year of probation, and required to attend an alcohol education program. In a later interview on Good Morning America, Witherspoon publicly apologized, admitting she panicked and made untrue statements during the arrest. She said, 'We thought we were OK to drive, but we definitely were not. It's something that will absolutely never happen again.' Witherspoon added that she and Toth were open with their children about the incident, stressing the importance of taking responsibility for one's mistakes.

Videoen, offentliggjort af TMZ, viser Witherspoon tale usammenhængende og hæve stemmen over for en betjent, efter hendes mand Jim Toth blev anholdt for spirituskørsel. Witherspoon ignorerede gentagne opfordringer fra både sin mand og betjenten om at blive i bilen. Hun steg ud af køretøjet, udfordrede betjentens autoritet og påstod fejlagtigt, at hun var gravid. Betjenten anholdt hende derefter for ikke at følge instruktionerne. Undervejs henviste Witherspoon til sine rettigheder som amerikansk statsborger og spurgte, om betjenten vidste, hvem hun var. Toth, der er agent hos CAA, undskyldte over for betjenten og understregede, at han ikke var involveret i hendes handlinger. Witherspoon blev sigtet og erkendte sig senere skyldig i fysisk forhindring, mens Toth erkendte sig skyldig i spirituskørsel. Toth fik 40 timers samfundstjeneste, et års prøvetid og skal deltage i et alkoholuddannelsesprogram. I et senere interview med Good Morning America undskyldte Witherspoon offentligt, indrømmede at hun gik i panik og sagde usande ting under anholdelsen. Hun sagde: "Vi troede, vi var ok til at køre, men det var vi bestemt ikke. Det er noget, der aldrig vil ske igen." Witherspoon tilføjede, at hun og Toth havde været ærlige over for deres børn om hændelsen og lagde vægt på vigtigheden af at tage ansvar for sine fejl.

article_content: We all know the Premier League’s definition of a ‘homegrown’ player is rather broad—players of any nationality are considered homegrown as long as they have been registered with an English club for three years before their 21st birthday. For example, Cesc Fabregas at Chelsea, Danny Welbeck at Arsenal, and Frank Lampard at Manchester City each qualify as homegrown for their new clubs. However, what about players who are truly homegrown—those developed by their clubs and eligible for the home nations? This past weekend in the Premier League, only nine clubs started players in their lineup who both qualify for a home nations country and were brought through their club’s academy. English forward Gabby Agbonlahor was Aston Villa’s match-winner against Liverpool at Anfield. Tyler Blackett has started all four of Manchester United's league matches so far this season. Wilfried Zaha progressed through Crystal Palace’s academy before signing with Manchester United and is now back at Palace. John Terry has remained at Chelsea, even as the club has brought in many foreign stars in recent years. Among the clubs, only Manchester United, Aston Villa, Leicester City, and West Ham started more than one homegrown player. United manager Louis van Gaal named Jonny Evans and Tyler Blackett in his side, which comfortably defeated Queens Park Rangers on Sunday. Mark Noble and James Tomkins both started for West Ham in their 2-2 draw at Hull City. Andy King and Liam Moore started for Leicester City, and Gabby Agbonlahor was one of two homegrown players in Paul Lambert’s Aston Villa lineup at Anfield. By contrast, Manuel Pellegrini did not include a single Manchester City academy graduate in his starting eleven against Arsenal.

For eksempel kvalificerer både Cesc Fabregas i Chelsea, Danny Welbeck i Arsenal og Frank Lampard i Manchester City sig som homegrown for deres nye klubber. Men hvad med dem, der virkelig er homegrown – spillere udviklet af deres klubber og kvalificeret for de britiske hjemmebanenationer? I denne weekend i Premier League var der kun ni klubber, der startede spillere i deres startopstilling, som både er kvalificeret til et af de britiske lande og er kommet gennem klubbens eget akademi. Engelske angriber Gabby Agbonlahor blev Aston Villas matchvinder mod Liverpool på Anfield. Tyler Blackett har startet alle fire af Manchester Uniteds ligakampe hidtil denne sæson. Wilfried Zaha kom gennem Crystal Palaces akademi, før han skrev under med Manchester United og er nu tilbage i Palace. John Terry har forblevet i Chelsea, selvom klubben har hentet mange udenlandske stjerner ind i de seneste år. Af klubberne var det kun Manchester United, Aston Villa, Leicester City og West Ham, der startede med mere end én homegrown-spiller. Uniteds manager Louis van Gaal havde Jonny Evans og Tyler Blackett i sin startopstilling, da Queens Park Rangers blev besejret komfortabelt søndag. Mark Noble og James Tomkins startede begge for West Ham i deres 2-2 kamp mod Hull City. Andy King og Liam Moore startede for Leicester City, og Gabby Agbonlahor var en af to homegrown-spillere i Paul Lamberts Aston Villa-hold på Anfield. Til sammenligning havde Manuel Pellegrini ikke inkluderet én eneste Manchester City-akademispiller i sin startopstilling mod Arsenal.

article_content: David DePape, convicted for attacking Paul Pelosi with a hammer in late 2022, was deeply influenced by right-wing conspiracy theories at the time. Experts on extremism caution that as the 2024 U.S. presidential election draws nearer, the risk of politically driven violence is likely to grow. Conspiracy movements such as QAnon and Pizzagate, once found mainly on the fringes of the internet, have now become part of mainstream political conversation, especially with Donald Trump seeking a return to the White House. Jacob Ware, a domestic terrorism expert at the Council on Foreign Relations, points out, 'Such divisive ideologies are no longer fringe—they're increasingly permeating American society.' A federal jury found DePape guilty of the October 28, 2022, assault at the Pelosi's San Francisco home. During his testimony, DePape admitted he intended to question Nancy Pelosi and threatened to injure her if he believed she lied about government corruption. Pelosi was in Washington when the attack occurred. DePape had posted online statements echoing QAnon beliefs, which falsely claim that prominent Democrats and celebrities are involved in criminal conspiracies. Trump has amplified QAnon content on social media, bringing these theories further into the political mainstream. The January 6, 2021, Capitol riot included many QAnon followers, with signs of violence being organized online beforehand. Before QAnon, the debunked 'Pizzagate' theory appealed to Trump supporters, alleging a child trafficking ring in a pizzeria's nonexistent basement—leading to a shooting in 2017 by a North Carolina man. Trump's 2024 campaign features more heated language, including remarks about retribution and jokes about violence, such as referencing the Pelosi attack or implying harsh punishment for former officials. Political threats target both parties, as shown by a plot to attack Supreme Court Justice Brett Kavanaugh. QAnon's influence continued even after Trump's 2020 loss, blending with other conspiracy movements. In 2021, researchers Sheehan Kane and Michael Jensen reported that more extremist incidents were associated with QAnon than with any other U.S. movement. Kane notes that such theories adapt with current events, making it difficult to predict mobilization. DePape says he was first drawn to online conspiracy circles through GamerGate, a harassment campaign targeting women in the gaming industry—including Brianna Wu, who argues that online radicalization affects all political sides and requires policy action. DePape also testified he wanted to interrogate Pelosi about 2016 election interference, planning to record it in a unicorn costume. He listed other targets influenced by conservative commentary, including a professor. Experts warn that lax moderation and widespread distribution of misinformation on social media make radical ideas more accessible. Brian Hughes of American University highlights a growing industry profiting from extreme rhetoric, with some individuals, like DePape, acting on these beliefs violently. Amarnath Amarasingam, an extremism researcher, compares consuming conspiracy material to addiction, providing followers with scapegoats and a perceived moral mission. Ware says violence increases around American elections, and similar incidents should be expected in 2024. Trump’s legal proceedings and campaign may further inflame rhetoric and extremist activity. Hughes observes that Trump often implies support for violence without explicit endorsement. Experts advise reducing political hostility and offering support to prevent online radicalization, describing conspiracy theory indulgence as a public health problem. — Reporting assistance by Olga R. Rodriguez from San Francisco. The Associated Press maintains editorial independence while receiving foundation support for explanatory election coverage.

Ekstremismeeksperter advarer om, at risikoen for politisk motiveret vold sandsynligvis vil stige, når det amerikanske præsidentvalg i 2024 nærmer sig. Konspirationsbevægelser som QAnon og Pizzagate, der tidligere kun fandtes på internettets yderkanter, er nu en del af den almindelige politiske debat – især hvor Donald Trump forsøger at vende tilbage til Det Hvide Hus. Jacob Ware, ekspert i indenrigs terror hos Council on Foreign Relations, påpeger: 'Sådanne splittende ideologier er ikke længere kun på kanten – de gennemsyrer i stigende grad det amerikanske samfund.' En føderal jury fandt DePape skyldig i angrebet den 28. oktober 2022 i Pelosis hjem i San Francisco. Under sin vidneforklaring indrømmede DePape, at han havde til hensigt at afhøre Nancy Pelosi og truede med at skade hende, hvis han mente, hun løj om regeringskorruption. Pelosi var i Washington, da angrebet fandt sted. DePape havde postet udtalelser online, der efterlignede QAnon-tankegangen, som fejlagtigt hævder, at fremtrædende demokrater og berømtheder er involveret i kriminelle sammensværgelser. Trump har fremhævet QAnon-indhold på sociale medier og trukket disse teorier længere ind i det politiske hovedspor. Optøjerne ved Kongressen den 6. januar 2021 involverede mange QAnon-tilhængere, og der blev organiseret vold online forud for begivenheden. Før QAnon tiltrak den tilbageviste 'Pizzagate'-teori Trump-tilhængere, hvor det blev påstået, at der var en børnesexring i en pizzerias ikke-eksisterende kælder – hvilket førte til et skyderi i 2017 udført af en mand fra North Carolina. Trumps kampagne i 2024 er præget af mere hidsig retorik, herunder udtalelser om gengældelse og vittigheder om vold – f.eks. kommentarer om Pelosi-angrebet eller antydninger om hårde straffe mod tidligere embedsmænd. Politiske trusler rammer begge partier, som eksempelvis ses i sammensværgelsen om at angribe højesteretsdommer Brett Kavanaugh. QAnon-bevægelsen fortsatte sin indflydelse efter Trumps nederlag i 2020 og flettede sig sammen med andre konspirationer. I 2021 rapporterede forskerne Sheehan Kane og Michael Jensen, at flere ekstremistiske hændelser er knyttet til QAnon end til nogen anden amerikansk bevægelse. Kane understreger, at sådanne teorier retter sig ind efter tidens begivenheder, hvilket gør det svært at forudsige, hvem der vil handle på dem. DePape forklarer, at han først blev tiltrukket af online konspirationsmiljøer gennem GamerGate – en chikane-kampagne mod kvinder i spilindustrien, herunder Brianna Wu, der argumenterer for, at online radikalisering rammer alle politiske sider og kræver politisk handling. DePape vidnede også, at han ønskede at afhøre Pelosi om indblanding i valget i 2016 og planlagde at optage det i et enhjørningekostume. Han nævnte yderligere mål, heriblandt en professor, som han hørte om gennem konservative medier. Eksperter advarer om, at svag moderation og udbredt misinformation på sociale medier gør radikale idéer mere tilgængelige. Brian Hughes fra American University fremhæver en voksende industri, der tjener på ekstrem retorik, og at nogle personer – som DePape – handler på disse idéer med vold. Amarnath Amarasingam, ekstremismeforsker, sammenligner overforbrug af konspirationsteorier med afhængighed, da det giver følgere syndebukke og en oplevelse af moralsk opgave. Ware siger, at volden typisk stiger omkring amerikanske valg, og at man bør forvente lignende hændelser i 2024. Trumps retssager og valgkampagne kan yderligere skærpe retorikken og ekstremistisk aktivitet. Hughes bemærker, at Trump ofte antyder støtte til vold uden eksplicit at støtte det. Eksperter opfordrer til at skrue ned for den politiske retorik og støtte personer, der er i risiko for at blive radikaliseret – og beskriver fordybelse i konspirationsteorier som et folkesundhedsproblem. — Med rapportering fra Olga R. Rodriguez i San Francisco. Associated Press opretholder redaktionel uafhængighed og modtager fondsstøtte til forklarende valgdækning.

article_content:
In 2019, Jason Eddy and his husband moved from London to New York, following a career opportunity at Google for Eddy’s partner. Eddy’s life has been marked by change: he was raised in Bermuda, finished school in Canada, trained as an actor in New York, and then spent 18 years in London. He values how living in new places broadens perspective.

New York occupies a special but complex place in Eddy’s heart. His first experience there as a young actor in 2000 was infused with excitement, but the trauma of 9/11 left an enduring impact. Nearly two decades later, the couple’s return to the city was quickly followed by the Covid-19 pandemic, leading to empty streets and a sense of upheaval reminiscent of his earlier experience. Yet, Eddy admired New Yorkers’ unique resilience and their ability to band together in times of crisis—qualities evident both post-9/11 and during the pandemic.

He noticed that New York offers greater openness and ambition, especially in the creative industry, compared to what he encountered in London. Auditions and opportunities felt more attainable, inspiring Eddy to shed self-doubt and embrace a more confident approach. Adapting to New York’s non-stop energy, including the round-the-clock work ethic, was challenging but invigorating.

Relocating also introduced Eddy to the distinct political and social atmosphere of the United States. He and his husband observed Americans’ directness in discussing politics and felt firsthand the charged atmosphere of the Trump presidency and the Black Lives Matter movement—an experience intensified by Eddy’s identity as a person of color.

A significant challenge for Eddy is adjusting to the American healthcare system, which stands in stark contrast to the NHS in the UK. Hearing about friends relying on crowdfunding for medical expenses highlighted for him the benefits of the healthcare system he grew up with.

I 2019 flyttede Jason Eddy og hans mand fra London til New York, fordi Eddys partner fik et jobtilbud hos Google. Eddys liv har været præget af forandringer: han er opvokset på Bermuda, gik i skole i Canada, blev uddannet skuespiller i New York, og boede derefter 18 år i London. Han værdsætter, hvor meget det udvider ens horisont at bo forskellige steder.

New York har en særlig, men kompleks plads i Eddys hjerte. Hans første oplevelse i byen som ung skuespillerelev i 2000 var fuld af begejstring, men traumet efter 9/11 satte et varigt præg. Næsten tyve år senere blev parrets gensyn med byen hurtigt fulgt af covid-19-pandemien, hvilket førte til tomme gader og uro, der mindede om hans tidligere oplevelser. Alligevel beundrede Eddy newyorkernes evne til at holde sammen og støtte hinanden gennem kriser – noget, han oplevede både efter 9/11 og under pandemien.

Han lagde mærke til, at New York byder på større åbenhed og ambition, især i den kreative branche, i forhold til London. Det virkede nemmere at få auditions og muligheder, hvilket inspirerede Eddy til at lægge selv-tvivl på hylden og prøve nye ting med mere selvtillid. At vænne sig til New Yorks energiske og uafbrudte tempo samt arbejdsrutiner døgnet rundt krævede tilpasning, men var også spændende.

At flytte til USA gav også Eddy indblik i landets meget direkte og åbne politiske og sociale miljø. Han og hans mand oplevede amerikanernes ligefremhed i politiske samtaler og mærkede tydeligt den intense stemning under Trump-præsidentskabet og Black Lives Matter-bevægelsen – især som person af farve.

En af de største udfordringer for Eddy har været at forstå det amerikanske sundhedssystem, som er meget anderledes end NHS i Storbritannien. Når venner må ty til crowdfunding for at dække lægeregninger, har han lært at sætte pris på den tryghed, det britiske system gav ham.

article_content: Mark Beckford, 45, survived an extraordinary 14 hours trapped in his car after it flipped and landed upside down in a water-filled ditch near Hamstreet, Kent. The incident happened at around 2am when Beckford’s red MG ZR left the road. His wife, Lesley, 60, reported him missing after he didn’t return home, leading family members Melanie Wellman, Nichola O’Shea, and others to reach out to friends, police, and hospitals during the search. Trapped inside the vehicle and unable to call for help due to his lost mobile phone, Beckford stayed alive by breathing from a small air pocket. Hope arrived shortly before 4pm when a lorry driver noticed the car’s upturned wheels and contacted emergency services. Kent Fire and Rescue quickly responded, using hydraulic equipment to access the hatchback and confirm Beckford’s presence. Firefighters winched the vehicle partly up the bank to ensure a safe rescue. Paramedics, including the Hazardous Area Response Team in dry suits, provided on-site medical care before Beckford was transported by ambulance to William Harvey Hospital, where he remains in stable condition. Rob Sherwood from Kent Fire and Rescue Service commended all those involved in the challenging rescue and gave special recognition to the alert lorry driver. The A2070 was closed in both directions during the incident, and Kent Police are appealing for any witnesses to come forward.

Ulykken skete omkring kl. 2 om natten, da Beckfords røde MG ZR kørte af vejen. Hans kone, Lesley, 60, meldte ham savnet, da han ikke kom hjem, hvilket fik familiemedlemmerne Melanie Wellman, Nichola O'Shea og andre til at kontakte venner, politiet og hospitaler under eftersøgningen. Beckford var fanget i bilen og kunne ikke ringe efter hjælp, da hans mobiltelefon gik tabt under ulykken. Han overlevede ved at trække vejret fra en lille luftlomme. Redningen kom kort før kl. 16, da en lastbilchauffør opdagede bilens opadvendte hjul og kontaktede alarmcentralen. Kent Fire and Rescue rykkede hurtigt ud og brugte hydraulisk udstyr til at få adgang til bagklappen og bekræfte, at Beckford var inde i bilen. Brandfolk trak bilen delvist op ad skråningen for at sikre en sikker redning. Paramedicinere, inklusive Hazardous Area Response Team i tørdragter, ydede førstehjælp på stedet, før Beckford blev kørt med ambulance til William Harvey Hospital, hvor han fortsat er i stabil tilstand. Rob Sherwood fra Kent Fire and Rescue Service roste alle involverede i den udfordrende redningsaktion og gav særlig ros til den opmærksomme lastbilchauffør. A2070-vejen var spærret i begge retninger under hændelsen, og Kent Police søger vidner til ulykken.

article_content: Berkshire Hathaway reported a $12.8 billion net loss for the third quarter of 2023, compared to a $2.8 billion loss in the same period of 2022. This loss stemmed mainly from unrealized declines in the investment portfolio due to stock market weakness. Nevertheless, operating earnings—excluding market-driven volatility and better reflecting core business performance—rose by 41% year-over-year. Share repurchases also contributed to a 43% increase in per-share operating income compared to Q3 2022. Year-to-date operating earnings for Q3 2023 were 46% higher than pre-pandemic 2019, with growth in most segments except for railroad and energy. Operating earnings per share for the year to date were 65% above 2019, further boosted by share repurchases. Segment performance was mixed. The insurance division posted strong results, with investment income up 75% thanks to higher yields on short-term investments. Insurance operating income rose 165% year-to-date, while non-insurance operating earnings declined by 12%. All three insurance units reported underwriting profits. GEICO benefited from higher premiums per policy and fewer claims, though policy counts decreased. The BNSF railroad segment saw a 15% drop in quarterly operating earnings and a 17% year-to-date decline, driven by lower freight volumes and increased non-fuel costs. Berkshire Hathaway Energy (BHE), 92% owned by Berkshire, saw a 69% drop in Q3 operating earnings and a 46% decline year-to-date, mainly because of $1.3 billion set aside for possible wildfire liabilities. The U.S. utilities business operated as expected otherwise. Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices saw an 81% year-to-date net earnings drop due to slower housing activity from higher interest rates. Manufacturing, service, and retailing showed varying results. Precision Castparts had a 32.5% rise in pre-tax earnings, benefiting from increased aerospace demand. Aviation services continued to grow, but housing-related companies lagged amid high mortgage rates. Berkshire Hathaway Automotive posted an 18.6% increase in earnings year-to-date. Retail and distribution were mixed, with McLane’s profits up, but home furnishing companies down. During Q3, Berkshire boosted its ownership of Pilot Travel Centers to 80%, but this segment's pre-tax earnings declined due to lower fuel prices and higher costs. Non-controlled businesses, including Kraft Heinz and Occidental Petroleum, contributed profits under the equity method. Berkshire repurchased around $1.1 billion of its own stock during Q3, in line with its approach to buy back shares below intrinsic value. The company was a net seller of publicly traded stocks, selling about $7 billion while purchasing approximately $1.7 billion. It reduced its Chevron holding by $2 billion. Buffett and Munger remain focused on long-term value rather than quarterly performance. Berkshire’s cash and equivalents totaled nearly $152 billion, supporting investment flexibility and resilience. Leadership succession is secure, with Greg Abel and Ajit Jain managing key divisions, and Ted Weschler and Todd Combs overseeing parts of the investment portfolio. Despite the reported net loss, the robust operating results—especially in insurance—highlight the strength of Berkshire’s diversified business mix amid economic headwinds.
translated_content: Berkshire Hathaway rapporterede et nettotab på 12,8 milliarder dollars for tredje kvartal 2023, sammenlignet med et tab på 2,8 milliarder dollars i samme periode i 2022. Dette tab skyldtes primært urealiserede fald i investeringsporteføljen, som følge af et svagt aktiemarked. Ikke desto mindre steg driftsindtjeningen – der udelukker markedsdrevne udsving og bedre afspejler kerneforretningen – med 41% år-over-år. Aktietilbagekøb bidrog også til en stigning på 43% i driftsindtjening pr. aktie sammenlignet med Q3 2022. De samlede driftsindtjeninger for tredje kvartal 2023 var 46% højere end før pandemien i 2019, med vækst i de fleste segmenter undtagen jernbane og energi. Driftsindtjeningen pr. aktie for året til dato var 65% over 2019, yderligere styrket af aktietilbagekøb. Resultaterne på tværs af forretningsområder var blandede. Forsikringsdivisionen leverede stærke resultater, hvor investeringsindtægterne steg med 75% takket være højere afkast på kortfristede investeringer. Driftsindtjeningen fra forsikring steg med 165% år-til-dato, mens driftsindtjeningen udenfor forsikringsselskaberne faldt med 12%. Alle tre forsikringsenheder opnåede forsikringsteknisk overskud. GEICO nød godt af højere gennemsnitlige præmier og lavere udbetalingsfrekvens, selvom antal policer faldt. BNSF jernbanesegmentet oplevede et fald på 15% i kvartalets driftsindtjening og et fald på 17% år-til-dato, primært på grund af lavere fragtvolumen og højere ikke-brændstofrelaterede omkostninger. Berkshire Hathaway Energy (BHE), hvor Berkshire ejer 92%, oplevede et fald på 69% i Q3’s driftsindtjening og et fald på 46% år-til-dato, hovedsageligt fordi der blev afsat 1,3 milliarder dollars til potentielle tab fra skovbrande. Den amerikanske forsyningsforretning fungerede ellers som forventet. Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices havde et fald på 81% i nettoindtjeningen år-til-dato, grundet lavere boligaktivitet forårsaget af højere renter. Inden for industri, service og detailhandel var resultaterne varierende. Precision Castparts havde en stigning på 32,5% i overskud før skat, drevet af større efterspørgsel fra luftfartsindustrien. Luftfartstjenester voksede fortsat, mens boligrelaterede virksomheder underpræsterede pga. høje realkreditrenter. Berkshire Hathaway Automotive havde en stigning på 18,6% i indtjening år-til-dato. Detail- og distributionsforretningerne var blandede, med solide gevinster hos McLane, men nedgang i møbelsegmentet. I tredje kvartal øgede Berkshire sin ejerandel i Pilot Travel Centers til 80%, men segmentets overskud før skat faldt grundet lavere brændstofpriser og højere omkostninger. Ikke-kontrollerede virksomheder, såsom Kraft Heinz og Occidental Petroleum, bidrog med indtjening efter kapitalmetoden. Berkshire tilbagekøbte cirka 1,1 milliarder dollars af egne aktier i tredje kvartal, i tråd med politikken om kun at købe under indre værdi. Selskabet var nettosælger af børsnoterede aktier og solgte for cirka 7 milliarder dollars, mens der blev købt for cirka 1,7 milliarder dollars. Chevron-beholdningen blev reduceret med 2 milliarder dollars. Buffett og Munger fokuserer fortsat på langsigtet værdiskabelse frem for kvartalsvise resultater. Berkshires kontantbeholdning og ækvivalenter udgør næsten 152 milliarder dollars, hvilket giver investeringsfleksibilitet og robusthed. Arvefølgen er sikret, med Greg Abel og Ajit Jain som ledere af nøgleforretninger samt Ted Weschler og Todd Combs, der håndterer dele af investeringsporteføljen. På trods af det rapporterede nettotab fremhæver de stærke driftsresultater – især inden for forsikring – fordelene ved Berkshires diversificerede forretningsmodel i et udfordrende økonomisk klima.

article_content: After securing their spot in the 2015 Rugby World Cup, Uruguay scrum-half Agustin Ormaechea turned his focus to making an impact at the tournament. Uruguay will face England, Australia, Wales, and Fiji in Pool A—the notorious 'Group of Death.' Uruguay advanced by defeating Russia in a two-legged playoff, overturning a narrow away loss with a 36-27 home victory in Montevideo to clinch a 57-49 aggregate win. This marks Uruguay’s third Rugby World Cup appearance and their first since 2003, after having previously competed in 1999. ‘We’re heading to England 2015 to experience the world’s greatest tournament,’ Ormaechea said. ‘We’ve dreamed about this for a long time, and achieving qualification feels incredible. Tonight, we celebrate—tomorrow, we set new goals.’ Head coach Pablo Lemoine attributed their success to years of dedication and a relentless drive to qualify. He emphasized the team’s determination and ability to stay focused when it mattered. Lemoine called this a major milestone for Uruguayan rugby and noted that, while the achievement should be enjoyed, attention now turns to preparing for the World Cup. Highlights from Uruguay’s playoff victory included crucial kicks from Felipe Berchesi and a try by Joaquin Prada, which helped secure their place in rugby’s top competition.
translated_content: Efter at have sikret sig en plads ved Rugby-VM 2015, retter Uruguays scrum-half Agustin Ormaechea nu blikket mod at gøre en forskel ved turneringen. Uruguay skal møde England, Australien, Wales og Fiji i Pulje A – den berygtede ‘Dødens Pulje’. Uruguay kvalificerede sig ved at besejre Rusland over to kampe. Efter et smalt nederlag på udebane vendte de det hele med en 36-27 sejr hjemme i Montevideo, hvilket gav en samlet sejr på 57-49. Dette bliver Uruguays tredje optræden ved et Rugby-VM og den første siden 2003, efter de også deltog i 1999. ‘Vi tager til England 2015 for at opleve verdens største turnering,’ sagde Ormaechea. ‘Vi har drømt om dette i lang tid, og det føles utroligt at have klaret kvalifikationen. I aften fejrer vi – i morgen sætter vi nye mål.’ Cheftræner Pablo Lemoine tilskrev succesen flere års dedikation og et stærkt ønske om at kvalificere sig. Han fremhævede holdets beslutsomhed og evne til at holde fokus, når det virkelig gjaldt. Lemoine kaldte det en stor milepæl for uruguayansk rugby og bemærkede, at mens holdet bør nyde øjeblikket, skifter fokus nu til forberedelserne til VM. Uruguays sejr blev blandt andet sikret gennem vigtige spark fra Felipe Berchesi og et forsøg af Joaquin Prada, hvilket hjalp holdet til pladsen blandt verdens bedste.

article_content: Blind Chinese civil rights activist Chen Guangcheng’s dramatic flight from house arrest has set off a tense diplomatic dispute between China and the United States. Chen, a self-taught lawyer renowned for opposing forced abortions under China’s one-child policy, escaped from his heavily guarded home and is widely believed to have sought refuge at the U.S. Embassy in Beijing. The incident has heightened friction in already-strained U.S.-China ties, following political turmoil linked to the ousting of former leader Bo Xilai. While Chen’s exact situation remains unclear, human rights campaigners are alarmed about the safety of both Chen and those who helped him. He Peirong, an activist from Nanjing who assisted in the escape, has been detained, prompting international calls for her release. Supporters say Chen’s wife Yuan Weijing, their young daughter, his elderly mother, and other relatives are in danger—some reportedly detained in retaliation for his escape. Top American officials, including Assistant Secretary of State Kurt Campbell, rushed to Beijing for urgent talks, coinciding with a planned high-level meeting led by Secretary of State Hillary Clinton and Treasury Secretary Timothy Geithner. The U.S. faces the challenge of advocating for human rights while safeguarding key diplomatic relations with China. President Obama’s national security team stressed support for freedom of expression and activists’ safety, balanced against maintaining vital international ties. Chinese authorities, meanwhile, have responded harshly. Several of Chen’s supporters, among them He Peirong and Gao Yushan, have been detained, and lawyers like Li Fangping—who sought to represent Chen—have been questioned by police. Activists Zeng Jinyan and Hu Jia have also faced interrogation after reportedly contacting Chen during his brief time in hiding. Chen’s flight comes on the heels of a recent political scandal: Wang Lijun, a former police official, previously fled to a U.S. consulate, precipitating the downfall of Bo Xilai just months before China’s leadership transition. These incidents have deepened Beijing’s suspicions that the U.S. aims to erode Communist Party authority. International rights organizations and prominent supporters have called for a united front in defense of Chen and his family. Sophie Richardson of Human Rights Watch highlighted the activists’ extraordinary bravery, while Bob Fu of China Aid emphasized the importance of U.S. support for Chen in upholding human rights principles. Diplomatic strains have also grown as the U.S. reconsidered military sales to Taiwan, further complicating relations. On the ground in China, activists and supporters—including actor Christian Bale—who tried to see Chen, have faced threats and ejection by security forces. Chen’s ordeal dates back to his original detention when he exposed forced abortions in his village, leading to imprisonment and house arrest under close watch. Observers argue that his ongoing confinement lacked legal basis, drawing global criticism and shining a light on persistent abuses in China’s human rights record.
translated_content: Den blinde kinesiske menneskerettighedsaktivist Chen Guangchengs dramatiske flugt fra husarrest har udløst en spændt diplomatisk konflikt mellem Kina og USA. Chen, en selvlært advokat kendt for sin modstand mod tvangsaborter under Kinas étbarnspolitik, undslap sit tungt bevogtede hjem og menes bredt at have søgt tilflugt på den amerikanske ambassade i Beijing. Hændelsen har øget friktionen i de allerede anstrengte forhold mellem USA og Kina efter politisk uro i kølvandet på fyringen af tidligere leder Bo Xilai. Mens Chens præcise situation fortsat er uklar, udtrykker menneskerettighedsforkæmpere stor bekymring for sikkerheden for både Chen og dem, der hjalp ham. He Peirong, en aktivist fra Nanjing, som assisterede med flugten, er blevet tilbageholdt, hvilket har udløst internationale krav om hendes løsladelse. Støtter fortæller, at Chens kone, Yuan Weijing, deres lille datter, hans ældre mor og andre familiemedlemmer er i fare—nogle er angiveligt tilbageholdt som gengældelse for hans flugt. Ledende amerikanske embedsmænd, deriblandt viceudenrigsminister Kurt Campbell, skyndte sig til Beijing til hastemøder, samtidig med at et planlagt topmøde med udenrigsminister Hillary Clinton og finansminister Timothy Geithner fandt sted. USA har udfordringer med både at kæmpe for menneskerettigheder og sikre vigtige diplomatiske relationer med Kina. Præsident Obamas nationale sikkerhedsteam understregede støtten til ytringsfrihed og aktivisters sikkerhed, samtidig med at vigtige internationale bånd søges bevaret. Kinesiske myndigheder har imidlertid reageret hårdt. Flere af Chens støtter, herunder He Peirong og Gao Yushan, er blevet tilbageholdt, og advokater som Li Fangping—der forsøgte at repræsentere Chen—er blevet afhørt af politiet. Aktivisterne Zeng Jinyan og Hu Jia er også blevet afhørt efter angiveligt at have haft kontakt med Chen, mens han var på flugt. Chens flugt sker kort tid efter en politisk skandale, hvor Wang Lijun, en tidligere politiofficer, flygtede til et amerikansk konsulat, hvilket udløste Bo Xilais fald få måneder før Kinas magtskifte. Disse begivenheder har øget Beijings mistanker om, at USA forsøger at undergrave kommunistpartiets magt. Internationale menneskerettighedsorganisationer og prominente støtter har opfordret til fælles opbakning til Chen og hans familie. Sophie Richardson fra Human Rights Watch fremhævede aktivisternes ekstraordinære mod, mens Bob Fu fra China Aid understregede vigtigheden af amerikansk støtte til Chen for at forsvare menneskerettighederne. De diplomatiske spændinger er yderligere forstærket, efter at USA har genovervejet våbensalg til Taiwan, hvilket komplicerer forholdet. I Kina har aktivister og støtter—including skuespilleren Christian Bale—som forsøgte at besøge Chen, oplevet trusler og er blevet fjernet af sikkerhedsstyrker. Chens prøvelser begyndte, da han afslørede tvangsaborter i sin landsby, noget der førte til fængsling og siden husarrest under tæt overvågning. Observatører mener, at hans vedvarende anholdelse ikke havde juridisk grundlag, hvilket har ført til global kritik og sat fornyet fokus på krænkelser af menneskerettigheder i Kina.

article_content: Donna Wright, aged 34, from West Cornforth in County Durham, has been sentenced to eight weeks in prison for harassing the family of missing Katrice Lee. Wright impersonated Katrice Lee—who disappeared in Germany in 1981 at age two—on social media. After a DNA test confirmed she was not Katrice, Wright began harassing Katrice's parents, Richard and Sharon Lee, via Facebook and phone calls. Despite a court order issued last year barring her from contacting the family, Wright repeatedly called them and verbally abused them over the phone. Wright received an eight-week jail sentence after admitting to harassing Richard Lee, 64, at Newton Aycliffe Magistrates’ Court. Due to a previously suspended sentence for harassing Katrice's mother, Sharon, and sister, Natasha, she will serve a total of 14 weeks in custody. Katrice Lee went missing on her second birthday, November 28, 1981, from a military supply store in Paderborn, West Germany, where her father was stationed with the King's Royal Hussars. Her disappearance occurred while her mother was briefly away shopping for party supplies. Initial police investigations suspected she may have drowned in the nearby River Lippe, but no body was ever found. Wright, who is the same age Katrice would be now, responded to an appeal for information in 2012. The court heard that after the DNA test, Wright sent spiteful messages to the family over Facebook. She admitted harassment after phone records were presented as evidence, following several court hearings and changes of legal representation. Richard Lee described Wright's persistent abuse as 'despicable' and emotionally distressing. Vicky Wilson, prosecuting, detailed in court how Wright repeatedly called Mr. Lee, sometimes hanging up, and at other times verbally abusing him and accusing him of posting a photo of an unrelated child on Facebook. The court was told that it was actually Wright who had posted the incorrect photo. Wright’s defense lawyer, Viv Waugh, highlighted her mental health issues and the risk of her losing access to accommodation and support workers if given a custodial sentence over eight weeks. Judge Martin Walker, however, said Wright's actions were hurtful, abusive, and caused significant distress. After the ruling, Richard Lee said the only comfort was not having to worry about further calls, and reiterated that his family remains committed to finding Katrice, despite the lasting impact of both their loss and Wright’s harassment. Katrice's story has received public attention through TV programs, such as BBC's Missing Live and Crimewatch, and her family continues their efforts to find her through a dedicated Facebook page.
translated_content: Donna Wright, 34 år og fra West Cornforth i County Durham, er blevet idømt otte ugers fængsel for at have chikaneret familien til den forsvundne Katrice Lee. Wright udgav sig for at være Katrice Lee – som forsvandt i Tyskland i 1981 som toårig – på sociale medier. Efter en DNA-test bekræftede, at hun ikke var Katrice, begyndte Wright at chikanere Katrices forældre, Richard og Sharon Lee, via Facebook og telefonopkald. På trods af et retsforbud, der blev udstedt sidste år, og som forbød hende at kontakte familien, ringede Wright gentagne gange til dem og udsatte dem for verbalt overgreb over telefonen. Wright modtog en fængselsdom på otte uger efter at have erkendt sig skyldig i at have chikaneret Richard Lee, 64, ved Newton Aycliffe Magistrates’ Court. På grund af en tidligere betinget dom for chikane mod Katrices mor, Sharon, og søster, Natasha, skal hun samlet afsone 14 uger i fængsel. Katrice Lee forsvandt på sin toårs fødselsdag, 28. november 1981, fra en militærbutik i Paderborn, Vesttyskland, hvor hendes far var udstationeret med King's Royal Hussars. Hun forsvandt, mens hendes mor kortvarigt var væk for at købe ind til fest. Politiet mistænkte oprindeligt, at hun måske var faldet i den nærliggende flod Lippe og druknet, men der blev aldrig fundet et lig. Wright, som er på alder med, hvad Katrice ville have været nu, reagerede på en efterlysning i 2012. Retten hørte, at Wright efter DNA-testen sendte hadefulde beskeder til familien via Facebook. Hun erkendte chikane, efter telefonoptegnelser blev præsenteret som bevismateriale, efter flere retsmøder og skift af forsvarsadvokat. Lee, nogle gange lagde på, og andre gange udsatte ham for verbale overgreb og beskyldte ham for at have lagt et billede op af et andet barn på Facebook. Retten blev oplyst om, at det faktisk var Wright, der havde delt det forkerte billede. Wrights forsvarsadvokat, Viv Waugh, fremhævede hendes mentale helbredsproblemer og risikoen for, at hun ville miste adgang til bolig og støttepersonale, hvis hun fik en fængselsdom på over otte uger. Dommer Martin Walker fastslog dog, at Wrights handlinger var sårende, krænkende og forårsagede betydelig forulempelse. Efter dommen sagde Richard Lee, at den eneste trøst var, ikke at skulle bekymre sig om flere opkald, og han understregede, at familien fortsat er engageret i at finde Katrice – trods konsekvenserne af både deres tab og Wrights chikane. Katrices historie har fået offentlig opmærksomhed gennem tv-programmer som BBC's Missing Live og Crimewatch, og hendes familie fortsætter arbejdet med at finde hende via en særlig Facebook-side.

article_content:
Disney has announced its first British live-action production, collaborating with Lime Pictures—the team behind The Only Way Is Essex and Hollyoaks—to create a four-part mystery adventure called 'Evermoor.' This marks Disney’s first non-animated film developed in the UK, which will be broadcast on the flagship U.S. Disney Channel.

'Evermoor' tells the story of American teenager Tara Bailey, who moves with her family from the United States to an isolated village in England named Evermoor, situated on the edge of mysterious moors in central England. As her mother and stepfather unpack, Tara and her siblings adjust to their new lives but soon face unexpected dangers that require them to unite in order to secure their family’s new beginning.

Tricia Wilber, Chief Marketing Officer of The Walt Disney Company Europe, Middle East, and Africa, described 'Evermoor' as Disney’s 'most ambitious production yet.' David Levine, the company’s Vice President for Programming and Production, expressed excitement, believing the series' story will captivate Disney Channel audiences worldwide. Claire Poyser, Managing Director of Lime Pictures, voiced her enthusiasm about partnering with Disney, noting that 'Evermoor' will further enhance Lime's strong track record in producing inspiring family dramas.

The series is scheduled to be broadcast in 160 countries from autumn 2014.

Dette markerer Disneys første ikke-animerede film udviklet i Storbritannien, som vil blive vist på den amerikanske hovedkanal Disney Channel.

'Evermoor' fortæller historien om den amerikanske teenager Tara Bailey, der flytter med sin familie fra USA til en isoleret engelsk landsby, Evermoor, beliggende på kanten af mystiske heder i det centrale England. Mens hendes mor og stedfar pakker ud, forsøger Tara og hendes søskende at finde sig til rette i deres nye omgivelser, men de står hurtigt over for uventede farer, der tvinger dem til at samarbejde for at sikre familiens nye begyndelse.

Serien forventes sendt i 160 lande fra efteråret 2014.

article_content: Michelle Obama received a heartfelt and culturally vibrant welcome when she arrived in Botswana during her goodwill tour of Africa. Twenty-five young people, ages 6 to 18, dressed in animal hide outfits with ankle shells, greeted her with spirited songs and dances, chanting 'Obama Ye-Le-Le.' Alongside Mrs. Obama were her daughters Malia and Sasha, her mother Marian Robinson, and other family members, all warmly participating as another group of 50 children waved U.S. and Botswana flags. Upon her arrival in Gaborone, Mrs. Obama visited a Baylor University-supported clinic that serves 4,000 children and their families. At the Botswana-Baylor Adolescent Center of Excellence, which works on pediatric AIDS, she and her family joined Teen Club members—youths affected by HIV—in painting a mural, with Mrs. Obama contributing a bright sun as part of the scene. Mrs. Obama later attended a women's leadership luncheon, where she praised Botswana as a thriving democracy with a booming economy and spoke of its promising vision for Africa. She also met with President Ian Khama, and the Obama family planned a dinner at a wildlife-filled nature park. This journey is Mrs. Obama’s first overseas trip alone without President Obama, focusing on promoting health, wellness, and AIDS prevention. At a student forum in Cape Town, South Africa, she discussed her role as the first African American First Lady, expressing her sense of great responsibility and her desire to make a positive impact, despite not originally seeking a public role. Throughout her visit, Mrs. Obama emphasized health advocacy and youth support, making a meaningful impression in each community she visited.
translated_content: Michelle Obama blev mødt af en varm og farverig velkomst, da hun ankom til Botswana på sin goodwill-rejse i Afrika. Femogtyve unge i alderen 6 til 18 år, klædt i dyreskind og med skaller om anklerne, bød hende velkommen med livlige sange og danse og råbte 'Obama Ye-Le-Le.' Sammen med fru Obama var hendes døtre Malia og Sasha, hendes mor Marian Robinson og andre familiemedlemmer. De deltog alle i den hjertelige modtagelse, mens yderligere 50 børn vinkede med amerikanske og botswanske flag. Efter ankomsten til Gaborone besøgte fru Obama en klinik støttet af Baylor University, der hjælper 4.000 børn og deres familier. På Botswana-Baylor Adolescent Center of Excellence, som arbejder med pædiatrisk AIDS, deltog hun og familien sammen med medlemmer af Teen Club—unge berørt af HIV—i at male et vægmaleri, hvor fru Obama malede en sol som en del af billedet. Fru Obama deltog senere i en frokost om kvindeligt lederskab, hvor hun roste Botswana som et blomstrende demokrati med en voksende økonomi og talte om landets vision for Afrika. Hun mødtes også med præsident Ian Khama, og Obama-familien planlagde at spise middag i en naturpark blandt vilde dyr. Rejsen er fru Obamas første udlandsrejse uden præsident Obama, med fokus på sundhed, trivsel og især forebyggelse af AIDS. Ved et forum for studerende i Cape Town, Sydafrika, talte hun åbent om sin rolle som USA’s første afroamerikanske førstedame og udtrykte sin følelse af stort ansvar og ønsket om at gøre en positiv forskel, selvom hun oprindeligt ikke ønskede en offentlig rolle. The UEFA Champions League returns this season, bringing excitement about emerging young stars. CNN consulted one of Europe’s leading scouting experts, Tor-Kristian Karlsen, who selected five young players to watch in this year’s competition. Think he missed someone? Share your picks with him on Twitter.

Alen Halilovic: The Barcelona attacking midfielder, a Croatian international, made his full international debut at 16. Currently with Barcelona B, Halilovic is anticipated to break into the first team this season.

Hakan Çalhanoglu: A 20-year-old German-born Turkish international attacking midfielder, Çalhanoglu joined Bayer Leverkusen for €14.5 million in July. Famous for his set-piece skills, he is already making an impact at his new club.

Ruben Neves: At just 17, the Portuguese central midfielder plays for FC Porto. Neves became the club’s youngest ever goal scorer after finding the net in the season opener. His vision and passing are highly praised.

Kingsley Coman: French attacking midfielder Coman, 18, was acquired by Juventus after leaving Paris Saint-Germain. Known for his speed and technical ability, his dynamic runs from midfield are tough for opponents.

Lucas Ocampos: The 20-year-old Argentine forward from Monaco boasts strength, skill, and versatility—capable of playing on both wings or as a floating forward. Ocampos is regarded as close to breaking into Argentina’s national team.

Who will lift the trophy on June 6 in Berlin? CNN sports journalists offered their views:

John Sinnott predicts Bayern Munich, citing coach Pep Guardiola and the squad’s depth—highlighting Xabi Alonso’s signing as crucial.

Tom McGowan favors Barcelona, emphasizing the attacking trio of Messi, Neymar, and newcomer Luis Suarez, with support from midfielders Iniesta and Rakitic.

James Masters backs Chelsea, crediting manager Jose Mourinho and the arrival of Diego Costa, whose prolific scoring has boosted the team.

Alex Thomas selects Real Madrid, praising the offensive additions of Toni Kroos and James Rodriguez, and recalling the club’s ability to win despite defensive shortcomings.

Who’s your pick to win the Champions League? Tweet @CNNFC or comment on our Facebook page.

article_content:
The recent attention on political campaigns demanding to approve quotes before publication has stirred debate about journalistic integrity. Known as 'quote approval,' this method allows staff from campaigns like Barack Obama’s and Mitt Romney’s to edit or sanitize statements before they appear in the press, according to The New York Times. What began as an uncommon practice reserved for senior aides seeking accuracy in complicated stories has now become regular across Washington, the campaign trail, and within the White House.

A decade ago, such requests were considered outlandish, and journalists typically relied on their professional judgment without granting officials the right to alter their words. Veteran reporter Peter Baker from The New York Times explained that quote approval initially helped transform background comments into attributable, on-the-record quotes when editors discouraged the use of unnamed sources. While it made sense for certain senior officials handling sensitive topics, reporters eventually started submitting sentences for approval—leading to wider adoption of the practice.

This approach has expanded far past its original intent, with many aides using quote approval to control messaging and avoid awkward missteps, rather than purely to ensure accuracy. Reporters often agree to these conditions, turning over editorial power to officials. Ron Fournier, editor-in-chief of National Journal, has rejected the practice for his newsroom, asserting that public officials should not shape press coverage. The relationship between sources and reporters has always involved negotiation, but giving sources excessive veto power undermines journalistic autonomy.

Ari Fleischer, a former press secretary, argues that quote approval is now overused and poses risks to press freedom. While both government and media play roles in shaping stories and sometimes reinforce focus on less critical issues, sources seeking quote approval often do so to avoid mishandling or distortions. Yet if journalists keep accepting these terms, they risk further ceding influence to those they cover.

Den nylige debat om politiske kampagner, der kræver godkendelse af citater inden offentliggørelse, har sat fokus på journalistisk integritet. 'Citategodkendelse' betyder, at medarbejdere fra kampagner som Barack Obamas og Mitt Romneys får mulighed for at redigere eller filtrere udtalelser, før de udgives, ifølge The New York Times. Det, der startede som en usædvanlig praksis forbeholdt højtstående medarbejdere for at sikre nøjagtighed i komplekse historier, er nu blevet udbredt både i Washington, under valgkampagner og i Det Hvide Hus.

For ti år siden blev sådanne krav anset for absurde, og journalister stolede som regel på deres egen dømmekraft uden at lade embedsmænd redigere deres udtalelser. Den rutinerede reporter Peter Baker fra The New York Times forklarede, at citategodkendelse først blev brugt som et redskab til at lave baggrundsudtalelser om til citater, der kunne tilskrives navngivne personer, når redaktører ikke ønskede anonyme kilder. Selvom det gav mening for enkelte højtstående embedsmænd, begyndte journalister efterhånden at sende sætninger til godkendelse — og det fik praksissen til at sprede sig.

Praksissen er nu udvidet langt ud over dets oprindelige formål. Mange medarbejdere bruger citategodkendelse til at styre historier eller undgå pinlige situationer i stedet for blot at sikre nøjagtighed. Journalister går ofte med på disse vilkår og overlader dermed redaktionel kontrol til embedsmænd. Ron Fournier, chefredaktør for National Journal, har forbudt praksissen i sit medie og understreger, at offentlige kilder ikke bør styre pressens dækning. Forholdet mellem kilder og presse har altid været præget af forhandling, men når kilder får for meget magt, risikerer det at underminere pressens uafhængighed.

Ari Fleischer, tidligere pressesekretær, mener, at citategodkendelse nu bliver overbrugt og udgør en trussel mod pressens frihed. Selvom både myndigheder og medier er med til at forme historierne – og til tider fokuserer på uvæsentlige emner – ønsker kilder ofte citategodkendelse for at undgå fejlfortolkning eller fordrejning. Men hvis journalisterne fortsætter med at acceptere disse krav, risikerer de at miste mere indflydelse til de personer, de dækker.

article_content: State elections have begun in two Indian states, marking a significant test for the opposition as they challenge Prime Minister Narendra Modi's ruling Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) ahead of the 2024 national elections. Voters in Chhattisgarh and Mizoram went to the polls on Tuesday, with three more states—Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, and Telangana—set to hold elections in the coming weeks. The results, scheduled to be announced on December 3, are expected to provide insight into voter sentiment before the nationwide elections, where Modi seeks a third consecutive term as Prime Minister. The Indian National Congress, the main opposition party, currently governs Rajasthan and Chhattisgarh, while the BJP is in power in Madhya Pradesh and its regional ally leads in Mizoram. Telangana is led by a strong regional party. Congress also spearheads the INDIA alliance—a coalition seeking to challenge Modi's growing influence—consisting of several previously divided opposition parties. Throughout an energetic campaign, both Modi and Congress leader Rahul Gandhi have traveled across the five states, pledging subsidies, loan waivers, and job guarantees to attract voters. National surveys suggest Modi and the BJP remain popular, with expectations of a third term. However, the BJP faces tough contests in these states, where issues such as unemployment and inflation are likely to influence voter decisions. Congress hopes to revive its fortunes by announcing welfare initiatives for women and farmers in states where it faces direct competition with the BJP. These local polls will test the INDIA alliance's effectiveness after its formation in July aimed at unifying opposition efforts. While Modi has expanded the BJP's reach over his nine years in power, the party has encountered challenges in states with strong regional parties. Recent state elections have seen Congress defeat the BJP in Karnataka and Himachal Pradesh, casting doubt on the ruling party's dominance. Modi seeks reelection amid India's growing diplomatic influence, but his time in office has also seen economic difficulties, rising unemployment, and concerns about the treatment of minorities and press freedoms.
