Vælgere i Chhattisgarh og Mizoram har stemt tirsdag, og tre flere stater – Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan og Telangana – skal stemme i de kommende uger. Resultaterne forventes offentliggjort den 3. december og ventes at give indsigt i vælgernes holdning før landsdækkende valg, hvor Modi søger en tredje periode som premierminister. Det indiske nationale kongresparti, hovedoppositionspartiet, styrer i øjeblikket Rajasthan og Chhattisgarh, mens BJP regerer i Madhya Pradesh og dets regionale allierede leder i Mizoram. Telangana ledes af et stærkt regionalt parti. Kongressen står også i spidsen for INDIA-alliance – en koalition, der søger at udfordre Modis voksende indflydelse – bestående af flere tidligere splittede oppositionspartier. Modi og kongreslederen Rahul Gandhi har under en energisk valgkamp rejst rundt i de fem stater og lovet subsidier, gældssanering og jobgarantier for at tiltrække vælgere. Nationale målinger antyder, at Modi og BJP stadig er populære, og der forventes en tredje periode. Alligevel står BJP over for hårde kampe i disse delstater, hvor emner som arbejdsløshed og inflation sandsynligvis vil påvirke vælgernes beslutninger. Kongressen håber at genoplive sin position via velfærdsinitiativer for kvinder og landmænd i stater, hvor den er i direkte konkurrence med BJP. Disse lokale valg vil teste INDIA-alliansens styrke efter dens dannelse i juli med det formål at forene oppositionen. Selvom Modi har udvidet BJPs rækkevidde gennem sine ni år ved magten, har partiet mødt udfordringer i stater med stærke regionale partier. Ved nylige delstatsvalg har Kongressen besejret BJP i Karnataka og Himachal Pradesh, hvilket har rejst tvivl om det regerende partis dominans. Modi søger genvalg samtidig med, at Indiens diplomatiske indflydelse vokser, men hans embedsperiode har også været præget af økonomiske vanskeligheder, stigende arbejdsløshed og bekymring for mindretal og pressefrihed.

article_content: An 18-month-old boy is being called a 'miracle baby' after surviving a tragic highway rollover crash that claimed the life of his mother and seriously injured another passenger. Riley, securely fastened in a safety seat in the center of the backseat, survived with only minor scrapes after the vehicle, driven by his 21-year-old mother Lindsey Michelle Woods, lost control and veered off Interstate 8 in Alpine, San Diego, on Wednesday evening. The Jeep rolled down a 150-foot embankment, resulting in Woods's death and leaving a 21-year-old male passenger with life-threatening injuries. According to witness Terry Ulmer, Riley appeared calm, healthy, and responsive at the scene. Lindsey's brother, Jonny DeWitt, credited the safety seat with saving his nephew's life and hopes the story serves as a warning about proper car seat use. He described his sister as a devoted single mother who turned her life around for Riley, ensuring he was always cared for and loved. Family members are now caring for Riley. According to the California Highway Patrol, the crash happened at around 5:30 p.m. while Woods was driving eastbound on I-8 at high speed. As she approached a slower vehicle, she braked suddenly and lost control, causing the vehicle to slide down the embankment and trap all occupants. Woods died at the scene, while the male passenger was airlifted to Sharp Memorial Hospital with major injuries. Officials say excessive speed caused the accident, and there is no evidence that drugs or alcohol were involved. The crash remains under investigation.

Riley, som var forsvarligt fastspændt i et barnesæde i midten af bagsædet, slap kun med mindre skrammer, efter at bilen, ført af hans 21-årige mor Lindsey Michelle Woods, mistede kontrollen og kørte af Interstate 8 i Alpine, San Diego onsdag aften. Ifølge California Highway Patrol indtraf ulykken omkring klokken 17.30, mens Woods kørte østpå ad I-8 med høj hastighed. Da hun nærmede sig et langsommere køretøj, bremsede hun pludseligt og mistede kontrollen, hvilket fik bilen til at glide ned ad skrænten og fange alle i bilen. article_content: Heritage Auctions is offering the original black-and-white artwork from Rob Liefeld’s 1996 'Heroes Reborn' Captain America cover—a piece well known for its strikingly exaggerated depiction of the superhero’s chest. While the anatomy in the illustration has become a popular topic for both critique and humor, it’s also cemented itself as a key artifact in the history of American comics, inspiring countless memes and online discussions. Rob Liefeld, a major name in comics for over three decades, created this work upon his high-profile return to Marvel after founding Image Comics. The signed artwork combines ink and graphite on a 9.5 by 15.25 inch Image Bristol board, showing minor edge wear and some touch-ups but remaining in excellent condition. The auction begins with a starting bid of $8,250.

Selvom anatomien ofte har været brugt til humor og kritik, er illustrationen også blevet et ikonisk samlerobjekt i amerikansk tegneseriehistorie og har inspireret et hav af memes og online debatter. Rob Liefeld, der har været en markant figur i tegneseriebranchen i mere end 30 år, lavede dette kunstværk, da han vendte tilbage til Marvel efter at have grundlagt Image Comics. Værket er signeret, udført i blæk og grafit på et Image Bristol-papir på 9,5 x 15,25 tommer, og det har mindre brugsspor og rettelser, men er stadig i fremragende stand. Auktionen starter med et bud på 8.250 dollars.

article_content: Angela Howarth has shown remarkable dedication to Ipswich Town, attending games at 90 different stadiums since she first started supporting the club in 1975. Her loyalty has led her across the UK and Europe, including trips to Russia, Italy, and the Netherlands to follow her team. Supporting Ipswich also shaped Angela’s personal life—she met her husband, Simon Stanmore, in the away section at a Millwall match in 1987. Her passion began at a UEFA Cup tie at Portman Road, watching Sir Bobby Robson's team defeat Feyenoord. Early on, she’d accompany her father to matches in the Churchman’s stand, now named after Sir Alf Ramsey. One of Angela’s favorite memories is attending the 1978 FA Cup semi-final at Highbury, a highlight among her many years following Ipswich. Angela’s adventures haven't all been smooth—she has navigated muddy pitches in Bracknell and witnessed Russian soldiers escorting fans during a 2001 away game versus Torpedo Moscow, noting that the visiting fans behaved impeccably despite the military presence. Beyond the UK, she has watched Ipswich play at iconic venues such as Inter Milan, Helsingborg, and Ajax. Among domestic grounds, she’s especially fond of trips to Newcastle and Sunderland but found Anfield's famous Kop less impressive than expected. Most of the time, Angela attends matches with Simon, her husband, their story beginning after a chance meeting at a Millwall game. Subsequently, they met again at Hull, and their relationship grew from there. Now living in Colchester and working full-time as a teacher, Angela is eager for Ipswich Town’s promotion to the Premier League so she can visit more top-flight stadiums. She’s optimistic about the club’s prospects, counting on their strong squad, manager Kieran McKenna, and loyal supporters. Angela hopes to reach the milestone of 100 stadiums in the near future, all while proudly flying her Ipswich banner.

Støtten til Ipswich har også haft stor betydning for Angelas privatliv, da hun mødte sin mand Simon Stanmore i udebaneafsnittet til en Millwall-kamp i 1987. Hendes fodboldglæde opstod til en UEFA Cup-kamp på Portman Road, hvor Sir Bobby Robsons hold slog Feyenoord. Dengang fulgte hun sin far til kampe på Churchman’s-tribunen, som i dag hedder Sir Alf Ramsey-tribunen. Et af Angelas absolutte højdepunkt var FA Cup-semifinalen på Highbury i 1978 – en uforglemmelig oplevelse blandt mange i hendes lange Ipswich-fankarriere. Der har dog også været udfordringer. article_content: Smartphones have become essential in daily life, replacing devices like televisions and game consoles. However, some analysts warn that consumers may be growing weary of the frequent need to upgrade their smartphones, predicting that sales growth will drop significantly. According to the market research firm IDC, growth in global smartphone shipments is expected to decline sharply in 2014 and continue slowing through 2018. Meanwhile, average prices are projected to fall as demand shifts toward China and other developing countries. In 2014, annual smartphone sales growth is predicted to be 19.3%, dropping to just 6.2% by 2018, according to IDC. This follows a notable 39.2% surge in 2013, when global smartphone shipments surpassed 1 billion units for the first time. IDC's report indicates that Android will continue to dominate as the leading mobile operating system, with iOS maintaining a firm second place. Apple is expected to keep focusing on the high-end market with its latest devices. Windows Phone could experience the fastest growth among leading smartphone operating systems, supported by Nokia and new partners. BlackBerry will face stiff competition, and its relatively high prices may limit its growth potential. Wall Street concerns are mounting that the smartphone boom, which began with Apple's iPhone launch in 2007, is slowing down, especially in the U.S. and other developed markets favoring premium devices. IDC expects smartphone growth in North America and Europe to fall to single digits, with Japan potentially seeing a slight decline in shipments over the next few years. Manufacturers are now turning their attention to China, where many consumers are upgrading from basic cellphones to smartphones priced under $300. Ryan Reith, an IDC analyst, stated: 'In North America, over 200 million smartphones are in active use, not counting feature phones. 2014 will be a significant year of transition for the smartphone market. Not only will growth slow more than ever before, but the fundamental drivers of smartphone adoption are changing. Emerging markets come with different dynamics, and 'premium' devices will not be the main growth factor in these regions.' Last year, the average selling price for smartphones was $335, well below flagship models like the iPhone 5S or Samsung Galaxy S4, and this is expected to decrease to $260 by 2018. Ramon Llamas, Research Manager at IDC, commented: 'To meet the demand in emerging markets, carriers and manufacturers must collaborate to lower prices. In the past year, 322.5 million smartphones sold for under $150—a figure set to grow. We're already seeing announcements of smartphones at prices as low as $25. As growth dynamics change, so too do pricing strategies in markets where expansion continues. Not every brand will compete in this segment, but those that do must carefully plan to succeed.'

Men nogle analytikere advarer nu om, at forbrugere måske er trætte af hele tiden at skulle opgradere deres smartphones, og forudser at væksten i salget vil falde markant. Ifølge markedsanalysefirmaet IDC forventes væksten i globale smartphone-forsendelser at falde kraftigt i 2014 og fortsætte med at falde frem til 2018. Samtidigt forventes gennemsnitspriserne at falde, efterhånden som efterspørgslen flytter mod Kina og andre udviklingslande. I 2014 er den årlige vækst i smartphone-salget forudsagt til at være 19,3 %, og denne vil falde til kun 6,2 % i 2018, ifølge IDC. Dette følger efter en bemærkelsesværdig stigning på 39,2 % i 2013, hvor de globale smartphone-forsendelser for første gang oversteg 1 milliard enheder. IDCs rapport viser, at Android fortsat vil dominere som det førende mobile styresystem, mens iOS fastholder en solid andenplads. Det forventes, at Apple fortsat vil fokusere på det dyre marked med deres nyeste enheder. Windows Phone kan opleve den hurtigste vækst blandt de ledende styresystemer, støttet af Nokia og nye partnere. BlackBerry vil stå over for hård konkurrence, og de relativt høje priser kan begrænse dets vækstpotentiale. Bekymringerne vokser på Wall Street om, at smartphone-boomet, der begyndte med Apples lancering af iPhone i 2007, er ved at aftage – især i USA og andre udviklede markeder, der foretrækker premium-enheder. IDC forventer, at smartphone-væksten i Nordamerika og Europa vil falde til etcifrede tal, mens Japan muligvis vil opleve et lille fald i forsendelser de næste år. Producenterne retter nu opmærksomheden mod Kina, hvor mange forbrugere opgraderer fra almindelige mobiltelefoner til smartphones til under 2.000 kroner. Ryan Reith, en IDC-analytiker, udtalte: 'I Nordamerika er der over 200 millioner smartphones i aktiv brug, uden at tælle almindelige mobiltelefoner. 2014 bliver et markant overgangsår for smartphone-markedet. Ikke alene vil væksten bremse mere end nogensinde før, men også de grundlæggende drivkræfter for smartphone-udbredelsen ændrer sig. Nye markeder har andre dynamikker, og 'premium'-enheder vil ikke være hovedfaktoren for vækst i disse regioner.' Sidste år var den gennemsnitlige salgspris for smartphones 335 dollar, langt under topmodeller som iPhone 5S eller Samsung Galaxy S4, og dette forventes at falde til 260 dollar i 2018. Ramon Llamas, forskningschef hos IDC, sagde: 'For at opfylde efterspørgslen i nye markeder må teleselskaber og producenter samarbejde for at sænke priserne. Sidste år blev 322,5 millioner smartphones solgt for under 150 dollar – et tal, der forventes at stige. Vi har allerede set annonceringer af smartphones til priser helt ned til 25 dollar. Når vækstdynamikkerne ændrer sig, gælder det samme for prisstrategier på de markeder, hvor væksten fortsætter. Ikke alle mærker ønsker at konkurrere i dette segment, men de, der gør, skal planlægge nøje for at lykkes.'

article_content: Early on Saturday, U.S. warplanes launched strikes near the Mosul Dam in northern Iraq, targeting ISIS strongholds. Kurdish sources and CNN confirmed that this was part of a joint operation to reclaim Iraq’s main hydroelectric facility, with Iraqi and Kurdish forces preparing to follow up on the ground. The Mosul Dam, situated on the Tigris River about 50 kilometers from Mosul, is vital for water and electricity supplies. ISIS has held the dam since earlier this month after fierce fighting, raising worries about deliberate sabotage or flooding. Coinciding with these military actions, the UN Security Council approved a unanimous resolution to curb ISIS funding, sanctioning six individuals linked to the group’s financial support. The resolution calls for restricting the flow of arms and money to ISIS and hints at further military action but does not explicitly authorize it. On Friday, officials reported that ISIS militants attacked the Yazidi village of Kojo, killing at least 80 men and abducting over 100 women. The captives were reportedly taken to ISIS-controlled Mosul and Tal Afar. CNN notes these claims align with prior survivor reports but has not independently verified them. The Yazidis, an ancient religious minority in Iraq, are among those heavily affected by ISIS’s advance. The United Nations estimates that over 400,000 people—mainly minorities—have been displaced since June, with at least 200,000 seeking refuge in Dohuk province. U.S. airstrikes near Sinjar continued to support groups at risk from ISIS. The U.S. military reported destroying two ISIS vehicles after Kurdish requests for support following further attacks on Kojo. In response to the violence, the European Union held an emergency meeting, with several nations considering sending arms to Kurdish forces. EU leaders supported U.S. humanitarian efforts and acknowledged requests for military aid from the Kurds. Attention has turned to Haider al-Abadi, Iraq’s new prime minister-designate, recently endorsed by outgoing leader Nuri al-Maliki. Many hope al-Abadi can unify Iraq’s diverse groups to resist ISIS. Aid operations, airdrops, and the evacuation of civilians from the Sinjar Mountains have helped some, but refugee camps inside and outside Iraq remain overcrowded as minorities seek safety. Reporting contributed by Anna Coren (Zahko, Iraq), Chelsea J. Carter (Atlanta), Richard Roth, and Hamdi Alkhshali.

Mosul-dæmningen, der ligger ved Tigris-floden cirka 50 kilometer fra Mosul, er afgørende for vandforsyning og elektricitet. ISIS har kontrolleret dæmningen siden begyndelsen af denne måned efter voldsomme kampe, hvilket har vækket bekymring for bevidst ødelæggelse eller oversvømmelser. Samtidig godkendte FN’s Sikkerhedsråd enstemmigt en resolution, der skal begrænse ISIS’s finansiering, og sanktionerede seks personer, der er tilknyttet gruppens økonomiske netværk. Resolutionen opfordrer til at standse våben og penge til ISIS og nævner mulig yderligere militær handling, uden dog at give direkte lov til det. De tilfangetagne blev angiveligt ført til ISIS-styrede Mosul og Tal Afar. Amerikanske luftangreb nær Sinjar fortsætter med at støtte udsatte grupper mod ISIS. Det amerikanske militær oplyser, at de ødelagde to ISIS-køretøjer efter kurdiske anmodninger om støtte efter yderligere angreb på Kojo. Chloe McCardel, a 29-year-old Australian swimmer, is attempting to become the first person to swim from Cuba to Florida without the protection of a shark cage. She began her 103-mile (166-kilometer) journey across the Florida Straits today—a stretch of water considered the 'Holy Grail' for marathon swimmers.

The only previous successful crossing was by fellow Australian Susie Maroney in 1997. Maroney, age 22 at the time, completed the swim in 25 hours using a shark cage that both protected her and assisted her with ocean currents. Since 2011, four uncaged attempts have failed, including three by American Diana Nyad and one by Australian Penny Palfrey. Altogether, McCardel noted, 20 people have previously tried and failed to make it across without a cage.

'It's the hardest marathon swim in the world,' McCardel told reporters at a press conference at the Hemingway Marina in Havana the day before her attempt. 'This is like winning the Soccer World Cup, setting a world record, or winning an Olympic gold medal—but it might be even tougher, since no one has managed to do it.'

McCardel, who works as a first aid trainer in Melbourne, trains year-round and has accomplished two double-crossings of the English Channel. For this swim, she is following English Channel marathon rules, which means she cannot touch any support boats during the estimated 60-hour journey that she hopes will finish in Key West, Florida.

Her main obstacles are physical and environmental: extreme fatigue, poisonous jellyfish, sharks, Portuguese man o' war, high waves, and the strong, unpredictable Gulf Stream current. McCardel and her husband, Paul, analyzed past attempts in-depth, using scientific approaches to increase her chances of success. Her swim is timed for a period when the highly venomous box jellyfish are less common and during a new moon phase, which reduces moonlight that tends to attract jellyfish to the water’s surface.

To deter sharks, she will rely on an underwater electromagnetic field. Her support crew of 50 includes U.S.-based scientists who are Gulf Stream experts. They will use computer models to help the accompanying boat 'Sunluver', a 44-foot (13-meter) catamaran, avoid perilous currents that have foiled previous swimmers. 'We can anticipate 10 to 30 kilometers ahead and, if possible, adjust our course to avoid getting caught in a Gulf Stream eddy pushing us off track,' said McCardel.

Beyond seeking to earn a sporting milestone, McCardel aims to raise funds for cancer research and support cancer patients—donations can be made through her website www.chloemccardel.com. She also hopes her swim will inspire improved relations between the United States and Cuba, countries whose political tension has persisted for more than 50 years despite their proximity.
translated_content:
Den 29-årige australske svømmer Chloe McCardel forsøger at blive den første person, der svømmer fra Cuba til Florida uden brug af hajbur. Hun begyndte i dag sin 166 kilometer lange tur over Florida-strædet – en strækning kendt som 'den hellige gral' blandt maratonsvømmere.

Den eneste succesfulde krydsning hidtil blev gennemført af landsmanden Susie Maroney i 1997. Maroney, der var 22 år gammel på det tidspunkt, gennemførte turen på 25 timer med et hajbur, som både beskyttede hende og hjalp hende med havstrømmene. Siden 2011 er fire forsøg uden bur mislykkedes, herunder tre fra amerikanske Diana Nyad og et fra australske Penny Palfrey. Ifølge McCardel har i alt 20 personer før prøvet og fejlet uden bur.

“Det er verdens hårdeste maratonsvømning,” sagde McCardel til journalister på en pressekonference i Hemingway Marina i Havana dagen før hendes forsøg. “Det svarer til at vinde VM i fodbold, sætte verdensrekord eller vinde en OL-guldmedalje – men det kan være endnu sværere, fordi ingen er lykkedes med det endnu.”

McCardel arbejder som førstehjælpsinstruktør i Melbourne, træner 50 uger om året og har tidligere gennemført to dobbeltkrydsninger af Den Engelske Kanal. Under denne svømmetur følger hun reglerne for Engelske Kanal-maratoner – hun må ikke røre nogen af de både, der ledsager hende på den anslåede 60 timer lange tur, hun håber afsluttes i Key West, Florida.

Hendes største udfordringer er både fysisk og miljømæssigt: ekstrem træthed, giftige brandmænd, hajer, portugisiske orlogsmand, høje bølger samt den stærke og uforudsigelige Golfstrøm. McCardel og hendes mand, Paul, har analyseret tidligere forsøg grundigt og taget videnskabelige metoder i brug for at øge chancerne for succes. Svømmeturen er planlagt til en periode, hvor de giftige box jellyfish er færre, og der er nymåne, hvilket betyder mindre måneskin og færre brandmænd ved overfladen.

For at holde hajer væk bliver et elektromagnetisk felt anvendt under vandet. Hendes støttehold på 50 personer inkluderer amerikanske forskere med ekspertise i Golfstrømmen. De bruger computermodeller til at hjælpe følgebåden 'Sunluver', en 13 meter lang katamaran, så de kan undgå farlige strømme, der tidligere har forpurret svømmeture. “Vi kan forudse 10 til 30 kilometer frem, og om muligt justere vores rute for at undgå at blive fanget i Golfstrømmens hvirvler,” udtalte McCardel.

Ud over det sportslige mål vil McCardel samle ind til kræftforskning og støtte kræftramte – donationer kan gives via hendes hjemmeside www.chloemccardel.com. Hun håber også, at hendes svømmetur kan inspirere til bedre relationer mellem USA og Cuba, to nabolande med over 50 års politiske spændinger.

Three main types of EV charging exist:
- Level 1 (120V): Slow charging, primarily for overnight home use.
- Level 2 (240V): Moderate charging, commonly available at workplaces and public locations.
- DC Fast Chargers: High-speed charging, suitable for quick top-ups during longer journeys.

Innovative platforms like GRID are central to the future of EV charging. GRID streamlines the charging experience, making it easier for drivers to locate and access charging stations. As electric vehicles become an essential part of daily life, services like GRID will remain crucial in supporting the shift to greener transportation and building a more sustainable future.

article_content: Ammie Fearon, a 26-year-old from Chelmsley Wood, Birmingham, is seeking legal redress from the NHS after enduring the stillbirth of her daughter, Lily-Ella, which she attributes to a series of medical oversights. In April 2012, while 39 weeks pregnant, Fearon's midwife grew concerned about her baby's lack of growth and arranged an emergency scan at Birmingham Heartlands Hospital. When Fearon arrived, locum consultant Dr. James Davis informed her there were no ultrasound appointments available. After an examination, he decided a scan wasn't necessary. Only four days later, a GP discovered that Lily-Ella had died in the womb. Fearon then underwent a traumatic labor and gave birth to her stillborn daughter on April 26, 2012. An investigation by the Heart of England NHS Foundation Trust highlighted six major failings, including the lack of a scan referral, insufficient staff training, and poor communication among staff. Fearon believes that rapid intervention could have prevented her baby's death. She said, 'I know Lily could have been saved if the problems had been found sooner.' She detailed the grief she suffered, describing the experience as something no one should face. Fearon also described additional distress, such as a locum consultant mistakenly congratulating her while she was in the bereavement ward, which she saw as another example of inadequate staff training. Later, during her next pregnancy, similar concerns about the baby's growth arose. This time, a scan revealed her second daughter, Macie, was in distress, prompting an emergency Caesarean. Although born six weeks early, Macie recovered well after time in the neonatal unit. Fearon noted the improved level of care during her second pregnancy and suspected it was due to recognition of prior mistakes. The Heart of England NHS Foundation Trust apologized for the standard of care but refuted claims of negligence. Joy Payne, the Trust’s head of midwifery, offered condolences, emphasized the seriousness with which the matter was treated, and invited Fearon to discuss her care further.

I april 2012, da hun var 39 uger gravid, blev hendes jordemoder bekymret for barnets manglende vækst og arrangerede en akut scanning på Birmingham Heartlands Hospital. Da Fearon ankom, oplyste vikarierende overlæge Dr. James Davis, at der ikke var ledige scanningstider. Efter en undersøgelse afviste han, at en scanning var nødvendig. Kun fire dage senere konstaterede en praktiserende læge, at Lily-Ella var død i livmoderen. Fearon måtte gennemgå en traumatisk fødsel og fødte sin døde datter den 26. april 2012. En undersøgelse fra Heart of England NHS Foundation Trust identificerede seks alvorlige svigt, herunder manglende scanning, utilstrækkelig personaleuddannelse og dårlig kommunikation. Fearon mener, at hurtig handling kunne have reddet hendes baby. Hun udtalte: 'Jeg ved, Lily kunne være blevet reddet, hvis problemerne var blevet opdaget tidligere.' Hun beskrev sorgen og sagde, at det var en oplevelse, ingen burde gennemgå. Fearon beskrev også ekstra stress, såsom da en vikarierende læge fejlagtigt lykønskede hende, mens hun var på sorgafsnittet – et eksempel på mangelfuld personaleuddannelse. Under sin næste graviditet opstod lignende bekymringer om barnets vækst. Denne gang viste en scanning, at hendes anden datter, Macie, var i nød, hvilket førte til et akut kejsersnit. Selvom Macie kom seks uger for tidligt, kom hun sig fint efter neonatalpleje. Fearon oplevede væsentligt bedre omsorg under sin anden graviditet og tror, det skyldtes erkendelse af tidligere fejl. Heart of England NHS Foundation Trust har undskyldt for plejen, men afviser ansvar for forsømmelighed. Joy Payne, leder for jordemødre i Trusten, udtrykte medfølelse og tilbød Fearon en samtale om sagen.

A new study from the University of Plymouth reveals that a commonly used hospital chlorine disinfectant fails to kill spores of Clostridioides difficile (C. diff), the leading cause of antibiotic-associated illness in healthcare environments worldwide. Research demonstrates that even high concentrations of chlorine bleach—often used to clean hospital scrubs and surfaces—are no more effective at destroying C. diff spores than plain water.

Published in the journal Microbiology, the study raises concerns that patients and healthcare workers may be exposed to C. diff, a bacterium responsible for diarrhea, colitis, and other serious bowel complications. Globally, C. diff infects millions of people each year, causing about 29,000 deaths in the United States and nearly 8,500 in Europe annually. Incidence in the UK was increasing before the COVID-19 pandemic, according to recent data.

The research team, led by Dr. Tina Joshi—Associate Professor in Molecular Microbiology—and medical student Humaira Ahmed, tested three strains of C. diff against three different concentrations of sodium hypochlorite, a type of chlorine disinfectant. Spores were applied to surgical scrubs and patient gowns, then examined with scanning electron microscopes to observe any structural changes. Results showed the chemical had little effect on the spores’ resilience.

Dr. Joshi, also a member of the Microbiology Society Council, emphasized the urgent need for more effective disinfectants and practical infection control guidelines, especially amid rising antimicrobial resistance (AMR). She stated that understanding how C. diff spores and disinfectants interact is crucial for managing infections and mitigating infection rates in healthcare settings.

The authors call for further research to develop alternative disinfection methods that can break the cycle of transmission, underscoring that tackling biocide tolerance is more pressing than ever in the face of growing AMR globally.

Forskningen viser, at selv høje koncentrationer af klorblegemiddel – ofte brugt til at rengøre hospitalskitler og overflader – ikke er mere effektive mod C. diff-sporer end almindeligt vand.

Studiet, offentliggjort i tidsskriftet Microbiology, vækker bekymring for, at patienter og sundhedspersonale risikerer at blive udsat for C. diff – en bakterie, der forårsager diarré, colitis og andre alvorlige tarmkomplikationer. Globalt smitter C. diff millioner årligt og forårsager omkring 29.000 dødsfald i USA og næsten 8.500 i Europa om året. Ifølge de nyeste data steg forekomsten i Storbritannien inden COVID-19-pandemien.

Forskerholdet, ledet af Dr. Tina Joshi – lektor i molekylær mikrobiologi – og medicinstuderende Humaira Ahmed, testede tre C. diff-stammer mod tre forskellige koncentrationer af natriumhypoklorit, en type klordesinfektion. Sporerne blev påført operationskitler og patientkåber og undersøgt med scanning-elektronmikroskop for strukturelle forandringer. Resultaterne viste, at kemikaliet kun havde en begrænset effekt på sporemodstandskraften.

Dr. Joshi, der også er medlem af Microbiology Society Council, understreger det presserende behov for mere effektive desinfektionsmidler og praktiske retningslinjer for infektionskontrol, især i takt med stigende antimikrobiel resistens (AMR). Hun udtaler, at forståelsen af samspillet mellem C. diff-sporer og desinfektionsmidler er afgørende for håndteringen af infektioner og for at reducere smitte i sundhedsvæsenet.

Forfatterne opfordrer til yderligere forskning for at udvikle alternative desinfektionsmetoder, der kan bryde smittekæden, og understreger, at håndtering af biocid-tolerance er vigtigere end nogensinde på grund af den voksende globale AMR-udfordring.

article_content: A deadly shooting unfolded on Monday near Texas A&M University in College Station, Texas, leaving three people dead: Brazos County Constable Brian Bachmann, suspected shooter Thomas Caffall, and civilian Chris Northcliff. Assistant Chief Scott McCollum said Constable Bachmann, 41, was attempting to serve an eviction notice when the gunfire erupted. Shortly after noon, police were alerted to shots fired in the neighborhood, which escalated into an active shooter scene. Authorities identified the gunman as 35-year-old Thomas Caffall, who was killed after exchanging gunfire with police. Bachmann became the sixth law enforcement officer in Texas killed in the line of duty this year. Several others were injured, including Officer Justin Oehlke, who sustained a gunshot wound to the calf, and two more officers with non-life-threatening injuries. A 55-year-old woman was hospitalized and underwent surgery. Texas A&M issued a Code Maroon alert, advising the public to steer clear of the affected area. Caffall’s family, via their attorney, described him as "ill" and expressed heartbreak over the tragedy and the loss. Mayor Nancy Berry paid tribute to Bachmann and first responders, extending sympathy to the families impacted and recognizing the enduring pain they would face. Authorities continue to investigate while the College Station community grieves this tragic event.

Vicepolitimester Scott McCollum oplyste, at constable Bachmann, 41, var ved at aflevere en udsættelsesmeddelelse, da skudepisoden begyndte. Kort efter middag blev politiet tilkaldt på grund af skud i nabolaget, hvilket udviklede sig til en aktiv skudepisode. Myndighederne identificerede gerningsmanden som den 35-årige Thomas Caffall, der blev dræbt efter skududveksling med politiet. Bachmann var den sjette politibetjent, der er blevet dræbt i tjenesten i Texas i år. Flere andre blev såret, blandt andet betjent Justin Oehlke, der blev ramt i læggen, samt to andre politifolk med ikke-livstruende skader. En 55-årig kvinde blev også indlagt og opereret. Texas A&M udsendte en Code Maroon-advarsel og opfordrede offentligheden til at holde sig væk fra det berørte område. Caffalls familie udtalte gennem deres advokat, at han var "syg" og udtrykte stor sorg over tragedien og tabet. Borgmester Nancy Berry hyldede Bachmann og førstehjælperne, udtrykte medfølelse med de berørte familier og anerkendte den langvarige smerte, de vil opleve. Myndighederne fortsætter efterforskningen, mens College Station-samfundet sørger over denne tragiske begivenhed.

article_content: A 5.1 magnitude earthquake hit Ecuador’s Pinchincha province on Tuesday, causing a deadly landslide at a quarry near Quito. About seven miles north of the capital, in the Catequilla area, two employees from a Chinese contractor working for the city were killed and eight more were injured. Three individuals remain missing, as rescue teams search the dust-covered site. The landslide created panic among workers and led to the evacuation of the area. Rescue crews have been retrieving bodies, as families mourn their loved ones. Another landslide to the north engulfed a vehicle, but the driver escaped unharmed. In total, four people died and eight were injured as a result of the earthquake and its consequences. Among the dead was a four-year-old boy in a different part of Quito, who died when sacks of rice fell on him, according to Mayor Mauricio Rodas. Thick dust clouds swept parts of Quito, causing temporary suspension at Tababela airport. Some sections of the Pan-American Highway became impassable, requiring alternative routes. The shallow earthquake, centered roughly 14 miles northeast of Quito at a depth of 4.8 miles, led to at least 44 aftershocks. Emergency crews continue their operations in the affected areas, supporting families and clearing debris. Ecuador’s position on the seismic ‘Ring of Fire’ means earthquakes are a continual threat.

Tre personer er stadig savnet, mens redningshold søger på det støvdækkede område. Jordskreddet medførte panik blandt arbejderne og førte til evakuering af stedet. Redningsmandskab har hentet omkomne, og familier sørger over deres mistede. Et andet jordskred nord for byen opslugte et køretøj, men føreren slap uskadet. I alt omkom fire personer, og otte blev såret som følge af jordskælvet og dets konsekvenser. Blandt de omkomne var en fireårig dreng i en anden del af Quito, som døde, da ris-sække faldt ned over ham, ifølge borgmester Mauricio Rodas. Tykke støvskyer bredte sig over dele af Quito og førte til midlertidig lukning af Tababela lufthavn. Visse dele af Pan-American Highway blev ufremkommelige, hvilket tvang folk til at finde alternative ruter. Det lavtliggende jordskælv, der havde epicenter cirka 14 miles nordøst for Quito i en dybde af 4,8 miles, førte til mindst 44 efterskælv. Redningstjenester arbejder fortsat i de ramte områder med støtte til familier og oprydning. Ecuadors placering på den seismiske ‘Ildring’ betyder, at jordskælv er en konstant risiko.

article_content:
The Karnataka government is planning to set up a fact-checking unit to combat misinformation and disinformation, especially on social media. State information technology minister Priyank Kharge noted that the proposed unit might need help from the central government when false information comes from outside Karnataka or India. Kharge gave the example of misinformation originating in an eastern European country: the state has no authority there and must ask the central government for assistance.

The Information Disorder Tackling Unit (IDTU) will address not only fake news that could disrupt communal harmony but also verify information about government schemes to ensure beneficiaries receive the right information. For instance, Kharge mentioned a video from Andhra Pradesh that falsely claimed to show an incident on a Karnataka bus service for women.

Such misinformation can affect governance and public order, making prompt fact-checking necessary. In October, the state government called for bids to set up teams for fact verification, analytics, and capacity building to run public awareness campaigns.

The observation committee for the unit will include civil society members, academics, public policy experts, media professionals, and government officials, who will decide what content needs to be fact-checked based on its impact. The process will combine traditional evidence gathering with technology like AI and machine learning.

Kharge emphasized that existing laws and guidelines will direct the unit’s work, and not every item identified as misinformation will be removed from social media; actions will follow current regulations.

Statens IT-minister, Priyank Kharge, bemærkede, at den foreslåede enhed muligvis får brug for hjælp fra centralregeringen, når falsk information stammer fra udenfor Karnataka eller Indien. Kharge gav et eksempel på misinformation fra et østeuropæisk land, hvor delstaten ikke har myndighed og derfor må anmode om hjælp fra centralregeringen.

Kharge nævnte for eksempel en video fra Andhra Pradesh, der fejlagtigt blev fremstillet som en hændelse på en gratis busservice for kvinder i Karnataka.

Enhedens observationskomité vil bestå af medlemmer fra civilsamfundet, akademikere, eksperter i offentlig politik, mediefolk og embedsmænd, som vil afgøre, hvilket indhold der skal faktatjekkes baseret på dets indflydelse. article_content: For many people, traveling by car almost guarantees the occasional disagreement among passengers. According to a new survey, the most frequent spark for these disputes is deciding which route to take. Other common causes include driving above the speed limit, resisting the urge to ask for directions when lost, and the noise made by children in the car. The study, jointly conducted by the AA and Populus, surveyed more than 23,000 AA members. Their findings showed that around two-thirds of participants experience arguments during car trips, with those aged 18 to 24 being more prone to quarrels than those over 65. Regionally, drivers in Northern Ireland are most likely to have heated exchanges, whereas the southwest of England is home to the calmest car journeys. Disagreements about the best route topped the list for all age groups, while driving too quickly came next—except among the 35-44 age group, who were most bothered by noisy children. Edmund King, president of the AA, commented: "Long road trips can sometimes become tense. Preparing ahead can help keep the peace."

Andre hyppige årsager er at køre for hurtigt, at lade være med at spørge om vej, når man er faret vild, og larmende børn på bagsædet. Undersøgelsen fra AA og Populus, der har spurgt over 23.000 AA-medlemmer, viser, at ca. to ud af tre oplever diskussioner på køreturen, og at unge mellem 18 og 24 år skændes mest – modsat dem over 65. Regionalt opstår der flest diskussioner på vejene i Nordirland, mens det sydvestlige England har de fredeligste ture. Uenighed om den bedste rute topper listen i alle aldersgrupper, mens høj fart ligger nummer to – undtagen i gruppen 35-44 år, som især slår sig på larmende børn. AA’s præsident, Edmund King, siger: "Længere køreture kan blive spændte. Forberedelse hjælper med at bevare roen."

article_content: Simon Stevens, the new chief executive of NHS England, plans to advocate for the reintroduction of smaller, community-oriented 'cottage hospitals.' He highlights that the UK's focus on large, centralized hospitals has led to impersonal care and subpar hospital performance compared to much of western Europe. Ahead of his upcoming keynote speech, Stevens argues that strengthening local healthcare services—including establishing smaller facilities—could better address healthcare challenges, particularly for the increasing elderly population. He points to successful examples from elsewhere in western Europe, where smaller hospitals serve local communities effectively, as models Britain could learn from. Historically, cottage hospitals provided care close to people’s homes, reducing travel and ensuring more personalized attention. In recent years, most have been replaced by larger general hospitals, justified by efficiency but often criticized for losing the personal touch patients need. Stevens advocates reversing this pattern, urging the NHS to move away from centralization and put more resources into community-based services tailored to an aging society. He criticizes the current emphasis on performance targets—especially those implemented under Labour—for sometimes interfering with actual patient care. Returning to the NHS from a well-paid private sector position in the US, Stevens is accepting a 10% voluntary salary cut from the standard £211,000. He assumes the leadership following difficulties under his predecessor, Sir David Nicholson, who was widely criticized for not taking responsibility for high-profile failings such as the neglect at the Mid Staffordshire NHS trust. According to Stevens, the pressing issue for the NHS is supporting older people, who now constitute about two-thirds of all hospital patients. He condemns the system's lack of dignity and compassion for vulnerable groups and urges a major expansion of local services to help seniors remain at home and prevent unnecessary hospital admissions.

Han fremhæver eksempler fra andre dele af Vesteuropa, hvor mindre hospitaler effektivt betjener lokalsamfundene, som modeller, Storbritannien kunne lære af. Historisk har cottage hospitals leveret pleje tæt på folks hjem, hvilket mindsker behovet for transport og sikrer mere personlig opmærksomhed. I de senere år er de fleste blevet erstattet af større sygehuse, der anses for at være mere effektive, men ofte kritiseres for at mangle den personlige kontakt, som patienterne har brug for. Casey and Sandy Parsons, the adoptive parents of missing North Carolina teenager Erica Parsons, appeared in federal court on Wednesday facing more than 75 charges of fraud. The couple is accused of continuing to collect government benefits on behalf of their adopted niece after she disappeared. Both pleaded not guilty to the charges in Greensboro Federal Court.

Erica Parsons was 13 years old when she was last seen in November 2011, but she was not reported missing until July 2013, when her 20-year-old adoptive brother contacted authorities after a dispute with his parents highlighted Erica's absence. The Parsons claim they sent Erica to live with her 'Nan,' but Erica’s biological mother asserts that no such grandparent exists.

The charges against the Parsons relate specifically to their actions after Erica was last seen, not to her disappearance. Federal prosecutors allege that the Parsons continued to receive several benefits intended for Erica, including a $634 monthly adoption assistance payment, funds for Medicaid, Social Security, and food assistance. The indictment also accuses the Parsons of filing false income tax returns by inventing fictitious dependents.

According to indictments, Erica was home-schooled, had hearing problems, and a learning disability. Casey Parsons faces 76 counts, including theft of government funds, making false statements regarding healthcare matters, and aiding the filing of false tax returns. Sandy Parsons faces 49 counts, including conspiracy to commit offenses against the United States and theft of government funds.

Investigators are still searching for Erica, who remains missing. The Parsons continue to insist they were not concerned for Erica’s safety, believing she was living with 'Nan.' However, it has been confirmed that both of Erica’s biological grandmothers are deceased. Carolyn Parsons, Erica’s biological mother, disputes the Parsons' claims and continues to search for her daughter, who would now be 15. She has said she has not seen Erica since January 2011. A polygraph test found Sandy Parsons was 'strongly deceptive' when questioned about his involvement in Erica’s disappearance. Erica was the niece of the Parsons.

Parret er anklaget for fortsat at have modtaget offentlige ydelser på vegne af deres adopterede niece efter hendes forsvinden. Begge nægtede sig skyldige i anklagerne ved retten i Greensboro.

Ifølge anklageskriftet blev Erica hjemmeundervist og havde høreproblemer samt indlæringsvanskeligheder. article_content: China's healthcare system is once again under scrutiny as a wave of pneumonia cases, particularly affecting children, sweeps through the country. The sudden increase in sick children and reports of widespread clusters of unidentified respiratory illnesses prompted the World Health Organization (WHO) to request more information to alleviate concerns that a new pathogen—similar to Covid-19—might be causing the outbreaks. Chinese officials have stated that the illnesses are due to known pathogens, including mycoplasma pneumoniae, RSV, adenovirus, and influenza. No new pathogens have been detected. Doctors have warned in recent weeks that a rise in 'walking pneumonia' cases, caused by common bacterial infections, was likely. In response to the WHO's request, Chinese health authorities clarified that increased outpatient visits and hospitalizations are a result of the spread of mycoplasma pneumoniae and other respiratory viruses. WHO acknowledged that while the illness levels are unusually high for this time of year, respiratory diseases in winter are common. The organization advised people to wear masks, stay home when unwell, and wash hands regularly, noting there is no need for travel restrictions at this time. Mycoplasma pneumoniae is a type of bacteria that usually causes mild infection with cold-like symptoms. It rarely leads to hospitalization, though coughs can linger for weeks. Young children with developing immune systems are more at risk of complications, which concerns many parents. Local media have reported that major pediatric hospitals in China have been overwhelmed by the surge in sick children, with families sometimes waiting as long as seven hours to see a doctor. Social media has circulated photos showing crowded waiting rooms and children receiving intravenous treatments. Most people recover from these infections on their own or with over-the-counter medicines to relieve symptoms. However, severe cases often require antibiotics. There is concern because China records the world’s highest rates of mycoplasma pneumoniae resistant to macrolide antibiotics like Zithromax. According to Dr. Yin Yudong of Beijing Chaoyang Hospital, up to 60%–70% of adult cases and as many as 80% of pediatric cases are not responsive to these drugs. It remains unclear why China is seeing a significant outbreak of mycoplasma pneumoniae, while the US and much of Europe are experiencing more cases of flu and RSV. Research suggests that previous Covid-19 prevention measures in China kept mycoplasma pneumoniae transmissions low for almost two years, and that lifting these measures may have contributed to the current uptick. Chinese health officials have noted that the increase in cases occurred earlier than usual but emphasized that similar respiratory surges have been reported in other countries following the end of pandemic restrictions. International reports on China’s respiratory illness surge have reminded many of the early days of the Covid-19 pandemic, which began with mysterious pneumonia cases in Wuhan in 2019. However, mycoplasma is a well-known and common germ, unlike Covid-19, and causes periodic outbreaks. Other viruses, like RSV, are also circulating, suggesting that a variety of respiratory pathogens are likely to affect many countries this winter.
translated_content: Kinas sundhedsvæsen er igen under pres, da en bølge af lungebetændelsestilfælde, især blandt børn, skyller ind over landet. Den pludselige stigning i syge børn og rapporter om udbredte klynger af ukendte luftvejssygdomme fik Verdenssundhedsorganisationen (WHO) til at bede om flere oplysninger for at berolige bekymringer om, at en ny sygdom — lignende Covid-19 — skulle være årsagen til udbruddene. Kinesiske myndigheder har oplyst, at sygdommene skyldes kendte smitstoffer, herunder mycoplasma pneumoniae, RSV, adenovirus og influenza. Der er ikke fundet nye patogener. Læger har i de seneste uger advaret om, at en stigning i 'walking pneumonia'-tilfælde forårsaget af almindelige bakterieinfektioner var sandsynlig. Som svar på WHO’s anmodning har de kinesiske sundhedsmyndigheder præciseret, at stigningen i ambulante besøg og hospitalsindlæggelser skyldes mycoplasma pneumoniae og andre luftvejsvirusser. WHO har påpeget, at selvom sygeligheden er usædvanligt høj for årstiden, er luftvejssygdomme om vinteren almindelige. Organisationen anbefaler folk at bære mundbind, blive hjemme ved sygdom og vaske hænder regelmæssigt, og har bemærket, at der ikke er behov for rejserestriktioner på nuværende tidspunkt. Mycoplasma pneumoniae er en type bakterie, der oftest forårsager milde infektioner med forkølelseslignende symptomer. Den fører sjældent til indlæggelse, selvom hoste kan vare i ugevis. Små børn med et endnu ikke fuldt udviklet immunsystem har større risiko for komplikationer, hvilket bekymrer mange forældre. Ifølge lokale medier er flere af Kinas store børnehospitaler blevet overvældet af det høje antal syge børn, og familier må nogle gange vente op til syv timer på at tale med en læge. På sociale medier florerer billeder af overfyldte venteværelser og børn koblet til drop. De fleste kommer sig af disse infektioner uden hjælp eller med håndkøbsmedicin, der lindrer symptomerne. Dog kræver alvorlige tilfælde ofte antibiotika. Det vækker bekymring, da Kina har verdens højeste forekomst af mycoplasma pneumoniae, der er resistente over for makrolid-antibiotika som Zithromax. Ifølge Dr. Yin Yudong fra Beijing Chaoyang Hospital reagerer op til 60–70% af voksentilfælde og op til 80% af børnetilfælde ikke på disse lægemidler. Det er stadig uklart, hvorfor Kina oplever et markant udbrud af mycoplasma pneumoniae, mens USA og store dele af Europa har flere tilfælde af influenza og RSV. Forskning tyder på, at de tidligere Covid-19-restriktioner i Kina begrænsede mycoplasma pneumoniae i næsten to år, og at ophævelsen af disse foranstaltninger kan have bidraget til den nuværende stigning. Kinesiske sundhedsmyndigheder har bemærket, at stigningen i antal tilfælde er kommet tidligere end normalt, men understreget at lignende bølger af luftvejssygdomme er set i andre lande efter endt pandeminedlukning. Internationale rapporter om Kinas bølge af luftvejssygdomme vækker minder om de tidlige dage af Covid-19-pandemien, der begyndte med mystiske lungebetændelsestilfælde i Wuhan i 2019. Men mycoplasma er et velkendt og almindeligt smitstof, i modsætning til Covid-19, og forårsager jævnligt udbrud. Andre virusser, som RSV, cirkulerer også, hvilket tyder på, at forskellige luftvejssygdomme vil ramme mange lande denne vinter.

article_content: During Sunday’s NFL matchup between the Dallas Cowboys and the Arizona Cardinals, spectators were treated to an impressive display as a Navy SEAL and his service dog rappelled from the scoreboard onto the field. This memorable moment took place just before kickoff at the AT&T Stadium in Arlington, Texas, with the pair delivering the official game coin for the coin toss. The spectacle was organized as part of the NFL’s ‘Salute to Service’ initiative, which celebrates military members at 32 games this season and contributes donations based on the total points scored. Additional active-duty personnel participated in the halftime show, and the field featured military-themed decorations. The Cardinals secured the win with a 28-17 victory over the Cowboys.

Dette mindeværdige øjeblik fandt sted lige før kampens start på AT&T Stadium i Arlington, Texas, hvor de leverede den officielle mønt til lodtrækningen. Opvisningen var arrangeret som en del af NFL’s ‘Salute to Service’ initiativ, som hylder militærpersonale ved 32 kampe i denne sæson og donerer penge baseret på det samlede antal point scoret. article_content: Online food delivery giant Zomato has recorded a marked turnaround in profitability for its fiscal second quarter ending September 2023, notching a net profit of Rs 36 crore. This follows a previous quarter profit of Rs 2 crore and stands in sharp contrast to the Rs 251 crore loss from the same time last year. Analysts surveyed by ET Now had anticipated a Rs 5 crore loss for the quarter. Operational revenue surged 71% year-on-year to reach Rs 2,848 crore, comfortably outpacing market forecasts of Rs 2,607 crore. The company's combined gross order value (GOV) across its business-to-consumer segments—which include food delivery, quick commerce, and dining out—leaped 47% compared to the previous year, totaling Rs 11,422 crore. The growth was propelled mainly by a rise in order volumes, even as the average transaction size remained almost unchanged. A significant boost came from greater popularity of Zomato’s membership program, Gold, which led to members placing orders more frequently. Food delivery GOV increased 20% year-on-year, marking a rebound after sluggish demand in the last quarters of the previous fiscal year. Zomato reiterated its forecast that adjusted revenue would show compound annual growth over 40% in the coming years, and reported a 53% year-on-year rise in adjusted revenue for Q2 to Rs 3,227 crore. The company’s adjusted EBITDA swung to a positive Rs 41 crore from a Rs 192 crore loss in the same quarter last year. The quick commerce business under the Blinkit brand achieved a milestone, turning contribution margin positive for a full quarter for the first time. Contribution margin as a share of GOV shifted from –7.3% to +1.3%. Quick commerce GOV grew 29% on a sequential basis following disruptions experienced in the first quarter. Looking ahead, Zomato maintains a cautiously optimistic outlook for the third quarter, anticipating that seasonal festivals and the ICC Cricket World Cup will drive further growth. However, it noted that, while these events typically spike food orders, more people also dine out or travel during such times, and the World Cup’s impact may be limited to select matches. The company’s cash reserves also grew by Rs 188 crore during Q2. The market reacted favorably, with Zomato shares climbing almost 10% in Friday afternoon trading. In related updates: Indian telecom companies have accused international technology giants like Microsoft and Amazon of bypassing standard regulations to message customers, which could potentially result in major revenue losses for both the industry and government. Meanwhile, Apple has been asked by authorities to join an investigation into attempted hacks of high-profile Indians’ iPhones. Also, India’s DGCA has informed the Delhi High Court that Go First’s leased aircraft and engines may now be returned to their original lessors, dealing a blow to the airline’s recovery efforts.

Dette følger et overskud på 2 crore rupees i forrige kvartal og står i skarp kontrast til tabet på 251 crore rupees samme tid sidste år. Analytikere interviewet af ET Now forventede et tab på 5 crore rupees for kvartalet. Omsætningen steg med 71 % år-til-år til 2.848 crore rupees, hvilket klart overgik markedets forventninger på 2.607 crore rupees. Virksomhedens samlede bruttoordreværdi (GOV) på tværs af B2C-segmenter—herunder madlevering, quick commerce og restaurantbesøg—steg med 47 % sammenlignet med året før og nåede samlet 11.422 crore rupees. Væksten var primært drevet af flere ordrer, mens den gennemsnitlige ordreværdi forblev stort set uændret. En vigtig drivkraft var den stigende popularitet for Zomatos medlemskabsprogram, Gold, som fik medlemmerne til at bestille mad oftere. Madleverings-GOV steg 20 % år-til-år og markerede et comeback efter faldende efterspørgsel i de sidste kvartaler af det foregående regnskabsår. Zomato gentog sin forventning om, at den justerede omsætning vil vokse med mere end 40 % årligt i de kommende år, og rapporterede en stigning på 53 % år-til-år for andet kvartal til 3.227 crore rupees. Virksomhedens justerede EBITDA blev positiv med 41 crore rupees efter et tab på 192 crore rupees i samme kvartal sidste år. Forretningsområdet quick commerce under Blinkit-brandet opnåede en milepæl ved for første gang at have positiv bidragsmargin for et helt kvartal. Bidragsmargenen som andel af GOV ændrede sig fra –7,3 % til +1,3 %. Quick commerce GOV steg med 29 % fra kvartalet før efter forstyrrelser i første kvartal. Zomato ser forsigtigt optimistisk på yderligere fremgang i tredje kvartal, især på grund af højtider og ICC Cricket World Cup. Dog bemærker de, at selvom disse begivenheder ofte øger madbestillinger, er der også flere, der spiser ude eller rejser, og effekten fra World Cuppen begrænser sig muligvis til enkelte kampe. Virksomhedens pengestrøm voksede med 188 crore rupees i andet kvartal. Markedet reagerede positivt, og Zomatos aktier steg næsten 10 % fredag eftermiddag efter regnskabet blev offentliggjort. I relaterede nyheder: Indiske teleselskaber har anklaget internationale teknologigiganter som Microsoft og Amazon for at omgå reglerne ved at sende beskeder til kunder, hvilket kan medføre betydelige tab for branchen og staten. Samtidig er Apple blevet bedt om at deltage i en undersøgelse af forsøg på hacking af kendte indiske iPhones. Desuden har den indiske luftfartsmyndighed DGCA meddelt Delhi High Court, at Go Firsts leasede fly og motorer nu kan returneres til udlejerne – et tilbageslag for flyselskabets genopretning.

Tiger Woods has decided to withdraw himself from possible selection for the U.S. Ryder Cup team as he recovers from back injuries. On his website, Woods shared that his doctors and trainer told him to avoid all golf activities for now to allow his back to heal properly. The 38-year-old, who boasts 14 major titles, stated that he didn’t want to take part in the Ryder Cup—one of golf’s most prestigious team events against Europe—unless he could give his best.

U.S. Ryder Cup captain Tom Watson told the PGA’s official site that he was disappointed by Woods’ choice but applauded his sense of responsibility and early communication. The team already has nine confirmed members: Rickie Fowler, Jim Furyk, Zach Johnson, Matt Kuchar, Phil Mickelson, Patrick Reed, Jordan Spieth, Jimmy Walker, and Bubba Watson. Watson will announce three additional captain’s picks on September 2 to round out the U.S. team.

This year’s Ryder Cup will run from September 26 to 28 in Perthshire, Scotland. Europe is the reigning champion. Woods has played in seven previous Ryder Cups, with a 13-17-2 record. He recently withdrew from the Bridgestone Invitational due to back spasms and missed the cut at the PGA Championship after consecutive rounds of 74. Woods aims to return to tournament golf at the World Challenge in Orlando, Florida, starting December 1.

USA’s Ryder Cup-kaptajn Tom Watson udtalte til PGA’s officielle hjemmeside, at han er skuffet over Woods’ beslutning, men han roser også Woods for ansvarlighed og at han var ude med beskeden i god tid. Kate Middleton and Prince William will be arriving in Australia on April 16, accompanied by their son, Prince George, as part of an 18-day tour. Their visit coincides with the heartwarming discovery by two Brisbane families of their distant royal lineage.

Mark Lowers, 46, a British-born mine worker living in the bayside suburb of Birkdale, recently found that he is Kate’s second cousin. Mark explained that in 2008, he discovered his mother Lillian and Kate’s mother Carole shared the same grandmother, Edith Eliza Chandler. This genealogical connection makes Mark and Kate second cousins, while young Prince George is a third cousin to the Lowers family. Mark joked about inviting the Duke and Duchess to his home for a barbeque but acknowledged their busy schedule may not allow it. His wife, Tia, and their nine-year-old daughter, Shae, delight in the news, suggesting that their daughter's love of tea and cucumber sandwiches fits her newfound 'princess' status.

Nearby, plumber Neil Geary, 74, learned that he is Prince William’s 14th cousin after his wife, Barbara, traced his heritage back to 1749, revealing they both descended from William Conyngsby and Beatrix Thursby. Neil has reached out to the Governor of Queensland in hopes of receiving a VIP invitation to a royal luncheon planned for April 19. While no invite has yet arrived, Neil is understanding of the challenge in accommodating all relatives. He fondly recalled writing to the Palace in 2009 and cherishing the response indicating William was pleased to hear from his Australian relations. Neil expressed pride in this familial connection to both William and Harry.

article_content: By Anucyia Victor for MailOnline. A group of students at James Madison University in Virginia gathered outside the Carrier Library to peacefully counter the sermons of an anti-gay preacher. The incident, caught on video, shows a young man playing guitar while fellow students sing the Christian song 'How He Loves' in response to the preacher. In the footage, the preacher is heard saying, 'I see through you all,' as he tries to continue speaking while the students’ singing drowns out his voice. The students, united in song, ignore the preacher and maintain their peaceful demonstration. The guitarist follows the preacher while he attempts to address the crowd, but their singing becomes louder whenever he speaks. They repeat the refrain, 'Oh how he loves us,' making it difficult for the preacher to be heard. Eventually, the preacher turns his back on the group, still trying to engage with the growing audience as students keep singing. The video also captures a moment when the preacher engages a student in conversation, while a police officer observes and more students record the scene on their phones. At one point, the singing ends when a student shouts, 'Jesus loves you all' to the crowd. The video, shared over 30,000 times on YouTube, has fueled debate among viewers about the students’ actions. Some commenters criticize the disruption of free speech, while others support the students' non-confrontational response to the anti-gay message. YouTube user Piers Echols-Jones said, 'On the one hand, I'm not down with homophobia. On the other hand, it's the tyranny of the majority to shut up a person by drowning them out.' Daniel Yang commented, 'The preacher claims to be spreading the Gospel but all he does is spread hate. At least the students responded with music and worship instead of argument.' Another user, John Howard, wrote, 'A group of people, united in love, are protecting others from judgment and hatred. This is a beautiful scene.' In a separate video from the same day, a woman is heard telling the preacher about her Catholic upbringing, to which the preacher replies, 'You’re growing up in a screwy religion, you’ve been raised in a screwy religion.'

De studerende står samlet i sang og ignorerer prædikanten, mens de fortsætter deres fredelige protest. Guitaristen følger prædikanten, mens han forsøger at henvende sig til forsamlingen, men sangen bliver højere, hver gang han taler. French President Francois Hollande will not attend the upcoming Winter Olympics in Sochi, Russia, French Foreign Minister Laurent Fabius confirmed on Sunday. This follows less than a week after German President Joachim Gauck also decided to boycott the Games. Asked about President Hollande’s plans, Fabius replied, “It has not been planned for him to attend. At the same time, I wish all the success for these Games. As it stands, it is not expected that the highest French authorities will be present.” Like his German counterparts, Fabius declined to provide any further explanation for the decision.

At the 2012 London Summer Olympics, around 80 heads of state and other world leaders were present for the opening ceremony, as reported by The Guardian. In recent months, Russia has faced international scrutiny over alleged human rights violations, harassment of opposition political figures, and a law banning so-called “gay propaganda,” which critics say promotes discrimination. For Sochi 2014, Russia has introduced designated protest zones.

Reporting contributed by CNN’s Lindsay Isaac and journalist Niki Cook.

Da Fabius blev spurgt til Hollandes planer, svarede han: ”Det har ikke været planlagt, at han skulle deltage. Samtidig ønsker jeg al mulig succes for legene. Som det ser ud, forventes det ikke, at de højeste franske myndigheder vil være til stede.” Ligesom de tyske embedsmænd undlod Fabius at uddybe beslutningen yderligere.

Ved sommer-OL i London 2012 var omkring 80 statsoverhoveder og andre verdensledere til stede under åbningsceremonien, rapporterer The Guardian. I de seneste måneder har Rusland mødt international kritik for påståede menneskerettighedskrænkelser, chikane af oppositionspolitikere og en lov, der forbyder såkaldt 'homopropaganda', som kritikere mener fremmer diskrimination. Til Sochi 2014 har Rusland indført særlige protestzoner.

Rapportering bidraget af CNN's Lindsay Isaac og journalist Niki Cook.

Nuclear fusion has long been called the 'holy grail' of energy—a source that could meet the world’s increasing need for clean power. Now, we might be closer to realizing this vision, as Lockheed Martin has announced a significant breakthrough in its efforts to develop fusion-based power sources. The Maryland-based company says that its first fusion reactors, compact enough to fit on a large truck, could be operational within a decade.

These reactors would use deuterium and tritium—hydrogen isotopes—as fuel to produce large amounts of energy with minimal waste. Dubbed Compact Fusion Reactors (CFRs), Lockheed Martin’s design incorporates a tube-like structure with a specialized magnetic field to confine plasma, addressing limitations found in traditional fusion reactor designs.

According to Tom McGuire, head of the project at Lockheed Martin’s Skunk Works division, a dedicated team has been working on fusion technologies for about four years. They are now seeking partnerships with industry and government to move development forward. Their initial 100-megawatt reactor design, measuring approximately 2.1 by 3 meters, is about ten times smaller than current fusion reactors and can be transported by truck.

Lockheed’s initiative aims to create a power source with virtually no greenhouse gas emissions and an almost limitless fuel supply, as deuterium is abundant in seawater and tritium can be made from lithium. The company plans to build and test a prototype in five years and anticipates the first operational reactor in ten years. Such compact reactors could serve both civil power needs and military applications, including powering Navy vessels and reducing reliance on other fuel sources.

Meanwhile, researchers at the University of Washington have developed their own fusion reactor concepts, which they presented at the International Atomic Energy Agency’s Fusion Energy Conference in Russia. Their design focuses on magnetic confinement of plasma and aims to match the costs and output of modern coal-fired power stations.

Despite these advancements, some experts urge caution regarding commercial viability. Dr. Joel Gilmore of Roam Consulting pointed out the technical challenges of sustaining fusion conditions and the long-standing difficulties in making fusion practical. Nonetheless, Professor Roger Dargaville of the University of Melbourne emphasized fusion’s promise as a low-carbon alternative for future electricity production, noting the advantages over traditional fission in terms of waste.

Disse reaktorer vil benytte deuterium og tritium—hydrogenisotoper—som brændstof til at skabe store mængder energi med minimalt affald. Lockheed Martins design, Compact Fusion Reactors (CFR), bruger en rørformet konstruktion med et avanceret magnetfelt, som fastholder plasmaet og dermed overvinder begrænsningerne ved traditionelle fusionsteknologier.

Tom McGuire, som leder projektet i Lockheed Martins Skunk Works, fortæller, at et dedikeret team har arbejdet med fusionsteknologi i cirka fire år. article_content: Harvard professor Claudia Goldin has been awarded the Nobel Prize in Economic Sciences for her extensive research on gender disparities in the workforce. Goldin, only the third woman among 93 honorees to receive this prize, has spent her career analyzing 200 years of data on women’s participation in the labor market. Her work reveals that, despite increases in women’s education and ongoing economic growth, the gender pay gap has persisted. According to Jakob Svensson, who chairs the Nobel committee for economics, Goldin's research has deepened society’s understanding of women’s roles in the job market and highlighted barriers that remain to be addressed. Rather than providing direct solutions, Goldin’s historical analyses detail how the pay gap sources have changed over time and vary by country development stage. Prize committee member Randi Hjalmarsson emphasized that, without understanding these causes, no single remedy will be effective. Goldin’s work involved creatively overcoming missing data in historical labor records, often serving as a 'data detective' to piece together information from different archives. At 77, Goldin expressed surprise and joy at the recognition. This economics Nobel follows the annual Nobel prizes in medicine, physics, chemistry, literature, and peace, which were also announced recently. The Bank of Sweden Prize in Economic Sciences in Memory of Alfred Nobel was established in 1968. Last year’s laureates were Ben Bernanke, Douglas Diamond, and Philip Dybvig for their research into financial crises. Other 2023 Nobel awards went to scientists Katalin Karikó and Drew Weissman (medicine), Anne L’Huillier, Pierre Agostini, and Ferenc Krausz (physics), Moungi Bawendi, Louis Brus, and Alexei Ekimov (chemistry), writer Jon Fosse (literature), and activist Narges Mohammadi (peace). The ceremonies for Nobel prizes are held each December in Oslo and Stockholm. Winners receive 11 million Swedish kronor (about US$1 million), as well as an 18-karat gold medal and a diploma.

article_content: England’s unsuccessful bid to host the 2018 World Cup will be given more attention in Michael Garcia’s report on the allegedly corrupt bidding process than the FA might prefer. England’s bid is viewed as one of the most transparent among the 2018 and 2022 World Cup contenders, while FIFA ethics judge Hans-Joachim Eckert is expected to issue a verdict next month. Despite reports of significant spending by Qatar to secure the 2022 tournament, there are concerns at Wembley that England could be criticized for relatively minor breaches of bidding rules. Garcia asked the FA for further details concerning four incidents: £230 Mulberry handbags given to FIFA executive committee members during a London visit, a £35,000 sponsorship for a Caribbean Football Union summit, a venue tour by former FIFA Executive Committee member Chuck Blazer, and an FA party at the Saxon Hotel in Johannesburg during the 2010 World Cup. Garcia has already delivered his report on the 2018 and 2022 World Cup bidding. The departures of FA general secretary Alex Horne and Chelsea chief executive Ron Gourlay within 24 hours are unrelated, and there is no suggestion of job swaps between the two. Gourlay, who was not universally popular at Stamford Bridge, managed to remain as CEO for five years but was increasingly sidelined by chairman Bruce Buck and owner Roman Abramovich’s advisor Marina Granovskaia. Manchester City’s £180-a-head corporate package for their game at West Ham on Saturday includes a talk by Ed Sulley, City’s head of research and innovation, focused on club performance strategies that keep the team at the top of the game, though not always successful in the Champions League group stage. The FA is negotiating with former FA Cup sponsor Budweiser regarding a reduced, second-tier endorsement. With the first round of the Cup approaching and no replacement sponsor in place, having Budweiser continue as main sponsor would avoid potential embarrassment for Wembley. Ascot and search firm Spencer Stuart had a difficult time finding a new chief executive from outside horse racing with experience of managing major venues. In a surprise move, Guy Henderson, 56, a former litigation lawyer at Allen & Overy and chairman of Wincanton races for two years, has been appointed. Ascot is hopeful for Henderson’s leadership, despite him being the cox of the Cambridge boat that sank in the rough waters of the 1978 Boat Race—a fact not mentioned in Ascot’s announcement. Troubled sports agency Kentaro has entered administration in the UK after bankruptcy proceedings in Switzerland. Newcastle, West Ham, and other clubs and federations are owed money following participation in a Kentaro-organized tournament at Schalke. Kentaro’s business of selling TV contracts across Europe faltered after UEFA centralized qualifying rights for European and World Cups. Renovation costs for the Olympic Stadium for West Ham rose by £35.9m, an extra expense agreed with builders Balfour Beatty. The transparent London Legacy Development Corporation will cover this from contingency funds. Installing the world’s largest single-span cantilever roof proved much more complicated and costly than originally expected, when the £154m contract was signed. Before the next election, Sports Minister Helen Grant plans to launch a £10m consumer and social media campaign, through Twitter, Facebook and other platforms, to encourage more women to participate in sport. Lottery funds will cover the project, which is being organized by Sport England. Sport England’s chairman Nick Bitel has held budget-friendly meetings with sports governing bodies to discuss the plan.

Trods rapporter om betydelige udgifter fra Qatar for at sikre sig 2022-turneringen, er der bekymring i Wembley for, at England kan blive kritiseret for relativt mindre overtrædelser af budreglerne. article_content: The Maharashtra state government announced the transfer of five IAS officers on Monday. Aman Mittal, previous MD of Maharashtra Petrochemicals Corporation, becomes deputy secretary in the water supply and sanitation department.

article_content: In Connecticut, the Kleeman family has amassed a vast collection of Space Age memorabilia, a testament to the era’s excitement and optimism about space exploration. Their barn now houses nearly 10,000 items, ranging from rocket-shaped lamps and star-studded toys to a 40-foot promotional trailer modeled after the 'Space Patrol' TV show’s Terra IV battle cruiser. What began as a father-son hobby, sparked by a $10 toy ray gun from a flea market 20 years ago, is growing into the 'Space Age Museum.' The family’s collection documents how space fever swept the world, especially following the Apollo 11 moon landing in 1969. Items include both professionally made objects and homemade memorabilia such as needlepoint and tin creations. Over the years, their quest has transformed into a family project, involving not just purchases but careful cataloging and photographing for a digital archive. Peter Kleeman, now 29, travels between New York and his family’s Connecticut home to help build the business side of the museum. The family aims to one day showcase their collection to the public, initially through touring exhibits and, with enough support, at a permanent location. According to Peter, his mother’s support and input have been vital, especially with significant acquisitions. For the Kleemans, the museum is about more than nostalgia—it serves as a reminder of an era when society was captivated by a sense of adventure and possibility. Peter believes rekindling this spirit could inspire creativity and optimism today, suggesting that future milestones such as a mission to Mars might help revive public enthusiasm for exploration. He advocates for a balanced approach that cares for Earth's issues while still pursuing space endeavors, reasoning that understanding our place in the universe can foster humility and a deeper appreciation for our planet’s uniqueness and fragility.

Det hele begyndte som et far-søn-hobbyprojekt, startet med en legetøjsstrålepistol til 10 dollars fra et loppemarked for 20 år siden, og i dag vokser det til at blive 'Space Age Museum'. Familiens samling dokumenterer, hvordan rumfeberen greb verden, især efter Apollo 11-månelandingen i 1969. Samlingen indeholder både professionelt fremstillede objekter og hjemmelavet memorabilia som broderier og ting lavet i tin. Med tiden er projektet blevet et familieforetagende, der omfatter både indkøb, nøje katalogisering og fotografering til et digitalt arkiv.
