Mahesh Bhupathi, renowned for his successful career as a doubles tennis specialist, now manages dual roles both on and off the court. The 37-year-old Indian athlete continues to play professionally on the ATP Tour, recently claiming a doubles title in Dubai. He also manages emerging Indian tennis talents through his company, Globosport, whose portfolio features several Bollywood film stars—giving Bhupathi a strong foundation for his post-tennis pursuits.

Bhupathi names entrepreneurs like Richard Branson and Sunil Mittal as inspirations, and he recently made his on-screen debut in a Globosport project. His wife, Lara Dutta, is an award-winning actress and was crowned Miss Universe in 2000.

As the first Indian to win a Grand Slam title, with 11 Grand Slam doubles trophies, Bhupathi hopes to blend the glamour of Bollywood with plans to nurture tennis talent in India. “Everyone who grows up with tennis knows the support needed to build a player,” he told CNN’s Open Court. “There's no shortage of talent in India—we've always had some of the best juniors globally. The real challenge is helping them transition from junior to senior level, and that often depends on financial support. In Western countries, young players have coaches, trainers, and solid support teams, which requires significant resources. Right now, we're supporting a talented 14-year-old full-time. Hopefully, we'll be able to support more kids, creating a steady stream of players emerging from India.”

While cricket stars are idolized in India, Bhupathi is among the country’s most prominent sporting figures. He has achieved a Grand Slam clean sweep in mixed doubles, starting with the French Open in 1997 with partner Rika Hiraki, and has four men’s doubles Grand Slam titles. At the 2012 Australian Open, Bhupathi partnered Rohan Bopanna—though they exited in the third round, they recently won the Dubai Open. His partnership with Leander Paes has yielded three men’s doubles Grand Slam titles: the French Open in 1999 and 2001, and Wimbledon in 1999.

Off the court, Bhupathi manages Sania Mirza—the first Indian woman to enter the world’s top 30 players—and Somdev Devvarman, who reached a career-high ATP ranking of 62. “Managing both playing and business is like two full-time jobs, but I enjoy it,” he said. “Sania was one of our first clients—we signed her when she was just 15. Because I’m on the tour, handling equipment and sponsorships is easy since I'm present at the tournaments.”

Bhupathi knows his playing career won’t last forever, but feels prepared for a smooth transition to business, especially since Globosport has been running for eight years. Although Bollywood opportunities are growing, Bhupathi says his current focus remains on tennis.

Selvom cricketstjerner er superstjerner i Indien, er Bhupathi en af landets mest kendte sportsprofiler. GCSE students in England will continue to receive formulae and equation sheets in their maths and science exams next year, as part of efforts to ease Covid-related learning disruptions. The Department for Education (DfE) has directed Ofqual, the exams regulator, to extend this support for another year. Most students due to sit exams next summer were in Year 7 when the first national lockdown began. Teaching unions have largely welcomed the proposal, which is under consultation. The DfE states that students taking maths, physics, and combined science GCSEs will receive 'enhanced formulae and equation sheets.'

Education Secretary Gillian Keegan explained, 'Young people taking GCSEs next year will be the last who experienced two years of national closures during their secondary education, and it's right that we recognize this with some additional support.'

Sarah Hannafin, head of policy at the school leaders’ union NAHT, noted there is 'no need for an additional test of memory' in the exams. She also expressed disappointment that the decision was made so late, considering pupils will soon take their mock exams. The Association of School and College Leaders endorsed the consultation but argued the materials should be given permanently. General secretary Geoff Barton said permanent access would help relieve exam stress and allow students to focus on core knowledge and skills.

England's exams were due to revert to 2019 arrangements before this update. Across the UK, exams were cancelled in 2020 and 2021, with teacher assessments leading to more top grades. When formal exams resumed in 2022, extra support was introduced to address Covid-related disruption, with some measures remaining for 2023. Exam papers were spaced further apart, giving students more time for revision; formulae and equation sheets were provided in certain subjects, and unfamiliar vocabulary was omitted from modern language exams. Unlike other UK nations, English students did not get advance topic lists. England alone returned grades to 2019 levels this summer; Wales and Northern Ireland are taking a slower approach, resulting in a steeper drop in English pass rates.

Last month, colleges told the BBC they are increasing class sizes and renting more exam halls to manage the growing number of compulsory maths and English GCSE resits. Following the DfE’s announcement, a Welsh Government spokesperson reaffirmed that formulae sheets are already standard for exams in Wales and will continue to be provided.

Uddannelsesministeriet (DfE) har bedt eksamensmyndigheden Ofqual om at forlænge denne støtte yderligere et år. De fleste elever, der skal op til eksamen næste sommer, startede i 7. klasse, da den første nationale nedlukning trådte i kraft. article_content: Daniel Harrison, a young boy from Nottingham, never ate a meal due to a severe fear of eating and drinking, rooted in painful acid reflux as a baby. As a result, he relied on a feeding tube for years. With the help of innovative treatment at the University Hospital in Graz, Austria, Daniel can now eat with his family. He managed his first meal two months after his first successful drink at the hospital, and his father notes that Daniel loves biscuits. While Daniel can eat many foods, some still need to be pureed since his mouth muscles are still developing. His father, Kevin Harrison, expressed immense pride, likening Daniel's achievement to winning major football tournaments. Daniel’s parents, Kevin and Catherine, traveled to Austria twice, where doctors used unique techniques unfamiliar in the UK to help Daniel overcome his fear of eating. The family spent nearly £25,000 on the treatment. The Austrian specialist team has treated around a dozen international patients successfully for similar eating challenges. Funding from their local Public Health Trust was initially denied because both parents worked. Although they received some financial support for their second trip, the family has endured significant financial strain to help Daniel. During his first visit to Austria, Daniel learned to drink from a special bottle containing a milk formula that provided essential nutrients. His parents had long struggled to help him, as he previously had no interest in food. The journey has been emotionally challenging, especially for Daniel’s older sister, Hannah. Kevin shares that finally being able to enjoy family meals together feels like a dream fulfilled.

Han spiste sit første måltid to måneder efter sin første succesfulde drik på hospitalet, og hans far fortæller, at Daniel elsker kiks. Selvom Daniel kan spise mange slags mad, skal noget stadig pureres, da hans mundmuskler først skal udvikles. Hans far, Kevin Harrison, udtrykte stor stolthed og sammenlignede Daniels præstation med at vinde store fodboldturneringer. Daniels forældre, Kevin og Catherine, rejste til Østrig to gange, hvor lægerne brugte unikke metoder, som ikke anvendes i Storbritannien, for at hjælpe Daniel med at overvinde sin frygt for mad. Familien har brugt næsten 25.000 pund på behandlingen. Det østrigske specialistteam har med succes behandlet omkring et dusin internationale patienter med lignende spiseudfordringer. Finansiering fra deres lokale sundhedsmyndighed blev oprindeligt nægtet, fordi begge forældre arbejder. Selvom de modtog en vis økonomisk støtte til anden rejse, har familien måttet udholde store økonomiske udfordringer for at hjælpe Daniel. Forældrene havde gennem længere tid kæmpet for at hjælpe ham, da han tidligere ikke viste interesse for mad. Forløbet har været følelsesmæssigt udfordrende, især for Daniels storesøster, Hannah. Kevin fortæller, at det nu føles som en drøm, endelig at kunne nyde familiemåltider sammen.

article_content: More than 80,000 customers in Florida were without power on Thursday morning after heavy rain and winds reaching 65 mph hit the state. Parts of South Florida, including areas near Key Largo, recorded over 1 foot of rain in the past 24 hours. Miami received 7.53 inches of rain on Wednesday, breaking its daily rainfall record. Public schools in Broward County, the sixth-largest school district in the country, were closed Thursday because of the severe weather. On Thursday morning, flood watches and high wind warnings remained in effect for Florida’s east coast. The state was expected to see a few more inches of rain and winds up to 45 mph before conditions begin to improve Thursday afternoon.

Offentlige skoler i Broward County, den sjette største skolekreds i landet, var lukkede torsdag på grund af det voldsomme vejr. Torsdag morgen var der fortsat oversvømmelsesvarsler og advarsler om kraftig vind for Floridas østkyst. Staten forventedes at få et par centimeter mere regn og vindstød op til 72 km/t, før forholdene begynder at blive bedre torsdag eftermiddag.

article_content: Harry Kane continued his remarkable scoring streak with two first-half goals to help Bayern Munich overcome promoted Heidenheim 4-2 on Saturday, moving the Bavarians to the top of the Bundesliga. Heidenheim fought back with two goals in three minutes after halftime, leveling the score at 2-2. However, late strikes from Raphael Guerreiro—scoring his first goal for Bayern—and Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting secured the win for the hosts. With this victory, Bayern lead the table, though Bayer Leverkusen could reclaim the top spot with a win against Union Berlin on Sunday. Kane, who entered the match with ten goals from his previous five outings, opened the scoring after 14 minutes with a turn and finish. He netted his second just before halftime, heading in unmarked from a corner. Manager Thomas Tuchel made three substitutions soon after the break, but Heidenheim responded rapidly. Tim Kleindienst and Jan-Niklas Beste scored within three minutes—the latter capitalizing after a defensive error from Kim Min-Jae—to equalize with 20 minutes left. Guerreiro restored Bayern’s lead, and Choupo-Moting added another with five minutes remaining, ensuring all three points for the reigning champions. Kane now boasts 17 goals in 11 league matches since his summer transfer from Tottenham. Borussia Dortmund suffered a 2-1 defeat at Stuttgart. Returning striker Serhou Guirassy netted a decisive late penalty—his 15th goal of the season—keeping Stuttgart near the top of the table. Dortmund manager Edin Terzic fielded the same starting eleven as Tuesday’s Champions League win over Newcastle, but the team looked sluggish. Goalkeeper Gregor Kobel made an early penalty save—the first for Dortmund in a decade—but Stuttgart soon equalized before halftime when Jamie Leweling perfectly set up Brighton loanee Deniz Undav. Niclas Fuellkrug had put Dortmund ahead with a close-range finish after a mistake by former Dortmund defender Dan-Axel Zagadou. Guirassy, returning from injury, came off the bench to convert the decisive penalty, handing Dortmund their second league defeat in three games. Dortmund now sit eight points behind leaders Bayern after 11 matches. Elsewhere, Augsburg held Hoffenheim to a 1-1 draw, with Ermedin Demirovic cancelling out an early goal from former Manchester United striker Wout Weghorst. Darmstadt and Mainz played out a goalless draw, and later on Saturday, Bochum were set to face fellow strugglers Cologne.

Heidenheim kæmpede sig tilbage med to mål på tre minutter efter pausen og udlignede til 2-2. Sene scoringer fra Raphael Guerreiro—hans første for Bayern—og Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting sikrede dog sejren for hjemmeholdet. Med denne sejr fører Bayern ligaen, men Bayer Leverkusen kan generobre førstepladsen med en sejr over Union Berlin søndag. Kane, der havde scoret ti mål i de foregående fem kampe, åbnede scoringen efter 14 minutter med en flot vending og afslutning. Han nettede sit andet lige før pausen, hvor han uhindret headede bolden i mål efter et hjørnespark. Guerreiro bragte Bayern foran igen, og Choupo-Moting øgede føringen med fem minutter tilbage, hvilket sikrede alle tre point til de forsvarende mestre. Kane står nu noteret for 17 mål i 11 ligakampe siden sit sommerskifte fra Tottenham. Borussia Dortmund led et 2-1 nederlag ude mod Stuttgart. Den tilbagevendte angriber Serhou Guirassy scorede et afgørende sent straffespark—hans 15. sæsonmål—som holder Stuttgart i toppen af tabellen. Dortmunds træner Edin Terzic stillede med samme startopstilling som i tirsdagens Champions League-sejr over Newcastle, men holdet virkede trætte. Målmand Gregor Kobel reddede et tidligt straffespark—Dortmunds første redning i ligaen i ti år—men Stuttgart udlignede før pausen, da Jamie Leweling perfekt assisterede Brighton-lejesvenden Deniz Undav. Dortmund er nu otte point efter Bayern efter 11 spillerunder. Andre steder spillede Augsburg og Hoffenheim 1-1, hvor Ermedin Demirovic udlignede efter et tidligt mål fra den tidligere Manchester United-angriber Wout Weghorst. Darmstadt og Mainz spillede uafgjort uden mål, og senere lørdag skulle Bochum møde bundrivalerne Köln.

article_content: When you buy a phone, tablet, or smartwatch today, it is clear how many years of software updates you'll receive—for example, three years for the Pixel Watch 2 or four years for the Galaxy Watch 6. However, if you buy a Garmin, Fitbit, or another fitness-focused watch, it is much harder to predict how long it will receive updates before becoming outdated. It's time for this to change. In his weekly column, Senior Editor for Wearables and Fitness Michael Hicks discusses trends in wearables, apps, and fitness tech, sharing his experiences as he seeks improvement in running and health. When $100-and-under fitness trackers were popular, buyers expected to get only basic software with few updates. This was similar to cheap Android phones, which typically receive a single OS update. Now, companies are selling fitness watches for $400 or more, often with advanced training and mapping software. But, unlike comparably priced smartwatches, these fitness devices often have undisclosed hardware and little guarantee of ongoing support. For example, the Pixel Watch 2 uses the Snapdragon W5 chip with 2GB of RAM, and both Google and Qualcomm are committed to ensuring long-term performance. In contrast, fitness watches rarely disclose their hardware specifications, making it difficult to evaluate performance improvements or longevity. With Garmin, it is generally understood that models like the Fenix or Epix offer higher performance and support for the latest features, while Instinct models typically have less processing power. However, the scale of these differences is unclear, making it hard for consumers to make informed decisions. Designing fitness watches requires balancing compact size, battery life, and the ability to power various sensors. Once this balance is established, it's difficult to add new software features later without compromising performance or battery life. As a result, even expensive wearables can be left behind, often without trade-in options. Garmin does update older watches after new models release, but usually waits until after the initial launch period, presumably to encourage upgrades. New features only reach older models if hardware allows. For example, Garmin added features like Hill Scores, Training Readiness, Training Load Ratio, and Morning Report to previous-generation Forerunner, Fenix, Epix, and Instinct watches only after new versions were released. Still, there is never certainty that a watch will get new features. It's problematic that Garmin can sell a $3,000 MARQ watch with no official support timeline. While Garmin generally provides years of updates, this should be guaranteed—especially since the MARQ is a variation of the MARQ Gen 2 from 2022, raising questions about its hardware's currency. Consider the 2022 Garmin Forerunner 255—a well-regarded running watch replaced by the Forerunner 265 in under a year. Aside from its AMOLED display, the 265's notable addition is Training Readiness. The 255 measures all relevant metrics but cannot aggregate them into a Training Readiness score, and Garmin has not enabled this feature. It is unclear whether this omission is due to hardware limitations or a marketing decision; Garmin does not advertise hardware upgrades between generations. COROS stands out for consistent software updates across all watches, regardless of price. Before launching the PACE 3, COROS updated all its devices so PACE 2 owners enjoyed comparable software—meaning upgrades focused on hardware improvements, not software enticements. Most other fitness watches, like those from Amazfit, typically receive updates only until the next model is released, with few meaningful improvements after that. There is hope that Fitbit will improve its update policy, but initial missteps after Google's acquisition—such as removing or limiting features from the Sense 2 and Versa 4—have created skepticism. Perhaps the Charge 6 will reverse this trend. Google recently introduced an impressive seven-year OS update policy for the Pixel 8, but this currently applies only to phones. The expectation is that Google could apply similar update benchmarks to Fitbit OS, aiming for regular software improvements and clear timelines. The reviewer is optimistic about the Fitbit Charge 6 but notes that at $160, and considering the subscription cost for Fitbit Premium, users deserve clarity on software support—especially since Google has previously removed features from older devices. If Google guaranteed the Charge 6 would receive the same updates as future models, or if Garmin committed to bringing features from upcoming models to current devices, it would increase consumer confidence. Comparable Apple and Samsung watches do receive future features over several years. While proprietary chargers for fitness watches are accepted as a reality due to evolving designs, it is fair to expect manufacturers to include hardware capable of supporting future updates for at least several years.
translated_content: Når du køber en telefon, tablet eller smartwatch i dag, er det tydeligt, hvor mange års softwareopdateringer du får—for eksempel tre år for Pixel Watch 2 eller fire år for Galaxy Watch 6. Men hvis du køber et Garmin-, Fitbit- eller andet fitness-ur, er det meget sværere at forudsige, hvor længe det får opdateringer før det bliver forældet. Det er tid til, at det ændrer sig. I sin ugentlige klumme diskuterer redaktør for wearables og fitness, Michael Hicks, tendenser inden for wearables, apps og fitnessteknologi og deler sine erfaringer i jagten på bedre løb og sundhed. Da fitness-trackere til under 100 dollars var populære, forventede købere kun grundlæggende software med få opdateringer. Det minder om billige Android-telefoner, der typisk får én OS-opdatering. Nu sælger virksomheder fitnessure til 400 dollars eller mere, ofte med avanceret trænings- og kortlægningssoftware. Men i modsætning til dyrere smartwatches har disse fitnessenheder ofte ukendt hardware og ingen garanti for løbende support. Pixel Watch 2 bruger for eksempel Snapdragon W5-chippen med 2GB RAM, og både Google og Qualcomm er engagerede i langvarig ydeevne. Fitnessure oplyser sjældent deres hardwarespecifikationer, hvilket gør det svært at vurdere forbedringer eller holdbarhed. Hos Garmin forstår man generelt, at Fenix- eller Epix-modeller har højere ydeevne og understøtter de nyeste funktioner, mens Instinct-modeller ofte har mindre processorkraft. Hvor stor forskellen præcis er, er dog uklart, hvilket besværliggør forbrugerens beslutning. Design af fitnessure kræver balance mellem kompakt størrelse, batterilevetid og evnen til at holde liv i mange sensorer. Når denne balance først er ramt, er det svært at tilføje nye softwarefunktioner senere uden at gå på kompromis med ydeevne eller batteritid. Derfor kan selv dyre ure ende med at blive efterladt, ofte uden mulighed for bytte. Garmin opdaterer ældre ure efter nye modeller lanceres, men venter ofte til efter lanceringsperioden—formodentlig for at motivere til opgraderinger. Nye funktioner når kun ældre ure, hvis hardwaren kan følge med. Eksempelvis blev funktioner som Hill Scores, Training Readiness, Training Load Ratio og Morning Report først tilføjet tidligere generationer af Forerunner-, Fenix-, Epix- og Instinct-ure, efter nye versioner udkom. Det er dog aldrig garanteret at få nye funktioner. Det er problematisk, at Garmin kan sælge et MARQ-ur til 3.000 dollars uden officiel supportperiode. Garmin leverer gerne opdateringer i flere år, men det bør garanteres—særligt da MARQ blot er en variant af MARQ Gen 2 fra 2022, hvilket rejser spørgsmål om hardwarens opdaterethed. Tag for eksempel Garmin Forerunner 255 fra 2022—et anerkendt løbeur, der blev erstattet af Forerunner 265 på under et år. Ud over AMOLED-skærmen er Training Readiness den største tilføjelse på 265’eren. 255’eren måler alle relevante data, men kan ikke samle dem til en Training Readiness-score, og Garmin har ikke aktiveret funktionen. Det er uklart, om det skyldes hardwarebegrænsninger eller strategi; Garmin reklamerer ikke for hardwareforbedringer mellem generationer. COROS er et positivt eksempel og giver ens softwareopdateringer til alle ure, uanset pris. Før lanceringen af PACE 3 opdaterede COROS alle sine ure, så PACE 2-ejere fik tilsvarende software—så opgraderinger fokuserede på hardware, ikke software. De fleste andre fitnessure, som Amazfit, får typisk kun opdateringer indtil næste model udkommer—med få betydelige forbedringer bagefter. Der er håb om, at Fitbit forbedrer sin opdateringspolitik, men vanskeligheder efter Googles opkøb—som at fjerne eller begrænse funktioner fra Sense 2 og Versa 4—har gjort mange skeptiske. Måske kan Charge 6 vende udviklingen. Google har for nylig lanceret syv års OS-opdateringer til Pixel 8, hvilket er imponerende, men gælder kun smartphones. Forhåbningen er, at Google giver Fitbit OS lignende opdateringsplaner, så brugere får regelmæssige softwareforbedringer med klare tidslinjer. Anmelderen er positiv over for Fitbit Charge 6, men påpeger, at når man betaler 1.200 kr. og eventuelt for Fitbit Premium, bør der være klarhed om software-support—særligt da Google før har fjernet funktioner fra ældre enheder. Hvis Google garanterede, at Charge 6 fik samme opdateringer som fremtidige modeller, eller hvis Garmin lovede nye funktioner til eksisterende produkter, ville det øge forbrugertillid. Apple- og Samsung-ure modtager nye funktioner i flere år. Selvom proprietære opladere accepteres pga. forskellige design, er det rimeligt at forvente, at producenterne sikrer hardware, der kan opdateres i flere år frem.
post_content: How long will your fitness watch ACTUALLY get software updates? Unlike phones and big-brand smartwatches, fitness trackers like Garmin & Fitbit keep us guessing. Brands like COROS are showing how updates should be done! Time for more transparency? #Smartwatch #FitnessTech #Updates
translated_post: Hvor længe får dit fitness-ur egentlig opdateringer? Modsat telefoner og kendte smartwatches, ved vi sjældent hvor længe brands som Garmin & Fitbit holder dem friske. COROS gør det bedre! Er det ikke tid til mere gennemsigtighed? #Smartwatch #FitnessTech #Opdateringer

article_content: Chloe Lapper, 28, from Banbury, Oxfordshire, is a former successful male model who has transitioned to live as a woman and is now pursuing a career as a female model. Previously known as Shane, Chloe walked the runways for renowned fashion houses like Dolce & Gabbana, beginning her modeling career at age 22. While she enjoyed professional success, Chloe described feeling uncomfortable and out of place, knowing she was living in the wrong body. After years of psychological evaluations, she has started hormone treatments and is raising funds for gender reassignment surgery. Chloe realized from a young age that she identified as female, growing up with five sisters and feeling envious of their ability to dress up. She recalls making her identity public at age 18 and notes consistent support from both her social circle and the fashion industry. Now, Chloe is proud of her identity and reports positive changes both physically and mentally since beginning her transition. She rarely experiences negativity in public and looks forward to a bright future as her true self, hoping to continue her modeling career and explore opportunities in television.

Efter flere års psykologiske vurderinger er hun nu begyndt på hormonbehandling og samler penge ind til sin kønsskifteoperation. Chloe indså allerede i en tidlig alder, at hun identificerede sig som kvinde. Hun voksede op med fem søstre og var misundelig på deres mulighed for at klæde sig ud. Hun fortæller, at hun offentliggjorde sin identitet som 18-årig, og nævner vedvarende støtte fra både sin sociale omgangskreds og modebranchen. article_content: Several major newspapers highlight UK Home Secretary Suella Braverman’s meeting with Metropolitan Police Commissioner Sir Mark Rowley on Monday, following the force’s handling of protests in central London over the weekend. The Daily Mail reports that a frustrated Home Secretary will demand to know why police took a 'low-key' approach and 'stood by' while a man chanted 'jihad' at a pro-Palestine rally. According to The Times, Sir Mark Rowley is expected to defend his officers, as the protesters could not be prosecuted under existing laws. The paper notes that Sir Mark co-authored a review two years ago finding extremists could act with 'impunity' and incite hatred due to significant gaps in UK legislation. The Daily Telegraph features comments from former Met Police officer and counter-terrorism expert Neil Basu, who asserts that the government did not act on Sir Mark’s review. The paper also quotes the Community Security Trust, a group representing Jewish people in the UK, accusing the police of 'legitimising obnoxious and hateful behaviour' by their response. Outrage is reported on the front of the Sun after allegations that a London Underground driver led passengers in chants of 'Free Palestine' on the Central line on Saturday. Both the British Transport Police and Transport for London are investigating. Elsewhere, The Guardian highlights growing pressure on Israel to negotiate for the release of more than 200 hostages held by Hamas in Gaza before an expected ground assault. Families of the hostages have reportedly pleaded with officials to 'free their loved ones.' Continuing coverage of the Israel-Gaza conflict, the Financial Times reports the United States is sending additional air defenses to the Middle East as regional tensions mount. US Defence Secretary Lloyd Austin is quoted expressing concern about the risk of conflict escalation. The i newspaper also covers the Home Secretary, this time reporting that civil servants have labeled her Rwanda scheme 'absurd.' The Daily Mirror pays tribute to football legend Sir Bobby Charlton, quoting his younger brother, who said Charlton would now be reunited with their brother Jack, who died in 2020.

article_content: A major new plan to stage a Formula One race in the heart of London is being showcased to the public. The proposed 3.2-mile route would bring F1 cars roaring past iconic sites such as Buckingham Palace, Nelson’s Column, and Piccadilly Circus. British drivers Lewis Hamilton and Jenson Button are expected to be involved, potentially assisting with track design. Formula One CEO Bernie Ecclestone has reportedly agreed to spend over £35 million to make the London Grand Prix happen. Organizers predict up to 120,000 spectators, with anticipated revenues reaching £100 million through ticket sales and tourism. Ecclestone claims this event could eclipse the prestige of the storied Monaco Grand Prix, offering enormous benefits to both the city and the nation. London Mayor Boris Johnson gave tentative approval, contingent upon resolving concerns about air quality and noise. At the launch of a new Thames cable car system, Johnson welcomed ideas that foster job creation and economic development, but insisted environmental impacts must be properly addressed. Santander, the bank sponsoring the British GP at Silverstone, proposed the idea. The new London race would run in addition to, rather than instead of, Silverstone’s event.  Santander spokesperson Nav Sidhu pointed to London’s proven ability to host major occasions—from marathons to large-scale concerts—as evidence of the city’s suitability. Sidhu acknowledged logistical challenges but expressed confidence they can be managed. The initial route would begin on The Mall by Buckingham Palace, loop past St James’s Palace, head towards the Ritz Hotel, and include high-speed stretches along Piccadilly and Park Lane. The circuit would also pass Birdcage Walk, Parliament Square, the Embankment, Trafalgar Square, and Admiralty Arch before looping back to the starting point. Event industry analysts like Nigel Currie of Brand-Rapport believe the race could bring in far more than early estimates, predicting significant commercial rewards and renewed excitement for major city events. While a different group has suggested a similar race around the Olympic Park, Ecclestone clarified he’s not linked to that proposal. The envisioned London Grand Prix would likely occur in summer, helping to create a vibrant, festival-like atmosphere and draw massive crowds.

De britiske kørere Lewis Hamilton og Jenson Button forventes at deltage og muligvis bidrage til banelayoutet. Formel 1's direktør Bernie Ecclestone har ifølge oplysninger accepteret at investere over 35 millioner pund for at gøre London Grand Prix til virkelighed. Arrangørerne forventer op til 120.000 tilskuere, og indtægterne anslås til 100 millioner pund fra billetsalg og turisme. Ecclestone mener, at løbet kan overgå det berømte Monaco Grand Prix og give enorme fordele for både byen og landet. Londons borgmester Boris Johnson har givet foreløbigt grønt lys, forudsat at problemer med luftkvalitet og støj løses. Ved åbningen af et nyt svævebanesystem over Themsen roste Johnson idéer, der skaber jobs og vækst, men understregede vigtigheden af at tage hensyn til miljøet. Initiativet kommer fra banken Santander, der også sponserer det britiske Grand Prix på Silverstone. Løbet i London skal supplere Silverstone, ikke erstatte det. Santanders talsmand Nav Sidhu fremhævede Londons erfaring med store events, fra maratonløb til kæmpekoncerter, som bevis for byens egnethed. Selvom der er logistiske udfordringer, er Sidhu overbevist om, at de vil blive løst. Ruten starter ved The Mall ved Buckingham Palace, fortsætter forbi St James’s Palace og Ritz Hotel og inkluderer hurtige strækninger på Piccadilly og Park Lane. Den går også forbi Birdcage Walk, Parliament Square, Embankment, Trafalgar Square og Admiralty Arch, før den slutter ved startpunktet. Sportsindustry-eksperter som Nigel Currie fra Brand-Rapport forudser, at løbet kan indbringe endnu mere end de første skøn og skabe stor kommerciel gevinst og begejstring for store events i London. article_content: Tottenham Hotspur faces UEFA sanctions after multiple pitch invasions disrupted Thursday’s Europa League match against Partizan Belgrade at White Hart Lane. The three men arrested for running onto the pitch – Dan Jarvis, Gomes Garcia, and Nathan Brown – are believed to be members of TrollStation, a group known for viral internet pranks. All three wore 'BassBuds' t-shirts during the incident. Mauricio Pochettino’s side secured a 1-0 victory, with Benjamin Stambouli scoring the winning goal to clinch a place in the knockout rounds. The game was interrupted three times in the first half, resulting in a suspension of play for nearly ten minutes. Roberto Soldado reacted angrily to one pitch invader, ripping off the individual's shirt, while Mousa Dembele attempted to detain another. UEFA stated their Control, Ethics, and Disciplinary Body would evaluate charges against Tottenham on December 11. Punishments for pitch invasions could range from warnings and fines to points deductions, though a substantial fine appears most likely. After spending Thursday night in police custody, the three men were identified as serial pranksters associated with TrollStation. Their previous pranks include staging a strip club on the London Underground and faking a kidnapping. TrollStation uploaded a video on YouTube of Thursday’s prank, featuring the trio introducing themselves and announcing their intention to see who could remain on the pitch the longest. BassBuds, which provides football-branded merchandise and advertises on Tottenham’s website, released a statement distancing itself from the pitch invasion. In response, Tottenham ended its official association with the brand. UEFA confirmed that Mousa Dembele and Roberto Soldado would not face disciplinary action for their efforts to subdue the invaders. Looking ahead to Tottenham’s Premier League match against Everton, Harry Kane emphasized the need to address the team’s struggles following Europa League fixtures. Spurs have often faltered at home after European matches, with Harry Kane stressing there would be 'no excuse' against Everton, who also played on Thursday. For Everton, goalkeeper Tim Howard expressed confidence in targeting a Champions League position, noting that the team is stronger than when it finished fifth last season. Everton’s 2-0 victory over Wolfsburg secured their spot in the Europa League knockout stage but came at the cost of several injuries, including James McCarthy, John Stones, Steven Naismith, Antolin Alcaraz, Gareth Barry, Leighton Baines, Bryan Oviedo, Darron Gibson, and Steven Pienaar.

Alle tre bar 'BassBuds'-t-shirts under hændelsen. Mauricio Pochettinos hold sikrede sig en 1-0-sejr, hvor Benjamin Stambouli scorede det afgørende mål og dermed sikrede plads i knockout-runden. Roberto Soldado reagerede vredt på en af banestormerne og rev personens trøje af, mens Mousa Dembele forsøgte at holde en anden tilbage. UEFA oplyste, at deres Control, Ethics and Disciplinary Body vil behandle sagen mod Tottenham den 11. december. Sanktioner for banestormeri kan variere fra advarsler og bøder til pointfradrag, men en større bøde virker mest sandsynlig. Efter at have tilbragt torsdagen i politiets varetægt blev de tre mænd identificeret som serie-prankstere fra TrollStation. Tidligere pranks omfatter blandt andet at lave en strippklub i London Underground og iscenesætte en fiktiv kidnapning. TrollStation lagde en video op på YouTube fra torsdagens prank, hvor trioen præsenterer sig selv og forklarer, at de vil se, hvem der kan blive længst på banen. BassBuds, som leverer fodbold-brandede produkter og reklamerer på Tottenhams hjemmeside, udsendte en erklæring, hvor de tager afstand fra hændelsen. Tottenham besluttede i forlængelse heraf at afslutte deres officielle samarbejde med virksomheden. UEFA bekræftede, at Mousa Dembele og Roberto Soldado ikke vil blive disciplineret for deres forsøg på at stoppe banestormerne. Evertons 2-0-sejr over Wolfsburg sikrede dem videre avancement i Europa League, men det kostede flere skader, heriblandt James McCarthy, John Stones, Steven Naismith, Antolin Alcaraz, Gareth Barry, Leighton Baines, Bryan Oviedo, Darron Gibson og Steven Pienaar.

NEW DELHI: As India’s Cricket World Cup campaign drew to a close with a hard-fought loss to Australia in the final, prominent Bollywood figures such as Ajay Devgn, Suniel Shetty, and Ayushmann Khurrana took to social media to praise the Indian cricket team's unwavering efforts throughout the tournament.

In the much-anticipated CWC 2023 final held in Ahmedabad on Sunday, the undefeated Indian side ultimately fell to a formidable Australian team, losing by six wickets. Despite the defeat, India’s performance was widely commended, having maintained an unbeaten streak until the final.

Ajay Devgn posted on X, “India, your relentless spirit throughout the championship was a victory in itself… Heads high.”

Suniel Shetty, who is also KL Rahul’s father-in-law, congratulated Australia and lauded the Indian squad for their world-class performance, saying, “Congratulations to Australia on their World Cup Final victory! One bad day for #MyTeamIndia. Let’s not lose sight of the force this #TeamIndia has been—winning 10 matches in a row! Truly a world-class team with outstanding performances from both batsmen and bowlers. I am truly proud of the effort, determination, and sportsmanship displayed. Heads held high, always.”

Ayushmann Khurrana, who watched the match live at Narendra Modi Stadium, expressed his gratitude to the Indian team for an exciting tournament: “Just a bad day at the office for Team India. You guys will always be remembered as the toughest side of #WorldCup2023. Thank you for the adrenaline! Well played!”

Abhishek Bachchan praised the team’s effort, writing, “A tough loss after a valiant effort. Commendable performance by the men in blue throughout. Hold your heads high and thank you for the journey. #TeamIndia #CWC23”

Richa Chadha simply stated, “Well played still,” on social media.

Dia Mirza reflected on the campaign by sharing, “Team #India, you gave us the most memorable moments in the past few weeks. Thank you so much! Congratulations on a well-played #WorldCup. We are proud of you. Congratulations #Australia for winning your 6th World Cup! You played your best game. #CWC2023Final #Worldcupfinal2023.”

Comedian Vir Das offered words of support: “Thank you for a tournament filled with spectacular cricket. Team India, proud of you!”

NEW DELHI: Da Indiens VM-rejse sluttede med et hårdt kæmpet nederlag til Australien i finalen, brugte store Bollywood-stjerner såsom Ajay Devgn, Suniel Shetty og Ayushmann Khurrana de sociale medier til at hylde det indiske cricketlandsholds urokkelige indsats gennem hele turneringen.

I den længe ventede CWC 2023-finale i Ahmedabad søndag tabte det hidtil ubesejrede indiske hold til et stærkt australsk mandskab med seks wickets. På trods af nederlaget blev Indiens præstation bredt rost, da de havde været ubesejrede indtil finalen.

Ajay Devgn skrev på X: “Indien, din utrættelige vilje gennem hele mesterskabet var en sejr i sig selv… Hovederne op.”

Suniel Shetty, som også er svigerfar til KL Rahul, lykønskede Australien og roste det indiske hold for en verdensklassepræstation: “Tillykke til Australien med sejren i VM-finalen! article_content: Sushil Modi, a BJP Rajya Sabha member and former deputy chief minister, has alleged that Bihar's revised 2024 school holiday calendar removes holidays for Hindu festivals such as Ram Navami and Janmashtami, while increasing closures for Muslim festivals. The Bihar Education Department released its academic holiday calendar for 2024, structured to comply with the Right to Education Act's requirement for 220 teaching days. The opposition BJP has criticized the Nitish Kumar-led government for these proposed changes, accusing it of disregarding Hindu festivals. Modi further claimed that some schools in Muslim-majority areas receive weekly holidays on Fridays, whereas Hindu festivals like Raksha Bandhan, Maha Shivaratri, and Anant Chaturdashi are not recognized as holidays. He accused Chief Minister Nitish Kumar and his allies of trying to divide the Hindu community along caste lines and favor Muslims. During Eid-ul-Fitr and Eid-al-Adha, schools will observe a three-day closure. Meanwhile, holidays for Hartalika Teej and Jitiya have reportedly been dropped, and festivals like Rakshabandhan, Saraswati Puja, Janmashtami, Ram Navami, Bhaidooj, and Shivratri do not appear on the new calendar. Leaders from the ruling Mahagathbandhan coalition criticized the BJP for misrepresenting the issue, noting that the coalition did not endorse these decisions and has called for revisions. Ashok Chaudhary, former education minister (JD-U), stated the department should have respected traditions and expressed confidence that Chief Minister Nitish Kumar would address concerns. A similar reduction in holidays announced in August was previously reversed after teacher protests. Union Minister Nityanand Rai described the move as a 'well-planned conspiracy to drive the state towards Islamisation.' Shakti Yadav (RJD) suggested reconsidering a holiday for Raksha Bandhan and clarified that holidays for Dussehra, Diwali, Holi, and Chhath remain unaffected. As debate continues, the government’s response and possible amendments are awaited.
translated_content: Sushil Modi, BJP's Rajya Sabha-medlem og tidligere vicechefminister, har påstået, at Bihars reviderede feriekalender for skolerne i 2024 fjerner helligdage for hinduistiske festivaler som Ram Navami og Janmashtami, mens lukkedage for muslimske festivaler øges. Bihars uddannelsesministerium har offentliggjort skolernes feriekalender for 2024, som er tilpasset kravene i loven om ret til uddannelse om 220 undervisningsdage. Oppositionspartiet BJP har kritiseret Nitish Kumar-regeringen for disse foreslåede ændringer og anklaget den for at negligere hinduistiske festivaler. Modi hævder yderligere, at nogle skoler i områder med muslimsk flertal får ugentlige fridage om fredagen, mens hinduistiske festivaler som Raksha Bandhan, Maha Shivaratri og Anant Chaturdashi ikke anerkendes som fridage. Han beskylder chefminister Nitish Kumar og hans allierede for at forsøge at splitte det hinduistiske samfund på grundlag af kaste og favorisere muslimer. Under Eid-ul-Fitr og Eid-al-Adha vil skolerne være lukket i tre dage. Samtidig er ferier for Hartalika Teej og Jitiya angiveligt blevet fjernet, og festivaler som Rakshabandhan, Saraswati Puja, Janmashtami, Ram Navami, Bhaidooj og Shivratri optræder ikke på den nye kalender. Ledende medlemmer af den regerende Mahagathbandhan-koalition har kritiseret BJP for at forvride sagen, og bemærker, at koalitionen ikke har godkendt disse beslutninger og har opfordret til revision. Ashok Chaudhary, tidligere uddannelsesminister (JD-U), udtalte, at ministeriet burde have respekteret traditionerne og udtrykte tillid til, at chefminister Nitish Kumar ville tage hånd om bekymringerne. En lignende reduktion i ferier, som blev annonceret i august, blev tidligere trukket tilbage efter protester fra lærere. Unionens minister Nityanand Rai kaldte initiativet en 'velplanlagt sammensværgelse for at gøre staten mere islamisk'. Shakti Yadav (RJD) foreslog at genoverveje en fridag for Raksha Bandhan og præciserede, at ferier for Dussehra, Diwali, Holi og Chhath forbliver urørte. Mens debatten fortsætter, afventes regeringens svar og eventuelle ændringer.

article_content: Bafétimbi Gomis scored his first goal for Swansea City as they continued their preparations for the upcoming Premier League season with a 2-0 victory over Exeter City. Following their 4-0 win against Plymouth on Sunday, the Swans concluded their pre-season tour in Devon with a win against the League Two side. Exeter started brightly, as Tom Nichols narrowly missed an early chance, heading over from close range after a Craig Woodman cross in the ninth minute. Swansea took the lead in the 31st minute when Neil Taylor set up Gomis, who headed home from close range to open his account for the Swans. The hosts nearly equalized before halftime when Arron Davies's cross found David Wheeler, who flicked the ball onto the bar. Just before the break, Jefferson Montero set up Gomis again, but his shot hit the post, and Swansea went into halftime with a narrow lead. Exeter, fielding a young team, continued to impress in the second half, but Dwight Tiendalli made crucial defensive interventions to keep them at bay. The match was settled in the 78th minute when Josh Sheehan finished from close range after an assist from substitute Wilfried Bony. Bony came close to adding a third goal in injury time, but his header was cleared off the line by Aaron Dawson. Attendance at St James Park was 2,274, including 375 travelling Swansea fans.
translated_content: Bafétimbi Gomis scorede sit første mål for Swansea City, da holdet fortsatte forberedelserne til den kommende Premier League-sæson med en 2-0 sejr over Exeter City. Efter deres 4-0 sejr mod Plymouth søndag sluttede The Swans deres pre-season-turné i Devon af med en sejr over League Two-holdet. Exeter startede stærkt, da Tom Nichols var tæt på scoring tidligt, men han headede over fra tæt hold efter et indlæg fra Craig Woodman i niende minut. Swansea kom foran i det 31. minut, da Neil Taylor fandt Gomis, som headede bolden ind fra tæt hold og dermed åbnede for målscoringen for The Swans. Værterne var tæt på at udligne før pausen, da Arron Davies’ indlæg fandt David Wheeler, der headede bolden på overliggeren. Lige inden pausen fandt Jefferson Montero igen Gomis i feltet, men hans skud ramte stolpen, og Swansea gik til pause med en smal føring. Exeter, der stillede med et ungt hold, gjorde god figur i anden halvleg, men Dwight Tiendalli lavede flere vigtige defensive indgreb for at holde dem fra scoring. Kampen blev afgjort i det 78. minut, da Josh Sheehan scorede fra tæt hold efter oplæg fra indskiftede Wilfried Bony. Bony var også tæt på at øge føringen i overtiden, men hans hovedstød blev reddet på stregen af Aaron Dawson. Der var 2.274 tilskuere på St James Park, hvoraf 375 var medrejsende Swansea-fans.

article_content: Contract negotiations between Hollywood actors and studios have broken down, prolonging the ongoing three-month performers' strike. Studios halted talks, claiming differences with the union were too significant to continue, even after offering what they described as a comparable deal to the writers’ recent agreement. Actors union SAG-AFTRA criticized the studios for 'bullying tactics' and misrepresenting proposals. Duncan Crabtree-Ireland, national executive director and lead negotiator for SAG-AFTRA, said on Thursday the union made significant concessions that studios failed to acknowledge. 'We’re not going to find a solution if they simply walk away,' he told the Associated Press from a Los Angeles picket line. Negotiations between SAG-AFTRA and the Alliance of Motion Picture and Television Producers (AMPTP)—representing studios and streamers—resumed on October 2 for the first time since the strike began July 14. Although writers struck a deal within days of renewed talks last month, talks with actors stalled. The studios ended negotiations after reviewing the actors’ latest proposal Wednesday. The AMPTP statement said, 'It’s clear the gap between AMPTP and SAG-AFTRA is too large, and conversations aren’t heading in a productive direction.' Studios claimed the union’s proposal would create an additional $800 million annual burden. SAG-AFTRA disputed this in a letter to members, saying the estimate was inflated by 60%. Crabtree-Ireland explained that the union entered talks with an open mind and aimed for meaningful dialogue. He said the union made counterproposals and adjusted their positions on AI and streaming revenue sharing at the studios’ insistence. Union negotiators said they were deeply disappointed by the breakdown, reporting the studios’ latest offer was even less favorable than what was proposed before the strike began. Core union demands include higher pay for streaming content and stronger protections against misused AI-generated likenesses. AMPTP insisted its contract offer was comparable to recent agreements with writers and directors. The union letter argued the companies have resisted crucial protections against AI replacement, meaningful wage increases, and equitable revenue sharing from streaming content. Crabtree-Ireland said studios were employing pressure and disrespectful negotiation tactics. 'There’s significant gaslighting. That’s no way to negotiate respectfully.' Actors and supporting writers organized pickets outside Netflix on Thursday. Union leaders, including Crabtree-Ireland, spoke to encourage the group. 'We’re all sticking together,' said long-time SAG-AFTRA member Cisco Reyes. Romel De Silva, a member since 2012, commented outside Paramount Studios, 'Despite some anger and frustration, there’s a lot of hope. Showing up daily proves we’re not backing down.' Unlike the intensive bargaining that ended the writers’ strike, actors’ talks have lacked momentum and progress, even with involvement from major studio executives. Writers also experienced stalled talks before eventually ratifying a new contract and ending their strike on September 26. Many WGA writers, including Tommy Pico, continued to support actors on the picket lines. Pico emphasized that AMPTP could end the dispute quickly. While late-night talk shows and 'Saturday Night Live' are returning, filming of scripted TV and movies remains halted until the actors' strike concludes. Crabtree-Ireland reiterated: 'Our only path forward is through dialogue. We’re ready at the table whenever they return.'
translated_content: Kontraktforhandlingerne mellem Hollywood-skuespillere og studierne er brudt sammen og forlænger dermed den igangværende tre måneder lange strejke blandt udøverne. Studierne standsede samtalerne og hævdede, at uoverensstemmelserne med fagforeningen var for store til at fortsætte, selv efter de havde tilbudt, hvad de beskrev som en tilsvarende aftale til forfatternes nylige overenskomst. Skuespillernes fagforening, SAG-AFTRA, kritiserede studierne for 'mobbetaktikker' og for at forvride fagforeningens forslag. Duncan Crabtree-Ireland, national direktør og ledende forhandler for SAG-AFTRA, fortalte torsdag, at fagforeningen havde givet betydelige indrømmelser, som studierne ikke anerkendte. 'Vi finder ikke en løsning, hvis de bare går væk,' sagde han til Associated Press fra en strejkevagt i Los Angeles. Forhandlingerne mellem SAG-AFTRA og Alliance of Motion Picture and Television Producers (AMPTP)—som repræsenterer studier og streamingtjenester—blev genoptaget 2. oktober for første gang siden strejken startede 14. juli. Selvom forfatterne lavede en aftale få dage efter at genoptage forhandlingerne i sidste måned, gik samtaler med skuespillerne i stå. Studierne afsluttede forhandlingerne efter at have gennemgået skuespillernes seneste forslag onsdag. AMPTP udtalte, at 'det står klart, at kløften mellem AMPTP og SAG-AFTRA er for stor, og samtalerne fører ikke i en produktiv retning.' Studierne påstod, at fagforeningens forslag ville medføre en ekstra byrde på 800 millioner dollars årligt. SAG-AFTRA afviste dette i et brev til medlemmerne og sagde, at tallet var oppustet med 60%. Crabtree-Ireland forklarede, at fagforeningen gik ind til samtalerne med et åbent sind og ønskede reel dialog. Han sagde, at fagforeningen kom med modforslag og justerede deres holdning til AI og streamingindtægter på studiernes opfordring. Fagforeningens forhandlere sagde, at de var dybt skuffede over sammenbruddet og rapporterede, at studiernes seneste tilbud var endnu mindre fordelagtigt end det, der blev fremsat før strejken. Hovedkravene fra fagforeningen inkluderer højere løn for streaming-indhold og stærkere beskyttelse mod misbrug af AI-genererede billeder. AMPTP fastholdt, at deres kontrakttilbud var sammenligneligt med de seneste aftaler med forfattere og instruktører. Fagforeningsbrevet hævdede, at virksomhederne har afvist væsentlige beskyttelser mod AI-udskiftning, meningsfulde lønstigninger og fair deling af indtægter fra streaming-indhold. Crabtree-Ireland sagde, at studierne brugte pres og respektløse forhandlingstaktikker. 'Der er betydelig gaslighting. Det er ikke sådan, man forhandler respektfuldt.' Skuespillere og støttende forfattere deltog torsdag i strejkevagten foran Netflix. Fagforeningsledere, herunder Crabtree-Ireland, talte for at opmuntre gruppen. 'Vi holder alle sammen,' sagde mangeårigt SAG-AFTRA-medlem Cisco Reyes. Romel De Silva, medlem siden 2012, udtalte foran Paramount Studios: 'Der er noget vrede og frustration, men også meget håb. Ved at møde op dagligt beviser vi, at vi ikke giver op.' I modsætning til de intensive forhandlinger, der afsluttede forfatterstrejken, har skuespillernes samtaler manglet fremdrift og resultater, selv med ledende studiechefer involveret. Forfatterne oplevede også stilstand før de til sidst ratificerede en ny kontrakt og afsluttede deres strejke den 26. september. Mange WGA-forfattere, inklusive Tommy Pico, fortsatte med at støtte skuespillerne på strejkevagterne. Pico understregede, at AMPTP hurtigt kunne afslutte konflikten. Mens latenight-talkshows og 'Saturday Night Live' vender tilbage, forbliver produktionen af manuskript-tv og film på pause, indtil skuespillernes strejke er slut. Crabtree-Ireland gentog: 'Den eneste vej fremad er gennem dialog. Vi er klar ved forhandlingsbordet, når de vender tilbage.'

article_content: A Delta Airlines flight from New York's JFK Airport to Tel Aviv was delayed for approximately 30 minutes after a group of ultra-Orthodox Jewish men refused to sit in their assigned seats, stating that their seats were next to female passengers. The male passengers, identified as Haredi, reportedly requested not to be seated between two women due to religious beliefs. The delay was extended when the women declined to move to accommodate the request, citing concerns about discrimination. The standoff ended when an American passenger traveling to Israel volunteered to switch seats. According to Israel Radio, this allowed the flight to continue. In ultra-Orthodox Jewish tradition, men typically avoid physical contact with women who are not close relatives or their spouse. Similar situations have occurred before. In September, passengers on an El Al flight from New York experienced a delay when Haredi men refused to sit next to women, and some reportedly offered compensation for others to swap seats. On that occasion, the flight crew informed passengers that changing seats was not mandatory, but the captain announced that the flight would not depart until all passengers were seated. Onboard accounts described passengers standing in the aisles, which contributed to the delay. Following similar incidents, El Al stated it would investigate complaints and take appropriate action if passengers were found to have acted improperly. After one such flight, Chicago-based passenger Sharon Shapiro started a petition calling for an end to practices she described as discriminatory toward women. MailOnline has contacted Delta Airlines for comment about the delay to flight 468 on December 20.
translated_content: Et Delta Airlines-fly fra JFK-lufthavnen i New York til Tel Aviv blev forsinket i cirka 30 minutter, efter at en gruppe ultraortodokse jødiske mænd nægtede at sidde på deres tildelte pladser, fordi de var placeret ved siden af kvindelige passagerer. De mandlige passagerer, identificeret som haredim, ønskede ikke at sidde mellem to kvinder af religiøse årsager. Forsinkelsen blev forlænget, da kvinderne afslog at flytte sig for at imødekomme ønsket, med henvisning til bekymringer om diskrimination. Konflikten blev løst, da en amerikansk passager på vej til Israel tilbød at bytte plads. Ifølge Israel Radio gjorde dette det muligt for flyet at fortsætte. I ultraortodoks jødedom forsøger mænd typisk at undgå fysisk kontakt med kvinder, der ikke er nære slægtninge eller ægtefæller. Lignende situationer er sket før. I september oplevede passagerer på en El Al-flyvning fra New York en forsinkelse, da harediske mænd nægtede at sidde ved siden af kvinder, og nogle angiveligt tilbød kompensation for at bytte plads. Ved den lejlighed oplyste kabinepersonalet, at det ikke var obligatorisk at bytte pladser, men kaptajnen meddelte, at flyet ikke ville afgå, før alle passagerer sad ned. Passagerer beskrev, at nogle stod i midtergangen, hvilket bidrog til forsinkelsen. Efter lignende hændelser har El Al udtalt, at de vil undersøge klager og tage passende handling, hvis nogle passagerer har handlet upassende. Efter en sådan flyvning startede den Chicago-baserede Sharon Shapiro en underskriftsindsamling for at stoppe praksisser, hun beskrev som diskrimination mod kvinder. MailOnline har kontaktet Delta Airlines for en kommentar om forsinkelsen på fly 468 den 20. december.

article_content:
Ukrainian protesters have vacated Kiev's city hall after nearly three months of occupation, following an agreement with the government to drop charges against those arrested during the demonstrations. According to opposition parliament member Arsen Avakov, protesters also unblocked a main street and left other government buildings as part of the amnesty deal, which required the opposition to vacate government properties in the capital. While protesters have left the buildings, they will remain outside city hall and prevent police from entering, Avakov stated. The opposition plans to hold a rally on Sunday morning.

Ukraine remains in the midst of a political crisis that has already resulted in the resignation of the Prime Minister. Since November, thousands of demonstrators have gathered in Kiev's Independence Square after President Viktor Yanukovych reversed his decision to sign a trade agreement with the European Union, opting instead to strengthen ties with Russia. Tensions escalated following the recent passage of a controversial anti-protest law, leading to violent clashes and a persistent standoff. Despite government concessions, Ukraine's opposition parties continue to call for constitutional reforms that would reduce presidential powers.

Ukraine, a nation of 45 million people, is sharply divided between pro-European western regions and a more Russia-leaning east. President Yanukovych and Russian President Vladimir Putin have agreed on a $15 billion package for Russia to purchase Ukrainian debt and lower natural gas prices. Yanukovych has resisted calls for his resignation and has defended the government's response to the ongoing crisis.
translated_content:
Ukrainske demonstranter har forladt rådhuset i Kiev efter næsten tre måneders besættelse, efter at have indgået en aftale med regeringen om at frafalde sigtelser mod de demonstranter, der blev anholdt. Ifølge oppositionsparlamentarikeren Arsen Avakov har demonstranterne også åbnet en hovedgade og forladt andre regeringsbygninger som del af amnestiaftalen, der krævede, at oppositionen forlod statslige bygninger i hovedstaden. Selvom de har forladt bygningerne, vil demonstranterne blive udenfor rådhuset og nægte politiet adgang, oplyser Avakov. Oppositionen planlægger en demonstration søndag morgen.

Ukraine står midt i en politisk krise, der allerede har ført til, at premierministeren er trådt tilbage. Siden november har tusindvis af demonstranter samlet sig på Frihedspladsen i Kiev, efter præsident Viktor Janukovitj trak sig fra en handelsaftale med EU og i stedet vendte sig mod Rusland. Spændingerne er steget i kølvandet på en kontroversiel anti-demonstrationslov, hvilket har ført til voldelige sammenstød og en uløst konflikt. Trods regeringens indrømmelser kræver oppositionen fortsat forfatningsændringer, som vil mindske præsidentens magt.

Ukraine, med 45 millioner indbyggere, er stærkt delt mellem pro-europæiske regioner i vest og øst, som har tætte forbindelser til Rusland. Præsident Janukovitj og den russiske præsident Vladimir Putin har indgået en aftale om, at Rusland skal købe ukrainsk gæld for 15 milliarder dollar og sænke gasprisen. Janukovitj afviser dog at træde tilbage og forsvarer regeringens håndtering af krisen.

article_content:
Portugal secured a commanding 5-0 victory against Bosnia and Herzegovina in Euro 2024 qualifying, preserving their perfect record under head coach Roberto Martinez. Cristiano Ronaldo contributed two goals, pushing his world record to 127 international goals. Teammates Bruno Fernandes, Joao Cancelo, and Joao Felix rounded out the first-half scoring, taking advantage of Bosnia's defensive struggles.

This win, following an earlier success over Slovakia, cements Portugal's spot at the Euro 2024 tournament in Germany, with eight wins from eight matches. Bosnia, led by Edin Dzeko, now sit in fifth place in Group J and are out of contention after Slovakia’s victory against Luxembourg. Bosnia trail second place by seven points, with only two matches remaining.

Portugal’s campaign has been dominant, tallying 32 goals while conceding only twice and collecting the maximum possible points. Al-Nassr forward Ronaldo, aged 38, opened the scoring from the penalty spot and netted another before being substituted after 65 minutes. An enthusiastic fan entered the pitch before halftime to approach Ronaldo, but was quickly handled by security staff.

Bosnia’s defense improved marginally in the second half, yet Portugal’s first-half supremacy left no doubt about the outcome.
translated_content:
Portugal sikrede sig en overbevisende 5-0-sejr over Bosnien-Hercegovina i EM 2024-kvalifikationen og bevarer dermed deres perfekte rekord under cheftræner Roberto Martinez. Cristiano Ronaldo bidrog med to mål, hvilket øgede hans verdensrekord til 127 landsholdsmål. Holdkammeraterne Bruno Fernandes, Joao Cancelo og Joao Felix fuldendte første halvlegs scoringer, da de udnyttede Bosniens defensive problemer.

Denne sejr, sammen med en tidligere triumf over Slovakiet, sikrer Portugals plads ved EM 2024 i Tyskland med otte sejre i otte kampe. Bosnien, anført af Edin Dzeko, ligger nu på femtepladsen i gruppe J og er ude af muligheden for kvalifikation efter Slovakiets sejr mod Luxembourg. Bosnien er syv point efter andenpladsen med kun to kampe tilbage.

Portugals kampagne har været yderst dominerende, med 32 mål og kun to indkasserede samt maksimum point. Al-Nassr-spilleren Ronaldo, nu 38 år, åbnede scoringen på straffe og lavede endnu et mål, før han blev udskiftet efter 65 minutter. En ivrig fan løb ind på banen før pausen for at hilse på Ronaldo, men blev hurtigt fjernet af sikkerheden.

Bosniens forsvar blev noget stærkere i anden halvleg, men Portugals overlegenhed fra første halvleg gjorde udfaldet uundgåeligt.

The low-cut tuxedo trend, often styled without anything worn underneath, is seeing a resurgence among female celebrities on high-profile red carpets. This daring look, which first gained major attention six years ago thanks to Kate Moss and Victoria Beckham, was notably worn by Rihanna and Emma Watson at the recent British Fashion Awards. Other stars embracing the style include Cara Delevingne, Jennifer Lawrence, Rosie Huntington-Whiteley, Suki Waterhouse, Gwyneth Paltrow, and Miley Cyrus.

Celebrities style the trend in various ways: Rihanna, for example, chose a Stella McCartney jacket accessorized only with jewelry and a handbag, while others, like Cara Delevingne and Suki Waterhouse, have preferred to wear full tuxedo ensembles. At the awards ceremony, Emma Watson paired her Dior tuxedo jacket with a Misha Nonoo jumpsuit for a more modest take.

Cara Delevingne, who accepted the Model of the Year award at the event, is known for frequently wearing tuxedo-inspired outfits, especially Burberry’s distinctive designs. She has been seen in a burgundy tuxedo at Harvey Weinstein's pre-BAFTA party, and a blue tuxedo at Burberry's London Fashion Week show. J.Crew’s executive creative director Jenna Lyons is also an advocate of the trend.

The tuxedo look has been showcased in other recent appearances, including Jennifer Lawrence’s black Dior tuxedo dress at the BFI London Film Festival, Rosie Huntington-Whiteley's zebra-print jacket at Paris Fashion Week, and Gwyneth Paltrow’s Tom Ford tuxedo at the amfAR LA Inspiration Gala.

The edgy, low-cut tuxedo has long attracted attention among influential figures in fashion, including Victoria Beckham, who previously wore a sequined tuxedo jacket to Robert Cavalli's 2008 Milan Men's Fashion Week show. Similarly, Miley Cyrus made headlines in a white Jean Paul Gaultier tuxedo dress at the 2012 American Music Awards.

However, the trend is not without pitfalls. In 2009, Kate Moss suffered a wardrobe malfunction in a Yves Saint Laurent tuxedo after leaving Sir Phillip Green’s birthday party. This highlights both the boldness and risks involved in embracing the low-cut tuxedo trend.

article_content: During a phone conversation on Monday, Iranian President Ebrahim Raisi urged Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi to use India's influence to help end Israeli military operations in Gaza, according to the Iranian news agency IRNA. Raisi highlighted India’s history of anti-colonial struggle and its role as a founding member of the Non-Aligned Movement, expressing that India is expected to leverage its position to halt Israeli actions against the people of Gaza. Raisi also reiterated Iran's support for any joint international efforts that would bring about an immediate ceasefire, lift the blockade, and deliver humanitarian aid to Gaza. He warned that continued violence could lead to wider regional consequences. Iran's ambassador to India, Iraj Elahi, was quoted by The Economic Times as saying that India, as a voice of the Global South and a nation inspired by Mahatma Gandhi's principles, has the moral standing and leadership to advocate for peace in Gaza. President Raisi also described relations between Iran and India as strategic and called for plans to deepen cooperation. During their discussion, Prime Minister Modi stressed the importance of avoiding escalation, ensuring the flow of humanitarian assistance, and working towards the early restoration of peace and stability in the region. Both leaders welcomed progress in bilateral cooperation, including collaboration on the Chabahar port project.

Raisi fremhævede Indiens historie med antikoloniale kampe og dets rolle som grundlægger af Den Alliancefri Bevægelse og udtrykte, at Indien forventes at udnytte sin position til at stoppe de israelske handlinger mod Gazas befolkning. Raisi gentog også Irans støtte til alle fælles internationale tiltag, der kan skabe øjeblikkelig våbenhvile, ophævelse af blokaden og levering af humanitær hjælp til Gaza. Han advarede om, at fortsat vold kan føre til større regionale konsekvenser. Irans ambassadør i Indien, Iraj Elahi, udtalte til The Economic Times, at Indien, som én af det Globale Syds stemmer og inspireret af Mahatma Gandhis principper, har en særlig moralsk autoritet og lederskab til at tale for fred i Gaza. Præsident Raisi beskrev også forholdet mellem Iran og Indien som strategisk og opfordrede til at planlægge for dybere samarbejde. Under samtalen fremhævede premierminister Modi vigtigheden af at undgå eskalering, sikre fortsat humanitær hjælp og arbejde for hurtig genetablering af fred og stabilitet i regionen. Begge ledere glædede sig over fremskridt i det bilaterale samarbejde, herunder projektsamarbejdet om Chabahar-havnen.

article_content: Canara Bank customers can now credit their Public Provident Fund (PPF) and Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) accounts held at Canara Bank using the National Electronic Fund Transfer (NEFT) facility to send contributions from any other bank. Previously, contributions to PPF or SSY accounts at Canara Bank could only be made via a linked Canara Bank savings account, according to the bank. PPF and SSY are small savings schemes launched by the Ministry of Finance, Government of India. They help individuals build a corpus over time, offering tax-free returns under the Exempt-Exempt-Exempt (EEE) category, which means the principal, interest, and maturity amounts are tax-free. How to contribute via NEFT: Customers can transfer funds from any other bank to their PPF or SSY accounts at Canara Bank by using the respective account number and the IFSC code CNRB0001953. PPF Details: Indian citizens aged 18 or older can open a PPF account through Internet Banking, the Canara Bank Mobile Banking App, or by visiting a branch. The account matures after 15 years, with extensions available in five-year blocks. The current PPF interest rate is 7.1% for this quarter. SSY Details: The account can be opened in the name of a girl child up to 10 years old by a natural or legal guardian. Accounts can be opened for up to two girl children (or three in the case of twins). Minimum deposit is Rs. 1,000, maximum Rs. 1.5 lakh per financial year. Deposits can be made for 14 years, with maturity 21 years after account opening. After the child turns 18, up to 50% of the balance at the end of the previous financial year can be withdrawn for education or marriage. Withdrawals: Only permitted after the account completes 21 years, with partial withdrawals allowed after age 18, as mentioned above. Recent Business Highlights: India's FMCG sales rose by 9% in value and 8.6% in volume during the September quarter, according to NielsenIQ, with rural demand driving growth. Snap Inc., the parent company of Snapchat, doubled its Indian user base to 200 million within a year, driven by increased adoption of new features. The finance ministry is considering slowing capital expenditure growth in the interim budget for FY25 to meet fiscal consolidation goals.

Tidligere kunne bidrag til PPF- eller SSY-konti i Canara Bank kun ske fra en tilknyttet Canara Bank opsparingskonto, ifølge banken. PPF og SSY er små opsparingsordninger startet af Finansministeriet i Indiens regering. Seneste forretning: Indiens FMCG-salg steg med 9% i værdi og 8,6% i volumen i september kvartalet ifølge NielsenIQ, især på grund af øget efterspørgsel fra landområder. Honasa Consumer, the parent company of Mamaearth, made its stock market debut on Tuesday, listing at a 2% premium over its issue price. The stock opened at Rs 330 on the National Stock Exchange, compared to its IPO price of Rs 324. On the Bombay Stock Exchange, it debuted at Rs 324. The IPO had closed on Thursday, receiving bids 7.61 times the shares available, with qualified institutional buyers making a final-day push, subscribing for 11.5 times their allotment. Retail investors subscribed 1.35 times.

The Indian startup community responded enthusiastically to Honasa Consumer’s listing. Kunal Bahl, cofounder of Snapdeal and Titan Capital—an early investor in Mamaearth—used X (formerly Twitter) to celebrate founders Varun Alagh and Ghazal Alagh. Bahl praised them for inspiring entrepreneurs, while his cofounder Rohit Bansal and other investors like Rahul Chowdhri of Stellaris Venture Partners echoed similar sentiments. Leap.club cofounder Ragini Das and Atomberg's Arindam Paul also offered congratulations, highlighting the milestone for D2C brands and women founders.

In other business updates: India's packaged consumer goods sector grew by 9% in value and 8.6% in volume during the September quarter compared to the previous year, driven by increased rural spending, according to NielsenIQ. Meanwhile, Snap Inc. (parent of Snapchat) reported doubling its user base in India to 200 million in a year, fueled by new app features.

Additionally, the Indian Ministry of Finance may slow the pace of capital spending growth to align with fiscal consolidation targets in the upcoming interim budget.

article_content: Former health secretary Matt Hancock expressed that he wanted to decide 'who should live and die' if the NHS became overwhelmed during the pandemic, according to testimony at the Covid inquiry. This information came from evidence given by Sir Simon Stevens, the former chief of NHS England. In his statement, Sir Simon said Mr Hancock believed that he, rather than doctors or the public, should ultimately make prioritization decisions if hospitals faced extreme pressure. Sir Simon added, 'Fortunately, this terrible dilemma never actually occurred.' Sir Simon further explained that he wanted to discourage the idea that the secretary of state—except in the most exceptional cases—should decide how care was provided. 'I felt we were well-served by the medical profession, in consultation with patients wherever possible, in making those decisions,' he explained. In addition, Sir Simon rejected then-Prime Minister Boris Johnson's suggestion that it was 'very frustrating' to enter lockdown because the NHS and social care sectors had not solved the longstanding problem of delayed discharges, where patients stay in hospital despite being medically ready to leave due to insufficient community support. Johnson claimed about 30% of beds were occupied by such patients. Sir Simon countered that this would equate to approximately 30,000 beds, but that in a reasonable worst-case scenario, up to 200,000 or even 800,000 patients could have required hospitalization. 'Even if all of those 30,000 beds were made available, for every one coronavirus patient admitted, there would have been another five needing care who unfortunately could not receive it,' he said. 'So, I do not think that is a fair summary of the rationale for the first wave decisions.'
translated_content: Tidligere sundhedsminister Matt Hancock udtrykte, at han ønskede at afgøre 'hvem der skulle leve og dø', hvis NHS blev overvældet under pandemien, ifølge vidneudsagn i Covid-undersøgelsen. Oplysningen kom fra Sir Simon Stevens, den tidligere chef for NHS England. I sin forklaring sagde Sir Simon, at Hancock mente, at det skulle være ham og ikke lægerne eller offentligheden, der i sidste ende traf beslutningerne om, hvem der skulle prioriteres, hvis sygehusene blev sat under ekstremt pres. Sir Simon tilføjede: 'Heldigvis opstod dette frygtelige dilemma aldrig i virkeligheden.' Sir Simon forklarede yderligere, at han gerne ville fraråde idéen om, at en sundhedsminister – bortset fra i de mest ekstraordinære situationer – skulle beslutte, hvordan plejen skulle gives. 'Jeg mente, at vi blev godt tjent af det medicinske personale, i samarbejde med patienterne, så vidt muligt, til at træffe de beslutninger,' forklarede han. Derudover afviste Sir Simon daværende premierminister Boris Johnsons påstand om, at det var 'meget frustrerende' at blive tvunget til nedlukning, fordi NHS og socialsektoren ikke havde løst det mangeårige problem med forsinkede udskrivninger, hvor patienter bliver på hospitalet, selvom de er klar til at tage hjem, på grund af manglende støtte i lokalsamfundet. Johnson hævdede, at omkring 30% af sengepladserne var optaget af sådanne patienter. Sir Simon svarede, at dette ville svare til cirka 30.000 senge, men at der i det rimelige værst tænkelige scenarie kunne have været op til 200.000 eller endda 800.000 patienter, der havde brug for indlæggelse. 'Selv hvis alle de 30.000 senge blev frigjort, ville der for hver coronavirussmitte, der blev indlagt, have været fem andre patienter, der desværre ikke kunne få den pleje, de havde brug for,' sagde han. 'Så jeg synes ikke, det er en retfærdig beskrivelse af beslutningsgrundlaget i den første bølge.'

article_content: The National Guard was called in to help evacuate hundreds of patients and staff from New York's Bellevue Hospital on Wednesday, as the flooded medical center in Manhattan struggled to function amid an ongoing power outage. Bellevue Hospital lost power when Hurricane Sandy struck on Monday. The facility relied on generators, and members of the Army National Guard carried fuel up to the hospital's roof throughout the week to keep the generators running. On Wednesday, a chaotic rescue took place as medical staff carried infants down stairwells and soldiers moved patients on gurneys. According to local media reports, the strong smell of fuel filled the air, and emergency lights provided intermittent illumination during the evacuation. Hundreds of patients and staff were evacuated from Bellevue Hospital as the facility struggled with the blackout that continued through much of New York City. The most critical patients were transferred to nearby medical centers, while others were discharged. A Bellevue nurse described the conditions as 'Katrina-esque' to ABC News. According to New York Governor Andrew Cuomo, 150 members of the National Guard assisted with the evacuation, focusing on moving the most critical patients to nearby hospitals. Millions of gallons of water flooded the hospital’s basement, which is located near the East River on 1st Avenue and 27th Street. Bellevue was the second hospital in Manhattan forced to evacuate patients after the storm. NYU's Langone Medical Center also had to move patients when its backup generators failed after losing electricity during the storm that struck the East Coast on Monday night.

article_content: Phoebe-Lettice Thompson, renowned for her unique style showcased on Made In Chelsea, has launched her own fashion collection. In collaboration with the London brand Illustrated People, she has unveiled a 22-piece debut line ranging from £35 to £65. The collection draws heavily from Tokyo’s energetic fashion scene, notably Harajuku street style and the playful influence of Gwen Stefani. This urban-inspired line features gingham co-ords, masculine shorts, and 90s silhouettes, combining quirky, graphic elements like eyeball motifs with soft pastel shades. Phoebe was intimately involved in every step—from designing initial concepts to personally selecting models. Rather than modeling herself, which she felt would be disingenuous, she sought out striking East London personalities she described as 'cool and tough' to represent her brand. Drawing from her background in couture and time at Tatler magazine, Phoebe emphasizes unique self-expression over conventional trends. She favors labels such as Moschino, Balmain, and Meadham Kirchhoff, and cites icons like Paris Hilton, Azealia Banks, and Angel Haze as influences. Since leaving Made In Chelsea after season six to pursue her fashion aspirations, Phoebe enjoys the creative independence of freelance work and has her sights set on launching her own label. For her, fashion acts as a powerful form of self-expression, and she seeks out rare statement pieces—reflecting her former affinity for cyber goth style, despite childhood restrictions on dyeing her hair.

Taylor Swift has expressed being "overwhelmed by grief" following the death of a 23-year-old fan just before her concert in Brazil. The fan, identified by Brazilian media as Ana Clara Benevides, collapsed at the Estádio Olímpico Nilton Santos in Rio de Janeiro before Swift’s Eras Tour performance. Benevides was revived and taken to the hospital but later died of a heart attack, according to her cousin.

Swift took to Instagram to share her sadness, posting: "I can't express how shocked I am right now. It still doesn't feel real, but we lost a fan before my show earlier tonight. I say this with a broken heart."

Friday marked the first of three Eras Tour concerts in Brazil, with upcoming dates scheduled in Buenos Aires, Argentina. Several fans voiced concern on social media about the stadium’s ban on water bottles, especially given the extreme heat during the event.
