Fanen, som brasilianske medier identificerede som Ana Clara Benevides, kollapsede ved Estádio Olímpico Nilton Santos i Rio de Janeiro lige inden Swifts Eras Tour-optræden. Benevides blev genoplivet og ført til hospitalet, men døde senere af et hjertestop, ifølge hendes fætter.

Swift delte sin sorg på Instagram og skrev: "Jeg kan ikke beskrive, hvor chokeret jeg er lige nu. Det føles stadig uvirkeligt, men vi mistede en fan inden mit show tidligere i aften. Jeg siger dette med et knust hjerte."

Fredag markerede starten på tre Eras Tour-koncerter i Brasilien, med kommende datoer planlagt i Buenos Aires, Argentina. Flere fans udtrykte bekymring på sociale medier over stadionets forbud mod vandflasker, især på grund af den ekstreme varme under arrangementet.

article_content: Britain’s leading companies saw over £30 billion wiped from their value yesterday as global stock markets experienced sharp declines. The FTSE 100 dropped by 130.64 points, or 2 percent, closing at 6417.16 in London. This decrease amounted to a £33.2 billion reduction in the worth of major UK firms, affecting millions of investors. Similar losses occurred elsewhere in Europe, with Milan’s stock market losing 940 points (4.92%) and shares in Athens dropping by 5.63%. Meanwhile, the euro hit a nine-year low against the US dollar amid growing worries about Greece’s economic future. Markets were rattled by fears that Greece could exit the eurozone. Uncertainty is mounting ahead of Greece’s snap election on January 25, where the left-wing Syriza party, which opposes the country’s £188 billion bailout agreement, is leading in opinion polls. Many fear Syriza’s rise could result in Greece abandoning the euro. Speculation that the European Central Bank may introduce more quantitative easing to prevent a recession has added to pressure on the euro. Dr Dennis Novy of the University of Warwick observed that the eurozone has struggled for years, and markets now expect a weaker euro. Der Spiegel, a German magazine, reported that Berlin sees a Greek exit as almost unavoidable if Syriza wins, a claim Germany’s government has denied. Carsten Brzeski, chief economist at ING, has warned that a Greek departure would set a worrying precedent and could destabilize the eurozone further. French President Francois Hollande stated that the ultimate decision to remain in the eurozone lies with the Greek people, stressing their right to choose their own direction. Analysts note that concerns over Greece’s potential exit have triggered widespread selling in European stock markets. Alastair McCaig of IG commented that, although a Syriza win doesn’t automatically mean a Greek exit, uncertainty is causing traders to prepare for further instability. In response to the changing economic outlook, major supermarkets such as Asda, Morrisons, Sainsbury’s, and Tesco lowered their petrol and diesel prices, with Asda capping petrol at 105.7p per litre and diesel at 112.7p.

article_content: Bill Cassidy, a Republican U.S. Congressman and Senate candidate from Louisiana, has announced that his 17-year-old daughter is expecting a baby. Cassidy and his wife, Laura Layden, a retired breast cancer surgeon, expressed their excitement about becoming grandparents this summer and emphasized their unconditional love and support for their daughter. Cassidy acknowledged the challenges his daughter may face and stressed the family's support. This announcement comes during Cassidy's campaign to unseat Democratic Senator Mary Landrieu, a three-term incumbent, in a pivotal race for Republican efforts to regain control of the Senate. Cassidy, a physician specializing in liver disease, has three children: a son and two teenage daughters. His campaign platform emphasizes a pro-life position and the protection of the unborn. Cassidy and Landrieu differ in their positions on abortion. Landrieu, a centrist Democrat, has a nuanced stance: she has voted against late-term abortion but supports access to abortion in early pregnancy and believes the government should not interfere in personal or medical decisions. Landrieu also criticized a restrictive abortion law signed by Governor Bobby Jindal. Cassidy has characterized Landrieu as a pro-choice candidate, criticizing her support for using taxpayer money for overseas abortions. He supports federal legislation banning abortions after 20 weeks of pregnancy. Cassidy describes Louisiana as a pro-life state, referencing its Catholic and evangelical population. The Cassidy campaign did not immediately respond to requests for further comment.

article_content: Public speaking is an invaluable tool for personal and professional growth, but it can be daunting, even for experienced professionals. For those new to public speaking, nerves are common, but there are effective ways to present confidently and promote your brand or company on stage. Here, 10 Young Entrepreneur Council members offer their top advice for first-time public speakers: 1. Be Well-Rehearsed: Public speaking doesn’t come naturally to everyone. Preparation is key—write your speech in a calm environment and practice it, such as by rehearsing in front of a mirror. The better you know your material, the more convincing you will be. - Vibhav Singh, XTEN-AV LLC 2. Build Anticipation With a Story: Study accomplished speakers who open with stories to engage the audience and use visuals effectively. Limit text, use large fonts, and deliver your message briefly and boldly. - Ben Landers, Blue Corona 3. Practice Exposure Therapy: Gradually face your fears by practicing, such as attending Toastmasters meetings. With continuous effort, you can transform anxiety into confidence and provide greater value to your audience. - David Henzel, Love not Fear 4. Channel Your Nervousness: Recognize nervousness as natural. Use it as energy, focus on your breathing, and shift anxiety into motivation and creativity. - Shu Saito, SpiroPure 5. Share Your Story: Rather than only teaching, share personal stories and experiences to connect with your audience. Authentic stories spark inspiration and learning. - Mario Peshev, Rush 6. Start With Humor: An appropriate joke or funny story at the beginning can make you memorable and encourage audience interaction. Practice your delivery to ensure your humor lands well. - Syed Balkhi, WPBeginner 7. Keep It Concise: Avoid overwhelming your audience with too much information. Stay direct and interactive to maintain attention. - Samuel Saxton, ConsumerRating.org 8. Speak Authentically: Be genuine and speak from the heart. Authenticity builds trust and helps the audience relate to you. - Chidambaram Bhat, Integral Technology Solutions, Inc. 9. Share Contact Information Afterwards: Make it easy for people to connect with you after your talk. Use tools like QR codes or apps to share your contact details and follow up with interested attendees. - Givelle Lamano, Oakland DUI Attorneys 10. Enjoy the Experience: Have fun and embrace the moment rather than worrying about mistakes. When you enjoy yourself, your passion is evident and your talk is more memorable for the audience. - Erik Knight, Knight Industries
translated_content: Offentlig tale er et uvurderligt værktøj for personlig og professionel udvikling, men det kan være skræmmende – selv for erfarne fagfolk. For dem, der er nye i offentlig tale, er nerver helt almindelige, men der findes effektive måder at præsentere selvsikkert og promovere din virksomhed eller dit brand på scenen. Her deler 10 medlemmer af Young Entrepreneur Council deres bedste råd til debutspeakere: 1. Vær Velforberedt: Offentlig tale kommer ikke naturligt til alle. Forberedelse er nøglen – skriv din tale i rolige omgivelser og øv dig, for eksempel foran et spejl. Jo bedre du kender dit materiale, desto mere overbevisende vil du være. - Vibhav Singh, XTEN-AV LLC 2. Skab Forventning med en Historie: Lær af dygtige talere, der starter med historier for at engagere publikum, og brug visuelle hjælpemidler effektivt. Brug færre ord, store skrifttyper og lever dit budskab kort og præcist. - Ben Landers, Blue Corona 3. Træn gennem Eksponering: Overvind frygten gradvist ved at øve dig, f.eks. ved at deltage i Toastmasters-møder. Kontinuerlig træning kan forvandle nervøsitet til selvtillid og gøre dig mere værdifuld for dit publikum. - David Henzel, Love not Fear 4. Kanaliser din Nervøsitet: Se nervøsitet som noget naturligt. Brug det som energi, fokuser på din vejrtrækning og omdan angst til motivation og kreativitet. - Shu Saito, SpiroPure 5. Fortæl din Historie: Del personlige historier og erfaringer i stedet for kun at undervise. Autentiske beretninger inspirerer og hjælper publikum med at lære. - Mario Peshev, Rush 6. Start med Humor: En passende joke eller sjov historie fra starten kan gøre dig mindeværdig og opfordre publikum til at interagere. Øv dig på leveringen, så joken eller historien rammer rigtigt. - Syed Balkhi, WPBeginner 7. Gør det Kort: Undgå at overvælde dit publikum med for mange informationer. Vær direkte og interaktiv for at fastholde opmærksomheden. - Samuel Saxton, ConsumerRating.org 8. Vær Autentisk: Vær ægte og tal fra hjertet. Autenticitet skaber tillid og gør det lettere for publikum at relatere til dig. - Chidambaram Bhat, Integral Technology Solutions, Inc. 9. Del Kontaktoplysninger efterfølgende: Gør det nemt for folk at tage kontakt efter din tale. Brug QR-koder eller apps til at dele dine kontaktinfo og følg op med interesserede deltagere. - Givelle Lamano, Oakland DUI Attorneys 10. Nyd Oplevelsen: Hav det sjovt og vær til stede, i stedet for at bekymre dig om fejl. Når du selv nyder det, smitter det af, og dit oplæg bliver mere mindeværdigt for publikum. - Erik Knight, Knight Industries

article_content: Jimi Hendrix's estate has put out a statement in response to reports about a new biopic featuring André 3000 of Outkast. Experience Hendrix, LLC—the family business overseeing Hendrix's legacy and his music rights—has stressed that any film using Hendrix’s original songs or copyrights must involve the estate’s full cooperation. This comes after news surfaced that the biopic, tentatively titled 'All Is By My Side,' is back in development after being stalled last year. The project aims to explore a crucial chapter of Hendrix’s life between 1966 and 1967, including the release of 'Are You Experienced?' Pre-production is progressing in Ireland, with main shooting set to begin soon in Wicklow and Dublin. The film’s writer and director is John Ridley, whose credits include 'Three Kings,' 'U-Turn,' and 'Red Tails.' Though Janie Hendrix, Jimi's sister and Experience Hendrix's CEO, and the board are not opposed to a biopic, the estate has previously chosen not to license Hendrix's music to other film projects, like one from director Paul Greengrass. The estate’s reminder is clear: their involvement from the very beginning is required if a movie plans to use Hendrix’s original songs. André 3000 discussed back in 2008 with MTV how complicated making a true biopic can be, saying, 'Everybody wants to do the movie, but there are so many things that go into a biopic.'
translated_content: Jimi Hendrix' bo har udsendt en erklæring som svar på rapporter om en kommende biografisk film med André 3000 fra Outkast. Experience Hendrix, LLC—familiefirmaet der varetager Hendrix' arv og musikerrettigheder—har understreget, at enhver film, som vil bruge Hendrix' originale sange eller ophavsret, skal have boets fulde samarbejde. Denne udmelding følger nyheder om, at biografifilmen, foreløbigt kaldet 'All Is By My Side,' er tilbage i udvikling efter at være blevet sat på pause sidste år. Projektet har til formål at udforske en vigtig periode i Hendrix' liv mellem 1966 og 1967, herunder udgivelsen af 'Are You Experienced?' Forproduktionen er i gang i Irland, og hovedoptagelserne forventes at begynde snart i både Wicklow og Dublin. Filmen er skrevet og instrueret af John Ridley, der tidligere har stået bag 'Three Kings,' 'U-Turn' og 'Red Tails.' Selvom Janie Hendrix, Jimis søster og direktør for Experience Hendrix, samt bestyrelsen, ikke er imod en biografifilm, har boet tidligere valgt ikke at udlicensere Hendrix' musik til andre filmprojekter, som eksempelvis et fra instruktør Paul Greengrass. Boets budskab er tydeligt: Deres medvirken fra starten er påkrævet, hvis en film vil anvende Hendrix' originale musik. André 3000 fortalte allerede i 2008 til MTV, hvor kompliceret det kan være at lave en autentisk biografifilm, og sagde: 'Alle vil lave filmen, men der er så mange ting, der indgår i en biopic.'

article_content: Washington (CNN) – President Barack Obama remarked Tuesday that he doesn't get out much, but joked that he doesn't need to when music legends like B.B. King and Mick Jagger come to play at his house. The blues and rock icons visited the White House for a PBS performance series in the East Room, honoring the history of blues music. A lineup of renowned blues artists, both past and present, performed classic standards that showcased the raw elements of this uniquely American genre rooted in the era of slavery. Obama even joined in; prompted by blues legend Buddy Guy, he sang a verse of the energetic finale 'Sweet Home Chicago.' Earlier, Obama described blues as a form of oral history that bears witness to the struggles of African Americans. 'The blues reminds us that we've been through tougher times before,' Obama said. 'I'm proud to have these artists here not just as a fan but as president. Their music teaches us that when we find ourselves at a crossroads, we don't avoid our problems, we address them. We face them, deal with them, sing about them, and turn them into art. Even as we face today's challenges, we imagine a brighter tomorrow.' Obama added that blues music 'speaks to something universal,' noting, 'No one goes through life without joy and pain, triumph and sorrow,' and that blues can express all of that 'sometimes with just one lyric or a single note.' The event, titled 'In Performance at The White House: Red, White and Blues,' scheduled as part of February’s Black History Month celebrations, featured blues greats King and Guy alongside contemporary musicians Shemekia Copeland, Trombone Shorty, Keb' Mo', and Gary Clark Jr. The concert also acknowledged the British blues wave of the 1960s with performances by Mick Jagger and Jeff Beck. Rock musicians Warren Haynes and Derek Trucks (of The Allman Brothers Band), and Susan Tedeschi—Trucks’ wife and Grammy-winning bandmate—also participated. Most performers assembled for the opening number, 'Let the Good Times Roll.' The 86-year-old B.B. King, seated at center stage, encouraged Obama’s re-election bid, saying, 'Mr. President, I’ve been praying for you for three years, and I want you to keep your job,' to applause. The event was hosted for PBS by actress and singer Taraji Henson, who commented on the surreal experience of introducing the night's lineup at the White House. 'I never dreamt in a million years that I would ever say these next five words, and certainly never thought I’d be saying them right here at the White House, but, ladies and gentlemen, Mick Jagger,' she said in welcoming the Rolling Stones frontman. True to rock star form, Jagger ran onstage to dance and sing 'I Can't Turn You Loose,' backed by the house band led by Booker T. Jones. Before performing his second song—a cover of Howlin' Wolf’s 'Commit a Crime' with Jeff Beck—Jagger shared how he discovered blues as a young man in England through artists like Sonny Boy Williamson. He recalled Williamson's time in London and his amusing take on British blues enthusiasts: 'He said those English boys, they want to play the blues real bad, and they do—real bad.' Copeland and Tedeschi then joined Jagger to sing backup on 'Miss You.' Copeland and Clark performed an emotional version of 'Beat Up Guitar,' followed by Clark’s 'Catfish Blues' and Keb’ Mo’s solo 'Henry.' Tedeschi, Trucks, and Haynes paid tribute to Etta James with a powerful version of 'I'd Rather Go Blind.' Jagger later joined Guy, Beck, and Clark for 'Five Long Years' by Eddie Boyd. The concert concluded with all performers onstage, serenading the president and first lady with a tribute to their hometown, as Obama declared them the 'White House Blues All-Stars.' About 200 guests, including Cabinet members Kathleen Sebelius, John Bryson, and Jacob Lew, stood and applauded at Obama’s urging, cheering when he took the microphone after Buddy Guy encouraged him to continue singing. 'I heard you singing Al Green,' Guy said. 'You started something. You got to keep it up.' Obama obliged, offering the mic to King to help finish the verse. Though Obama’s singing may not have matched the vocal power of the professionals, it marked a memorable presidential performance, reminiscent of Bill Clinton’s saxophone playing.
translated_content: Washington (CNN) – Præsident Barack Obama bemærkede tirsdag, at han ikke kommer så meget ud, men jokede med, at han ikke behøver det, når musiklegender som B.B. King og Mick Jagger optræder i hans hjem. Blues- og rockikonerne besøgte Det Hvide Hus til en PBS-koncertserie i East Room for at hylde bluesmusikkens historie. En række anerkendte bluesmusikere, både fra fortid og nutid, spillede klassiske sange, der fremhævede de rå elementer i denne unikt amerikanske genre, der har rødder i slavetiden. Obama deltog selv – ansporet af blueslegenden Buddy Guy sang han et vers af den energiske afslutning 'Sweet Home Chicago.' Tidligere beskrev Obama blues som en form for mundtlig historie, der vidner om afroamerikaneres kampe. 'Blues minder os om, at vi har været igennem værre tider før,' sagde Obama. 'Jeg er stolt af at have disse kunstnere her, ikke kun som fan, men også som præsident. Deres musik lærer os, at når vi står ved en korsvej, undgår vi ikke vores problemer, vi håndterer dem. Vi konfronterer dem, bearbejder dem, synger om dem og gør dem til kunst. Selv når vi står overfor nutidens udfordringer, forestiller vi os en lysere fremtid.' Obama tilføjede, at bluesmusik 'taler til noget universelt' og sagde: 'Ingen kommer gennem livet uden glæde og smerte, triumf og sorg,' og at blues kan udtrykke alt det 'nogle gange med blot en linje eller en enkelt tone.' Arrangementet, 'In Performance at The White House: Red, White and Blues', blev afholdt som en del af februars fejring af Black History Month og havde blandt andet bluesstjernerne King og Guy sammen med nutidige musikere som Shemekia Copeland, Trombone Shorty, Keb' Mo' og Gary Clark Jr. Koncerten anerkendte også den britiske bluesbølge fra 1960'erne med optrædener af Mick Jagger og Jeff Beck. Rockmusikere Warren Haynes og Derek Trucks (fra The Allman Brothers Band) samt Susan Tedeschi – Trucks’ hustru og Grammy-vindende bandkammerat – deltog også. De fleste musikere samledes til åbningsnummeret 'Let the Good Times Roll.' Den 86-årige B.B. King, der sad i midten på scenen, opmuntrede Obama til at genopstille og sagde: 'Hr. Præsident, jeg har bedt for dig i tre år, og jeg vil have, at du beholder dit job,' hvilket udløste bifald. Arrangementet blev præsenteret for PBS af skuespillerinden og sangeren Taraji Henson, der bemærkede det særlige ved at introducere aftenens stjerner i Det Hvide Hus. 'Jeg havde aldrig i mit liv drømt om, at jeg skulle sige de næste fem ord, og slet ikke her i Det Hvide Hus, men mine damer og herrer: Mick Jagger,' sagde hun og bød Rolling Stones-frontmanden velkommen. I ægte rockstjerne-stil løb Jagger på scenen for at danse og synge 'I Can't Turn You Loose', akkompagneret af husorkestret ledet af Booker T. Jones. Før han opførte sit andet nummer – et cover af Howlin' Wolfs 'Commit a Crime' sammen med Jeff Beck – fortalte Jagger, hvordan han som ung i England opdagede blues via kunstnere som Sonny Boy Williamson. Han mindedes Williamsons tid i London og hans sjove syn på engelske bluesfans: 'Han sagde, at de engelske drenge vil spille blues virkelig dårligt – og det gør de også, virkelig dårligt.' Copeland og Tedeschi sluttede sig til Jagger som kor på 'Miss You'. Copeland og Clark fremførte en følelsesladet version af 'Beat Up Guitar', efterfulgt af Clarks 'Catfish Blues' og Keb’ Mo’s solo 'Henry'. Tedeschi, Trucks og Haynes hyldede Etta James med en stærk version af 'I'd Rather Go Blind.' Senere fik Jagger selskab af Guy, Beck og Clark på 'Five Long Years' af Eddie Boyd. Koncerten blev afsluttet med alle musikere på scenen, hvor de hyldede præsidenten og førstedamen med en sang til deres hjemby – Obama døbte dem 'White House Blues All-Stars.' Omkring 200 gæster, herunder ministrene Kathleen Sebelius, John Bryson og Jacob Lew, rejste sig og klappede på Obamas opfordring og jublede, da han tog mikrofonen efter opfordring fra Buddy Guy om at fortsætte sangen. 'Jeg hørte dig synge Al Green,' sagde Guy. 'Du startede noget. Du er nødt til at fortsætte.' Obama adlød og rakte mikrofonen til King, som hjalp med at afslutte verset. Selvom Obamas sang måske ikke matchede de professionelle sangeres stemmer, var det et mindeværdigt præsidentielt indslag – som da Bill Clinton spillede saxofon.

Bitcoin wallets created before 2016 may have a vulnerability that puts over $1 billion in cryptocurrency at risk, according to a report in the Washington Post. Unciphered, a cryptocurrency recovery company, discovered that countless crypto wallets were designed with built-in flaws, leaving a backdoor in their code that hackers could potentially exploit. Crypto wallets typically rely on random number generators for security, but Unciphered found that many wallets were built on open-source software using numbers that weren’t random enough. These vulnerable wallets use keys that are one in several thousand, rather than one in a trillion, making them susceptible to brute-force attacks.

Unciphered informed the Post that it has contacted over a million people about 'Randstorm'—the nickname for the vulnerability—but millions more may be affected. Users can check if their wallet is vulnerable by visiting keybleed.com.

The issue reportedly stems from BitcoinJS, a software used to create wallets for popular platforms like Blockchain.info (now Blockchain.com), Dogechain.info (main wallet provider for Dogecoin), and several other sites. According to Unciphered co-founder Eric Michaud, anyone using a BitcoinJS-based wallet 'is at very high risk of attack.'

Wallets created before March 2012 are especially vulnerable. While most wallets made between then and the end of 2015 are safe, at least two percent could still be at risk. Random number generation in the crypto community has since improved, so recent wallets should not have this flaw. Unciphered has not found any wallets created after 2016 that contain the Randstorm vulnerability.

Blockchain.com, the leading site still using the affected software, developed a way to automatically update users’ wallets when they visit the platform. They also emailed 1.1 million affected customers. The company says the problem only existed in two percent of the 90 million wallets it created. However, millions who received wallets from now-defunct companies may not be reachable.

Correction: A previous version of this article incorrectly identified the software responsible for the flaw. The correct software is BitcoinJS. We regret the error.

article_content: A Turkish company has cut off power to Guinea-Bissau's capital, Bissau, over an unpaid bill of at least $15 million (£12 million), leaving the city in darkness and severely disrupting daily life. Hospitals have been affected, and radio stations have gone off the air. Economy Minister Suleimane Seidi acknowledged the outstanding debt, saying most of it would be paid within 15 days. Karpowership, one of the world's largest floating power plant operators, supplies electricity to several African nations and has taken a firm stance on non-payment. Just last month, it cut power to Freetown, Sierra Leone's capital, over a $40 million unpaid bill. The Turkish company has also signed an agreement to provide power to South Africa, aiming to cover more than 5% of the country's total electricity needs. South Africa has been grappling with extensive power cuts, with residents sometimes facing up to 10 hours a day without electricity. Power in Bissau, a city of over 400,000 people, was cut in the early hours of Tuesday and had not been restored as of a recent report to the BBC. Some public hospitals are now using generators for surgeries, local journalist Assana Sambu told the BBC. However, these facilities do not have running water due to insufficient electricity, and hospital administrators have appealed for power to cook food for patients. Another journalist, Alberto Dabo, said he was forced to drink well water because the water supply had been interrupted amid sweltering heat reaching up to 40°C. Many families are unable to stay indoors at night due to the heat and lack of electricity, often remaining outside until the early morning. State-run Rádio Nacional and other media have stopped broadcasting, while the private station where Sambu works is only partially operational. Karpowership has been supplying 100% of Guinea-Bissau's electricity since signing a five-year agreement with the state-owned electricity and water utility in 2019. Guinea-Bissau is among the world's poorest countries and has experienced ongoing instability since its independence. A Karpowership spokesperson told Reuters: 'Unfortunately, after a prolonged period of non-payment, our floating power plant can no longer continue operation. We are working continuously with officials to resolve this and aim to restore power as soon as possible.' Energy Minister Isuf Baldé stated that $6 million of the $15 million owed had already been paid, but carrying out such a large transfer in a small, poor country like Guinea-Bissau takes time. He also said that the contract with Karpowership needed renegotiation, as costs had nearly doubled and were now unaffordable. Karpowership also provides electricity to six other African countries: Ghana, The Gambia, Ivory Coast, Mozambique, Senegal, and Sierra Leone. The company describes itself as 'the owner, operator, and builder of the world's only Powership (floating power plant)'. Turkey’s involvement in Africa’s electricity sector has grown notably in recent years. While access to electricity in sub-Saharan Africa has improved, more than 50% of the population still lacks grid connections, according to the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD).

article_content: Indonesia's hosting of Miss World 2013 ignited strong objections from conservative Islamic groups, who argued the event was at odds with religious values and exploitative of women. Protestors organized rallies, urging cancellation and advocating for modest dress requirements. In response, the pageant eliminated the swimsuit section, opting for less revealing attire. However, ongoing protests led to the finals being moved from Jakarta to Bali for security reasons. Police stopped members of the Islamic Defenders Front from reaching Bali. Hary Tanoesoedibjo, the event’s local organizer, maintained that the contest was consistent with local customs and did not breach any laws. Religious critics, however, continued to denounce the event, calling it offensive to Islamic principles. With 127 contestants participating in a variety of rounds—from beach wear to talent and charitable work—the top 10 finalists hailed from a diverse group of countries. Security for the event was heightened, with over 700 officers deployed at the finale. The government's approach drew scrutiny from some, who argued that bowing to protestors set a troubling precedent. In defense, Tourism and Creative Economy Minister Mari Elka Pangestu stressed Indonesia's openness but acknowledged the challenge of balancing different perspectives. Recently, Jakarta also hosted the World Muslimah competition, celebrating women who exemplify Islamic values through modest dress and religious knowledge. Nigeria’s Obabiyi Aishah Aijbola won the title, although even this event received criticism from some conservative organizations. World Muslimah founder Eka Shanty explained that her event focuses on honoring the character and talent of Muslim women, rather than physical appearance. The debates sparked by both Miss World and World Muslimah underscore Indonesia’s ongoing conversations about culture, faith, and modern identity.

Alligevel fortsatte protesterne, hvilket førte til, at finalen blev flyttet fra Jakarta til Bali af sikkerhedsmæssige årsager. Politiet forhindrede medlemmer af Islamisk Forsvarsfront i at rejse til Bali. Religiøse kritikere blev dog ved med at kritisere begivenheden og kaldte den krænkende for islamiske principper. 127 deltagere konkurrerede i forskellige kategorier – fra strandtøj til talent og velgørenhedsarbejde – og de ti finalister repræsenterede vidt forskellige lande. Sikkerheden var skærpet med over 700 betjente til stede ved finalen. Regeringens håndtering blev kritiseret for at sætte et uheldigt eksempel ved at imødekomme demonstranternes krav. Turisme- og minister for kreativ økonomi, Mari Elka Pangestu, fremhævede dog Indonesiens åbenhed og erkendte udfordringen i at balancere forskellige holdninger. For nylig blev World Muslimah-konkurrencen også afholdt i Jakarta, hvor kvinder, der repræsenterer islamiske værdier gennem tækkelig beklædning og religiøs kundskab, fejres. Obabiyi Aishah Aijbola fra Nigeria vandt titlen, selvom også denne konkurrence blev kritiseret af enkelte konservative grupper. World Muslimahs grundlægger, Eka Shanty, forklarede, at konkurrencen handler om at fejre muslimske kvinders karakter og talent frem for udseende. article_content: Selecting AI Brilliance vs. AI Mediocrity: How To Decide? Artificial Intelligence (AI) is now central in business and entrepreneurship. As with other breakthrough technologies, it’s important to separate AI-generated brilliance from mediocrity. Here are five key questions to help you evaluate AI’s true value. 1. Will AI-generated ideas improve the chances of venture success? Entrepreneurship often overemphasizes ideas. A Wharton experiment found that AI-generated ideas had a 47% purchase intent success rate compared to 40% for student ideas. Still, do entrepreneurial skills matter more than just the idea? Among 85 billion-dollar entrepreneurs studied, only 1% succeeded solely because of their idea; the remaining 99% won due to strategic skills and strong execution. 2. Does AI-based reverse design thinking outperform traditional design thinking? A Harvard Business Review article highlights that AI can generate uses for a technology before the exact problem is defined. Many founders do this: they build a product and then look for a market, which often leads to failure. Conversely, some innovations are dismissed until visionaries prove their value. For instance, liquid crystal displays (LCDs) originated at RCA but were first commercialized in Japan; Xerox invented the laser printer, the Alto (a mouse-based PC), and Ethernet, yet others commercialized them. Will more AI-generated ideas really help? Ultimately, AI has to pick winners. Is that possible? 3. Can AI emulate Steve Jobs? Should we use or release such a tool? There’s speculation that AI could develop blockbuster products as Steve Jobs did. But how would anyone recognize if an AI truly replicated Jobs’ creative process? And if such an AI was developed, should it be widely released? 4. Can AI outperform venture capitalists at spotting brilliance? Some argue that entrepreneurs know good ideas and avoid bad ones. But even experts miss out: - Sam Walton’s concept for big-box stores in small towns was not recognized as brilliant. - IBM did not recognize the potential in Bill Gates' idea to license the operating system non-exclusively. - Michael Dell's direct PC sales idea was mostly dismissed. - Google's search engine was rejected by over 10 VCs and a corporation declined to purchase it for $1 million. - Steve Jobs was fired after launching Apple, despite his innovation. If VCs struggle to predict brilliance, can AI do any better? 5. Can AI surpass billion-dollar entrepreneurs at identifying winning strategies? Great strategies require matching product, customer segment, competitors, and sales approach to dominate a market. Can AI forecast such combinations without field testing? Does it mean AI must keep constant track of everything? Conclusion: At the crossroads of AI and entrepreneurship, rapid idea generation is tempting. But the core challenge remains: filtering valuable ideas from the noise and executing successfully. If 200 entrepreneurs deploy AI-driven strategies, can AI reliably spot the differentiation in skills that truly lead to success—especially when similar tools and strategies are used?

Vil AI-genererede idéer forbedre chancerne for iværksættersucces? Iværksætteri får ofte for meget fokus på idéen. Et eksperiment fra Wharton viste, at AI-genererede idéer havde en succesrate på 47 % (købsinteresse) mod 40 % for studerendes idéer. Men betyder iværksætterens færdigheder mere end selve idéen? Vil flere AI-genererede idéer virkelig hjælpe? I sidste ende skal AI kunne udpege vinderne. Kan det lade sig gøre? 3. Kan AI efterligne Steve Jobs? Bør vi bruge eller frigive sådan et værktøj? Nogle spekulerer i, om AI kan skabe store succeser som Steve Jobs. Men hvordan ved man, om en AI virkelig efterligner Jobs’ kreative proces? Og hvis sådan en AI blev udviklet, bør den så frigives til alle? 4. Kan AI overgå venturekapitalister i at spotte genialitet? Nogle mener, at iværksættere kender gode idéer og undgår dårlige. Men selv eksperterne misser ofte: - Sam Waltons idé om stormagasiner i små byer blev ikke anset som genial. - IBM så ikke potentialet i Bill Gates’ idé om at licensere operativsystemet ikke-eksklusivt. - Michael Dells idé om direkte PC-salg blev afvist. - Googles søgemaskine blev afvist af over 10 venturekapitalister, og en virksomhed takkede nej til at købe den for $1 mio. - Steve Jobs blev fyret efter at have lanceret Apple. Hvis VC’er ofte rammer ved siden af, kan AI så gøre det bedre? 5. Kan AI overgå milliardær-iværksættere til at finde vindende strategier? Gode strategier kræver, at produkt, kundesegment, konkurrenter og salgsmetode matcher for at dominere en branche. Kan AI forudsige sådanne kombinationer uden at teste dem i praksis? Men den største udfordring er stadig at skelne mellem værdifulde idéer og støj – og at udføre dem godt. Hvis 200 iværksættere bruger AI-drevne strategier, kan AI så udpege de kompetencer, der virkelig skaber succes – især hvis alle bruger de samme værktøjer og strategier?

article_content: France coach Fabien Galthie could not hide his disappointment after his four-year plan for a Rugby World Cup triumph ended with a narrow 29-28 loss to South Africa (the Springboks) in the quarter-finals on Sunday. Galthie immediately thought of the passionate supporters who had backed the team, as well as the players and their families, but stated he had no regrets about how the campaign unfolded. "No regrets, none," he told reporters. "The players have a right to lose a match like this. I believe we did everything possible to maximize our potential and managed several incidents as well. Over the last four years, we've created a wonderful chapter for French rugby—the players and coaches can be proud." One significant challenge the team faced was captain Antoine Dupont’s fractured eye-socket, sustained in France’s third pool game against Namibia. Dupont returned for Sunday’s quarter-final after missing the final pool match and expressed frustration over some refereeing decisions by New Zealand official Ben O’Keeffe. "It’s difficult to talk about it now, but there were some clear incidents that should have been called, and they weren’t," said Dupont. "I don’t want to be a sore loser or complain about the officiating, but I’m not sure it was at the level required tonight. That said, this doesn’t take away from South Africa’s performance—they were better fighters and played very well." Galthie chose not to echo Dupont’s criticism of the refereeing, although he did note that South Africa's Eben Etzebeth’s fumbled interception when France was pushing for a second early try was a key moment. "I understand the players’ frustrations, truly, but I will not criticize the refereeing," Galthie said. "We congratulate South Africa and wish them further success in the tournament. We have to show the same bravery tonight that we have displayed over the past four years." Galthie, whose contract runs until after the next World Cup in 2027, confirmed he will stay on as coach. "This French team will continue—we’ll soon play our first Six Nations match in Marseille. What we've experienced in this tournament is just another chapter in the French team’s story."
translated_content: Frankrigs træner Fabien Galthié kunne ikke skjule sin skuffelse, da hans fireårige plan om et VM-triumf endte med et snævert 29-28 nederlag til Sydafrika (Springboks) i kvartfinalen søndag. Galthié tænkte straks på de passionerede fans, der havde støttet holdet, samt på spillerne og deres familier, men understregede, at han ikke fortrød, hvordan turneringen var forløbet. "Ingen fortrydelse, ingen," sagde han til journalisterne. "Spillerne har ret til at tabe sådan en kamp. Jeg mener, vi gjorde alt for at maksimere vores potentiale og håndterede flere udfordringer undervejs. I de sidste fire år har vi skrevet et smukt kapitel for fransk rugby – spillerne og trænerne kan være stolte." En stor udfordring holdet stod over for, var at kaptajn Antoine Dupont fik en brækket øjenhule i Frankrigs tredje puljekamp mod Namibia. Dupont vendte tilbage til kvartfinalen søndag efter at have misset den sidste puljekamp og udtrykte frustration over nogle dommerkendelser fra New Zealandske Ben O'Keeffe. "Det er svært at tale om nu, men der var nogle tydelige episoder, der skulle være blevet dømt, og det blev de ikke," sagde Dupont. "Jeg vil ikke være en dårlig taber eller klage over dommeren, men jeg er ikke sikker på, at det var på det niveau, det burde være i aften. Det tager dog ikke noget fra Sydafrikas præstation – de kæmpede hårdere og spillede virkelig godt." Galthié valgte ikke at gentage Duponts kritik af dommeren, men nævnte, at Sydafrikas Eben Etzebeth’s missede interception-forsøg, da Frankrig pressede for et tidligt andet forsøg, var et afgørende øjeblik. "Jeg forstår spillernes frustrationer, virkelig, men jeg vil ikke kritisere dommeren," sagde Galthié. "Vi ønsker Sydafrika tillykke og held og lykke videre i turneringen. Vi må vise samme mod i aften, som vi har gjort de sidste fire år." Galthié, hvis kontrakt løber frem til efter næste VM i 2027, bekræftede, at han forbliver som træner. "Dette franske hold fortsætter – vi spiller snart vores første Six Nations-kamp i Marseille. Det, vi har oplevet ved denne turnering, er blot endnu et kapitel i det franske holds historie."

Casey Bloys, head of programming at HBO and Max, admitted Thursday to using secret Twitter (now X) accounts to respond to critics’ negative reviews of HBO’s programming. Speaking at a New York promotional event, Bloys emphasized his passion for the shows and the people behind them, stating, “I want the shows to be great. I want people to love them.”

Bloys described his use of the secret accounts as a “very, very dumb idea to vent my frustration,” explaining that, during 2020 and 2021 while working from home, he sent only six tweets over a year and a half. He apologized to people mentioned in leaked emails or texts, noting, “Nobody wants to be part of a story that they have nothing to do with.” Bloys added that in recent years, he has shifted to using direct messages for feedback and discussion about reviews, finding this a healthier approach.

Bloys’ admission comes after Rolling Stone published details from a wrongful termination lawsuit filed by former HBO employee Sully Temori. Temori alleges he was asked to create fake Twitter accounts and faced retaliation and discrimination after disclosing a mental health diagnosis. Leaked messages between Bloys and HBO's senior VP of drama, Kathleen McCaffrey, referenced creating a “secret army” of accounts to push back against unfavorable reviews. 

One such troll account used the identity “Kelly Shepherd,” a fictitious Texas mom described as a vegan, aromatherapist, and herbalist. Tweets from this account targeted critics such as The New York Times’ James Poniewozik and Mike Hale, and Rolling Stone’s Alan Sepinwall. In one exchange, Kelly Shepherd responded to criticism of HBO’s series “The Nevers,” rebuffing negative comments with personal remarks about the critics. 

HBO declined to comment on the situation when interviewed by Insider.

Bloys beskrev brugen af de hemmelige konti som en “meget, meget dum idé til at lufte min frustration” og forklarede, at han kun sendte seks tweets i løbet af halvandet år, mens han arbejdede hjemme i 2020 og 2021. Han undskyldte over for personer nævnt i lækkede emails og sms’er og sagde: “Ingen ønsker at være en del af en historie, de ikke har noget at gøre med.” Bloys tilføjede, at han i de senere år er begyndt at bruge private beskeder til feedback og diskussioner omkring anmeldelser, hvilket han mener er en sundere tilgang.

Bloys’ indrømmelse kom efter, at Rolling Stone offentliggjorde detaljer fra en sag om uberettiget fyring anlagt af den tidligere HBO-medarbejder Sully Temori. En af de falske profiler hed “Kelly Shepherd,” en opdigtet texansk mor beskrevet som veganer, aromaterapeut og herbalist. Tweets fra denne konto gik efter kritikere som The New York Times’ James Poniewozik og Mike Hale samt Rolling Stones Alan Sepinwall. I en udveksling svarede Kelly Shepherd på kritik af HBO-serien “The Nevers” ved at modsige de negative kommentarer med personlige bemærkninger om anmelderne.

Emily Wax-Thibodeaux, a journalist from Washington, D.C., is a breast cancer survivor who underwent a double mastectomy before having her first child. Because of her surgery, she was unable to breastfeed her son, Lincoln, and instead fed him formula. Despite her medical situation, Emily faced criticism and pressure from other mothers and nurses, who insisted that 'breast is best.'

Emily describes her experience in the Washington Post, noting that formula feeding is often stigmatized, and she frequently found herself explaining her circumstances. In one example, at a baby-and-me yoga class, another mother told her, 'You know, breastfeeding is optimal,' and on social media, friends questioned her choice to use formula. According to Emily, women often shame each other for their feeding choices, promoting the belief that breastfeeding is always superior.

However, Emily points out that recent studies indicate that breast milk may be no better for newborns than formula. When she shared this information with friends, some still pressured her, with one even offering her frozen breast milk.

Emily recalls her first experience of 'formula shaming' happened at the hospital when Lincoln was born, with lactation advocates encouraging her to breastfeed despite her surgery. She had to recount her cancer journey to strangers just after giving birth. One nurse inaccurately suggested she might still be able to produce milk, but her breast surgeon, Shawna Wiley, confirmed that milk production was not possible after her double mastectomy.

The pressure to breastfeed, particularly for women unable or unwilling to do so, can be emotionally damaging. Emily emphasizes that no group should make a mother feel guilty for being unable to breastfeed.

Others have shared similar experiences, saying they felt shamed for not breastfeeding for various reasons, including work demands, adoption, pain, or personal preference. Emily’s article received a largely positive response, with many parents expressing relief and thanking her for speaking out against the stigma surrounding formula feeding.

Emily Wax-Thibodeaux, en journalist fra Washington D.C., har overlevet brystkræft og fik foretaget en dobbelt mastektomi før hun fik sit første barn. Ifølge Emily skammer kvinder ofte hinanden over deres valg om at amme eller bruge erstatning og holder fast i, at amning er det bedste.

Men Emily fremhæver, at nyere undersøgelser peger på, at modermælk måske ikke er bedre for spædbørn end erstatning. Da hun delte denne viden med venner, oplevede hun stadig pres—en tilbød endda at give hende sin egen frosne modermælk.

Emily husker, at hun første gang følte 'erstatningsskam' på hospitalet efter Lincolns fødsel, hvor ammekonsulenter opfordrede hende til at amme på trods af operationen. Hun måtte dele hele sin kræfthistorie med fremmede kort efter fødslen. En sygeplejerske foreslog fejlagtigt, at hun måske stadig kunne producere mælk, men hendes brystkirurg, Shawna Wiley, bekræftede, at mælkeproduktion ikke er mulig efter en dobbelt mastektomi.

Presset for at amme—særligt for kvinder, der ikke kan eller ikke ønsker det—kan have negative følelsesmæssige konsekvenser. Emily understreger, at ingen bør få en mor til at føle skyld over ikke at kunne amme.

Once the official photograph was taken, Berlusconi loudly called out to President Barack Obama in an attempt to capture his attention. The Queen, seemingly annoyed by the interruption, turned toward Berlusconi, gave a shrug, and asked, "What is it? Why does he have to shout?" Buckingham Palace later dismissed claims of discord, with a spokesperson emphasizing that the atmosphere was upbeat and no offense was taken. However, Italian media portrayed the episode as yet another social faux pas by Berlusconi, whose history of controversial remarks includes describing Obama as 'handsome and suntanned.' The report also highlighted a past incident in which Berlusconi publicly apologized to his wife, Veronica Lario, after making flirtatious comments to other women at a previous public function.

article_content: The responses of the NBA and NFL to major scandals have exposed stark differences in leadership approaches. After Adam Silver succeeded David Stern as NBA commissioner, he immediately faced Donald Sterling's racist remarks. Silver reacted promptly by dispatching investigators to Los Angeles, confirming Sterling's comments, banning him for life, imposing a $2.5 million fine, and starting the process to remove him as Clippers owner. Despite challenges, Silver remained resolute. Sterling later apologized but continued to make controversial comments, particularly targeting Magic Johnson and his community involvement. Johnson largely dismissed Sterling's words and expressed sympathy. Silver's swift actions received widespread praise from NBA players, team owners, and civil rights advocates. LeBron James remarked, 'There's no room for Donald Sterling in the NBA.' Spike Lee stressed Magic Johnson's worldwide respect and criticized Sterling's statements. However, some questioned why the NBA took so long to intervene, given Sterling's history of discrimination lawsuits related to his Los Angeles properties and previous legal disputes with former Clippers general manager Elgin Baylor. Conversely, Roger Goodell faced significant criticism for his handling of the Ray Rice domestic violence case. TMZ released video evidence of Rice dragging his unconscious fiancée, Janay Palmer, from an elevator. Goodell waited several months before interviewing Rice and Palmer together, eventually suspending Rice for two games, which many deemed inadequate. Following public backlash and the release of a second, more graphic video, Rice was released from the Ravens and suspended indefinitely by the NFL. Goodell conceded his initial response was insufficient and introduced stricter domestic violence policies. Organizations such as the National Organization for Women called for Goodell's resignation, asserting that the NFL faced broader issues with violence against women. The league also encountered scrutiny over separate allegations involving Dallas Cowboys owner Jerry Jones. Prominent commentators like Keith Olbermann and Ann Killion also urged Goodell’s resignation, citing eroded public trust. The contrasting responses to these scandals highlight the impact of decisive leadership in addressing crises within sports organizations.

Silver reagerede hurtigt ved at sende efterforskere til Los Angeles, bekræfte Sterlings udtalelser, udelukke ham på livstid, udstede en bøde på 2,5 millioner dollars og indlede processen med at fratage ham ejerskabet af Clippers. På trods af udfordringer forblev Silver beslutsom. Sterling undskyldte senere, men fortsatte med at komme med kontroversielle kommentarer, især imod Magic Johnson og hans samfundsengagement. Johnson afviste for det meste Sterlings udtalelser og udtrykte medfølelse. Silvers hurtige handlinger fik bred ros fra NBA-spillere, ejere og borgerrettighedsforkæmpere. LeBron James sagde: 'Der er ikke plads til Donald Sterling i NBA.' Spike Lee påpegede Magic Johnsons verdensomspændende anseelse og kritiserede Sterlings udtalelser. Eric Tyler, a Research Fellow at the New America Foundation, a non-profit think tank based in Washington, D.C., is currently at sea near Hilo, Hawaii.

Unreasonable at Sea, launched this month, is an ambitious experiment that brings together 11 startups, Google executives, Stanford professors, a Nobel Peace Laureate, and 600 college students aboard a 590-foot ocean liner focused on nurturing global entrepreneurship. The initiative also includes representatives from multinational companies, international foundations, venture capitalists, environmental philanthropists, a Saudi Arabian prince, and the founder of WordPress—all committed to fostering innovation.

The ship will travel from Hawaii to developed markets such as Japan and Spain, as well as developing economies including Burma (Myanmar) and Ghana. This journey allows startup founders to test and refine their products in different local contexts. Many entrepreneurs, from countries like China, Botswana, Spain, India, and Mexico, are sailing for the first time; while seasickness has been an issue, it hasn't diminished their participation in workshops, meetings, and pitch events.

The program is led by Stanford University's Institute of Design and the Unreasonable Institute, in partnership with Semester at Sea. The 105-day journey covers 13 countries and is financially supported by companies including Microsoft and SAP. The mission is to unite diverse individuals, encouraging openness, experimentation, and resilience in the face of failure.

Conversations among participants often focus on issues like intellectual property in China and supply chain challenges in Sub-Saharan Africa. Program co-founder Daniel Epstein says the initiative seeks startups that use technology to tackle major social and environmental problems, aiming for billion-dollar market opportunities. Out of nearly 1,000 global applicants, a select group was chosen, offering products such as educational software for teachers and solar-powered cooking stoves.

George Kembel, co-founder of Stanford's d.school and leader of the onboard program, observes that society is shifting away from the industrial era and needs reinvented institutions to move forward.

One participant, Deepak Ravindran, founder and CEO of Indian startup Innoz, describes how he and classmates developed a text message-based search engine to bridge the information gap for those without internet access in Kerala. The service now has 120 million users and receives five million daily queries. Ravindran hopes the program’s international route will help Innoz scale up further.

Though the final results of Unreasonable at Sea are unpredictable, participants share optimism about the potential for true innovation.

Initiativet omfatter også repræsentanter fra multinationale virksomheder, internationale fonde, venturekapitalister, miljøfilantroper, en saudiarabisk prins og grundlæggeren af WordPress – alle engagerede i at fremme innovation.

Skibet sejler fra Hawaii til udviklede markeder som Japan og Spanien samt vækstøkonomier som Burma (Myanmar) og Ghana. Deltagerne diskuterer ofte problemstillinger som intellektuelle ejendomsrettigheder i Kina og forsyningskædeudfordringer i Afrika syd for Sahara. article_content: Be vigilant for cancellation penalties, energy surcharges, and facilities fees when renting cars. In late 2008, Hertz reported a $73 million loss, prompting rental companies to quietly introduce new surcharges to increase revenue during an economic downturn. For instance, Jim Swofford found a $5 cancellation fee on his Hertz bill, although such fees were uncommon before. When he tried to cancel another reservation, he was informed there would be a $25 fee for cancellation, or $50 if he did not show up. Similarly, Eric Hegwer from Austin, Texas, noticed a $1 'energy surcharge' on his Hertz rental. Hertz spokesperson Paula Rivera explained that the cancellation fee, introduced in December, applies only to prepaid reservations and covers paperwork and vehicle holding costs. The energy surcharge, added in October, is a $1-per-day fee to offset rising expenses for utilities, fuel, oil, and maintenance. Car rental companies are experiencing significant financial challenges. Alongside Hertz, Avis lost $121 million in the same quarter, and Advantage Rent A Car filed for bankruptcy before selling its assets to Hertz for about $33 million. Lawsuits about undisclosed fees and surcharges are common, according to annual reports from public car rental firms. This indicates a broader trend. Robert Barton, President of the American Car Rental Association and COO at U-Save Car & Truck Rental, says companies must clearly communicate all charges at the time of rental. Many new charges consumers may face include duplicate charges (such as fuel fees for cars returned full), fees for items expected to be included (like mandatory 'tire fees' in some states), and surcharges atop existing surcharges (such as 'privilege' or 'concession recovery' fees). Local taxes, for example stadium or arena fees, often appear on rental bills to fund projects, such as the Sprint Center in Kansas City or new stadiums in Georgia. Extra driver fees have become more strictly enforced. For example, Payless in Phoenix charged $9 per day for an extra driver. Previously, enforcement of these policies was more lenient, but stricter rules now exist due to tighter finances. Most of these fees may be avoided by pre-paying via online travel agencies like Hotwire.com or Priceline.com, although even prepaid customers might sometimes face additional charges. Consumers should closely review their rental agreements and final bills. This article was written by Christopher Elliott, ombudsman for National Geographic Traveler. More travel tips can be found at elliott.org, or by emailing celliott@ngs.org.
translated_content: Vær opmærksom på afbestillingsgebyrer, energitillæg og facilitetsafgifter, når du lejer bil. I slutningen af 2008 rapporterede Hertz et tab på 73 millioner dollars, hvilket fik biludlejningsfirmaer til stille og roligt at indføre nye tillæg for at øge indtægterne under økonomiske udfordringer. For eksempel fandt Jim Swofford et afbestillingsgebyr på 5 dollars på sin Hertz-regning, selvom sådanne gebyrer tidligere var usædvanlige. Da han forsøgte at afbestille en anden reservation, blev han informeret om et gebyr på 25 dollars for afbestilling og 50 dollars, hvis han ikke mødte op. Ligeledes bemærkede Eric Hegwer fra Austin, Texas, et 'energitillæg' på 1 dollar på sin Hertz-leje. Hertz’ talsperson Paula Rivera forklarede, at afbestillingsgebyret, som blev indført i december, kun gælder for forudbetalte reservationer og dækker papirarbejde samt omkostninger ved at holde bilen reserveret. Energitillægget, introduceret i oktober, er et gebyr på 1 dollar pr. dag for at kompensere for stigende udgifter til forsyning, brændstof, olie og vedligeholdelse. Biludlejningsfirmaerne oplever store økonomiske udfordringer. Ud over Hertz tabte Avis 121 millioner dollars i samme kvartal, og Advantage Rent A Car gik konkurs, før deres aktiver blev solgt til Hertz for omkring 33 millioner dollars. Søgsmål over skjulte gebyrer og tillæg er almindelige ifølge de børsnoterede biludlejningsfirmaers årsrapporter og viser en bredere tendens. Robert Barton, præsident for American Car Rental Association og COO hos U-Save Car & Truck Rental, siger, at selskaberne skal informere tydeligt om alle gebyrer ved udlejningstidspunktet. Nye gebyrer, som forbrugere bør være opmærksomme på, inkluderer dobbeltopkrævninger (som brændstofgebyrer på tilbageleverede biler med fuld tank), gebyrer for forventede ting (som obligatoriske 'dæksgebyrer' i visse stater), og tillæg oven på eksisterende tillæg (som 'privilegiegebyrer' eller 'concession recovery fees'). Lokale skatter, f.eks. stadion- eller arena-afgifter, optræder ofte på regningen for at finansiere projekter, såsom Sprint Center i Kansas City eller nye stadioner i Georgia. Ekstra chaufførgebyrer håndhæves nu mere strengt. For eksempel opkrævede Payless i Phoenix 9 dollars om dagen for en ekstra chauffør. Tidligere var reglerne mere lempelige, men nu er de strammet på grund af økonomisk pres. De fleste af disse gebyrer kan undgås ved at forudbetale via online rejsebureauer som Hotwire.com eller Priceline.com, men selv forudbetalte kunder risikerer nogle gange ekstra gebyrer. Former French Prime Minister Dominique de Villepin has been taken into police custody in connection with a corruption investigation. The 58-year-old is under scrutiny as part of a fraud inquiry centered on Relais & Chateaux (R&C), a prestigious international hotel and restaurant group. Regis Bulot, a former senior manager at R&C and a close friend of de Villepin, previously spent seven months in prison awaiting trial for allegedly embezzling £1 million through overcharging for the club’s guidebooks, widely distributed in Britain.

Transcripts of phone conversations from late 2011 have reportedly surfaced, suggesting that de Villepin attempted to dissuade R&C's new management from pursuing legal action against Bulot. Investigators also suspect that some of the misappropriated funds may have supported de Villepin's political activities. Both men share a close personal relationship and their families have often vacationed together at R&C properties. Other prominent supporters, including renowned chef Alain Ducasse, reportedly advocated for Bulot during the legal proceedings. Ducasse was overheard urging Bulot to act decisively against his successor in a recorded conversation.

Bulot has admitted to receiving illicit cash payments but denies participating in any unlawful political financing. De Villepin acknowledges visiting R&C's new management to discuss his friend, but insists he was invited and maintains his innocence: "I have nothing to reproach myself for. It is unbearable to try and implicate me in a matter in which I am not involved," he said before his arrest.

The case follows the conviction of former president Jacques Chirac, who received a suspended sentence for corruption last year, and comes amid separate allegations against former president Nicolas Sarkozy regarding illicit campaign contributions from Lilliane Bettencourt, France’s richest woman. Chirac, Sarkozy, and de Villepin were all once close conservative cabinet colleagues, though their relationships have since fractured.

Police confirmed de Villepin was being questioned in central Paris following a request from judges in Strasbourg, and may be held for up to 48 hours before charges are either filed or he is released.

article_content: Grace Oyelude, the winner of the first Miss Nigeria beauty pageant in 1957, celebrated her 93rd birthday on Thursday, November 16, 2023. The milestone was marked by the organizers of Miss Nigeria, along with Oyelude’s family and friends. Rita Dominic, actress and chairman of the Miss Nigeria pageant, shared her birthday wishes on Instagram, saying, "Wishing Mama Grace Oyelude, the very first Miss Nigeria, a very happy 93rd birthday." Dominic also wished Oyelude good health and all-round wellness, thanking God for her grace and praying for her continued strength to serve humanity. The Miss Nigeria organization released a statement praising Oyelude’s courage, resolve, and strength of character, highlighting how these qualities have endeared her to many. The statement added, "Thank you for paving the way and setting the standards that all Miss Nigeria queens follow, as well as your priceless contributions toward women’s empowerment." Oyelude was lauded for using her platform to inspire young girls and women to pursue their dreams and make meaningful contributions to society. Fidelis Anosike, whose company Folio Communications previously owned Miss Nigeria, described Oyelude as "a mother par excellence and a trailblazer for women empowerment." Born on November 16, 1931, in Sabon Gari, Kano State, Oyelude won the inaugural Miss Nigeria pageant at age 26, standing out among over 200 participants and receiving a prize of 200 pounds. Recently, after 16 years of managing the pageant, Anosike transferred the responsibility to The Audrey Silva Company, which is co-owned by his wife, Rita Dominic, and filmmaker Mildred Okwo. The Audrey Silva Company is preparing to host the 2024 edition of the Miss Nigeria pageant in the first quarter of the upcoming year.

Erklæringen tilføjede: "Tak, fordi du har banet vejen og sat standarden for alle Miss Nigeria-dronninger, samt for dine uvurderlige bidrag til kvinders empowerment." article_content: The Chelsea Supporters Trust has voiced its strong opposition to renewed discussions about holding Premier League matches outside England. Reports indicate that league officials are once again entertaining the idea of staging one regular-season game abroad—an idea originally floated in 2008 but quickly dropped after facing major backlash. CST believes such a move would damage the integrity of the competition, raising concerns over fairness, the loss of traditional 'home' advantage, and the practical difficulties for both players and fans. They argue that shifting a game overseas would put loyal supporters at a disadvantage, as dedicated fans might feel obliged to travel internationally at extra cost—further straining already expensive commitments to following their teams. According to the Trust, this proposal threatens to erode the foundational atmosphere that makes the Premier League unique, as season ticket holders would lose access to one of their matches, potentially missing out on major fixtures. CST also criticizes the plan as prioritizing commercial gains over maintaining the community and spirit of English football. They warn this could be just the beginning, opening the door to more domestic games being sent abroad in the future. Citing comparisons to American Football’s international fixtures, CST argues English football’s global reach does not justify following the same model. The Trust expresses deep skepticism about the desire or ability of groups like the FA, UEFA, or FIFA to intervene on behalf of fans and stresses their intent to work with other supporter organizations to campaign against the idea. In summary, the Chelsea Supporters Trust strongly urges both the Premier League and club representatives to consider the long-term consequences for fans and the historic integrity of English football, instead of focusing primarily on additional revenue opportunities.

CST mener, at et sådant tiltag vil skade ligaens integritet og vækker bekymring om retfærdighed, tab af hjemmebanefordel og praktiske udfordringer for både spillere og fans. De påpeger, at loyale fans vil føle sig nødsaget til at rejse udenlands med ekstra omkostninger – oven i de betragtelige udgifter, de allerede har ved at følge deres hold. CST kritiserer også planerne for at sætte kommercielle interesser over fællesskabet og den engelske fodbolds ånd. article_content: A recent report from the Centre for Science and Environment (CSE) highlights that India endured severe weather almost every day from January to September 2023, resulting in nearly 3,000 fatalities. During this time, 86% of days featured extreme conditions, underscoring India's high vulnerability to climate disasters. The report details widespread damage: nearly two million hectares of crops ruined, 80,000 houses lost, and more than 92,000 animals killed. CSE notes that actual numbers are likely higher due to incomplete reporting. CSE attributes the surge in extreme weather to a "new abnormal" created by global warming, with the burning of fossil fuels identified as a primary driver. The report also cites concerns about the growing frequency and intensity of such events due to climate change. On the international front, the 2015 Paris Agreement set temperature limits to well below 2 degrees Celsius over pre-industrial levels, aiming for 1.5 degrees if possible. However, current studies indicate that progress is insufficient, and immediate emissions reductions are needed to avoid surpassing these thresholds. States did not experience equal impacts. Madhya Pradesh saw the most weather incidents (138), while Bihar recorded the highest death toll (642). Other severely affected states included Himachal Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Kerala, Telangana, Karnataka, Assam, and Nagaland, suffering various forms of destruction including loss of crops, livestock, and homes. The year brought notable climate anomalies, with January being warmer than usual and February setting a 122-year heat record. August was also the driest in over a century. Lightning and storms were most common, causing 711 deaths—primarily in Bihar—while heavy rain, floods, and landslides resulted in over 1,900 deaths. Additional analysis shows that more than 80% of Indians reside in areas exposed to significant climate risks. Other business-related updates mentioned, such as stock market movements and corporate developments, are not connected to the climate report.

I denne periode var der ekstreme forhold på 86 % af dagene, hvilket understreger Indiens store sårbarhed over for klimakatastrofer. Rapporten beskriver store ødelæggelser: næsten to millioner hektar afgrøder gik tabt, 80.000 huse blev ødelagt, og mere end 92.000 dyr døde. CSE bemærker, at de reelle tal sandsynligvis er højere på grund af ufuldstændig indberetning. Ifølge CSE skyldes den stigende mængde ekstreme vejrhændelser en "ny unormal" forårsaget af global opvarmning, hvor afbrænding af fossile brændstoffer er en hovedfaktor. Rapporten udtrykker også bekymring over den stigende hyppighed og intensitet af sådanne hændelser på grund af klimaforandringer. Internationalt satte Paris-aftalen i 2015 som mål at holde temperaturstigninger under 2 grader celsius over det førindustrielle niveau, helst 1,5 grader. Nu viser undersøgelser, at fremskridtene er utilstrækkelige og at umiddelbare reduktioner af udledninger er nødvendige for at undgå at overskride disse grænser. De enkelte delstater blev ramt forskelligt. Madhya Pradesh oplevede flest vejrhændelser (138), mens Bihar havde flest dødsfald (642). Andre hårdt ramte stater var Himachal Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Kerala, Telangana, Karnataka, Assam og Nagaland, der led under blandt andet tab af afgrøder, husdyr og boliger. Året bød på bemærkelsesværdige klimaafvigelser; januar var varmere end normalt og februar satte varmerekord for de sidste 122 år. August var også den tørreste i over et århundrede. Lyn og storme var de hyppigste katastrofer med 711 dødsfald—primært i Bihar—mens kraftig regn, oversvømmelser og jordskred kostede over 1.900 livet. Yderligere analyser viser, at mere end 80% af Indiens befolkning bor i områder med betydelig klimarisiko. Andre erhvervsnyheder, der nævnes, såsom aktiemarkedsbevægelser og virksomhedsudviklinger, er ikke forbundet med klimarapporten.

Casey Stoney, the former England women's football captain with 117 international appearances, has shared her personal journey of coming to terms with her sexuality and the complexities of coming out as gay. At 25, Stoney faced the challenge of hiding her same-sex relationship from her partner’s family, which left her feeling isolated and anxious because of the fear of rejection.

Her determination to start a family prompted her to publicly come out in February. As a leading figure in women’s football—having served as England captain and led Team GB at the 2012 London Olympics—Stoney credits diver Tom Daley’s 2013 public announcement as a source of inspiration. While she braced herself for negative responses, Stoney and her pregnant fiancée, Megan Harris (a former teammate), were met with overwhelming support after revealing they were expecting twins via IVF.

Stoney notes that the positive public reaction—including congratulations from Deputy Prime Minister Nick Clegg and comedian Matt Lucas—reflects greater acceptance of LGBTQ+ families in Britain. Nonetheless, she has faced online criticism questioning same-sex parenting. Stoney emphasizes that the defining characteristic of a family is love and support, not its gender composition.

Stoney, who describes herself as cautious, appreciates Megan’s confidence and the contrast in their backgrounds—Megan had her family's full support, while Stoney’s early years in Basildon, Essex, were shaped by financial hardship and self-doubt following her parents’ divorce due to her father’s gambling addiction. Football became her safe space after realizing she was different from her peers at 15.

After meeting Megan at Lincoln Ladies in 2011, Stoney gained the confidence to pursue a family. The couple chose to use Megan’s eggs and an anonymous sperm donor, successfully conceiving after three IVF cycles. Stoney publicly shared the pregnancy news on the BBC sports website and has received strong support from colleagues in football. She observes that female footballers tend to find it somewhat easier than male players to come out, as there is generally less scrutiny and commercial pressure in women's football.

Intent on challenging stereotypes, Stoney believes that around 30 to 40 percent of women footballers are gay, partially due to the challenges women face balancing parenthood with a sports career. As the first woman to join the Professional Footballers’ Association committee, she advocates for addressing these issues.

Embracing motherhood has helped Stoney accept herself, and she hopes her children will grow up in a society where same-sex families are fully accepted—envisioning a future where diversity in family structures is seen as normal.

Casey Stoney, tidligere kaptajn for det engelske kvindefodboldlandshold med 117 landskampe, har delt sin personlige rejse om at acceptere sin seksualitet og de vanskeligheder, der fulgte med at springe ud som lesbisk. Som 25-årig stod Stoney i den svære situation, at hun måtte skjule sit forhold til en kvinde for kærestens familie, hvilket gjorde hende isoleret og angst på grund af frygt for afvisning.

Hendes ønske om at stifte familie motiverede hende til at stå offentligt frem i februar. Som en markant skikkelse i kvindefodbolden—tidligere anfører for England og leder af Team GB ved OL i London 2012—fandt Stoney inspiration i svømmeren Tom Daleys offentlige udmelding i 2013. Selvom hun forberedte sig på negative reaktioner, blev Stoney og hendes gravide forlovede, Megan Harris (tidligere holdkammerat), mødt med overvældende støtte, da de annoncerede, at de ventede tvillinger via IVF.

Stoney bemærker, at den positive respons fra offentligheden—herunder lykønskninger fra vicepremierminister Nick Clegg og komikeren Matt Lucas—afspejler den øgede accept af LGBTQ+-familier i Storbritannien. Alligevel har hun mødt online kritik af samkønnede forældreskab. Stoney understreger, at det centrale for en familie er kærlighed og støtte—ikke forældrenes køn.

Stoney, som beskriver sig selv som forsigtig, sætter pris på Megans selvtillid og påpeger kontrasterne i deres baggrunde—Megan havde fuld støtte fra sin familie, mens Stoney voksede op i Basildon, Essex, præget af økonomiske problemer og selvtvivl efter forældrenes skilsmisse på grund af farens spilafhængighed. Fodbold blev hendes fristed, især da hun i teenagealderen opdagede, hun var anderledes.

Efter at have mødt Megan hos Lincoln Ladies i 2011, fik Stoney den styrke, hun behøvede for at starte en familie. Parret valgte at bruge Megans æg og en anonym sæddonor, og lykkedes med graviditet efter tre IVF-forsøg. Stoney delte nyheden på BBC sportens hjemmeside og har oplevet stor støtte i fodboldmiljøet. Hun oplever, at det oftest er lettere for kvindelige end mandlige spillere at springe ud, da kvindefodbold har mindre offentlig opmærksomhed og færre kommercielle forpligtelser.

Stoney ønsker at modarbejde stereotyper og mener, at 30 til 40 procent af kvindelige fodboldspillere er homoseksuelle, delvist fordi balance mellem moderskab og sport kan være udfordrende. Som første kvinde i Professional Footballers’ Association-komitéen vil hun sætte fokus på disse emner.

At blive mor har hjulpet Stoney til at acceptere sig selv, og hun drømmer om, at hendes børn vokser op i et samfund, hvor familier med to mødre eller fædre er naturligt accepteret—og hvor forskellige familieformer ikke vækker opsigt.

article_content: Nigerian defender Bruno Onyemaechi has joined the list of Super Eagles players in doubt for this month’s 2026 World Cup qualifiers against Lesotho and Zimbabwe after picking up a muscle injury during training with his Portuguese club, Boavista, according to PUNCH Sports Extra. The Eagles will already be without key players Victor Osimhen, Wilfred Ndidi, Samuel Chukwueze, and Zaidu Sanusi due to hamstring injuries, while striker Taiwo Awoniyi's availability remains uncertain despite him resuming training at Nottingham Forest. Onyemaechi missed Boavista’s 2-0 league loss to Sporting Lisbon on Monday due to his muscle issue, and it is not yet clear if he will recover in time for their upcoming match against Rio Ave on Sunday. Notably, the Boavista defender featured in all three of Nigeria’s last matches—friendlies against Saudi Arabia and Mozambique last month, and the final 2023 Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON) qualifier against São Tomé and Príncipe in Uyo. Except for the qualifier against Sierra Leone, Onyemaechi has been called up for every Super Eagles game since November 2022. The 24-year-old remains a key player for Boavista, having started seven out of the team's nine league games this season. Meanwhile, Onyemaechi’s teammate Chidozie Awaziem is among the nominees for Boavista’s Player of the Month award for October, alongside Sebastián Pérez and Róbert Boženík.

Eagles må allerede undvære nøglespillere som Victor Osimhen, Wilfred Ndidi, Samuel Chukwueze og Zaidu Sanusi på grund af fiberskader, og angriber Taiwo Awoniyis deltagelse er fortsat usikker, selvom han er genoptaget træningen i Nottingham Forest. article_content: A 14-month-old girl from Trull, Somerset, is preparing to go home after spending her entire life so far in Musgrove Hospital, Taunton, due to a rare and undiagnosed condition. Maddison Gill is unable to cry, suck, swallow, gag, or cough, and requires ongoing care including tube feeding and medication. Doctors believe Maddison may be unique in the world with her set of symptoms, which have left them unable to give a definitive diagnosis. Since birth in October 2011, Maddison has needed constant medical attention, with her parents, Tamsin Whately and Gene Gill, by her side. When Maddison was born, doctors noticed she gurgled instead of cried, and she needed resuscitation after turning blue during her first bottle feeding. After extended time in the neonatal unit and several operations—including a tracheostomy to help her breathe and a gastrostomy for feeding—Maddison began to show progress. She is now able to roll, stand with support, and has developed her own form of movement, despite lacking basic reflexes. Doctors have now agreed on a comprehensive care routine that will allow Maddison to leave the hospital for the family's home, where community nurses will provide near-constant support. Tamsin, Maddison’s mother, says she is 'really excited' and proud, though acknowledges the family will still require help to give Maddison the care she needs. Arrangements have been made for five days a week of professional care, with Tamsin’s mother assisting on the remaining days. The family hopes Maddison will be home by the end of the month, marking a significant step in her challenging journey. While Maddison's condition is still a mystery, her achievements have surpassed early expectations. Her family is eager to begin this new chapter together, appreciating every milestone Maddison reaches.
translated_content: En 14 måneder gammel pige fra Trull, Somerset, forbereder sig på at komme hjem efter at have tilbragt hele sit liv indtil nu på Musgrove Hospital, Taunton, på grund af en sjælden og udiagnosticeret tilstand. Maddison Gill kan hverken græde, sutte, synke, gabe eller hoste og har brug for vedvarende pleje, inklusive sondeernæring og medicin. Lægerne mener, at Maddison kan være den eneste i verden med sine symptomer, som hidtil har gjort det umuligt at stille en endelig diagnose. Siden sin fødsel i oktober 2011 har Maddison haft brug for konstant medicinsk overvågning, mens hendes forældre, Tamsin Whately og Gene Gill, har været ved hendes side. Da Maddison blev født, bemærkede lægerne, at hun gurglede i stedet for at græde, og hun måtte genoplives, efter hun blev blå under sin første flaske. Efter længere tid på neonatalafdelingen og flere operationer – herunder en trakeostomi for at hjælpe hende med at trække vejret og en gastrostomi til ernæring – begyndte Maddison at vise fremskridt. Hun kan nu rulle, stå med støtte og har udviklet sin egen måde at bevæge sig på, selvom hun mangler grundlæggende reflekser. Lægerne har nu godkendt en omfattende plejepakke, der gør det muligt for Maddison at forlade hospitalet og komme hjem, hvor hun vil få næsten konstant støtte fra hjemmesygeplejersker. Maddisons mor, Tamsin, siger, at hun er 'meget spændt' og stolt, selvom familien fortsat får brug for hjælp til at tage sig af Maddison. Der er lavet aftaler om professionel pleje fem dage om ugen, mens Tamsins mor hjælper de resterende dage. Familien håber, at Maddison kan komme hjem inden udgangen af måneden, hvilket markerer et vigtigt skridt på hendes udfordrende rejse. Selvom Maddisons tilstand stadig er et mysterium, har hendes fremskridt overgået de tidlige forventninger. Familien ser frem til dette nye kapitel og værdsætter hvert af Maddisons milepæle.
