article_content: Ferne McCann has stepped out from behind her friend Lucy Mecklenburgh by becoming the new face of By Caprice’s Valentine’s Day lingerie campaign. Personally chosen by CEO and designer Caprice Bourret, Ferne now leads the brand’s latest collection, taking the spotlight from Lucy. In the photos for the campaign, 23-year-old Ferne models several pink lingerie looks designed for Valentine’s Day. Caprice complimented Ferne’s confidence and authenticity, calling her the ideal ambassador and highlighting her fun, stylish, and sexy nature. Caprice also praised Ferne for embracing her curves. Speaking to Closer magazine, Ferne revealed she works hard to maintain her figure, inspired by co-stars like Lucy Mecklenburgh. While Lucy is naturally slim, Ferne says she puts extra effort into frequent workouts, including sessions with her trainer, friends, and her mother. Through this hard work, Ferne says she feels more confident and sexy. Ferne expressed her excitement at joining By Caprice, saying she’s always been a fan of the brand. She appreciates the lingerie’s feminine design, its flattering fit for all shapes, and the confidence it inspires. On a personal note, Ferne recently ended her relationship with Charlie Sims due to trust issues, and has focused on her own well-being since. She also suggested more dramatic moments are ahead in the next season of 'The Only Way is Essex.' By Caprice’s new lingerie collection, now fronted by Ferne, is available online at the brand’s website.

article_content: NEW DELHI: In one of the standout catches of the ongoing 2023 ODI World Cup, South African cricketer Rassie van der Dussen executed an impressive diving grab to dismiss Australia's Mitchell Marsh in Kolkata on Thursday. Van der Dussen’s superb effort boosted the Proteas’ morale as Australia lost their second wicket while chasing a modest target of 213 runs at Eden Gardens. The brilliant catch occurred in the eighth over when Marsh, on zero, attempted a drive off a back-of-length delivery from pacer Kagiso Rabada. The ball was hit forcefully to the right of cover, where van der Dussen was positioned. Launching into a full-stretch dive, van der Dussen caught the ball mid-air and landed safely, completing an outstanding catch. Marsh walked back for a six-ball duck, looking disappointed, while his South African teammates celebrated van der Dussen’s effort. Earlier, David Miller scored a vital 101 to help South Africa reach a competitive total of 212 all out after a severe top-order collapse in the knockout match. Heinrich Klaasen also contributed a crucial 47 runs.

Van der Dussens flotte indsats løftede Proteas’ moral, da Australien mistede deres andet gærde i jagten på et beskedent mål på 213 point på Eden Gardens. Det fantastiske greb fandt sted i ottende over, da Marsh, som var uden point, forsøgte at slå bolden fra en mellemlang aflevering fra paceren Kagiso Rabada. Bolden blev slået hårdt mod højre for cover, hvor van der Dussen stod. Med et fuldt strakt dyk greb van der Dussen bolden i luften og landede sikkert – og fuldendte et fremragende greb. Marsh gik tilbage til pavillonen efter seks bolde uden point og så skuffet ud, mens hans sydafrikanske holdkammerater fejrede van der Dussens præstation. Tidligere havde David Miller scoret vigtige 101 point og hjulpet Sydafrika frem til en konkurrencedygtig total på 212 efter et voldsomt kollaps blandt de første gærdespillere i knockoutrunden. Heinrich Klaasen bidrog også med afgørende 47 point.

article_content: I got married in 2001 at the age of 31, and my first son was born in 2003. My wife and I met at the British High Commission in 2000 while both applying for visas to the United Kingdom. She was accompanied by her aunt. Our first interaction was brief—just exchanging greetings. Neither of us imagined we would one day end up together, though I was one of the only people she and her aunt recognized there. After that encounter, we kept in touch through the landline since GSM phones were not available then. Our conversations were initially purely platonic and not centered on romance or marriage. I told them that whenever I was traveling back to Kano (where they lived), I'd try to visit. That's how our friendship started. Later, when I was in Birmingham, England, for a human rights course, one of the participants asked me why I wasn't married. At the time, I had no interest in marriage, citing the many problems in Nigeria. My motto was 'The struggle must continue!' However, that participant encouraged me to think about family life. Eventually, I reconsidered, and that conversation rekindled the idea of marriage in me. When I returned to Nigeria, I met my future wife again, but we still didn't discuss marriage. Her aunt later encouraged me to settle down, but I responded that there was a lot of work to do in Nigeria. After much thought, I grew more serious, and we mutually agreed to marry. We've now shared 22 fantastic years together, raising our three beautiful children—two girls and one boy. My first child, a boy, is in his 20s. My first daughter just turned 14, and my youngest is 10. Marriage has taught me discipline and accountability, constantly reminding me to be transparent about my whereabouts and intentions, and to always communicate openly with my partner. It has required patience, generosity, and responsibility, discouraging reckless behavior. Marriage instills discipline and the expectation of mature behavior. To me, fatherhood is a tremendous responsibility, requiring me to set a good example so that my children are well raised and learn positive habits. I make it a point to talk to my children every day, especially connecting with my youngest daughter through video calls.

Min kone og jeg mødte hinanden på den britiske højkommission i 2000, hvor vi begge søgte visum til Storbritannien. Hun var sammen med sin tante. Vores første møde var kort – vi udvekslede bare høfligheder. Ingen af os forestillede os, at vi en dag ville ende sammen, men jeg var én af de få, som hun og hendes tante kunne identificere der. Efter det møde holdt vi kontakten via fastnettelefon, da der ikke var GSM-telefoner dengang. Vores samtaler var i starten helt platoniske og ikke centreret om romantik eller ægteskab. Jeg sagde til dem, at når jeg var på vej tilbage til Kano (hvor de boede), ville jeg kigge forbi. Sådan begyndte vores venskab. Senere, da jeg deltog i et kursus om menneskerettigheder i Birmingham, England, spurgte en af deltagerne mig, hvorfor jeg ikke var gift. Dengang havde jeg ikke interesse for ægteskab, blandt andet pga. de mange problemer i Nigeria. Mit motto var 'Kampen må fortsætte!' Men denne person fik mig til at overveje familielivet. article_content: An unusually large number of high-profile Hollywood movies are hitting theaters this Christmas, showcasing several big-name stars. With Tom Cruise portraying a real-life anti-Nazi hero and Brad Pitt taking audiences on a fantastical journey, there's a wide variety of films on offer. Here are five top movies opening Thursday: 1. 'Valkyrie' – Tom Cruise stars as Colonel Claus von Stauffenberg, a German officer involved in a plot to assassinate Hitler to prevent the collapse of Europe. Kenneth Branagh and Tom Wilkinson co-star in this United Artists release. 2. 'The Curious Case of Benjamin Button' – Brad Pitt leads this adaptation of F. Scott Fitzgerald's tale about a man who lives his life backward, getting younger with time. Cate Blanchett co-stars in the nearly three-hour film, which has already garnered several critics' awards. Paramount Pictures is distributing. 3. 'Marley & Me' – Owen Wilson and Jennifer Aniston play a couple whose adopted dog, Marley, brings both chaos and life lessons, in a story adapted from John Grogan’s best-selling memoir. The film, featuring Alan Arkin and Kathleen Turner and rated PG, comes from 20th Century Fox. While comedic, it also touches on deeper emotions. 4. 'Bedtime Stories' – Adam Sandler plays a hotel handyman whose bedtime stories magically start to come true, creating unforeseen adventures. The cast includes Guy Pearce, Courteney Cox, and Keri Russell. This family-friendly comedy has a PG rating and has received mixed reviews. 5. 'The Spirit' – Gabriel Macht takes on the role of Denny Colt, a masked vigilante fighting his foe, the Octopus, portrayed by Samuel L. Jackson. Eva Mendes co-stars in this graphic novel adaptation, which is rated PG-13 and distributed by Lionsgate, aiming especially at teen and young adult male audiences.

article_content: Deborah O'Conner, a business communications lecturer at Florida State University, resigned following a series of racist, homophobic, and anti-Muslim comments made publicly on Facebook. O'Conner, who holds a Ph.D. from FSU and taught there for 18 years, posted comments referencing Black people, gay people, and Muslims in a disparaging way on a third party’s Facebook post. Her remarks were a response to New York-based stylist Colin Lively, who had posted about the Justice Department’s finding that Cleveland police engage in excessive force. O'Conner’s comments included statements such as, 'YOU elected POTUS, Holder et al. And they are supposed to represent all Americans, not just blacks,' as initially reported by Folioweekly.com. Further messages included derogatory slurs and references to various social groups, as well as negative remarks about France and Muslims. Colin Lively, the recipient of O'Conner’s comments, initially found them surprising but was ultimately disturbed by the extent of her statements. A friend of Lively documented the posts before O'Conner deleted her Facebook account. These comments were subsequently shared with the National Justice Network, which contacted FSU with a complaint. O'Conner then resigned from her position but did not offer an apology, expressing instead that she believed the punishment was disproportionate. She also requested the business school dean, Caryn Beck-Dudley, to help suppress the story, but the dean declined to engage with that request and accepted her resignation without comment on the specifics.

Hendes udtalelser var et svar til den New York-baserede stylist Colin Lively, som havde skrevet om Justitsministeriets konklusion om, at politiet i Cleveland bruger overdreven magt. O'Conners kommentarer inkluderede blandt andet: 'DU valgte præsidenten, Holder m.fl. Og de skal repræsentere alle amerikanere, ikke kun sorte,' hvilket først blev rapporteret af Folioweekly.com. Yderligere beskeder omfattede nedsættende ord og referencer til flere sociale grupper samt negative bemærkninger om Frankrig og muslimer. Colin Lively, der modtog O'Conners kommentarer, blev først overrasket, men blev til sidst foruroliget over omfanget af hendes udtalelser. En ven af Lively tog screenshots af opslagene, før O'Conner slettede sin Facebook-profil. Kommentarerne blev derefter delt med National Justice Network, som kontaktede FSU med en klage. O'Conner valgte derefter at fratræde sin stilling, men hun undskyldte ikke og udtrykte i stedet, at hun mente, at straffen var for hård. article_content: A recent court ruling may hinder Royal Dutch Shell's plans to drill for oil off the coast of Alaska. The Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals determined that federal regulators relied on an 'arbitrary and capricious' estimate when approving the project in the Chukchi Sea. This decision comes as Shell prepares to resume its intermittent oil exploration there. The project has drawn strong opposition from environmental groups and native Alaskan communities, who have been pursuing legal action to halt the drilling. According to the judges, the federal government used 'an unrealistically low estimate' of how much oil Shell could extract, a key variable in assessing the Arctic environmental impact. The Minerals Management Service, the agency handling leases at the time, set the figure at 1 billion barrels, though the court noted expert estimates ranged up to 12 billion barrels. The panel’s split decision sends the issue back to a lower court in Alaska for additional review. In response, the plaintiffs called the ruling 'a victory for the Arctic Ocean' and maintained that 'the government has no business offering oil companies leases in the Chukchi Sea.' Shell did not provide an immediate comment; spokesman Curtis Smith said the company was still evaluating the ruling. Niel Lawrence, senior attorney at the Natural Resources Defense Council, stated that the Obama administration 'can't in good conscience authorize Shell to do exploratory drilling under those leases.' Lawrence added that the court’s findings mean the government does not fully understand the impact of the leases and must reconsider them before allowing Shell to continue. The NRDC is among the plaintiffs in the lawsuit. Both the Environmental Protection Agency and the Fish and Wildlife Service had previously challenged the 1 billion barrel estimate before the lease sale in 2008, according to the court decision. Lawrence asserted Shell’s Arctic clearance was 'predicated on a lowball estimate of production,' arguing this is a significant issue rather than a mere technicality. The Minerals Management Service has since been reorganized, now operating as the Bureau of Ocean Energy Management, which declined to comment on the case. In court, the agency stated its estimate could be too high because producing oil in such a remote and risky environment may not occur at all. Shell has invested billions in Arctic exploration and began preliminary drilling in September 2012, but soon encountered major setbacks, such as a grounded drill barge. The company skipped drilling in 2013 but has sought permission to resume work. Shell’s schedule was also affected by the Deepwater Horizon disaster, which caused significant loss and environmental harm in 2010. Shell contends it is drilling in shallower water and at lower pressures than those in the Deepwater Horizon accident. The retreat of Arctic sea ice, which reached record lows in 2012, has created new energy exploration opportunities. Climate scientists largely agree that this melting is symptomatic of global warming caused by the burning of fossil fuels, though this remains a politically sensitive issue.

Appeldomstolen for det niende distrikt har fastslået, at føderale myndigheder har baseret deres godkendelse på et 'vilkårligt og uforsvarligt' estimat i forbindelse med projektet i Chukchi-havet. Afgørelsen falder, mens Shell forbereder at genoptage den tilbagevendende olieefterforskning i området. Projektet har mødt markant modstand fra miljøgrupper og oprindelige samfund i Alaska, som har ført retssager for at standse boringerne. Ifølge dommerne brugte den føderale regering et 'urealistisk lavt estimat' for, hvor meget olie Shell kunne udvinde – et centralt punkt i vurderingen af miljøpåvirkningen i Arktis. Minerals Management Service, som dengang håndterede licensering, fastsatte tallet til 1 milliard tønder, selvom retten bemærkede, at eksperter vurderede op til 12 milliarder tønder. Den delte dom sender sagen tilbage til en lavere domstol i Alaska for yderligere behandling. Sagsøgerne kaldte afgørelsen for 'en sejr for det arktiske hav' og fastholdt, at 'regeringen ikke bør udleje områder i Chukchi-havet til olieselskaber.' Shell havde ingen umiddelbar kommentar; talsmand Curtis Smith oplyste, at selskabet stadig analyserer afgørelsen. Niel Lawrence, ledende advokat hos Natural Resources Defense Council, udtalte, at Obama-administrationen 'ikke med god samvittighed kan give Shell lov til at foretage efterforskningsboringer under de nuværende licenser.' Lawrence tilføjede, at dommens konklusion betyder, at regeringen ikke forstår konsekvenserne af licenserne fuldt ud og derfor skal revurdere dem, før Shell kan fortsætte. NRDC er blandt sagsøgerne i retssagen. Både Environmental Protection Agency og Fish and Wildlife Service havde tidligere udfordret estimatet på 1 milliard tønder inden licitationsrunden i 2008, ifølge dommen. Lawrence fastslog, at Shells arktiske tilladelse var 'baseret på et lavt sat estimat for produktion' og argumenterede for, at dette er en alvorlig fejl, ikke blot en teknikalitet. Minerals Management Service er nu blevet omorganiseret og fungerer som Bureau of Ocean Energy Management, som har afvist at kommentere på sagen. Agenturet udtalte i retten, at deres estimat måske var for højt, fordi oliefremstilling i et så afsides og risikofyldt område måske slet ikke bliver til noget. Shell har investeret milliarder i Arktis og begyndte forberedende boringer i september 2012, men stødte hurtigt på store forhindringer, blandt andet da en borepram gik på grund. Selskabet sprang boringerne over i 2013, men har senere søgt om tilladelse til at genoptage arbejdet. Shells tidsplan blev også påvirket af Deepwater Horizon-ulykken, som i 2010 havde store menneskelige og miljømæssige omkostninger. Shell hævder, at deres boringer foregår på lavere vand og under mindre tryk end i Deepwater Horizon-ulykken. Tilbagetrækningen af havisen i Arktis, der ramte rekordlave niveauer i 2012, har skabt nye muligheder for energiudvinding i området. Klimaforskere er stort set enige om, at denne afsmeltning skyldes global opvarmning fra afbrænding af fossile brændstoffer, selvom emnet fortsat er politisk følsomt.

article_content: Preparations for Diwali are underway in Ayodhya, where the city aims to set a world record by lighting 2.4 million lamps at 51 ghats simultaneously. On Saturday morning, Uttar Pradesh Tourism Minister Jaiveer Singh will flag off a procession of tableaus from Saket Degree College, highlighting the craftsmanship of artisans from across the state. The tableaus are scheduled to arrive at Ram Katha Park at 2:30 p.m. The procession will include seven tableaus from the Uttar Pradesh Tourism Department, one Ram Rath, and eleven tableaus from the Information Department, each depicting different stories from the Ramayana. Additionally, dancers will perform traditional dances such as Dhobiya from Azamgarh, Kullu Nati from Himachal Pradesh, Gatka and Bhangra from Punjab, Garba from Gujarat, Dhol Tasha from Nagpur, and more from various parts of India. Approximately 25,000 volunteers from Avadh University and the Ayodhya district administration will assist in lighting the diyas at the same time. Officials from the Guinness Book of World Records will count the lamps with drone cameras. The grand Deepotsav program will begin at 3 p.m. and be inaugurated by Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, with most Uttar Pradesh ministers present. After the Deepotsav, the city will host a laser show. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath will arrive in Ayodhya at 2 p.m. Diplomats from over 50 countries, as well as Deputy Chief Ministers Keshav Maurya and Brajesh Pathak, will participate. The Chief Minister will watch the tableau procession at Ram Katha Park. The performer playing Lord Ram will arrive in Ayodhya by helicopter at 3:30 p.m., after which the Governor and Chief Minister will perform his coronation. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath will perform the Saryu Aarti at 6:30 p.m. and inaugurate the festival of lights at Ram Ki Paidi on the banks of the Saryu river at 7:30 p.m. He and the guests will then watch Ramlila performances from four countries. Yogi Adityanath is expected to stay in Ayodhya overnight. Meanwhile, a sand artist from Ballia has created works inspired by Lord Ram's life, such as his Pushpak Viman and Bharat Milap. Students from the state's Lalit Kala Academy have also depicted Lord Ram's journey in their artwork. A dancer portraying Lord Ram shared his gratitude, saying, 'Dressing up as Lord Ram during Diwali in Ayodhya is a blessing. I follow his teachings in my life.' Another dancer, dressed as Sita, said, 'Our dance company is performing in Ayodhya for the first time. This is a significant achievement. There will be 210 dancers performing together.'

article_content: ROME — Search operations resumed Sunday in the sea and along the southwestern Sicilian coast after a fishing boat carrying dozens of migrants ran aground, resulting in five deaths and about 20 people missing, according to rescuers. The bodies of five men were recovered Saturday morning on the beach at Marinella di Selinunte near Trapani. Thirty-five other men survived the shipwreck and were identified after reaching nearby towns, the Coast Guard said. Captain Daniele Governale of the Palermo Coast Guard, leading the coordination of search and rescue operations, reported, "Based on survivors' accounts, the boat left Tunisia on Thursday night with around 60 people on board. That would mean approximately 20 individuals are missing. However, since extensive searches at sea, including those by divers, have yielded no results so far, we remain hopeful that some have survived and reached shore." Arrivals of people on Italy’s shores from North Africa in small and unseaworthy boats have increased significantly in recent months. Since January, more than 142,000 migrants have arrived in Italy, compared to 82,000 over the same period last year, according to Interior Ministry data. The Mediterranean remains one of the world’s most dangerous migration routes. The International Organization for Migration estimates that roughly 2,500 people have died or gone missing during the crossing since the start of the year. Italy’s coalition government, led by right-wing Premier Giorgia Meloni—who vowed to curb illegal immigration—recently passed stricter regulations to limit arrivals, including longer detention terms for irregular migrants.

Ligene af fem mænd blev fundet lørdag morgen på stranden ved Marinella di Selinunte nær Trapani. Femogtredive andre mænd overlevede skibbruddet og blev identificeret efter at have nået nærliggende byer, oplyser Kystvagten. Kaptajn Daniele Governale fra Palermo Kystvagt, der leder koordinationen af søgning og redning, udtalte: "Ifølge overlevendes beretninger forlod båden Tunesien torsdag aften med omkring 60 personer ombord. Det betyder, at ca. 20 personer stadig er savnede. Selvom omfattende eftersøgninger til havs, også udført af dykkere, endnu ikke har givet resultater, håber vi fortsat, at nogle har overlevet og nået land." Antallet af personer, der ankommer til Italiens kyster fra Nordafrika i små og usikre både, er steget markant i de seneste måneder. Siden januar er mere end 142.000 migranter ankommet til Italien, sammenlignet med 82.000 i samme periode sidste år, ifølge data fra Indenrigsministeriet. Middelhavet er fortsat en af de farligste migrationsruter i verden. Den Internationale Organisation for Migration anslår, at cirka 2.500 personer er døde eller savnet under overfarten siden årets begyndelse. Italiens koalitionsregering, ledet af den højreorienterede premierminister Giorgia Meloni – der har lovet at stramme op overfor ulovlig indvandring – har for nylig vedtaget strengere regler for at begrænse ankomster, herunder længere tilbageholdelsestider for irregulære migranter.

Karl Stephenson, a 30-year-old tree surgeon from Hagley, West Midlands, has described how he intervened to stop a violent assault outside a pub while dressed in a caveman costume. The incident took place outside the Mitre Inn in Stourbridge on October 27th. CCTV footage released by West Midlands Police shows Stephenson confronting three men who were attacking a 31-year-old man. The attackers had pushed the victim to the ground and were kicking and punching him as he lay defenseless.

Stephenson, accompanied by a friend, approached the group wearing his fancy dress costume, armed only with an inflatable club. His intervention stopped the attack, and he stayed with the injured man until the police and ambulance arrived. The footage quickly gained attention after being publicized by the police in hopes of identifying the assailants.

Commenting on the incident, Stephenson said, “I was just trying to be a good citizen and hoped someone would do the same for me.” He was surprised to learn the footage had spread widely, adding, “Out of all the things I could be wearing, it was a caveman costume. We decided to wear fancy dress because it was Halloween.”

Detective Constable John Horrobin appealed for anyone who witnessed the assault or attended the event at the Mitre Inn to come forward. He stated, “The victim remembers very little about the attack, but thankfully he is expected to make a full recovery.”

Karl Stephenson, en 30-årig træspecialist fra Hagley i West Midlands, har fortalt, hvordan han greb ind for at stoppe et voldeligt overfald udenfor en pub, mens han var iført et hulemandskostume. Episoden fandt sted udenfor Mitre Inn i Stourbridge den 27. oktober. Overvågningsvideo fra West Midlands Politi viser Stephenson konfrontere tre mænd, der var i gang med at overfalde en 31-årig mand. Overfaldsmændene havde væltet offeret omkuld og slog og sparkede ham, mens han lå forsvarsløs på jorden.

Stephenson, som var sammen med en ven, gik hen til gruppen iført sit udklædningskostume og kun bevæbnet med en oppustelig kølle. Hans indgriben stoppede overfaldet, og han blev hos den tilskadekomne mand, indtil politi og ambulance ankom. Optagelserne fik hurtigt stor opmærksomhed, efter politiet offentliggjorde dem i håb om at identificere gerningsmændene.

Om hændelsen fortæller Stephenson: “Jeg ville bare være en god borger og håber, nogen ville gøre det samme for mig.” Han blev overrasket over at se, hvor hurtigt optagelserne spredte sig og tilføjer: “Ud af alle de ting jeg kunne have haft på, så var det et hulemandskostume. Vi valgte at klæde os ud, fordi det næsten var Halloween.”

Efterforsker John Horrobin fra politiet opfordrer nu alle, der overværede overfaldet eller deltog i begivenheden på Mitre Inn, til at henvende sig. Han siger: “Offeret kan huske meget lidt fra overfaldet, men heldigvis forventes han at komme sig helt.”

A dramatic rescue unfolded in Midtown Manhattan on Wednesday when two maintenance workers became stranded nearly 600 feet above ground after their scaffold bent into a V-shape on the side of the iconic Hearst Tower. The incident, which occurred around 2:40pm, left the workers dangling 45 stories up for about 90 minutes. New York Fire Department (FDNY) officials arrived promptly, securing the trapped men with safety ropes.

Rescue teams cut through thick glass windows on the 44th floor using specialized tools to reach the workers. FDNY firefighter Tom Gayron explained that once the workers were secured from the roof, rescue members assisted them back inside the building. Throughout the ordeal, both men—26-year-old Victor from the Bronx and 49-year-old Steve from Brooklyn—remained remarkably composed.

Authorities blocked off nearby streets and sidewalks for safety as crowds gathered below to watch the rescue. Once inside, medics assessed the workers, who were found to be in good condition, smiling and free of major injuries.

The scaffold, equipped with advanced safety features and monitored by a system of 67 sensors, is one of the most sophisticated in New York but reportedly failed to lock properly, causing the accident. By 5:30pm, the scaffolding was being retrieved. Officials from the New York State Department of Labor are investigating the incident.

Hændelsen, der opstod omkring kl. 14.40, efterlod arbejderne hængende 45 etager oppe i cirka 90 minutter. New Yorks brandvæsen (FDNY) ankom hurtigt og sikrede de fastklemte mænd med sikkerhedsreb.

Redningsholdet skar gennem tykke glasvinduer på 44. etage med specialværktøj for at nå arbejderne. FDNY-brandmand Tom Gayron forklarede, at når arbejderne var sikret fra taget, hjalp redningsmedlemmer dem tilbage ind i bygningen. Begge mænd—26-årige Victor fra Bronx og 49-årige Steve fra Brooklyn—forblev bemærkelsesværdigt rolige gennem hele situationen.

Myndighederne afspærrede gader og fortove i nærheden som en sikkerhedsforanstaltning, mens folk samledes nedenfor for at overvære redningen. Da de kom ind, blev arbejderne undersøgt af læger, der kunne konstatere, at de var i god form, smilende og uden alvorlige skader.

Klokken 17.30 var stilladset ved at blive hentet. Embedsmænd fra New York State Department of Labor undersøger hændelsen.

article_content: DOVER AIR FORCE BASE, Delaware (CNN) -- Staff Sergeant Phillip A. Myers of the U.S. Air Force was killed by a roadside bomb in Afghanistan on Saturday. His remains arrived at Dover Air Force Base in Delaware on Sunday. The return of Myers, age 30, marked a solemn occasion that has occurred more than 5,000 times at Dover since the Afghanistan war began in late 2001. The proceedings followed established traditions: the carry team respectfully transferred the flag-draped transfer case from the plane to a waiting vehicle, with the Myers family quietly observing every step. On this occasion, however, roughly 40 journalists were present to document the return—the first time in almost 20 years that media coverage was allowed under a new policy. Myers’ widow was the first to be asked if she wanted the media present, as required by new rules from Defense Secretary Robert Gates. Her decision allowed the public to witness a moment rarely seen during the wars in Afghanistan and Iraq. The only notable sound was the hum of the Atlas Air 747's generator, which had transported both Myers and another fallen soldier. Media coverage was permitted only for Myers, as the family of the other service member did not authorize coverage. Journalists on the flight line were instructed to remain silent, refrain from using camera flashes, and limit their movement. As cameras filmed, an eight-member carry team in dress uniforms and white gloves stood by the transfer case carrying Myers while Chaplain Maj. Klabens Noel offered a prayer. The team moved the case to the loader with care, and lights illuminated the scene as it was carried to a waiting truck. After securing the case, the team saluted, the doors slowly closed, and the truck, escorted by police, took Myers to the base mortuary. Seven family members looked on, including one man who wept quietly. Myers, from Hopewell, Virginia, was assigned to the 48th Civil Engineer Squadron at Royal Air Force Lakenheath in the UK. He was awarded the Bronze Star for valor in March 2008. He was 30 years old. Media coverage of returning war dead had been banned since 1991 by a decision from President George Bush, with debate about whether it constituted censorship or protected families' privacy. An exception by President Clinton in 2000 allowed coverage after the USS Cole attack. President Obama later asked Gates to review the policy, resulting in its reversal in February. Families now decide if media can be present for their loved ones' return. Opinions are mixed about the change—some support showing the human cost of war, while others prefer privacy. Gates stated, “We are committed to ensuring that America’s fallen heroes are received with honor, respect, and recognition. The key principle is that families should decide about media coverage.”
translated_content: DOVER AIR FORCE BASE, Delaware (CNN) -- Stabssersjant Phillip A. Myers fra det amerikanske luftvåben blev dræbt af en vejkantbombe i Afghanistan lørdag. Hans jordiske rester ankom til Dover Air Force Base i Delaware søndag. Hjemkomsten af Myers, 30 år, markerede en højtidelig begivenhed, der har fundet sted over 5.000 gange ved Dover siden Afghanistankrigen begyndte i slutningen af 2001. Processen fulgte indarbejdede traditioner: bæringsteamet overførte respektfuldt den flagdækkede transferkasse fra flyet til et ventende køretøj, mens familien Myers stille observerede hvert skridt. På denne aften var omkring 40 journalister dog til stede for at dokumentere hjemkomsten—det var første gang i næsten 20 år, at medierne fik lov under en ny politik. Myers' enke var den første, der blev spurgt, om hun ønskede mediernes tilstedeværelse, som regler fra forsvarsminister Robert Gates kræver. Hendes beslutning gav offentligheden mulighed for at opleve et øjeblik, der sjældent ses under krigene i Afghanistan og Irak. Den eneste bemærkelsesværdige lyd var summen fra Atlas Air 747'eren, der havde transporteret både Myers og en anden faldet soldat. Mediedækning blev kun tilladt for Myers, da den anden soldats familie ikke gav tilladelse. Journalisterne på flypladsen blev bedt om at forholde sig stille, undgå kamerablitz og begrænse deres bevægelser. Mens kameraerne rullede, stod et otte mand stort bæringsteam i paradeuniformer og hvide handsker ved transferkassen med Myers, mens feltpræst major Klabens Noel holdt en bøn. Teamet flyttede kassen med omtanke til laderen, og kraftig belysning oplyste scenen, mens den blev båret til en ventende lastbil. Efter at kassen var sikret, saluterede holdet, dørene lukkede langsomt, og lastbilen, eskorteret af politiet, transporterde Myers til base-mortuaret. Syv familiemedlemmer så på, inklusive en mand der stille græd. Myers, fra Hopewell, Virginia, var tilknyttet 48th Civil Engineer Squadron ved Royal Air Force Lakenheath i Storbritannien. Han modtog Bronze Star for tapperhed i marts 2008. Han var 30 år. Mediedækning af hjemvendende faldne soldater havde været forbudt siden 1991 efter en beslutning af præsident George Bush, og der har været debat om, hvorvidt dette var censur eller beskyttede familiernes privatliv. En undtagelse fra præsident Clinton i 2000 tillod dækning efter USS Cole-angrebet. Præsident Obama bad senere Gates om at gennemgå politikken, hvilket førte til, at den blev omstødt i februar. Nu afgør familierne selv, om medier må være til stede ved hjemkomsten. Der er blandede holdninger til ændringen—nogle støtter at vise krigens menneskelige omkostninger, mens andre foretrækker privatliv. Gates udtalte: 'Vi er forpligtet på, at USA’s faldne helte modtages med ære, respekt og anerkendelse. Det afgørende princip er, at familierne selv skal beslutte omkring mediedækning.'
post_content: For the first time in nearly 20 years, the return of a fallen U.S. Airman, Staff Sgt. Phillip Myers, was covered by the media at Dover AFB. Families now choose if journalists can witness this solemn moment. #Military #History #DoverAFB

article_content: Ahead of the Australian Open, the first Grand Slam of the year, defending champion Roger Federer spoke with CNN’s Pedro Pinto about his rivalry with Rafael Nadal, clarifying that their competition is restricted to the tennis court, and that they maintain a strong friendship off it. “Some people may find that strange, others think it’s great—and it’s certainly good for the sport,” Federer said. He compared their rapport to past rivalries that were marked by animosity, saying that kind of tension is no longer necessary. Federer believes that his tough matches with Nadal have improved them both and strengthened their mutual respect. At the end of last year, Nadal accepted Federer’s invitation to join him in the ‘Match for Africa’ charity event in Zurich, benefiting the Roger Federer Foundation’s work supporting child development in Africa. Federer won in Zurich, while Nadal claimed victory in Madrid soon after. Federer’s winning form continued into the new year, with a third career title at the Qatar Open in Doha. Although they did not compete against each other there, the two have played 22 times since 2004, with Nadal currently leading their head-to-head 14 wins to 8. As Federer prepares for the Australian Open in Melbourne, he acknowledges some nerves as defending champion: “There’s a bit of pressure, but I love coming to Australia—it’s a wonderful place to play,” he said, noting that solid off-season practice has boosted his confidence. Federer’s resurgence has prompted critics to reconsider their assessments, especially after losing and regaining the number one ranking. “It’s not the first time I’ve been written off,” he said. “After Rafa overtook me, people doubted me, and when Rafa went nine months without a title, people doubted him too. It’s frustrating—memories can be short and press conferences can be negative even when there’s no cause. Sometimes, my opponent just plays better, but that’s not always recognized.” Federer’s team includes Swiss Davis Cup captain Severin Luthi, and, since last August, renowned coach Paul Annacone, formerly Pete Sampras’s coach. Annacone has encouraged a more aggressive approach in Federer’s game. “He’s pushed me to play more aggressively and we’ve focused on some key areas, which have started to pay off,” Federer explained.
translated_content: Forud for Australian Open, årets første Grand Slam, fortalte den forsvarende mester Roger Federer til CNN’s Pedro Pinto, at hans rivalisering med Rafael Nadal kun udspiller sig på tennisbanen – udenfor er de gode venner. ”Nogle synes måske, det er mærkeligt, andre synes, det er fantastisk – og det er bestemt godt for sporten,” siger Federer. Han sammenligner deres forhold med tidligere tiders rivaliseringer, hvor fjendskab var normen, og påpeger, at den slags spændinger ikke længere er nødvendige. Federer mener, at de krævende kampe mod Nadal har gjort dem begge til bedre spillere og styrket deres gensidige respekt. Sidste år tog Nadal imod Federers invitation til at deltage i ”Match for Africa” i Zürich, et velgørenhedsevent til fordel for Roger Federer Foundation og dens arbejde for børns udvikling i Afrika. Federer vandt kampen i Zürich, mens Nadal fik revanche i Madrid kort efter. Federer har taget sin gode form med ind i det nye år og har vundet Qatar Open i Doha for tredje gang. Selvom de ikke stod overfor hinanden der, har de mødt hinanden 22 gange siden 2004, og Nadal fører 14-8. Federer forbereder sig nu på Australian Open i Melbourne og erkender, at han mærker presset som forsvarende mester: ”Der er et vist pres, men jeg elsker at komme til Australien – det er et fantastisk sted at spille,” siger han og tilføjer, at god træning uden for sæsonen har gjort ham selvsikker. Federers gode resultater har fået kritikere til at genoverveje deres vurderinger, især efter han mistede og genvandt sin førsteplads. ”Det er ikke første gang, jeg er blevet afskrevet,” siger han. ”Efter Rafa overtog førstepladsen, tvivlede folk på mig, og da Rafa gik ni måneder uden en titel, var det ham, de begyndte at tvivle på. Det er frustrerende – folk glemmer hurtigt, og pressemøderne kan være præget af en negativ tone, selvom der ikke er grund til det. Nogle gange spiller modstanderen bare bedre, men det er ikke altid anerkendt.” Federers team består af Davis Cup-kaptajn Severin Luthi samt – siden august – den anerkendte træner Paul Annacone, tidligere coach for Pete Sampras. Annacone har opfordret Federer til at spille mere aggressivt og sammen har de arbejdet på vigtige områder, som ifølge Federer allerede bærer frugt.

article_content: Jakarta, Indonesia (CNN) – Within hours after polls closed in Indonesia's presidential election, candidate Joko "Jokowi" Widodo declared victory, while his rival Prabowo Subianto urged supporters to be patient as the official vote count continued. Unofficial quick counts on Wednesday indicated Widodo held a narrow lead over Prabowo. Widodo, a former furniture exporter who became governor of Jakarta, was ahead of Prabowo, a former military officer. "Today, Indonesia's new leader has been chosen by the people," Widodo announced. "We begin a new chapter in our history and a fresh start for Indonesia." Widodo's rise from relative obscurity to becoming a front-runner for the presidency of the world's largest Muslim-majority country has drawn comparisons to the rapid ascent of U.S. President Barack Obama in 2008. For his supporters, the so-called "Jokowi effect" signals the arrival of a new style of political leadership, departing from Indonesia's tradition of leaders with military, bureaucratic, or elite backgrounds. "This is not just a victory for the party or the team, but a win for all Indonesians," Widodo told his supporters, wearing his signature checkered shirt. Independent polling organizations estimated that Widodo received about 52-53% of the vote, while Prabowo had around 46-48%. These unofficial quick counts, based on samples from polling stations, are typically accurate within one to two percentage points. However, unlike previous Indonesian elections, this presidential race remains very close. "By most democratic standards, a margin of five to six percentage points would be decisive, but in Indonesia, this is considered a tight race," said Thomas Pepinsky, an associate professor at Cornell University who studies South Asia. On Wednesday night, Prabowo indicated he was undeterred by the quick count results. "Let the KPU (Indonesia’s election commission) do its work and determine the official result," he told his supporters. "Despite several quick counts, the real count shows that we are still ahead of our competitor." Prabowo, the former son-in-law of former president Suharto, has emphasized his military background in his campaign. He has never held public office but has run on his experience as a former lieutenant general. "Let’s be patient and respectful," he told supporters. "But don’t think that we are weak or easily intimidated." Millions of Indonesians cast their paper ballots on Wednesday. The ballots will be counted at local districts and then recounted at the national level, a process expected to take two to three weeks. Widodo urged his supporters in Jakarta to monitor the process and ensure the election commission’s count is transparent and fair. "Our responsibility is to safeguard the count and make sure it is proper, honest, and free from manipulation," he said. The next president of Indonesia will be inaugurated on October 20. Voters face concerns over slow economic growth, increasing violence against religious minorities, and widespread government corruption. "The next president must aggressively tackle corruption to improve Indonesia’s economy and make it attractive for domestic and international investment," Pepinsky noted. Reporting for CNN: Kathy Quiano in Jakarta and Madison Park in Hong Kong, with contributions from David Molko in Jakarta.
translated_content: Jakarta, Indonesien (CNN) – Få timer efter at valgstederne lukkede ved Indonesiens præsidentvalg, erklærede kandidaten Joko "Jokowi" Widodo sejr, mens hans rival Prabowo Subianto opfordrede sine støtter til at være tålmodige, mens den officielle optælling fortsatte. Uofficielle hurtigtællinger onsdag viste, at Widodo havde et lille forspring over Prabowo. Widodo, tidligere møbeleksportør og nu guvernør i Jakarta, lå foran Prabowo, en tidligere militærofficer. "I dag er Indonesiens nye leder blevet valgt af folket," annoncerede Widodo. "Vi starter et nyt kapitel i vores historie og en frisk begyndelse for Indonesien." Widodos opstigning fra relativ ukendthed til at være en af favoritterne i præsidentvalget i verdens største muslimske land har givet anledning til sammenligninger med den hurtige opstigning for USA's præsident Barack Obama i 2008. For hans tilhængere signalerer den såkaldte "Jokowi-effekt" ankomsten af en ny type politisk lederskab, et brud med Indonesiens tradition for ledere med militær, bureaukratisk eller elitær baggrund. "Dette er ikke kun en sejr for partiet eller holdet, men en sejr for alle indonesere," sagde Widodo til sine støtter iført sin karakteristiske ternede skjorte. Uafhængige meningsmålinger vurderede, at Widodo fik ca. 52-53% af stemmerne, mens Prabowo havde omkring 46-48%. Disse uofficielle hurtigtællinger, baseret på stikprøver fra valgsteder, er normalt nøjagtige inden for ét til to procentpoint. Men i modsætning til tidligere indonesiske valg er dette præsidentvalg meget tæt. "Efter de fleste demokratiske standarder ville en margin på fem til seks procentpoint være afgørende, men i Indonesien betragtes dette som et tæt valg," sagde Thomas Pepinsky, lektor ved Cornell University, der forsker i Sydøstasien. Onsdag aften lod Prabowo forstå, at han ikke lod sig påvirke af hurtigtællingsresultaterne. "Lad KPU (Indonesiens valgkommission) gøre sit arbejde og afgøre det officielle resultat," sagde han til sine støtter. "På trods af flere hurtigtællinger viser den reelle optælling, at vi stadig er foran vores konkurrent." Prabowo, tidligere svigersøn til tidligere præsident Suharto, har lagt vægt på sin militære baggrund under valgkampen. Han har aldrig haft et offentligt embede, men stiller op på baggrund af sin erfaring som tidligere generalløjtnant. "Lad os være tålmodige og respektfulde," sagde han til sine tilhængere. "Men tro ikke, at vi er svage eller nemt kan intimideres." Millioner af indonesere afgav deres stemmer på papir onsdag. Stemmerne skal tælles på lokalt niveau og derefter optælles nationalt, en proces forventet at tage to til tre uger. Widodo opfordrede sine støtter i Jakarta til at overvåge processen og sikre, at valgkommissionens optælling foregår gennemsigtigt og retfærdigt. "Vores ansvar er at beskytte optællingen og sikre, at den er korrekt, ærlig og uden manipulation," sagde han. Indonesiens næste præsident bliver indsat den 20. oktober. Vælgerne står over for bekymringer om langsom økonomisk vækst, stigende vold mod religiøse minoriteter og udbredt korruption i regeringen. "Den næste præsident skal tackle korruption aggressivt for at forbedre Indonesiens økonomi og gøre landet attraktivt for nationale og internationale investeringer," bemærkede Pepinsky. Rapportering for CNN: Kathy Quiano i Jakarta og Madison Park i Hong Kong, med bidrag fra David Molko i Jakarta.

article_content: Shanghai made headlines in 2009 after its students excelled in the global PISA exam, topping rankings in math, science, and reading. While this showcased China's educational prowess, it also cast a spotlight on critical flaws within the system. Shanghai’s schools regularly achieve top scores, but this success comes amid intense competition and stress. Such pressures can foster not only student anxiety and health problems, but also dishonest practices like cheating and bribery, undermining equality and fairness. Inside these schools, classrooms are crowded yet orderly, with focused students and dedicated, well-educated teachers who constantly collaborate to improve their lessons. Earning about 10,000 yuan ($1,640) monthly, teachers are considered middle-class in Shanghai and are driven by incentives both from schools and from appreciative parents through gifts or extra tutoring work. The local government supports students from lower-income families by ensuring equal funding and encouraging high-performing and lower-performing schools to partner. Devoted teachers stay after hours to help struggling students and receive recognition for their extra effort. Nonetheless, many educators agree that socio-economic factors are the main force behind student achievement, and that extra support may only offer short-term help. For many parents, enrolling children in top public schools also means competing in Shanghai’s costly real estate market or turning to bribery and gift-giving practices. Wealthy families add to their children’s advantages with additional lessons and enriching activities, compounding educational inequality. Students are under immense pressure to qualify for elite universities like Fudan and Jiao Tong. Academic performance dictates social standing and personal identity. Research cited in works such as Daniel Pink’s ‘Drive’ reflects that pressure-based incentives can diminish students’ joy of learning, creativity, and mental health. These high stakes have fueled cheating; efforts to stop it have led to backlash from parents, reflecting how widespread and normalized the problem has become. Amid Shanghai’s PISA achievements, Finland stands as an alternative model. Though not always first, Finnish schools promote balance and holistic learning, with shorter school days and plenty of free time, while still achieving strong outcomes. These similarities in performance raise questions about the true benefits of high-pressure schooling. Increasingly, affluent and well-educated Chinese parents, mindful of the personal costs of academic competition, are enrolling their children in private Western-style schools or moving abroad. This trend threatens the pace of education reform in China, as those with the most influence are choosing to leave the system.
translated_content: Shanghai skabte overskrifter i 2009, da byens elever klarede sig bedst i den internationale PISA-undersøgelse, og toppede ranglisterne i matematik, naturfag og læsning. Selvom det fremhævede Kinas uddannelsesmæssige styrke, satte det også fokus på store problemer i systemet. Shanghai-skoler scorer rutinemæssigt højt, men denne succes sker på bekostning af intens konkurrence og stress. Det skaber ikke kun angst og sundhedsproblemer hos eleverne, men bidrager også til uhæderlige praksisser som snyd og bestikkelse, hvilket underminerer lighed og retfærdighed. Inde på skolerne er klasselokalerne fyldte, men ordentlige, med målrettede elever og engagerede, veluddannede lærere, der hele tiden samarbejder for at forbedre deres undervisning. Lærere tjener omkring 10.000 yuan (1.640 $) om måneden og regnes for middelklasse i Shanghai. De motiveres både af skolernes incitamenter og af taknemmelige forældre – via gaver eller ekstraundervisning. Lokale myndigheder støtter elever fra mindre bemidlede familier med ensartet finansiering og partnerskaber mellem stærke og svage skoler. Dedikerede lærere bliver ofte længere efter skoletid for at hjælpe elever med problemer og får anerkendelse for deres indsats. Ikke desto mindre mener mange undervisere, at de socioøkonomiske forhold fortsat er den primære faktor for elevernes resultater, og at ekstra støtte kun har kortvarig effekt. For mange forældre betyder det at få barnet ind på en topskole også, at man konkurrerer i Shanghais dyre boligmarked – eller tyer til bestikkelse og gaver. Velhavende familier giver desuden deres børn yderligere fordele med ekstraundervisning og aktiviteter, hvilket øger uligheden. Elever står over for et enormt pres for at komme ind på eliteuniversiteter som Fudan og Jiao Tong. Karakterer bestemmer social status og bliver en del af selvidentiteten. Forskning, som bl.a. omtalt i Daniel Pinks bog 'Drive', viser, at præstationspres kan undergrave læringsglæde, kreativitet og mental trivsel. Presset har resulteret i snyd, og forsøg på at stoppe det har mødt modstand fra forældre – et tegn på hvor udbredt og normalt problemet er blevet. Midt i Shanghais PISA-succes står Finland som et alternativt forbillede. Selv om de ikke altid ligger nummer ét, fremmer finske skoler balance og helhedsorienteret læring med kortere skoledage og mere fritid – uden at det går ud over resultaterne. Disse ligheder stiller spørgsmålstegn ved værdien af et højt præstationspres. Stadig flere velstillede og veluddannede kinesiske forældre, som overvejer de personlige omkostninger ved konkurrence, sender deres børn på private vestlige skoler eller til udlandet. Denne tendens kan bremse reformer i det kinesiske uddannelsessystem, da dem med størst indflydelse vælger at forlade det.

article_content: Google is expanding its augmented reality (AR) shopping feature, which allows users to virtually try on beauty products before making a purchase. This update brings the feature to mobile browsers and Google Shopping ads, with new tools for experimenting with foundation and hair dye colors. This week, a new hair color category will begin rolling out to Google AR Beauty, letting users see hair dye shades from L’Oréal on themselves or on models that match their preferences. According to Google, shades from other brands like Revlon and Splat will be available to try on soon. The foundation category is also being updated. Users can still try different shades on 148 diverse models, but now they will also be able to virtually test foundation on themselves to better find a perfect match. Hair dye shades can be previewed on models or through the user's own device camera. The same applies to foundations — if no model matches your skin tone, you can see the shade on yourself instead. Soon, users will be able to access Google’s AR beauty tools outside the Google app. When the hair and foundation updates become available, they can be used from any mobile browser in the US. Categories for eye and lip makeup are scheduled for release in the coming weeks. Brands can now incorporate these AR beauty tools in Google Shopping ads, replacing typical product images. This shift provides customers with a more personalized experience since products can be displayed on models with various skin tones. However, Google AR Beauty ads display products on a range of models and can't yet be virtually worn by shoppers within the ads themselves. Lip and eye products will be the first to support this feature, with foundations coming soon. YouTube started testing a similar AR ad feature in 2019, but it hasn’t seen widespread adoption. While shoppers cannot currently try on products directly within Google Shopping ads, selecting a model with a similar skin tone remains helpful. Despite efforts by brands like L’Oréal and Maybelline to popularize AR beauty tools, the technology is still relatively niche. Many other notable brands have made their collections available for virtual try-on through Google’s AR beauty tools since their launch in 2020, including CoverGirl, Dior Beauty, Fenty Beauty, Laura Mercier, and Makeup by Mario. Physical cosmetics retailers such as Sephora and Ulta have supported virtual try-on experiences for years, but it has taken longer for these features to become common in online shopping.

Fysiske skønhedsbutikker som Sephora og Ulta har i årevis tilbudt virtuelle makeup-prøvninger, men det har taget længere tid for disse funktioner at blive almindelige ved online shopping.

article_content: In an unusual experiment, German DJs John and Rasheed decided to undergo a temporary breast enhancement using saline injections to better understand what life might be like for women. The duo, both known for their unconventional antics and as hosts at Jam FM, had 700 milliliters of saline injected into their chests by surgeon Dr. Mark Wolter, forming C cup-sized breasts designed to last for about 24 hours. Their adventure began with mixed emotions—Rasheed expressed apologies to his mother, and John was supported by his wife, who even brought him bikinis. Despite risks such as bruising and inflammation, both men proceeded with the procedure, joking throughout. After the saline was injected, they noticed their new breasts initially felt firm but softened considerably within a few hours. Embracing their temporary transformation, John and Rasheed shared selfies, went bra shopping, worked out at the gym, and even tried skipping ropes to test out their new physiques. The pair observed firsthand how much attention breasts can draw, especially from other men, and they found wearing bras uncomfortable, playfully declaring that women deserve medals for enduring them. This temporary breast enhancement is not unique to Germany. The trend, often referred to as 'vacation breasts' or 'party boobs,' is also catching on in the UK, where Dr. Neetu Nirdosh offers the 24-hour saline injection in London. According to Dr. Nirdosh, the procedure boosts breast size from an A to a C cup almost instantly, but the effect fades as the saline is absorbed by the body within a day. While the method is not considered medically dangerous, Dr. Nirdosh warns against frequent repetitions due to potential issues with electrolyte balance. She suggests it can be a fun, low-risk way for women to preview surgical augmentation before committing to permanent solutions, especially as non-surgical alternatives grow in popularity after implant controversies. However, she notes that the temporary nature might lead to surprises, especially if new partners aren't aware of the enhancement. Overall, John and Rasheed’s lighthearted take on the experiment brings attention to both the physical and social experiences that come with breast enhancement, even if only briefly.
translated_content: I et usædvanligt eksperiment valgte de tyske DJs John og Rasheed at få lavet en midlertidig brystforstørrelse med saltvandsindsprøjtninger for at forstå, hvordan det føles at være kvinde. Duoen, der er kendt for deres utraditionelle påfund og som værter på Jam FM, fik 700 milliliter saltvand indsprøjtet i brystet af kirurgen Dr. Mark Wolter, hvilket gav dem bryster i størrelse C, der skulle vare omkring 24 timer. Deres eventyr startede med blandede følelser—Rasheed undskyldte overfor sin mor, og John fik støtte af sin kone, som også havde taget bikinier med til ham. Trods risiko for blå mærker og betændelse gennemførte begge mænd proceduren, mens de lavede sjov undervejs. Efter indsprøjtningen bemærkede de, at deres nye bryster først føltes hårde, men de blev blødere efter nogle timer. De omfavnede deres midlertidige forvandling, delte selfies, gik på bh-shopping, trænede i fitness og testede deres krop med sjippetov. Parret oplevede på egen krop, hvor meget opmærksomhed bryster kan tiltrække—særligt fra andre mænd—og fandt det ubehageligt at have bh på. De sagde med glimt i øjet, at kvinder fortjener medaljer for at bære dem. Denne midlertidige brystforstørrelse er ikke unik for Tyskland. Trenden, ofte kaldt 'feriebryster' eller 'party boobs', vinder også indpas i Storbritannien, hvor Dr. Neetu Nirdosh tilbyder 24-timers saltvandsindsprøjtning i London. Ifølge Dr. Nirdosh øger proceduren bryststørrelsen fra A til C næsten med det samme, men effekten forsvinder, når kroppen optager saltvandet i løbet af et døgn. Metoden anses ikke for at være sundhedsskadeligt, men Dr. Nirdosh advarer mod hyppig gentagelse på grund af mulige problemer med kroppens saltbalance. Hun foreslår, at det kan være en sjov, lavrisiko-måde for kvinder at prøve kirurgisk brystforstørrelse, før de tager et permanent valg—ikke mindst fordi ikke-invasive alternativer er blevet mere populære efter skandaler omkring implantater. Hun bemærker dog, at den midlertidige effekt kan overraske, især hvis en partner ikke kender til forstørrelsen. Overordnet set sætter John og Rasheeds humoristiske eksperiment fokus på både de fysiske og sociale oplevelser, der følger med brystforstørrelse—om end kun for en kort stund.

article_content: Gary Dawn, 54, a professional clown also known as Pogo the Clown, was acquitted at Nottingham Crown Court after being accused of injuring police officer Mark Szeremetta with a vodka bottle. The incident occurred on February 12 in Stoke Bardolph, Nottinghamshire, when Dawn, distressed over a recent breakup, had been drinking. Police were called by a concerned friend to check on his wellbeing. Officer Szeremetta suffered a head injury from a bottle Dawn had in his hand during the encounter and required hospital treatment. Prosecutors argued Dawn acted recklessly with intent to harm, but Dawn stated he was startled and didn’t realize he still held the bottle when pushing the officer away. Known for his long career as a clown and charity involvement, Dawn told the court he acted in distress and without intention. The jury accepted Dawn’s explanation, resulting in a not guilty verdict.

Episoden fandt sted den 12. februar i Stoke Bardolph, Nottinghamshire, hvor Dawn, der var påvirket af et nyligt brud, havde drukket alkohol. Politiet blev kontaktet af en bekymret ven for at tjekke, hvordan han havde det. Betjent Szeremetta fik en hovedskade fra en flaske, som Dawn havde i hånden under optrinnet, og han måtte behandles på hospitalet. article_content: LUCKNOW, India: Five-time champions Australia revived their World Cup campaign with a dominant five-wicket win over Sri Lanka on Monday (Oct 16). After earlier defeats to India and South Africa, Australia were determined with the ball, dismissing Sri Lanka for 209 runs in under 44 overs, thanks to Adam Zampa's 4-47. Sri Lanka seemed set for a big total at 157-1, but their batting faltered and they finished below expectations. Australia, chasing a modest target, struggled early and slipped to 24-2. However, half-centuries from Mitchell Marsh (52) and Josh Inglis (58) steadied the chase, and Glenn Maxwell’s quick 31 not out saw Australia home with nearly 15 overs remaining. This first win of the tournament moved Australia from last to eighth in the 10-team table, ahead of 1996 champions Sri Lanka, who are winless after three games. Australia captain Pat Cummins said: "We didn't say much before the game, but after two losses we wanted to get back to our high standards. Their openers started well and we were under pressure, but our bowlers stuck together and limiting them to 209 was a great effort." Sri Lanka were led by new captain Kusal Mendis after Dasun Shanaka was ruled out due to injury. Mendis chose to bat, and Pathum Nissanka (61) and Kusal Perera (78) put on a 125-run opening stand. However, David Warner took two sharp catches, Pat Cummins dismissed Perera, and the middle and lower order collapsed. Strong winds delayed the start of Australia’s chase and blew down some banners in the stadium. When play resumed, Dilshan Madushanka struck with a two-wicket maiden over, removing David Warner (11) and Steve Smith. Marsh hit a brisk half-century before falling for a risky second run. Marnus Labuschagne was initially given out caught behind, but a review showed the ball hit his thigh pad. He scored 40 before getting out, while Inglis completed his fifty before being dismissed. Maxwell smashed two sixes and four fours in his 21-ball cameo, and Marcus Stoinis hit the winning six. Mendis commented, "Pathum and Kusal Perera batted well at the start, but our middle order struggled. If we had reached 290-300 runs, it would have been a strong total on this pitch."

article_content: Even though rest is essential for your body to recover, most workplaces offer little time or space for it. As a result, many people are not only sleep-deprived but also deprived of rest, which can negatively affect mood, performance, and health. Overworking yourself or repeating the same tasks without breaks can lead to exhaustion. Taking breaks is one of the best ways to reduce errors caused by fatigue, but finding effective ways to rest at work while remaining productive can be challenging. Since traditional naps are rarely allowed—about half of Fortune 500 companies will reprimand or even fire employees for napping—alternative techniques are needed. One approach is the 'UnNap Nap,' which uses a paradoxical relaxation technique. What is an UnNap Nap? It's a brief exercise (one to three minutes, but can be longer), where you pay attention to muscle tension to encourage relaxation—without actively trying to relax. How to perform an UnNap Nap: 1. Sit comfortably (try this at home first). 2. Focus on any tight muscle in your head. If unsure, the middle of your forehead or a spot on your neck often feels tense. 3. Place one hand over your closed eyes (if questioned at work, you can say you have a slight headache). 4. With your other hand, point to the tense muscle to centralize your focus, then lower your hand. 5. Concentrate all your attention on that tense muscle for 30 seconds, simply observing the feeling without trying to change it. You may visualize the muscle as a set of tightly bunched teeth in a comb. 6. After 30 seconds, remove your hand from your eyes and open them. Notice how the muscle and the rest of your body feel. Focusing attention on one spot allows the rest of your body to relax. 7. Repeat this process with another tense muscle, focusing on it for 15 seconds. Continue until you feel more relaxed. To make the UnNap Nap more effective, do a mental scan from head to toe, sensing and focusing on tense muscles for 15 seconds each. With practice, this technique can be done in as little as 15 seconds at your desk. The UnNap Nap can help you quickly refocus, relieve stress, aid in falling asleep, and support relaxation even during exams or stressful situations. Rest is vital for rejuvenation. Active rest techniques like the UnNap Nap help direct the body’s recovery, leading to increased productivity, alertness, relaxation, and an overall sense of well-being. © CareerBuilder.com 2011. translated_content: Selvom hvile er vigtig for, at din krop kan komme sig, er der ofte ikke tid eller plads til det på arbejdspladsen. Derfor er mange mennesker ikke kun søvnberøvede, men også berøvet hvile, hvilket kan påvirke humør, præstation og helbred negativt. Hvis du arbejder for meget eller gentager de samme opgaver uden pauser, kan det føre til udmattelse. Pauser er en af de bedste måder at undgå fejl på grund af træthed, men det kan være udfordrende at finde effektive måder at hvile på arbejdet og samtidig forblive produktiv. Da traditionelle lure sjældent er tilladt – cirka halvdelen af Fortune 500-virksomheder vil irettesætte eller endda fyre medarbejdere, der tager en lur – er alternative teknikker nødvendige. En mulighed er 'UnNap Nap', som bruger en paradoksal afslapningsteknik. Hvad er en UnNap Nap? Det er en kort øvelse (et til tre minutter, men kan vare længere), hvor du retter opmærksomheden mod muskelspændinger for at fremme afslapning – uden aktivt at prøve at slappe af. Sådan udfører du en UnNap Nap: 1. Sæt dig behageligt (prøv det først derhjemme). 2. Fokuser på en stram muskel i hovedet. Hvis du er i tvivl, føles midten af panden eller et punkt i nakken ofte spændt. 3. Læg den ene hånd over dine lukkede øjne (hvis nogen spørger, kan du sige, du har lidt hovedpine). 4. Peg med den anden hånd på den spændte muskel for at samle dit fokus, og læg derefter hånden ned igen. 5. Fokuser al din opmærksomhed på den spændte muskel i 30 sekunder og observer blot, hvordan det føles, uden at forsøge at ændre det. Du kan forestille dig musklen som tænder i en tæt kam. 6. Efter 30 sekunder tager du hånden væk fra øjnene og åbner dem. Læg mærke til, hvordan musklen og resten af kroppen føles. Ved at fokusere på ét punkt, slapper resten af kroppen af. 7. Gentag processen med en anden spændt muskel og fokuser på den i 15 sekunder. Fortsæt, indtil du føler dig mere afslappet. For at gøre UnNap Nap mere effektivt, lav et mentalt tjek fra hoved til tå og fokuser på spændte muskler i 15 sekunder hver. Med øvelse kan denne teknik udføres på så lidt som 15 sekunder ved dit skrivebord. UnNap Nap kan hjælpe dig til hurtigt at genfinde fokus, lindre stress, falde i søvn og støtte afslapning – selv under eksamener eller stressende situationer. Hvile er vigtig for restitution. Aktive hvileteknikker som UnNap Nap styrker kroppens restitution, så du bliver mere produktiv, opmærksom og afslappet samt får en generel følelse af velvære. © CareerBuilder.com 2011. article_content: On Saturday afternoon under sunny skies, India cautiously reached 53 for one in their second innings. With Hurricane Bertha threatening to disrupt play, England faced their own setbacks as Stuart Broad was sidelined by a broken nose and Jimmy Anderson struggled with illness. Had India survived the day, the series could have been level heading to the final Test at The Oval. Instead, a dramatic collapse ensued as India lost nine wickets in just 22 overs, six of them to Moeen Ali and Chris Jordan. Captain MS Dhoni was dismissed attempting a risky shot to midwicket, drawing criticism for his lack of responsibility. India were bowled out twice within the equivalent of a day's play, marking a significant low point. After the match, Dhoni told Mike Atherton he was 'quite happy' with his team's 'progress,' comments widely seen as disconnected from reality. Instead of challenging Dhoni, commentator Ravi Shastri remarked that Dhoni simply wanted the interview to end quickly, despite Dhoni’s reputation for long press conferences. This reflects a recurring issue in India's overseas campaigns under Dhoni, where only their Lord’s win stands out positively. Following that victory, India’s fortunes waned. At Southampton and Manchester, they scored 821 runs for 40 wickets lost, compared to England's 1,141 runs for 21 wickets, underscoring a performance disparity. India averaged 20 runs per wicket, while England averaged 57, recalling prior away series struggles. Constant changes in India's selection have not helped. England, meanwhile, is revitalized, with crucial contributions from Alastair Cook—who scored 95 after a dropped catch by Jadeja lifted team spirit—and standout bowling from Anderson and Broad. Emerging talents like Gary Ballance, Moeen Ali (notably for his spin), and Jos Buttler have impressed, while Ian Bell and Joe Root have proven their worth. England’s management steered focus back to cricket by de-emphasizing the Anderson-Jadeja altercation. India, in contrast, lingered on the dispute, leading to distractions and a misplaced sense of injustice. Consequently, England’s bowlers excelled on favorable pitches, while India faltered, and team selections—such as Jadeja's repeated inclusion—have faced scrutiny. Off the pitch, the ICC has increased enforcement on illegal bowling actions, recently banning Sri Lanka’s Sachithra Senanayake, New Zealand’s Kane Williamson, and Pakistan’s Saeed Ajmal—all off-spinners with suspect arm actions. The ICC’s rule limiting elbow flexion to 15 degrees is now strictly applied. Although some suggest possible umpire bias, the ICC’s measures indicate a shift toward more rigorous standards. Sri Lankan captain Angelo Mathews has achieved an outstanding batting average of nearly 87 as captain—second only to the legendary Don Bradman—a testament to his growth as a leader. Meanwhile, non-London Test venues in the UK have faced difficulties this summer, struggling with poor ticket sales, subpar playing conditions, and unfavorable weather, hurting their financial prospects. Finally, Cricket Australia’s removal of a video criticizing England’s Matt Prior—allegedly due to copyright concerns—has sparked debate about fairness in cricket media coverage, as similar attention toward MS Dhoni seems unlikely.

The BBC’s Comic Relief 2013, intended as a family night of comedy for charity, sparked controversy after sketches featuring explicit sexual references and strong language aired before the 9pm watershed. Many parents watching with young children complained to the BBC as they considered the content inappropriate for its time slot.

One notable segment, aired at 7:45 pm on BBC1, featured Rowan Atkinson as the Archbishop of Canterbury in a satirical sketch that included explicit language. Another skit from 'Call the Midwife' referenced a 'vajazzle,' an intimate body decoration made popular by 'The Only Way is Essex.' Comedian Peter Kay used the word 'a***', raising concerns as children repeated the term.

Parents like Lindsay Bruce from Middlesbrough and Trisha Telfer from Edinburgh expressed distress at having to explain adult language to young children. Complaints intensified after a young girl questioned a swear word heard during the show.

Despite the backlash, Comic Relief raised a record £75 million in donations and sponsorship, with singer Jessie J raising £500,000 by shaving her head on air. The BBC, noted for 'pushing the boundaries of comedy,' responded by removing the Archbishop sketch from its iPlayer service after a surge in complaints.

John Whittingdale, Conservative MP and chair of the culture, media and sport select committee, supported the BBC’s decision to withdraw the sketch, saying it was right for the broadcaster to recognize the mistake. Ofcom, the UK’s broadcasting regulator, is currently assessing the complaints to decide on any further action.

During the broadcast, comedian John Bishop apologized for comments about people from Newcastle, which some viewers found offensive. He later took to Twitter to clarify that no offence was intended.

Separately, the BBC faced further criticism after omitting a performance by Frankie Boyle, which included offensive jokes about the Queen, the Duchess of Cambridge, and Oscar Pistorius, from TV broadcast due to concerns over its content.

A BBC spokesperson stated that Rowan Atkinson’s character was 'an affectionate portrayal of an Archbishop,' intended only to amuse and entertain, not offend. As Ofcom reviews the complaints, the BBC’s approach to early evening comedy is under scrutiny.

Archaeology students from Georgia Southern University have made significant discoveries at Camp Lawton, a former Civil War stockade and prison near Millen, Georgia. The team unearthed a variety of personal items belonging to Union prisoners, including a distinctive ring with a diamond-shaped centerpiece, a badge, a pocketknife, keys, and a Michigan-made token used for trading. Some of these items, such as the ring and badge, feature diamond motifs, thought to be symbolic of the Union's III Corps, a unit that fought in major battles before being reorganized in 1864.

The finds provide a window into the harsh realities faced by Union prisoners during Camp Lawton's brief six-week existence in 1864, when men struggled with scarce food and rampant disease. Researchers believe the isolated location of the camp helped preserve it from relic hunters, leaving a trove of artifacts—nearly 300 unearthed so far—untouched for almost 150 years.

Among the artifacts is a letter written by Corporal Charles H. Knox of the 1st Connecticut Cavalry, sent to his wife just eight days before the camp was evacuated as Union forces advanced. In his letter, Knox expresses hope for a prisoner exchange and urges his wife to consider selling the family cow to raise money. He survived imprisonment, returning to Andersonville before being paroled in early 1865.

The discoveries, which include uniform buttons, bullets, smoking pipes, utensils, coins, and handmade items, are currently on display at the Georgia Southern University Museum. The site, which also encompasses areas of federal and state land, remains protected from unauthorized access. Archaeologists, led by graduate student Kevin Chapman, continue to explore and map the camp, estimating that less than 1% of the area previously occupied by prisoners has been surveyed.

Camp Lawton was built to alleviate overcrowding at the notorious Andersonville prison. Over 700 to 1,300 men died at Lawton during its short operation. The camp housed up to 10,000 Union soldiers before being abandoned as Union troops advanced during Sherman’s March to the Sea. Artifacts suggest the presence of soldiers with Irish and German heritage among the Union ranks. The team aims to better understand the day-to-day lives of both the prisoners and their Confederate captors.

While no known photographs of Camp Lawton exist, watercolors and journals from Union prisoners help to illustrate the difficult conditions they endured. The site is expected to yield further findings as researchers continue their work, offering a rare look into Civil War history that has mostly been lost to time.

Arkæologistuderende fra Georgia Southern University har gjort betydningsfulde fund ved Camp Lawton, en tidligere fangecamp fra den amerikanske borgerkrig nær Millen, Georgia. Nogle af disse genstande, såsom ringen og badget, har diamantmotiver – og det menes, at de symboliserer Unionshærens III Korps, en enhed der deltog i store slag, inden den blev reorganiseret i 1864.

Fundene giver et indblik i de barske vilkår, unionsfangerne stod over for i Camp Lawtons seks uger i 1864, hvor mændene kæmpede med mangel på mad og sygdom. Undersøgerne mener, at lejrens isolerede placering har beskyttet den mod skattejægere, og næsten 300 artefakter er til nu blevet gravet op – uberørte i næsten 150 år.

Blandt fundene er et brev fra korporal Charles H. Knox fra 1st Connecticut Cavalry, sendt til hans kone blot otte dage før lejren blev evakueret, da unionsstyrker nærmede sig. I brevet udtrykker Knox håb om fangeudveksling og opfordrer sin hustru til at overveje at sælge familiens ko for at få penge. Han overlevede fangenskabet, blev sendt retur til Andersonville og løsladt i begyndelsen af 1865.

Fundene – herunder uniformsknapper, kugler, pibehoveder, bestik, mønter og håndlavede genstande – er nu udstillet på Georgia Southern University Museum. Stedet, der omfatter føderal og statslig jord, er beskyttet mod adgang udefra. Arkæologerne, ledet af kandidatstuderende Kevin Chapman, udforsker fortsat lejren og vurderer, at under 1 % af området tidligere brugt som fangecamp er undersøgt.

Camp Lawton blev bygget for at aflaste den berygtede Andersonville-lejr. Over 700 til 1.300 mænd døde i Lawton i løbet af dens korte drift. Lejren husede op mod 10.000 unionssoldater, inden den blev forladt, efterhånden som unionshærens tropper nærmede sig under Shermans March to the Sea. Fundene tyder på, at nogle soldater havde irsk eller tysk baggrund. Holdet vil gerne lære mere om dagliglivet for både fanger og konfødererede vagter.

Selvom der ikke findes billeder fra Camp Lawton, giver akvareller og dagbøger fra unionsfanger et billede af de hårde forhold. Forskerne forventer at finde flere genstande i fremtiden, så stedet kan fortsætte med at give sjældne indblik i borgerkrigens historie.

article_content: Brett Favre, a retired Hall of Fame NFL quarterback, is speaking out about the risks of repeated head injuries in football. At 44, Favre has begun experiencing significant memory loss, which he attributes to numerous concussions during his playing years. Favre was sacked 525 times, more than any other quarterback in NFL history. In a recent interview, Favre shared a frightening episode: he couldn’t remember an entire summer when his daughter played soccer, which deeply unsettled him. Speaking with Sports Talk 570, Favre admitted this memory loss brought real fear for the first time. He’s also expressed doubts about letting children participate in football, suggesting he might not want his own son to play due to health risks and societal pressure. These views will be explored further in his upcoming Today News interview. As concerns grow, the NFL has responded by updating safety rules and advocating for improved safety measures in youth sports. Despite these changes, football remains a dangerous profession, with long-term brain injuries having devastating effects. High-profile cases like Junior Seau and Dave Duerson—both of whom died by suicide and were diagnosed posthumously with CTE—underscore the risks. Many former players have taken legal action against the NFL, arguing that vital information on brain injury risks was withheld. The resulting lawsuit ended with a $765 million settlement benefiting thousands of affected players. Dozens of ex-players have donated their brains to research in hopes of advancing understanding of brain trauma. NFL spokesperson Brian McCarthy asserts the league is committed to player safety, citing investments in medical research, improved protocols, and collaborations with organizations like the CDC and NIH. Medical professionals such as Dr. Richard Figler warn that concussion symptoms are often overlooked, and returning to play too soon increases long-term harm. Figler stresses the need for better education and vigilance to ensure players fully recover before resuming the sport. Currently, Favre has opted not to return to the NFL but is instead coaching high school football in Mississippi, focusing on youth guidance and athlete safety.

Han har også ytret tvivl om, hvorvidt børn bør spille amerikansk fodbold, og nævner, at han måske ikke ville ønske, at hans egen søn skulle spille på grund af helbredsrisici og samfundspres. Retssagen førte til et forlig på 765 millioner dollars til gavn for tusindvis af berørte spillere. I dag har Favre valgt ikke at vende tilbage til NFL, men træner i stedet high school-fodbold i Mississippi, hvor han fokuserer på unge og spillersikkerhed.
