Launching a successful startup depends on careful financial planning. Many entrepreneurs find financial management overwhelming, but it's essential for long-term growth and sustainability. To help, 20 experts from the Forbes Finance Council have outlined the most important financial steps every startup should take, along with the reasons these steps matter.

Start by setting up a reliable accounting process with enough resources to manage bookkeeping, budgeting, and fundraising, in line with best practices. Next, develop a thorough budget and cash flow projection so you always understand your financial situation. Monitor business performance to spot gaps that could impede progress.

Rely on a financial model to guide business decisions, balancing enthusiasm with practical needs. Craft a business plan that addresses budgeting, forecasting, record-keeping, and monitoring to form a solid base. Knowing how long your funds will last—your financial runway—will help you avoid running out of money.

Create separate business banking accounts to simplify tracking, and use local support centers for guidance. Regularly review your financial plan and make adjustments as circumstances change. Envision your company's future, map out steps to get there, and revisit your plan often.

A comprehensive, regularly reviewed financial plan—with clear objectives and expert advice—can attract investors. Investing your own resources can foster discipline. Prioritize managing your intellectual property's value as part of your assets. Understanding cash flow, burn rate, and runway are essential for keeping your business afloat.

Communicate your financial strategies clearly to your team. Pursue ongoing improvements and review your financial figures often, especially in the early stages. Build flexibility into your budget so it can adapt to changing needs, and seek professional support for future planning. Evaluate your capital requirements accurately, balancing debt with growth opportunities. Surround yourself with mentors and a strong network to gain additional expertise. These actions set a solid foundation for startup financial health and future success.

article_content: Next time you have a private conversation near a streetlamp, you might want to think twice—what seems like just a light fixture could be quietly recording you. At a recent art show in Manhattan, a lamp was adapted to secretly capture and share nearby conversations, raising important questions about everyday surveillance. Named 'Conversnitch,' the device listens in and posts selected lines from overheard chats to Twitter. Built affordably with off-the-shelf parts—a Raspberry Pi, microphone, LED, and a basic plastic flower pot—the project cost less than $100 to make. Fitted into a standard bulb socket and powered from there, Conversnitch sends audio through open Wi-Fi connections. The recordings are uploaded to Amazon Mechanical Turk, where paid workers transcribe the speech and post excerpts to the @conversnitch Twitter account. The device has been active for several months, anonymously broadcasting fragments of conversations on topics like job hunting, relationships, and workplace drama. Its physical location is currently unclear. Created by New Yorkers Kyle McDonald and Brian House, Conversnitch is intended to prompt people to think about privacy and the realities of surveillance. The concept originated just before the public learned of NSA data gathering through Edward Snowden’s disclosures. By using simple technology, the creators wanted to show how accessible it is for anyone to create real-world listening devices. According to McDonald, their project is a reminder of the unease many people feel when privacy is threatened by widespread surveillance. Despite some challenges—such as workers potentially inventing dialogues, which led to some deletions—the creators say their main goal is to make people more aware of how easily private conversations might be monitored and shared. McDonald also points out that as governmental surveillance moves from just digital records to physical settings, it’s vital for the public to consider the potential for being observed or recorded in nearly any situation.

Til en kunstudstilling i Manhattan blev en lampe bygget om, så den i al hemmelighed kunne optage og dele samtaler fra nærtstående personer, hvilket sætter fokus på overvågning i hverdagen. Konceptet hedder 'Conversnitch' og lytter til folks samtaler for så at udgive udvalgte sætninger på Twitter. Projektet blev udført billigt med almindelige dele — en Raspberry Pi, mikrofon, LED og en plastik-urtepotte — og kostede under 700 kr. Conversnitch sættes i en standard fatning og får strøm derfra, hvorfra den sender lydoptagelser via åbne Wi-Fi-netværk. Optagelserne uploades til Amazon Mechanical Turk, hvor ansatte transskriberer og deler udvalgte citater på @conversnitch’s Twitter-konto. Apparatet har været aktivt i flere måneder og offentliggør anonymt samtalefragmenter om alt fra jobsamtaler og forhold til drama på arbejdspladsen. Lampens placering er dog ukendt. Conversnitch er udviklet af newyorkerne Kyle McDonald og Brian House for at få folk til at tænke over privatlivets grænser og udbredelsen af overvågning. Idéen opstod kort før afsløringerne om NSA’s praksis fra Edward Snowden. Ved at bruge simpel teknologi ønskede skaberne at vise, hvor let det er for enhver at lave aflytningsudstyr. Ifølge McDonald skal projektet minde folk om den utryghed, mange føler, når privatlivet bliver truet af udbredt overvågning. Trods visse udfordringer — nogle gange har folk, der transskriberer, muligvis opfundet samtaler, og derfor er nogle tweets blevet slettet — understreger skaberne, at hovedformålet er at gøre folk mere bevidste om, hvor nemt private samtaler kan optages og deles. McDonald understreger desuden, at efterhånden som myndigheder udvider overvågning fra digitale til fysiske omgivelser, bør offentligheden i højere grad overveje risikoen for at blive observeret og optaget overalt.

article_content: The producers behind 'Fast & Furious 9' have been hit with an £800,000 ($1 million) fine after stuntman Joe Watts suffered a severe head injury while filming at Warner Bros studios in Hertfordshire, UK, back in July 2019. Watts fell eight meters onto concrete when his safety line detached during a scene that had been rehearsed but was changed at the last minute. The judge in the case described Watts as 'lucky to be alive' and criticized the lack of safety checks and the failure to adjust safety measures when the stunt changed. The Health and Safety Executive, which brought the case to court, called the injuries 'life-changing.' FF9 Pictures, the studio responsible, acknowledged their shortcomings regarding health and safety regulations. Before the accident, Watts had contributed to major films such as 'Game of Thrones,' 'Johnny English Strikes Again,' 'Star Wars: The Last Jedi,' and 'Kingsman: The Golden Circle.' 'Fast & Furious 9,' featuring stars like Vin Diesel and Charlize Theron, was produced with a budget of $200-$225 million and grossed $726.5 million worldwide after its 2021 release.

Watts faldt otte meter ned på betongulvet, da hans sikkerhedsline blev afkoblet under en scene, der ellers var øvet, men blev ændret i sidste øjeblik. Dommeren kaldte Watts 'heldig, at han overlevede', og kritiserede de manglende sikkerhedstjek og manglende justering af sikkerhedsforanstaltninger, da stuntet blev ændret. Health and Safety Executive, der førte sagen i retten, karakteriserede skaderne som 'livsændrende.' FF9 Pictures, det ansvarlige studie, har anerkendt deres manglende overholdelse af sundheds- og sikkerhedsregler. article_content: Donnie McLendon, 26, is fighting for his life after accidentally shooting himself in the head during a Russian Roulette game in St. Petersburg, Florida. Police say McLendon was the third participant to play with a loaded .44 caliber handgun after he and two friends spent the evening drinking and using marijuana. The group's initial claim that McLendon was hurt during a home invasion fell apart as they later admitted to playing Russian Roulette when questioned by authorities. Daniel McKee, 22, and Thomas Rady, 29, survived their turns in the deadly game. After the shooting, McLendon’s friends—along with McKee’s girlfriend, who was in another room—brought him to the hospital. Police found the weapon and a spent casing at the scene. The investigation is ongoing, and so far, no one has been charged. McLendon received emergency care at St. Anthony’s Hospital before being moved to Tampa General, where he remains in critical condition. 'Russian Roulette,' depicted in movies like 'The Deer Hunter,' has recently caused several tragedies: a 17-year-old died in Largo, Florida just months ago, and earlier in September, a 35-year-old in San Bernardino, California, also lost his life playing the game. The risky game has even surfaced in criminal cases, with reports of it being used to threaten families, including one incident where a Florida family was terrorized with their young child forced to play.

article_content: A woman taking her dogs for a walk in Longwood, Florida, was severely injured after being attacked by a bear earlier this week. Wildlife officials have since captured and euthanized a 200-pound female bear they believe was responsible for the incident. According to the Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission, the bear closely matched descriptions provided by witnesses and was trapped in the same neighborhood within two days following the attack. Authorities also managed to capture a yearling female bear shortly after, but officials determined she was not connected to the attack. The victim, Susan Chalfant, suffered significant facial injuries and was hospitalized; her current condition has not been disclosed. A neighbor who called emergency services described her injuries as so severe that her age was difficult to determine. Residents in the Longwood area report that bears are a common sight, particularly at night before garbage collection, leading to concerns that unsecured trash is attracting the animals. 'There’s a well-worn path between homes where bears pass through regularly,' noted a local resident named Richard. Wildlife officials have urged locals to secure their garbage, warning that a lack of proper trash management will continue to draw bears searching for food into residential neighborhoods. Karen Parker, a spokeswoman for the FWC, stressed the importance of community cooperation to keep bears away. Unprovoked attacks by black bears on people are extremely uncommon in Florida, with the first documented incident by the commission occurring only last year. Experts link the increase in human-bear encounters to new housing developments in areas that used to be natural bear territory. Additional reporting for this story was provided by CNN’s Holly Yan, John Zarrella, and John Couwels.
translated_content: En kvinde blev alvorligt såret, da hun gik tur med sine hunde i Longwood, Florida, efter et bjørneangreb tidligere på ugen. Vildtmyndigheder har siden fanget og aflivet en hunbjørn på 90 kilo, som de mener stod bag hændelsen. Ifølge Floridas Fisk- og Vildtforvaltningskommission matchede bjørnen nøje de beskrivelser, vidner gav, og blev fanget i samme nabolag inden for to dage efter angrebet. Myndighederne fangede også en ung hunbjørn lige efter, men konkluderede, at hun ikke havde noget med angrebet at gøre. Offeret, Susan Chalfant, fik alvorlige ansigtsskader og blev indlagt på hospitalet; hendes nuværende tilstand er ikke oplyst. En nabo, der ringede efter hjælp, beskrev hendes skader som så voldsomme, at det var svært at fastslå hendes alder. Beboere i Longwood fortæller, at bjørne ofte ses i området, især om natten før skraldeindsamling, hvilket har ført til bekymring for, at usikret affald tiltrækker dyrene. 'Der er nærmest en fast bjørnestil mellem husene, hvor de ofte passerer forbi,' siger en lokal beboer ved navn Richard. Vildtmyndighederne har opfordret de lokale til at sikre deres affald og advarer om, at utilstrækkelig håndtering af skrald vil fortsætte med at lokke sultne bjørne ind i boligområder. Karen Parker, talskvinde for kommissionen, understregede vigtigheden af, at hele lokalsamfundet arbejder sammen for at holde bjørnene væk. Uprovokerede angreb på mennesker fra sortbjørne er ekstremt sjældne i Florida, og det første dokumenterede tilfælde fandt sted så sent som sidste år. Eksperter mener, at flere møder mellem mennesker og bjørne skyldes nye boligbyggerier i områder, hvor bjørnene tidligere levede. Yderligere rapportering til denne historie kom fra CNN's Holly Yan, John Zarrella og John Couwels.

Crunchyroll announced today that renowned filmmaker Makoto Shinkai’s animated film 'Suzume' will be available exclusively on its streaming platform starting November 16. The award-winning film will be accessible in North America and all of Crunchyroll’s international territories, excluding Asia and France.

'Suzume' tells the coming-of-age story of 17-year-old Suzume as she journeys across disaster-stricken locations in Japan, working to close mysterious doors that cause devastation. This latest work from Makoto Shinkai, known internationally for his visionary storytelling and previous films 'Your Name' (2016) and 'Weathering With You' (2019), continues to cement his reputation as a leading figure in animation.

'Suzume' has received broad critical acclaim, earning nominations for the World Soundtrack Awards' “Discovery of the Year” and the Asia Pacific Screen Awards' “Best Animated Feature Film.” It also won Outstanding Achievement in Music at the 46th Japan Academy Awards. The film premiered internationally at the Berlin International Film Festival in February 2023, becoming the first anime feature in over two decades to screen in the event’s prestigious competition section.

During its initial theatrical run, 'Suzume' grossed over $300 million worldwide, ranking as the fourth highest-grossing anime film in history. The film’s global theatrical release in April was handled by Crunchyroll in partnership with Sony Pictures Entertainment, Wild Bunch International, Wild Bunch Germany, and Eurozoom, with the exception of Asia.

BlackBerry’s decline in the U.S. market has been dramatic, with estimates suggesting that by last fall, only around 2% of American mobile phone users still used a BlackBerry device. Yet, sub-Saharan Africa is on the verge of tremendous mobile expansion. According to the GSMA, the region is expected to add 175 million new mobile users over the next three years.

"Mobile has already revolutionized African society and demand continues to grow by almost 50% each year," said Tom Phillips, Chief Government and Regulatory Affairs Officer at GSMA. This strong growth could offer a significant opportunity for BlackBerry. The company, recently rebranded from Research in Motion to BlackBerry, claims to hold a 70% market share in South Africa.

However, BlackBerry’s latest models, unveiled this week, may be too costly for many of their key users in emerging markets. The company has pledged that some of the six new phones will be tailored to meet those customers’ needs.

While consumers in China, Europe, and the U.S. have rapidly adopted Android and iOS smartphones, millions of users in markets like Brazil, Malaysia, Nigeria, Kenya, and South Africa are optimistic about the new BlackBerry 10 update. In these regions, the mobile phone often serves as the primary link to the internet, and BlackBerry Messenger remains popular for providing unlimited chats without SMS fees.

Unlike some consumers in wealthier countries, who may spend several months’ salary to purchase the latest iPhone, many African users seek practical and affordable connectivity. Infrastructure differences play a large role in shaping mobile use. Isobel Coleman, a senior fellow at the Council on Foreign Relations, explains that mobile technology is filling gaps where infrastructure is lacking, impacting culture, the economy, innovation, education, and healthcare.

For many Africans, a mobile phone account is also their first bank account, fueling the rapid growth of mobile banking due to sparse networks of traditional bank branches. By 2015, Africans were expected to transfer over $200 billion per year, representing 18% of the continent’s GDP, via mobile devices.

The distinctive BlackBerry keyboard continues to have strong appeal, and the company has included both touch and traditional keypads on its new models. Feedback from users in emerging markets highlights ongoing enthusiasm for BlackBerry, with many praising its affordability, physical keyboard, security, and data cost savings.

What these users want from BlackBerry 10 is clear: longer battery life, durability, and cost-effective connectivity. As Isobel Coleman notes, any company hoping to succeed in these markets must deliver practical, robust, and affordable devices.

While smartphones are changing the way people communicate, bank, and shop, it’s noteworthy that there are an estimated 1 billion smartphone users globally compared to 5 billion feature phone users—illustrating vast growth opportunities for BlackBerry and other manufacturers.

BlackBerrys tilbagegang på det amerikanske marked har været markant, hvor det anslås, at kun omkring 2% af de amerikanske mobilbrugere sidste efterår stadig brugte en BlackBerry-enhed. Alligevel står det subsahariske Afrika over for en enorm mobilvækst. Ifølge GSMA forventes regionen at få 175 millioner nye mobilbrugere over de næste tre år.

"Mobilteknologi har allerede revolutioneret det afrikanske samfund, og efterspørgslen vokser stadig med næsten 50% om året," siger Tom Phillips, Chief Government and Regulatory Affairs Officer hos GSMA. Denne stærke vækst kan give BlackBerry en betydelig mulighed. Virksomheden, der for nyligt har skiftet navn fra Research in Motion til BlackBerry, hævder at have en markedsandel på 70% i Sydafrika.

Dog kan BlackBerrys nyeste modeller, som blev afsløret i denne uge, være for dyre for mange af virksomhedens vigtigste brugere i vækstmarkederne. Virksomheden har lovet, at nogle af de seks nye telefoner vil være tilpasset disse kunders behov.

Mens forbrugere i Kina, Europa og USA hurtigt har taget Android- og iOS-smartphones til sig, er millioner af brugere i lande som Brasilien, Malaysia, Nigeria, Kenya og Sydafrika optimistiske omkring den nye BlackBerry 10-opdatering. I disse regioner fungerer mobilen ofte som den primære adgang til internettet, og BlackBerry Messenger er populær, fordi det giver ubegrænset chat uden SMS-gebyrer.

I modsætning til nogle forbrugere i rigere lande, der måske bruger flere måneders løn på at købe den nyeste iPhone, søger mange afrikanske brugere praktisk og overkommelig forbindelse. Forskelle i infrastruktur har stor betydning for mobilbrug. Isobel Coleman, seniorforsker ved Council on Foreign Relations, forklarer, at mobilteknologi udfylder tomrummet, hvor infrastruktur mangler, og påvirker kultur, økonomi, innovation, uddannelse og sundhed.

For mange afrikanere er en mobilkonto også deres første bankkonto, hvilket driver den hurtige vækst i mobilbank, da der er få traditionelle bankfilialer. I 2015 forventedes afrikanerne at overføre mere end 200 milliarder dollars om året – svarende til 18% af kontinentets BNP – via mobilenheder.

Det karakteristiske BlackBerry-tastatur har stadig stor tiltrækningskraft, og virksomheden har inkluderet både touch og traditionelle taster på de nye modeller. Tilbagemeldinger fra brugere i vækstmarkeder viser fortsat begejstring for BlackBerry, hvor mange roser dens overkommelighed, fysiske tastatur, sikkerhed og besparelse på data.

Disse brugeres ønsker til BlackBerry 10 er tydelige: længere batterilevetid, holdbarhed og billig forbindelse. Som Isobel Coleman påpeger, skal alle virksomheder, der ønsker succes på disse markeder, levere praktiske, solide og billige enheder.

Selvom smartphones ændrer den måde, folk kommunikerer, banker og handler på, er det værd at bemærke, at der globalt anslås at være 1 milliard smartphone-brugere sammenlignet med 5 milliarder brugere af almindelige mobiltelefoner – hvilket viser det store vækstpotentiale for BlackBerry og andre producenter.

article_content: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has affirmed that Israel will continue its war against Hamas, even after a temporary pause meant to facilitate the return of hostages. Netanyahu made these remarks ahead of a scheduled Cabinet vote on a ceasefire proposal. He stated, 'There is a lot of misinformation suggesting that the war will end after the pause to return our hostages. Let me be clear: We are at war – and will continue the war.' According to Netanyahu, Israel’s war objectives are the elimination of Hamas, the return of all hostages and missing persons, and ensuring that no group in Gaza poses a threat to Israel. Netanyahu described the return of the hostages as a 'sacred and supreme task' and said he is fully committed to achieving their release. He recounted a meeting with members of the war cabinet and families of the hostages, listening to their distress. 'I told the families: Returning our hostages is a sacred and supreme task. We will not relent in our efforts until we bring them all back,' he said. Reiterating his position, Netanyahu emphasized that the war would continue until all of Israel’s goals are met: eliminating Hamas, securing the return of all hostages, and ensuring that Gaza no longer harbors elements that support terrorism or threaten Israel. Netanyahu also sent a strong warning to the Palestinian Authority, stating that once Hamas is defeated, Israel will not permit any civil administration in Gaza that supports terrorism. The conflict intensified after the October 7 attack by Hamas, in which around 2,500 militants crossed from Gaza into Israel, causing numerous casualties and seizing hostages. According to The Times of Israel, approximately 240 hostages were taken, and about 1,200 people, mostly civilians, were killed in the attack. The hostages include children, elderly people, and foreign nationals from Thailand and Nepal. In other news, the Indian IPO market has seen a surge, with offerings by Tata Technologies, Flair Writing Industries, and Gandhar Oil Refinery being fully subscribed within hours. Airline IndiGo is considering introducing premium class seating and additional services to attract business travelers. Separately, creditors have withdrawn over 26,000 insolvency cases in India since the enactment of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code.

article_content: As Thanksgiving approaches, households across the United States are preparing for a feast rooted in both tradition and gratitude. Among the array of dishes, one small yet vibrant fruit often stands out—the cranberry. This tart berry has become closely associated with Thanksgiving, but what is its historical significance? Native to North America, cranberries have a rich history connected to Thanksgiving. Indigenous peoples used these red berries for both food and medicinal purposes long before the arrival of European settlers. During the 17th century, it is likely that cranberries featured in the harvest feast shared between Pilgrims and Native Americans—a meal considered a precursor to the modern Thanksgiving celebration. This event helped establish cranberries' lasting role in Thanksgiving traditions. Cranberries are typically harvested in the fall and are at their peak during the holiday season. Their availability matches perfectly with Thanksgiving, enhancing the sense of seasonality and connection to the land. Cranberries are also valued for their versatility on the Thanksgiving menu. They offer both sweetness and tartness that complement many dishes, from cranberry sauce that adds a tangy contrast to turkey and gravy, to cranberry relish that provides a refreshing bite. These berries enhance the overall flavor profile of the Thanksgiving meal. Their health benefits further contribute to their popularity. Cranberries are rich in antioxidants and vitamins, making them a nutritious addition to holiday spreads. Their tartness balances the richness of traditional Thanksgiving foods. Many families have made the preparation of homemade cranberry sauce a cherished holiday tradition. Simmering cranberries with sugar and spices fills kitchens with inviting aromas and signals the start of the festive season. Beyond their culinary use, cranberries have taken on a symbolic role representing gratitude and abundance. Sharing a meal, expressing thanks for the harvest, and reflecting on the blessings of the year are central to Thanksgiving. Cranberries, with their deep historical roots, serve as a reminder of the traditions that make Thanksgiving special. FAQs When is Thanksgiving 2023? Thanksgiving in 2023 falls on November 23. Why is Thanksgiving celebrated? Thanksgiving is an annual national holiday in the United States that celebrates the harvest and other blessings from the past year. It is commonly believed to be inspired by the 1621 harvest feast between the English colonists (Pilgrims) and the Wampanoag people.

I det 17. århundrede er det sandsynligt, at tranebær indgik i høstfesten, som blev delt mellem pilgrimme og indfødte amerikanere—et måltid, der anses som forløberen for den moderne Thanksgiving-fejring. article_content: Jane Hamm, daughter of oil executive Harold Hamm and his ex-wife Sue Ann Arnall, married Thomas Lerum in a private ceremony at the Grand Del Mar resort in San Diego, California, during her parents’ divorce trial. The ceremony took place on October 4 and was kept very discreet, with minimal media coverage and few photographs. At the time, Sue Ann Arnall was appealing a court decision that awarded her a $1 billion divorce settlement from Harold Hamm—the second largest in U.S. history—arguing that the amount undervalued her share of marital assets. It is unclear whether both her parents attended the ceremony; however, social media activity between Jane and her mother suggests Sue Ann may have been present. Jane works for the Republican Party of Los Angeles County, and the couple honeymooned at the Rosewood Mayakoba resort in Playa del Carmen, Mexico. In addition to Jane, Arnall and Hamm have another daughter, Hilary, who attends Dartmouth College. Arnall's appeal cites 78 alleged errors in the court's ruling, claiming her contributions to Continental Resources and the couple’s assets were undervalued. Continental Resources, founded by Harold Hamm in 1967, increased in value from approximately $50 million in 1988 (the year they married) to about $20 billion. As part of the settlement, Arnall received several properties, including three homes in Oklahoma and a ranch in Carmel, California, while Hamm retained other properties. The couple did not have a prenuptial agreement, which influenced the division of assets. Hamm’s majority stake in Continental Resources was ruled as his separate property, so he kept ownership. Arnall argues that only a small percentage (6%) of the $14 billion growth in Continental's value during their marriage was considered marital property by the court—a calculation she and her legal team dispute. Harold Hamm’s fortune was valued at around $20 billion as recently as August, but decreased to approximately $9 billion due to a drop in oil prices. Sue Ann Arnall filed for divorce in March 2013, alleging infidelity. Harold Hamm rose from modest beginnings, growing up as one of 13 children to a sharecropper, working a variety of jobs before founding Continental Resources. He became active in politics in 2012, serving as an energy adviser to Mitt Romney’s presidential campaign and making significant campaign contributions. In 2012, Hamm was named to the Time 100 list; he and Arnall attended the ceremony together in New York. The legal dispute is expected to remain unresolved for up to two years as the appeal continues.
translated_content: Jane Hamm, datter af oliechefen Harold Hamm og hans ekskone Sue Ann Arnall, blev gift med Thomas Lerum ved en privat ceremoni på Grand Del Mar resortet i San Diego, Californien, mens hendes forældre gennemgik deres skilsmissesag. Ceremonien fandt sted den 4. oktober og blev holdt meget diskret, med minimal mediedækning og få fotografier. På det tidspunkt ankede Sue Ann Arnall en dom, der tildelte hende en skilsmisseopgørelse på 1 milliard dollars fra Harold Hamm—den næststørste i USA’s historie—idet hun mente, at beløbet undervurderede hendes andel af fællesformuen. Det er uklart, om begge hendes forældre deltog i ceremonien, men aktivitet på sociale medier mellem Jane og hendes mor antyder, at Sue Ann muligvis var til stede. Jane arbejder for Det Republikanske Parti i Los Angeles County, og parret holdt bryllupsrejse på Rosewood Mayakoba resortet i Playa del Carmen, Mexico. Udover Jane har Arnall og Hamm også en anden datter, Hilary, som går på Dartmouth College. Arnalls anke nævner 78 påståede fejl i rettens afgørelse og hævder, at hendes bidrag til Continental Resources og parrets værdier blev undervurderet. Continental Resources, grundlagt af Harold Hamm i 1967, voksede i værdi fra cirka 50 millioner dollars i 1988 (året hvor de blev gift) til omkring 20 milliarder dollars. Som en del af opgørelsen modtog Arnall flere ejendomme, heriblandt tre huse i Oklahoma og en ranch i Carmel, Californien, mens Hamm beholdt andre ejendomme. Parret havde ikke en ægtepagt, hvilket påvirkede fordelingen af værdierne. Hamms majoritetsandel i Continental Resources blev betragtet som hans separate ejendom, så han beholdt ejerskabet. Arnall hævder, at kun en lille procentdel (6%) af de 14 milliarder dollars værdistigning i Continentals aktier under ægteskabet blev regnet som ægteskabelig formue—en beregning hun og hendes advokater bestrider. Harold Hamms formue blev så sent som i august vurderet til ca. 20 milliarder dollars, men faldt til omkring 9 milliarder dollars på grund af faldende oliepriser. Sue Ann Arnall indgav skilsmisse i marts 2013 med henvisning til utroskab. Harold Hamm voksede op under beskedne kår som en af tretten børn af en forpagter og havde mange forskellige jobs, inden han grundlagde Continental Resources. Han blev aktiv i politik i 2012, hvor han var energirådgiver for Mitt Romneys præsidentkampagne og bidrog med betydelige beløb til kampagnen. I 2012 blev Hamm optaget på Time 100-listen, og han og Arnall deltog sammen ved ceremonien i New York. Den juridiske strid forventes at forblive uafklaret i op til to år, mens ankeforløbet fortsætter.

article_content: Netanyahu’s Indecisive, Distrustful Leadership Raises Concerns During Gaza War, Experts Say Gal Hirsch, who lacks experience in hostage negotiations and left the Israeli military in 2006 after criticism over his role in the Lebanon war against Hezbollah, was appointed by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to lead efforts to release captives taken by Hamas after its October 7 attack. Political psychologist Saul Kimhi suggests that Netanyahu selects wartime administration members based on personal loyalty rather than qualifications. Hirsch is a Likud party member and, like Netanyahu, has faced corruption charges. Kimhi, a Tel Aviv University professor who has studied Netanyahu for nearly twenty-five years, identified troubling behavioral patterns in Netanyahu as early as 1999—describing him as narcissistic, entitled, and paranoid, and as someone who reacts poorly under stress. Kimhi's 2017 follow-up found these traits had intensified. As Netanyahu leads Israel’s response in Gaza, these personal traits may greatly influence his decisions. Kimhi and others believe Netanyahu is often indecisive and struggles with hard choices. Kimhi told Al Jazeera, 'He is not a resilient person at all.' Before Hirsch's appointment on October 8, the hostage negotiator role had been unfilled for over a year. After Hamas took over 200 Israelis captive, only a few have been released, highlighting Netanyahu's tendency for last-minute decisions. Despite criticism, Netanyahu’s political resilience is notable. A 2021 study by Professor Walid ‘Abd al-Hay described Netanyahu as charismatic, with a strong memory and high analytical skills. Such qualities have helped him sustain a long political career, becoming Israel’s longest-serving prime minister since 1996. Many far-right or controversial members have been included in his cabinets, such as National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir, Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich, and Interior and Health Minister Aryeh Deri, leading critics to say Netanyahu prioritizes political survival above national interests. Although Netanyahu has stated support for a two-state solution, analysts argue he consistently undermines it, insisting on restrictions for a future Palestinian state and overseeing the expansion of Israeli settlements. Palestinian deaths in the occupied West Bank have reached record highs even before October 7, with over 150 killed in 2023, including 38 children, and more than 100 additional deaths since October 7. Netanyahu’s approach to negotiations and settlement policy is deeply influenced by his father Benzion Netanyahu’s Revisionist Zionist ideology, which envisions Israel’s borders extending beyond their current reach. Netanyahu’s political base has shifted in recent years with growing opposition, particularly over his efforts at judicial reform. He faces charges of corruption, fraud, and breach of trust, and public opinion often blames him for failing to prevent the October 7 attack, which resulted in about 1,400 deaths and roughly 200 hostages. Some analysts believe Netanyahu may seek to prolong the conflict in Gaza, since it is unusual to replace leadership during wartime. The current military campaign has resulted in more than 8,500 Palestinian deaths, including over 3,000 children, in recent weeks. Analysts note that Netanyahu appears focused on remaining in power above all. Kimhi concludes, 'The Israeli public needs a real leader who can unite people.' Additional reporting by Nils Adler.
translated_content: Netanyahus ubeslutsomme og mistroiske lederskab vækker bekymring under Gaza-krigen, siger eksperter. Gal Hirsch, der ikke har erfaring med gidselforhandlinger og forlod det israelske militær i 2006 efter kritik af hans rolle i Libanon-krigen mod Hezbollah, blev udnævnt af premierminister Benjamin Netanyahu til at lede indsatsen for at få gidsler frigivet efter Hamas' angreb den 7. oktober. Den politiske psykolog Saul Kimhi vurderer, at Netanyahu vælger medlemmer af sin krigsadministration ud fra personlig loyalitet frem for kvalifikationer. Hirsch er medlem af Likud-partiet og har, ligesom Netanyahu, mødt korruptionsanklager. Kimhi, professor ved Tel Aviv Universitet, som har studeret Netanyahu i næsten femogtyve år, identificerede bekymrende adfærdsmønstre allerede i 1999 – han beskrev ham som narcissistisk, berettiget og paranoid, og som en, der reagerer dårligt under pres. Kimhis opfølgning i 2017 fandt, at disse træk var blevet stærkere. Mens Netanyahu står i spidsen for Israels respons i Gaza, kan disse personlige egenskaber få stor betydning for hans beslutninger. Kimhi og andre mener, at Netanyahu ofte er ubeslutsom og finder det svært at træffe svære beslutninger. Kimhi sagde til Al Jazeera: 'Han er slet ikke en modstandsdygtig person.' Inden Hirschs udnævnelse den 8. oktober havde posten som gidselforhandler været ubesat i over et år. Efter at Hamas tog over 200 israelere som gidsler, er kun få blevet løsladt. Det fremhæver Netanyahus tendens til at træffe vigtige beslutninger i sidste øjeblik. Trods kritik er Netanyahus politiske overlevelsesinstinkt bemærkelsesværdigt. En undersøgelse fra 2021 af professor Walid 'Abd al-Hay beskrev Netanyahu som karismatisk, med god hukommelse og høje analytiske evner. Disse egenskaber har hjulpet ham til at få en lang karriere som Israels længstsiddende premierminister siden 1996. Hans regeringer har ofte inkluderet højreradikale eller kontroversielle medlemmer som Itamar Ben-Gvir, Bezalel Smotrich og Aryeh Deri, hvilket har ført til kritik for at fokusere på sin egen politiske overlevelse over nationale interesser. Selvom Netanyahu har tilkendegivet støtte til en tostatsløsning, mener analytikere, at han løbende undergraver den, blandt andet ved at insistere på restriktioner for en fremtidig palæstinensisk stats militære magt og godkende udvidelse af bosættelser. Palæstinensiske dødstal på Vestbredden var allerede rekordhøje før 7. oktober, med over 150 dræbte i 2023, heraf 38 børn, og mere end 100 flere siden denne dato. Netanyahus syn på forhandlinger og bosættelsespolitik er stærkt præget af faren Benzion Netanyahus revisionistisk-zionistiske ideologi, der forestiller sig Israels grænser bredere end dem i dag. Netanyahus vælgerbase har ændret sig de seneste år med øget modstand mod især hans retsreformer. Han står tiltalt for korruption, bedrageri og tillidsbrud, og mange i offentligheden giver ham skylden for ikke at have forhindret angrebet den 7. oktober, hvor cirka 1.400 mennesker blev dræbt og omkring 200 taget som gidsler. Nogle analytikere mener, at Netanyahu kan se en fordel i at forlænge konflikten, da det sjældent sker, at ledere udskiftes under krig. Den nuværende offensiv har ført til over 8.500 palæstinensiske dødsfald, heraf over 3.000 børn, på få uger. Analytikere bemærker, at Netanyahu fremstår mest optaget af at bevare magten. Kimhi konkluderer: 'Det israelske folk har brug for en rigtig leder, der kan samle folket.' Yderligere rapportering: Nils Adler.

An inmate in an Israeli prison, reportedly connected to Mossad, was found dead by hanging in the shower of his high-security cell on December 15, 2010. He died from asphyxiation, having used a bedsheet tied to a bathroom window. The man, referred to as 'Prisoner X,' was identified by the Australian Broadcasting Corporation (ABC) as Ben Zygier, an Australian-Israeli citizen alleged to have worked with Mossad. The details emerged after Israel partially lifted a gag order, releasing court documents. His cell in Ayalon Prison was a maximum-security unit equipped with CCTV and originally built for Yigal Amir, the convicted assassin of former Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin.

Judge Daphna Blatman Kedrai, who authored a report on the death, found alleged failings in the Israel Prison Service. 'Orders to prevent suicide were given and the personnel responsible were aware, but the orders were not followed, allowing a 'window of opportunity' for the deceased to commit suicide,' she wrote.

Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu argued that revealing security and intelligence operations risked Israel's national safety, stating, 'We are not like all other countries. We are more threatened, more challenged, and therefore we have to ensure the proper activity of our security forces.'

Prisoner X’s identity and details of his imprisonment were initially kept secret. On Tuesday, ABC identified him as Ben Zygier, 34, a dual citizen, and reported that he had allegedly worked for Mossad and the Australian Security Intelligence Organisation (ASIO). ABC claimed Zygier had disclosed information about various Mossad operations, including a secret mission in Italy, and suggested he was arrested after his links to Australia were uncovered.

Netanyahu’s office published a statement denying that 'Prisoner X' had any connection with Australian security or organizational services, and emphasized that cooperation between Israeli and Australian agencies remains strong and transparent.

Han døde af kvælning, efter at have brugt et lagen bundet til et vindue på badeværelset. Manden, omtalt som 'Fange X', blev identificeret af Australian Broadcasting Corporation (ABC) som Ben Zygier, en australsk-israelsk statsborger, der menes at have arbejdet for Mossad. Detaljerne kom frem, efter at Israel delvist ophævede et navneforbud og frigav retsdokumenter. Hans celle i Ayalon-fængslet var en højsikkerhedsenhed med overvågningskameraer og oprindeligt bygget til Yigal Amir, den dømte morder af den tidligere premierminister Yitzhak Rabin.

Dommer Daphna Blatman Kedrai, der stod bag rapporten om dødsfaldet, konstaterede angivelige fejl i det israelske fængselsvæsen. 'Der blev givet ordrer om at forhindre selvmord, og det ansvarlige personale var klar over dem, men ordrerne blev ikke fulgt, hvilket gav den afdøde en 'mulighed' for at begå selvmord,' skrev hun.

Vi er mere truet, mere udfordret, og derfor skal vi sikre, at vores sikkerhedsstyrker kan arbejde ordentligt.'

Fange X’s identitet og oplysninger om hans fængsling blev oprindeligt holdt hemmelige. Tirsdag identificerede ABC ham som Ben Zygier, 34 år, dobbelt statsborger, og rapporterede, at han angiveligt havde arbejdet for Mossad og den australske efterretningstjeneste ASIO. ABC hævdede, at Zygier havde givet oplysninger om flere Mossad-operationer, herunder en hemmelig mission i Italien, og at han blev arresteret, efter hans forbindelser til Australien blev afsløret.

Netanyahus kontor udsendte en erklæring, der afviste, at 'Fange X' havde nogen forbindelse til australske sikkerheds- eller organisationstjenester og understregede, at samarbejdet mellem israelske og australske myndigheder forbliver stærkt og gennemsigtigt.

article_content: Streaming platforms have witnessed a significant comeback for the mystery genre, highlighted by standout series like Poker Face, The Afterparty, and Only Murders in the Building. These shows offer a fresh alternative to both blockbuster dramas and reality TV. Poker Face, directed by Rian Johnson, stars Natasha Lyonne as Charlie, a modern sleuth with the unique skill of detecting lies. Each episode is a self-contained tale set in a new town, with Charlie inevitably caught in a local murder mystery. The format recalls classic whodunits while catering to contemporary viewers, and Lyonne's performance is a major draw. The series also develops an overarching plot, with a second season already confirmed. Apple TV Plus’s The Afterparty blends comedy and mystery. The story unfolds after a reunion party turns deadly, with every episode showcasing a different attendee’s account in a new movie genre, ranging from action-packed to musical. The recently concluded second season moves the action to a wedding, introduces new faces, and expands its playful parodies. Only Murders in the Building, on Hulu, follows three unlikely detectives—portrayed by Selena Gomez, Steve Martin, and Martin Short—who investigate murders in their apartment while producing a true-crime podcast. In its third season, a murder disrupts a new Broadway play, enlivened by guest stars like Meryl Streep and Paul Rudd. The series sustains its humor and inventiveness. Each of these series uses creativity and a blend of genres to reinvigorate mystery storytelling on streaming services, echoing the appeal of timeless shows like Murder, She Wrote and Columbo.

Poker Face, instrueret af Rian Johnson, har Natasha Lyonne i rollen som Charlie – en moderne detektiv med den særlige evne at afsløre løgne. Hvert afsnit byder på en ny historie i en ny by, hvor Charlie uundgåeligt bliver involveret i et mordmysterie. Der er også en overordnet historie, og en anden sæson er allerede på vej. The Afterparty på Apple TV Plus forener komedie og mystik. Handlingen udvikler sig, efter en genforeningsfest ender med et mord, og hvert afsnit fortælles fra en ny gæsts perspektiv i en anderledes filmgenre – alt fra action til musical. Den netop afsluttede anden sæson foregår til et bryllup, præsenterer nye karakterer og endnu flere sjove parodier. Disse serier kombinerer kreativitet og genrekrydser for at gentænke mysteriefortælling på streamingtjenester, og henter inspiration fra tidløse klassikere som Murder, She Wrote og Columbo.

However, some conspiracy theorists, particularly those associated with QAnon, claim without evidence that the alert will activate COVID-19 vaccines and turn people into 'zombies.' These unfounded theories have spread across major social media platforms, including X (formerly Twitter), and on QAnon-focused sites. As with previous baseless predictions, October 4 is being promoted as another ‘big date’—though similar dates have passed without incident. In reality, there is no cause for concern; the alert is simply a standard test.

article_content: Port-au-Prince, Haiti (CNN) – After several intense days in Haiti, Gary Garner, a physician from Salt Lake City, Utah, found himself emotionally and physically drained. Over the past five days, he had cared for dying patients and performed more amputations than he could recall. On Friday, exhausted and searching for relief, he stood on the tarmac at Port-au-Prince airport, hoping to return to his regular life. "We're going to go home and cry," Garner admitted quietly, his emotions evident as he started to cry right there. Similarly, pediatrician Elizabeth Bellino from New Orleans, Louisiana, also felt overwhelmed. While volunteering at the University of Miami field hospital, she broke down in her car after another hospital refused her offers of food, water, or permission to bring patients back for treatment. "It's so frustrating. Why would they do that?" Bellino expressed. In Haiti, crying is common among caregivers facing hardship. Many expect even more tears once they return home, but for now, their work continues. At the hospital near the Toussaint L'Ouverture International Airport, Bellino faced a growing number of patients, especially after a 5.9-magnitude aftershock earlier in the week. Despite his exhaustion, Garner kept tending to incoming patients, assisted by three private helicopters owned by Utah businessman Jeremy Johnson. Johnson had offered to transport the medical team to Haiti in the aftermath of last week's devastating 7.0-magnitude earthquake. Garner joined the team at the last minute, which was organized by Utah financial adviser Craig Nelson. Nelson, along with fellow Utah physicians Steve Hansen and Chuck Peterson, had previously served in Haiti on a Mormon mission two decades earlier. Hearing about the earthquake's impact, Nelson gathered the group to help. The team arrived in Leogane, a coastal city about 20 miles west of Port-au-Prince and near the earthquake’s epicenter, where reports indicated up to 90 percent of buildings were damaged or destroyed. The U.S. doctors were among the first on site and later worked alongside medical teams from Cuba, Germany, Canada, and others. In Leogane, collaboration was smooth. "It was like the United Nations of medical work," Nelson described. Garner added, "There were no nationalities." Together, they treated around 300 patients. Due to scarce supplies, treatment was basic. For instance, one doctor used a Leatherman tool for an amputation, and a bike rack served as a makeshift orthopedic splint. The workdays were long, with little sleep. "We worked until our headlamps ran out of batteries, then people brought us replacements," Garner said. "You can sleep when you're dead. I’ll have plenty of time to rest this weekend—and probably a good cry or two."
translated_content: Port-au-Prince, Haiti (CNN) – Efter flere intense dage i Haiti var Gary Garner, en læge fra Salt Lake City, Utah, både følelsesmæssigt og fysisk udmattet. I løbet af de sidste fem dage havde han passet døende patienter og foretaget flere amputationer, end han kunne huske. Fredag stod han udmattet på landingsbanen ved Port-au-Prince lufthavn og håbede på at vende tilbage til en mere normal hverdag. "Vi tager hjem og græder," indrømmede Garner stille, mens følelserne kom til udtryk, da han begyndte at græde med det samme. Børnelægen Elizabeth Bellino fra New Orleans, Louisiana, følte sig også overvældet. Hun arbejdede som frivillig på University of Miamis felthospital og brød sammen i sin bil, efter at et andet hospital havde afslået hendes tilbud om mad, vand eller at tage patienter med til behandling. "Det er så frustrerende. Hvorfor gør de det?" sagde Bellino. Det er almindeligt, at omsorgspersoner græder i Haiti under de svære forhold. Mange forventer flere tårer, når de vender hjem, men indtil da fortsætter arbejdet. På hospitalet ved Toussaint L'Ouverture Internationale Lufthavn oplevede Bellino et stigende pres fra patienter, især efter et efterskælv på 5,9 tidligere på ugen. Trods udmattelse fortsatte Garner med at tage sig af nye patienter, hjulpet af tre private helikoptere ejet af erhvervsmanden Jeremy Johnson fra Utah. Johnson tilbød at transportere det medicinske team til Haiti efter det ødelæggende jordskælv på 7,0 i sidste uge. Garner deltog på holdet i sidste øjeblik, organiseret af finansrådgiver Craig Nelson fra Utah. Nelson og hans kolleger, lægerne Steve Hansen og Chuck Peterson, havde tidligere været på mission i Haiti for tyve år siden. Da Nelson hørte om jordskælvet, samlede han gruppen for at hjælpe. Holdet ankom til Leogane, en kystby omkring 30 km vest for Port-au-Prince tæt på jordskælvets epicenter, hvor op til 90 procent af bygningerne ifølge rapporter var beskadiget eller ødelagt. De amerikanske læger var blandt de første på stedet og samarbejdede siden med teams fra bl.a. Cuba, Tyskland og Canada. Samarbejdet gik gnidningsfrit i Leogane. "Det var som lægernes FN," sagde Nelson. Garner tilføjede: "Der var ingen nationaliteter." Samlet behandlede de omkring 300 patienter. På grund af mangel på udstyr var behandlingen ofte enkel. En læge brugte eksempelvis et multiværktøj til amputation og et cykelstativ som improviseret skinne. Arbejdsdagene var lange, og søvn blev sjælden. "Vi arbejdede, indtil vores pandelamper løb tør for batteri, så kom der folk med flere," sagde Garner. "Man kan sove, når man er død. Jeg får tid til at hvile mig i weekenden—og garanteret også græde en enkelt gang eller to."

For years, high school graduates were urged to pursue traditional college degrees instead of vocational training, but that mindset is beginning to shift among Gen Z. Today, more young adults are recognizing the appeal and practical advantages of careers in the skilled trades.

Frequent stories of slow and scarce repair services reflect a larger problem: the U.S. construction sector, for example, is currently short over half a million skilled workers. This shortage has been deepened as many experienced tradespeople retire, while not enough younger individuals are stepping in to fill their shoes.

A recent report from Jobber, titled “Gen Z and the Uncertain Future of the Trades,” brings attention to how members of Gen Z perceive blue-collar jobs and notes that a lack of incoming talent could disrupt essential services. As Sam Pillar, Jobber’s CEO, points out, society relies on skilled professionals to maintain homes, businesses, and infrastructure, and ignoring their importance is risky.

One revealing survey from Jobber polled 1,000 Americans aged 18–20. Findings showed that most parents push their kids toward college (79%), while just 5% specifically encourage vocational education. Unsurprisingly, 74% of respondents said there’s a stigma around choosing a trade. Still, trades offer real upsides: competitive salaries, faster career starts, and greater resistance to economic disruptions and AI.

Sam Pillar notes that this bias is harmful. "The misconception keeps students from great careers, makes life harder for homeowners, and hurts the economy," he explains. Trades are often less expensive to enter—vocational schools cost between about $3,800 and $15,500 per year, compared to nearly $20,000 for a four-year college (excluding living expenses). Many trades even pay while you learn, and about 75% of Gen Z say they’re interested in paid, hands-on training.

Expanding the definition of higher education may help parents and teens see the full range of available options. The report also debunks the myth that only certain trades are lucrative; industries like landscaping, plumbing, or cleaning often generate profits of $1 million or more annually, according to Jobber’s data. For instance, Jason Shipway built his cleaning company from scratch, turning $300 into $50,000 the first year and reaching around $700,000 in his third—projected to break one million soon.

Another factor attracting Gen Z? Job security. With more automation and AI impacting desk jobs, 56% of young people surveyed now view blue-collar roles as safer from automation than traditional office work. The threat of AI is also making them rethink taking on student debt for a college degree.

Changing how skilled trades are viewed isn’t just up to employers—they can help by partnering with schools, offering apprenticeships, and reaching out to young talent. But parents, educators, and communities also need to highlight these careers and break down outdated stigmas. Recognizing the essential role of tradespeople can help shape a workforce ready to meet tomorrow’s needs, benefiting individuals and society alike.

I årevis er unge blevet opfordret til at tage en traditionel universitetsuddannelse i stedet for en erhvervsuddannelse, men med tiden ændrer det sig hos Generation Z. Flere og flere unge begynder at se de mange fordele og muligheder i faglærte erhverv.

Oplevelser med langsomme eller manglende håndværkere viser et større problem: For eksempel mangler den amerikanske byggebranche over en halv million faglærte medarbejdere. Denne mangel forværres, i takt med at erfarne håndværkere går på pension, uden at nok unge tager over.

En ny rapport fra Jobber – "Gen Z og den usikre fremtid for faglærte erhverv" – retter fokus på unge voksnes syn på blåt arbejde og advarer om, at manglende tilgang af unge kan bringe vigtige samfundsopgaver i fare. Sam Pillar, direktør for Jobber, understreger, at vi er afhængige af fagfolk til at holde samfundet kørende, og at det har konsekvenser, hvis vi ikke anerkender deres værdi.

En undersøgelse blandt 1.000 amerikanere mellem 18 og 20 år viste, at 79% af forældrene opfordrede dem til at gå universitetet, mens blot 5% anbefalede erhvervsuddannelse. Ikke mærkeligt, at 74% mener, at der er et stigma omkring at vælge en erhvervsuddannelse. Stadigvæk rummer fagene fordele: god løn, hurtig adgang til jobbet og større jobsikkerhed – også i en fremtid med AI.

Pillar kalder denne stigmatisering for skadelig og påpeger, at fordommene holder unge væk fra gode job, skader boligejere og har negative konsekvenser for økonomien. At gå erhvervsvejen er ofte billigere: Uddannelserne koster typisk mellem 3.800 og 15.500 dollars om året, mens et fireårigt universitet koster nær de 20.000 dollars (uden leveomkostninger). Mange erhvervsuddannelser indebærer løn undervejs, og omkring tre fjerdedele af Gen Z viser interesse for betalt oplæring.

Hvis vi udvider opfattelsen af, hvad "videregående uddannelse" er, kan unge og forældre lettere se alle valgmuligheder. Rapporten afviser desuden, at det kun er visse fag, der er lønsomme. Ifølge Jobbers tal indbringer fx virksomheder inden for gartneri, rengøring og VVS ofte over én million dollars årligt. Eksempelvis har Jason Shipway startet sit rengøringsfirma med 300 dollars, tjente 50.000 dollars det første år og nåede 700.000 dollars det tredje år – og sigter mod millionen i omsætning.

Job-tryghed tiltrækker også Gen Z. Med AI og automatisering, der presser traditionelle kontorjobs, vurderer 56% af unge, at håndværksfagene er mere sikre. Flere overvejer derfor, om det giver mening at tage studiegæld for en universitetsuddannelse.

Det kræver et fælles løft at ændre synet på faglærte; arbejdsgivere kan hjælpe med praktikpladser og samarbejde med skoler, men også forældre, lærere og lokalsamfund skal bakke op og aflive gamle fordomme. Når vi anerkender nødvendigheden af fagfolk, kan vi sammen bygge en arbejdsstyrke, der er rustet til fremtiden – til gavn for både den enkelte og samfundet.
post_content: Gen Z is breaking the mold—more young people are turning to skilled trades for secure, well-paid careers without mountains of student debt. Blue-collar jobs = high earning, less AI threat, real impact! Let’s smash the old stigmas! 💪🔧 #SkilledTrades #GenZ #RethinkCareers

The Nigeria Sovereign Investment Authority (NSIA) has launched a $500 million Renewables Investment Platform for Limitless Energy (RIPLE), designed to develop renewable energy projects throughout Nigeria’s value chain. According to NSIA, RIPLE aims to expand energy access, boost energy efficiency, and enhance energy security across the country.

NSIA is an independent investment institution established by an Act of Parliament to manage funds exceeding Nigeria’s budgeted hydrocarbon revenues. The agency operates three main funds: the Stabilization Fund, the Future Generation Fund, and the Nigeria Infrastructure Fund.

In a statement released in Abuja on Sunday, NSIA announced the RIPLE launch alongside the signing of a strategic partnership agreement with the International Finance Corporation (IFC). This partnership is set to further transform Nigeria’s energy sector, reflecting a joint commitment to advancing renewable energy development.

The initiative’s pilot project is located in the Tokarawa Industrial Hub, Kano State, and involves creating a generation and distribution system to supply 70 megawatts of unsuppressed energy demand. This system will serve industrial activities, commercial enterprises, and residential customers, covering approximately 9,000 connections.

Yusuf Umar, Programme Manager for RIPLE, expressed excitement about the collaboration, stating, “We are excited to partner with the International Finance Corporation to advance the transition to energy-efficient solutions in Nigeria.”

Ifølge NSIA sigter RIPLE mod at udvide adgangen til energi, øge energieffektiviteten og styrke energisikkerheden i landet.

NSIA er en uafhængig investeringsinstitution, etableret ved en lov vedtaget af parlamentet til at forvalte midler, der overstiger Nigerias budgetterede indtægter fra fossile brændstoffer. Agenturet administrerer tre hovedfonde: Stabiliseringsfonden, Fremtidsgenerationsfonden og Nigerias Infrastrukturfond.

I en erklæring udsendt i Abuja søndag meddelte NSIA lanceringen af RIPLE sammen med underskrivelsen af en strategisk partnerskabsaftale med International Finance Corporation (IFC). Yusuf Umar, programchef for RIPLE, udtrykte sin begejstring for samarbejdet og udtalte: "Vi er glade for at samarbejde med International Finance Corporation om at fremme overgangen til energieffektive løsninger i Nigeria."

article_content: A 73-year-old man has died after being struck by a tree he was attempting to cut down in Luton, Bedfordshire. The incident took place in a wooded spot near Leagrave Park, in an area called Rotten Corner, where he had reportedly been gathering firewood. Emergency services, including police and paramedics, responded to a call just after 1pm, but the man was pronounced dead at the scene. According to Bedfordshire Police, there are no suspicious circumstances surrounding the death and the man's family has been notified. The East of England Ambulance Service dispatched an ambulance and rapid response unit, but confirmed that the man had already passed away before help arrived. The accident happened in the patch of woodland separating Marsh Farm and Sundon Park estates next to Leagrave Park, which falls under Luton Borough Council's care. The council announced that an investigation is underway and will be referred to the Health and Safety Executive. A spokesperson noted that there had been no prior concerns reported about the surrounding woodlands, and the area was inspected before the park reopened to the public earlier today.
translated_content: En 73-årig mand er død efter at være blevet ramt af et træ, han forsøgte at fælde i Luton, Bedfordshire. Hændelsen skete i et skovområde nær Leagrave Park, i et område kendt som Rotten Corner, hvor han angiveligt havde samlet brænde. Politi og ambulancer rykkede ud kort efter kl. 13, men manden blev erklæret død på stedet. Ifølge Bedfordshire Police er der ingen mistænkelige omstændigheder omkring dødsfaldet, og mandens familie er blevet informeret. East of England Ambulance Service sendte både en ambulance og en akutbil, men kunne bekræfte, at manden allerede var afgået ved døden, da hjælpen nåede frem. Ulykken fandt sted i skovområdet mellem boligområderne Marsh Farm og Sundon Park ved siden af Leagrave Park, som administreres af Luton Borough Council. Kommunen har oplyst, at der er indledt en undersøgelse, som vil blive overdraget til Arbejdstilsynet. En talsmand understregede, at der ikke tidligere har været rapporteret problemer med skovområdet, og at området blev kontrolleret, inden parken igen blev åbnet for offentligheden tidligere i dag.

An Israeli airstrike on a building adjacent to Gaza’s historic Church of Saint Porphyrius, belonging to the Greek Orthodox Patriarchate of Jerusalem, has caused extensive damage to the church. According to the Patriarchate, the destroyed building was affiliated with the church and collapsed following the explosion. Approximately 500 people had sought shelter in the church compound after the recent outbreak of violence. The late-night airstrike on Thursday, October 19, left many injured and at least 16 dead. The Greek Orthodox Patriarchate strongly condemned the attack, calling it a war crime. 

A statement from the Patriarchate emphasized: “Targeting churches and their affiliated institutions, as well as the shelters they provide for innocent citizens—especially children and women who lost their homes as a result of Israeli bombing of residential areas during the past thirteen days—constitutes a war crime that cannot be ignored.”

Located in Gaza’s Old City’s Zaytun Quarter, the Church of Saint Porphyrius was first consecrated around 425 CE and houses the tomb of its namesake saint. Saint Porphyrius, born in Thessaloniki in 347 CE, served as bishop of Gaza from 395 to 420 CE. His life is recorded in the ‘Vita Porphyrii,’ written by Mark the Deacon, describing his efforts to Christianize Gaza and authorize the destruction of pagan temples, with their stones reused for paving streets, thanks to support from Emperor Arcadius. 

The first church was erected less than five years after Porphyrius’s death. It became a mosque following the Islamic conquest in the 7th century CE, then was reclaimed and rebuilt in the 12th century by Crusaders; the latest major renovations occurred in 1856. Architecturally, it shares features with the Great Mosque of Gaza, formerly the Cathedral of Saint John the Baptist. Today, it remains one of three churches in Gaza, including the Holy Family Catholic Church and Gaza Baptist Church.

There are about 1,000 Christians in Gaza, mostly Greek Orthodox, amid a population of 2.3 million. The church is a central institution for Gaza’s Christian community and has long provided sanctuary for both Christians and Muslims. Both faiths have sought refuge there during recent hostilities.

During the 2014 Israeli Defense Forces’ campaign in Gaza, which coincided with Ramadan, the church compound was also damaged, with tanks hitting water installations and a neighboring church-owned house. Despite these incidents, the church’s courtyard remained a place for daily prayers, demonstrating its ongoing role as a sanctuary in times of conflict.

Et israelsk luftangreb mod en bygning ved siden af Gazas historiske Sankt Porfyrios Kirke, der tilhører det græsk-ortodokse patriarkat i Jerusalem, har påført kirken omfattende skader. Ifølge patriarkatet var den ødelagte bygning tilknyttet kirken og kollapsede efter eksplosionen. Omkring 500 personer havde søgt tilflugt i kirkekomplekset efter den seneste voldsbølge. Luftangrebet, der fandt sted sent torsdag den 19. oktober, resulterede i mange sårede og mindst 16 dræbte. Det græsk-ortodokse patriarkat fordømte angrebet kraftigt og kaldte det en krigsforbrydelse.

I en erklæring pointerede patriarkatet: “At ramme kirker og deres tilknyttede institutioner, samt de ly de tilbyder uskyldige borgere—særligt børn og kvinder, der har mistet deres hjem på grund af israelske bombninger af boligområder de seneste tretten dage—udgør en krigsforbrydelse, der ikke kan ignoreres.”

Sankt Porfyrios Kirke, der ligger i Zaytun-kvarteret i Gazas gamle by, blev indviet ca. år 425 e.Kr. og har graven for sin navnehelgen. Sankt Porfyrios, født i Thessaloniki i 347 e.Kr., var biskop i Gaza fra 395 til sin død i 420 e.Kr. Hans liv beskrives kun i 'Vita Porphyrii', skrevet af Mark Deacon, hvor hans arbejde med at kristne Gaza og destruere hedenske templer fremhæves. Med støtte fra kejser Arcadius blev stenene fra de ødelagte templer genbrugt til byens gader.

Den oprindelige kirke blev opført kort efter Porfyrios' død, men blev omdannet til en moské efter den islamiske erobring i det 7. århundrede e.Kr. Siden blev kirken generobret og genopbygget af korsfarerne i 1100-tallet, og gennemgik sidst større renoveringer i 1856. Kirken minder arkitektonisk om Gazas store moské, som tidligere var Johannes Døberens Katedral. I dag er Sankt Porfyrios Kirke en af tre aktive kirker i Gaza, sammen med Hellige Familie Kirke og Gaza Baptistkirke.

Omkring 1.000 kristne, hovedsageligt græsk-ortodokse, bor i Gaza blandt en befolkning på 2,3 millioner. Kirken er et vigtigt samlingssted for Gazas kristne og har længe fungeret som tilflugtssted for både kristne og muslimer. Under de seneste uroligheder har begge trosretninger søgt ly i kirken.

Under Israels militæroperation i Gaza i 2014, som fandt sted under ramadanen, blev kirkekomplekset igen beskadiget—vandinstallationer og et nærliggende hus ejet af kirken blev ramt af kampvogne. På trods af dette forblev kirkegården et sted for daglige bønner og har fortsat sin rolle som fristed, selv i konfliktens mørke.

Apple is reportedly preparing significant upgrades for the iPhone 16 Pro series cameras, according to a new report from Economic Daily News in Taiwan. Apple may introduce advanced molded glass lenses, potentially resulting in a lighter and thinner device while improving optical zoom capability. Presently, the iPhone 15 Pro Max features a tetraprism telephoto lens with 5x optical zoom (120mm focal length), while the iPhone 15 Pro offers 3x optical zoom.

These changes are expected to focus on the telephoto lens, addressing manufacturing challenges and production capacity limits. To accommodate these developments, Apple has begun material preparations about a year in advance, reportedly for the first time. Other brands, including Oppo and Vivo, are exploring molded glass lens technology as well. Apple representatives have visited glass manufacturer Hoya to ensure the lenses can be delivered as needed.

It is rumored that the new molded glass telephoto lens could support a 'super telephoto' feature, potentially offering a 300mm focal length. However, this technology may also increase production costs, with estimates indicating a 10% to 20% price rise for flagship iPhone 16 models.

Additional leaks suggest the iPhone 16 series may introduce an extra, flush-mounted solid-state capacitive button designed primarily for photography. This would require moving the mmWave antenna currently located on the right edge of U.S. models to the opposite edge, making space for the new button. The button is intended to enhance photo capture in landscape orientation and is expected to be unresponsive to gloved touches. The recently introduced Action Button on the iPhone 15 Pro series is not expected to change.

A few years back, Canadian musician Dave Carroll found himself at odds with United Airlines after his guitar was broken during a flight. Rather than fume in private, he channeled his frustration into the catchy video "United Breaks Guitars," which went viral and racked up a million views in only four days. United responded with an offer of compensation, but Carroll, after months of wrangling, declined. For him, it was about more than just reimbursement; he wanted the airline to change how it handled such complaints.

Carroll’s story is one of many instances where consumers have taken their grievances online. What set him apart was his use of humor, music, and storytelling, making for a video that people actually enjoyed watching and sharing. Carroll believes that shouting or complaining online catches some attention, but only something creative can inspire people to join your cause.

Consumer advocate Clark Howard echoes this perspective, suggesting that adding humor to outrage increases impact. Ken and Meredith Williams, an Atlanta couple, put this to the test when their experience with Bank of America dragged out for 78 days while trying to buy their first home. Despite having stable jobs and a clear plan, the process became a bureaucratic nightmare with lost paperwork, unreturned calls, and accumulating fees. One bank employee even quit without handing off their case.

Early in their ordeal, the Williamses began saving emails. When deadlines passed and their patience stretched thin, they got creative: Meredith documented their story on their blog, while Ken wrote and performed a song. Within hours they filmed a video, featuring themselves and their cats, set to a comedic tune from Flight of the Conchords. Although it didn’t go viral, the video drew enough attention from local media that the bank soon reached out, resolving their case within a week.

The couple’s mortgage was a 203(k), a loan designed for renovation projects that typically takes longer to process, sometimes up to 90 days. A Bank of America spokesperson acknowledged the delays and said the Williamses’ case led to tighter procedures.

Carroll’s creativity not only netted him compensation but also led him to travel worldwide sharing his story, run a website to help others (Gripevine.com), and write a book about his experience.

Both Carroll and the Williamses believe that producing a fair, articulate, and creative message is key to capturing attention—whether or not it 'goes viral.' Ultimately, making a public complaint in this way gives frustrated customers some sense of control and can inspire much-needed change. Their advice? Be fair, be original, and if you can, add some music.
translated_content:
For nogle år siden oplevede den canadiske musiker Dave Carroll, at hans guitar blev ødelagt af United Airlines under en flyvetur. I stedet for bare at brokke sig lavede han den fængende video "United Breaks Guitars", som hurtigt fik en million visninger på kun fire dage. United tilbød ham erstatning, men Carroll sagde nej efter måneders tovtrækkeri – for ham handlede det om at ændre flyselskabets tilgang til klager.

Carrolls historie er et eksempel på, hvordan forbrugere kan tage deres frustrationer online. Det særlige ved Carroll var hans brug af humor, musik og fortælling, som gjorde videoen værd at dele. Han mener, at enkel klagesang måske skaber lidt opmærksomhed, men det er kreativitet, der får folk med på vognen.

Forbrugereksperten Clark Howard er enig og siger, at humor sammen med utilfredshed har stor effekt. Ken og Meredith Williams fra Atlanta prøvede det selv, da deres boligkøb nærmest gik i stå i hele 78 dage på grund af rod med Bank of America. På trods af sikre jobs blev det et bureaukratisk mareridt med forsvundne papirer, ubesvarede opkald og nye gebyrer. En bankmedarbejder sagde endda op uden at overgive sagen.

Tidligt besluttede parret at gemme vigtige e-mails. Da deadlines blev misset og tålmodigheden bristede, tænkte de kreativt: Meredith bloggede om oplevelsen, mens Ken skrev og indspillede en sang. Sammen lavede de en sjov video med sig selv og deres katte til en melodi fra Flight of the Conchords. Videoen gik ikke viralt, men fik nok opmærksomhed til, at lokalpressen samlede den op. Banken reagerede hurtigt, og deres sag blev ordnet indenfor en uge.

Parrets lån var et 203(k)-lån til boligrenovering, som ofte tager op mod 90 dage at gennemføre. En talsperson fra Bank of America erkendte forsinkelserne og fortalte, at Williams’ sag førte til strammere procedurer.

Carrolls opfindsomhed gav ham ikke kun tilbud om kompensation, men førte ham også på turné verden over med hans historie. Han har oprettet sitet Gripevine.com for at hjælpe andre og skrevet en bog om sine oplevelser.

Både Carroll og Williams-parret mener, at en fair, gennemtænkt og kreativ tilgang er nøglen – også selvom din sag ikke går viralt. At klage offentligt kan give kontrol og inspirere til forandring. Deres råd? Vær fair, vær kreativ – og tilføj gerne et musikalsk indslag.
post_content: Ever had a big company ignore your problem? Try some creativity! Sometimes going viral isn't even needed – but it sure helps if you have a guitar! #CustomerPower #MakeSomeNoise

article_content: A woman walking her dog was amazed to spot a cloud shaped like an elephant in the sky overhead. Margaret Worrall, a 72-year-old former GP, was strolling along the banks of the River Forth near her home in Aberdour, Scotland, when she saw the unusual cumulus cloud. An avid amateur photographer, Mrs. Worrall had been taking pictures of butterflies among the wildflowers when she noticed the distinctively-shaped cloud. She said, 'Every day I walk my dog along the beach by the Forth. On this day, I was actually photographing butterflies when I looked up and saw this cloud. I had to look twice because one of the clouds looked just like an elephant. Sometimes you think you see shapes in the clouds, but this one was very clear.' 'My house overlooks the water and I've seen some incredible clouds before, but never anything like this. I only use a basic digital camera and although I often edit my photos on the computer, this picture was perfect as it was.' Cumulus clouds are a type of low-level cloud known for their puffy shapes and well-defined edges, forming at altitudes below 6,500 feet and often appearing in clusters.
translated_content: En kvinde, der gik tur med sin hund, blev forbløffet, da hun opdagede en sky, der lignede en elefant på himlen over hende. Margaret Worrall, en 72-årig tidligere praktiserende læge, spadserede langs bredden af floden Forth nær sit hjem i Aberdour, Skotland, da hun så den usædvanlige kumulussky. Som ivrig amatørfotograf havde fru Worrall taget billeder af sommerfugle blandt vilde blomster, da hun så den specielt formede sky. Hun sagde: 'Hver dag går jeg tur med min hund langs stranden ved Forth. Denne dag tog jeg faktisk billeder af sommerfugle, da jeg kiggede op og så denne sky. Jeg måtte kigge to gange, for en af skyerne lignede præcis en elefant. Nogle gange synes man, man ser figurer i skyerne, men denne var meget tydelig.' 'Mit hus har udsigt over vandet, og jeg har set nogle utrolige skyer før, men aldrig noget som dette. Jeg bruger kun et simpelt digitalkamera, og selvom jeg ofte redigerer mine billeder på computeren, var dette billede perfekt, som det var.' Kumulusskyer er en type lavtliggende skyer, kendt for deres bløde former og tydelige kanter, og de dannes i højder under 2.000 meter og optræder ofte i grupper.
post_content: Wow! Margaret Worrall, 72, spotted a cloud shaped exactly like an elephant while snapping butterfly pics by the River Forth in Scotland – talk about perfect timing! 🐘🌥️ #CloudSpotting #NatureSurprise

article_content: A Mexican police officer was dismissed after being filmed engaging in sexual activity with a woman while on duty and in uniform. David Raymundo Vazquez Ucan, 31, lost his job after footage showing the incident—on the hood of a car beside a road in broad daylight—was uploaded online and quickly went viral. The video opens with a woman leaving a house in Merida and approaching the Yucatan State Police officer's patrol vehicle. While Officer Vazquez accompanied the woman to the back of the vehicle, fellow officer Benjamin Gaspar Sanchez remained in the driver's seat and did not intervene. Vazquez was seen interacting with the woman before engaging in explicit acts. Subsequently, he removed his duty belt, including his holster, during the encounter. Both Vazquez and Sanchez faced disciplinary action: Vazquez was fired for his conduct, and Sanchez was reprimanded for not taking action. Their dismissals were formalized following a ceremony in which their unit turned their backs on them as they surrendered their badges. The video, recorded on October 23, made it possible to identify Vazquez through the visible police vehicle number 2037. It is unclear who captured the footage, though there is speculation it may have been a sting operation. The incident and subsequent actions were reported by Union Yucatan and Vanguardia.
translated_content: En mexicansk politibetjent blev fyret, efter han blev filmet i seksuel aktivitet med en kvinde, mens han var på arbejde og i uniform. David Raymundo Vazquez Ucan, 31, mistede sit job, efter at optagelser af hændelsen—på hjelmen af en bil ved vejkanten i fuldt dagslys—blev uploadet online og hurtigt gik viralt. Videoen begynder med, at en kvinde forlader et hus i Merida og går hen til Yucatans delstats politibetjents patruljevogn. Mens betjent Vazquez ledsagede kvinden til bagsiden af køretøjet, forblev kollegaen Benjamin Gaspar Sanchez på førersædet og greb ikke ind. Vazquez ses tale med kvinden, inden de indleder eksplicitte handlinger. Efterfølgende fjernede han sit tjenestebælte, inklusive hylster, under hændelsen. Både Vazquez og Sanchez blev disciplineret: Vazquez blev fyret for sin opførsel, og Sanchez blev irettesat for ikke at gribe ind. Deres afskedigelser blev formaliseret ved en ceremoni, hvor hele deres enhed vendte dem ryggen, mens de afleverede deres politiskilte. Videoen, optaget den 23. oktober, gjorde det muligt at identificere Vazquez via det synlige politibilnummer 2037.
